 385: export const CityWorldRenderer = forwardRef<CityWorldRendererHandle, CityWorldRendererProps>(function CityWorldRenderer(
 386:   { scene, selectedPlaceId, cameraPresetId, debugMode, suppressPlaceLabels = false, onSelectPlace },
 387:   ref,
 388: ) {
 389:   const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
 390:   const appRef = useRef<Application | null>(null);
 391:   const worldRef = useRef<Container | null>(null);
 392:   const sceneRef = useRef(scene);
 393:   const cameraRef = useRef<CameraState>({ x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1, minZoom: 0.6, maxZoom: 1.8 });
 394:   const animatedRef = useRef<AnimatedTarget[]>([]);
 395:   const movedRef = useRef(false);
 396:   const dragRef = useRef<{ active: boolean; x: number; y: number }>({ active: false, x: 0, y: 0 });
 397:   const activePointersRef = useRef(new Map<number, { x: number; y: number }>());
 398:   const pinchRef = useRef<{ distance: number; zoom: number } | null>(null);
 399:   // Touch-feel pass: cumulative tap-slop origin, flick velocity samples, the
 400:   // live inertia animation, and the deferred material-texture rebuild flag
 401:   // (crossing the 1.55 texture gate mid-gesture must not hitch the gesture).
 402:   const gestureOriginRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
 403:   const velocitySamplesRef = useRef<Array<{ x: number; y: number; t: number }>>([]);
 404:   const inertiaFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
 405:   const pendingMaterialRefreshRef = useRef(false);
 406:   // Budget-clipped windows (heaviest generated mobile scenes) can leave near-
 407:   // zero streaming margin, so an un-throttled pan rebuilds the window several
 408:   // times per gesture. While fingers are down, allow at most one streaming
 409:   // rebuild per interval and flush the rest on release.
 410:   const pendingGestureWindowRefreshRef = useRef(false);
 411:   const lastGestureWindowRefreshRef = useRef(0);
 412:   const themeCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
 413:   const selectPlaceRef = useRef(onSelectPlace);
 414:   const activeWindowFrameRef = useRef<CityWorldViewportFrame | null>(null);
 415:   const pendingWindowRefreshRef = useRef(false);
 416:   // 0.67H interaction hardening (ported through the 0.75R merge): camera
 417:   // applies coalesce to one rAF per frame, and the rebuild counter is exposed
 418:   // for the mobile-interaction browser proof.
 419:   const cameraFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
 420:   const rebuildCountRef = useRef(0);
 421:   const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
 422:   const [hoverPlaceId, setHoverPlaceId] = useState<string | undefined>();
 423:   const [atlasTextures, setAtlasTextures] = useState<CityWorldTextureMap>({});
 424:   const [windowRefreshKey, setWindowRefreshKey] = useState(0);
 425:   // Perf counters surfaced on __ATLAS_QA__.perf so browser verifiers can gate
 426:   // "hover must not rebuild the scene" and "idle must not render".
 427:   const perfRef = useRef({ sceneRebuilds: 0, lastRebuildMs: 0, overlayRedraws: 0, renderedFrames: 0, streamingRefreshFired: 0, streamingRefreshDeferred: 0 });
 428:   // Focus-overlay animations (selection pulse) live apart from scene ambient
 429:   // animations so the overlay can clear its own targets without touching the
 430:   // scene's, and vice versa.
 431:   const focusAnimatedRef = useRef<AnimatedTarget[]>([]);
 432:   // Render-on-demand state: the loop runs only while a repaint is pending or
 433:   // animated targets exist, then parks at 0 fps. Ambient animation is capped
 434:   // at ~30fps (wall-clock driven, so speed is unchanged â€” only sample rate).
 435:   const renderLoopRef = useRef({ active: false, needsRender: true, lastAnimTick: 0 });
 436:   const focusIndexRef = useRef<FocusIndex | null>(null);
 437:   const focusLayerRef = useRef<Container | null>(null);
 438:   const focusPulseTimeoutRef = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
 439:   const resizeObserverRef = useRef<ResizeObserver | null>(null);
 440:   const visibilityCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
 441:   const [focusEpoch, setFocusEpoch] = useState(0);
 442: 
 443:   function invalidateRender() {
 444:     renderLoopRef.current.needsRender = true;
 445:     ensureRenderLoop();
 446:   }
 447: 
 448:   function ensureRenderLoop() {
 449:     const loop = renderLoopRef.current;
 450:     if (loop.active) return;
 451:     loop.active = true;
 452:     requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
 453:   }
 454: 
 455:   function renderFrame() {
 456:     const loop = renderLoopRef.current;
 457:     const app = appRef.current;
 458:     if (!app || !app.renderer) {
 459:       loop.active = false;
 460:       return;
 461:     }
 462:     const animating = animatedRef.current.length + focusAnimatedRef.current.length > 0 && !document.hidden;
 463:     // Wall-clock cap: rAF timestamps are virtualized in headless/BeginFrame
 464:     // environments, so the ambient 30fps gate keys off performance.now().
 465:     const now = performance.now();
 466:     const animDue = animating && now - loop.lastAnimTick >= 33;
 467:     if (loop.needsRender || animDue) {
 468:       if (animating) {
 469:         animateTargets(animatedRef.current, 2);
 470:         animateTargets(focusAnimatedRef.current, 2);
 471:         loop.lastAnimTick = now;
 472:       }
 473:       app.render();
 474:       loop.needsRender = false;
 475:       perfRef.current.renderedFrames += 1;
 476:     }
 477:     if (animating || loop.needsRender) requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
 478:     else loop.active = false;
 479:   }
 480: 
 481:   useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
 482:     zoomIn: () => zoomBy(1.12),
 483:     zoomOut: () => zoomBy(0.88),
 484:     center: () => resetCamera(scene),
 485:   }));
 486: 
 487:   useEffect(() => {
 488:     selectPlaceRef.current = onSelectPlace;
 489:   }, [onSelectPlace]);
 490: 
 491:   useEffect(() => {
 492:     sceneRef.current = scene;
 493:   }, [scene]);
 494: 
 495:   useEffect(() => {
 496:     let cancelled = false;
 497:     void loadCityWorldAtlasTextures()
 498:       .then((textures) => {
 499:         if (!cancelled) setAtlasTextures(textures);
 500:       })
 501:       .catch((error) => {
 502:         console.warn("Atlas city-world sprite textures failed to load. Primitive fallback remains active.", error);
 503:       });
 504:     return () => {
 505:       cancelled = true;
 506:     };
 507:   }, []);
 508: 
 509:   useEffect(() => {
 510:     const mount = mountRef.current;
 511:     if (!mount) return;
 512:     const mountElement = mount;
 513: 
 514:     const app = new Application();
 515:     appRef.current = app;
 516:     let cancelled = false;
 517:     let initComplete = false;
 518:     let destroyed = false;
 519:     const destroyApp = () => {
 520:       if (destroyed) return;
 521:       destroyed = true;
 522:       themeCleanupRef.current?.();
 523:       themeCleanupRef.current = null;
 524:       app.destroy({ removeView: true }, { children: true });
 525:     };
 526: 
 527:     async function initPixi() {
 528:       await app.init({
 529:         autoDensity: true,
 530:         antialias: true,
 531:         background: resolveBackgroundColor(),
 532:         preference: "webgl",
 533:         resolution: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2),
 534:         resizeTo: mountElement,
 535:       });
 536:       initComplete = true;
 537: 
 538:       if (cancelled) {
 539:         destroyApp();
 540:         return;
 541:       }
 542: 
 543:       app.canvas.className = "city-world-canvas";
 544:       mountElement.appendChild(app.canvas);
 545:       // Backdrop lives inside the stage so the post grade (vignette/haze)
 546:       // covers the open ground beyond the streamed tile window too.
 547:       const backdrop = new Graphics();
 548:       const paintBackdrop = () => {
 549:         backdrop.clear().rect(0, 0, app.screen.width + 2, app.screen.height + 2).fill({ color: resolveBackgroundColor() });
 550:       };
 551:       paintBackdrop();
 552:       app.renderer.on("resize", paintBackdrop);
 553:       app.stage.addChild(backdrop);
 554:       // Live theme changes (host pushes openai:set_globals; OS toggles flip
 555:       // prefers-color-scheme) repaint the surround without a scene rebuild.
 556:       const onThemeChange = () => {
 557:         paintBackdrop();
 558:         invalidateRender();
 559:       };
 560:       window.addEventListener("openai:set_globals", onThemeChange, { passive: true });
 561:       const darkQuery = window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
 562:       darkQuery?.addEventListener?.("change", onThemeChange);
 563:       themeCleanupRef.current = () => {
 564:         window.removeEventListener("openai:set_globals", onThemeChange);
 565:         darkQuery?.removeEventListener?.("change", onThemeChange);
 566:       };
 567:       const world = new Container();
 568:       world.sortableChildren = true;
 569:       worldRef.current = world;
 570:       app.stage.addChild(world);
 571:       // QA hook: verifiers and browser QA sessions bisect draw layers through
 572:       // this handle (e.g. hide propLayer to attribute a visual artifact) and
 573:       // gate perf behavior through the counters.
 574:       const countGraphics = (container: Container): number =>
 575:         container.children.reduce((sum, child) => sum + 1 + (child instanceof Container ? countGraphics(child) : 0), 0);
 576:       (window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).__ATLAS_QA__ = {
 577:         app,
 578:         world,
 579:         perf: {
 580:           get sceneRebuilds() { return perfRef.current.sceneRebuilds; },
 581:           get lastRebuildMs() { return perfRef.current.lastRebuildMs; },
 582:           get overlayRedraws() { return perfRef.current.overlayRedraws; },
 583:           get renderedFrames() { return perfRef.current.renderedFrames; },
 584:           animatedTargetCount: () => animatedRef.current.length + focusAnimatedRef.current.length,
 585:           loopParked: () => !renderLoopRef.current.active,
 586:           graphicsCount: () => countGraphics(world),
 587:           get streamingRefreshFired() { return perfRef.current.streamingRefreshFired; },
 588:           get streamingRefreshDeferred() { return perfRef.current.streamingRefreshDeferred; },
 589:         },
 590:       };
 591:       try {
 592:         app.stage.filters = [createAtlasGradeFilter()];
 593:         app.stage.filterArea = app.screen;
 594:       } catch (error) {
 595:         console.warn("Atlas golden-hour grade filter unavailable. Continuing without post grade.", error);
 596:       }
 597:       // Render on demand: stop Pixi's always-on ticker render; the component-
 598:       // owned rAF loop repaints only when dirty or animating, then parks.
 599:       app.stop();
 600:       const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
 601:         app.resize();
 602:         invalidateRender();
 603:       });
 604:       resizeObserver.observe(mountElement);
 605:       resizeObserverRef.current = resizeObserver;
 606:       const handleVisibility = () => {
 607:         if (!document.hidden) invalidateRender();
 608:       };
 609:       document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibility);
 610:       visibilityCleanupRef.current = () => document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibility);

 612:       setReady(true);
 613:     }

 615:     void initPixi().catch((error) => {
 616:       console.warn("CityWorldRenderer failed to initialize Pixi.", error);
 617:     });
 618: 
 619:     return () => {
 620:       cancelled = true;
 621:       setReady(false);
 622:       animatedRef.current = [];
 623:       focusAnimatedRef.current = [];
 624:       resizeObserverRef.current?.disconnect();
 625:       resizeObserverRef.current = null;
 626:       visibilityCleanupRef.current?.();
 627:       visibilityCleanupRef.current = null;
 628:       worldRef.current = null;
 629:       appRef.current = null;
 630:       if (cameraFrameRef.current !== null) {

 633:       }

 636:       // the cancelled branch inside initPixi destroys after init resolves.
 637:       if (initComplete) destroyApp();
 638:     };
 639:   }, []);
 640: 
 641:   useEffect(() => {
 642:     const mount = mountRef.current;
 643:     if (!mount) return;
 644:     activeWindowFrameRef.current = null;
 645:     pendingWindowRefreshRef.current = false;
 646: 
 647:     // Touch-feel constants: cumulative tap slop (a slightly wobbly finger tap
 648:     // must stay a tap), flick velocity floor, and inertia decay per 16.7ms.
 649:     const TAP_SLOP_PX = 8;
 650:     const FLICK_MIN_SPEED = 0.25; // px/ms
 651:     const FLICK_SAMPLE_WINDOW_MS = 100;
 652:     const INERTIA_DECAY = 0.94;
 653:     const INERTIA_STOP_SPEED = 0.02;
 654: 
 655:     const cancelInertia = () => {
 656:       if (inertiaFrameRef.current !== null) {
 657:         window.cancelAnimationFrame(inertiaFrameRef.current);
 658:         inertiaFrameRef.current = null;
 659:       }
 660:     };
 661:     const startInertia = (vx: number, vy: number) => {
 662:       cancelInertia();
 663:       let lastT = performance.now();
 664:       let velocityX = vx;
 665:       let velocityY = vy;
 666:       const step = (now: number) => {
 667:         // Keep inertiaFrameRef non-null for the whole coast â€” applyCameraNow's
 668:         // streaming-refresh throttle reads isGestureActive() mid-step, and
 669:         // nulling here would bypass it every frame (rebuild storm).
 670:         const dt = Math.min(48, now - lastT);
 671:         lastT = now;
 672:         const decay = Math.pow(INERTIA_DECAY, dt / 16.7);
 673:         velocityX *= decay;
 674:         velocityY *= decay;
 675:         if (Math.hypot(velocityX, velocityY) < INERTIA_STOP_SPEED) {
 676:           inertiaFrameRef.current = null;
 677:           flushPendingMaterialRefresh();
 678:           return;
 679:         }
 680:         cameraRef.current.x += velocityX * dt;
 681:         cameraRef.current.y += velocityY * dt;
 682:         applyCameraNow();
 683:         inertiaFrameRef.current = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
 684:       };
 685:       inertiaFrameRef.current = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
 686:     };
 687:     const pinchMidpoint = () => {
 688:       const [first, second] = [...activePointersRef.current.values()];
 689:       if (!first || !second) return null;
 690:       return { x: (first.x + second.x) / 2, y: (first.y + second.y) / 2 };
 691:     };
 692:     const trackVelocity = (x: number, y: number) => {
 693:       const now = performance.now();
 694:       const samples = velocitySamplesRef.current;
 695:       samples.push({ x, y, t: now });
 696:       while (samples.length > 6 || (samples.length > 1 && now - (samples[0]?.t ?? now) > FLICK_SAMPLE_WINDOW_MS)) samples.shift();
 697:     };
 698:     const releaseVelocity = (): { vx: number; vy: number } | null => {
 699:       const samples = velocitySamplesRef.current;
 700:       const last = samples[samples.length - 1];
 701:       const first = samples[0];
 702:       if (!first || !last || first === last) return null;
 703:       // A real flick is many move events over real time. Two samples over a
 704:       // few ms (synthetic pans, twitchy releases) produce garbage velocities
 705:       // that turn a nudge into a runaway coast.
 706:       if (samples.length < 3) return null;
 707:       const dt = last.t - first.t;
 708:       if (dt < 30 || performance.now() - last.t > 80) return null;
 709:       const vx = (last.x - first.x) / dt;
 710:       const vy = (last.y - first.y) / dt;
 711:       const speed = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
 712:       if (speed < FLICK_MIN_SPEED) return null;
 713:       // Cap the coast: beyond ~1.5px/ms the decay tail crosses several window
 714:       // margins and streams rebuilds for no user-visible benefit.
 715:       const scale = Math.min(1, 1.5 / speed);
 716:       return { vx: vx * scale, vy: vy * scale };
 717:     };
 718: 
 719:     const handleWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
 720:       event.preventDefault();
 721:       // Anchor to the cursor so wheel zoom dives toward what's pointed at.
 722:       setCameraZoomAnchored(cameraRef.current.zoom * (event.deltaY > 0 ? 0.92 : 1.08), event.clientX, event.clientY);
 723:     };
 724:     const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
 725:       cancelInertia();
 726:       activePointersRef.current.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
 727:       dragRef.current = { active: true, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
 728:       gestureOriginRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
 729:       velocitySamplesRef.current = [{ x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, t: performance.now() }];
 730:       movedRef.current = false;
 731:       try {
 732:         mount.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
 733:       } catch {
 734:         // Synthetic browser-proof events may not register as active pointers.
 735:       }
 736:       const distance = pointerDistance(activePointersRef.current);
 737:       if (distance) {
 738:         pinchRef.current = { distance, zoom: cameraRef.current.zoom };
 739:       }
 740:     };
 741:     const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
 742:       if (activePointersRef.current.has(event.pointerId)) {
 743:         activePointersRef.current.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
 744:       }
 745: 
 746:       const distance = pointerDistance(activePointersRef.current);
 747:       if (distance && pinchRef.current) {
 748:         movedRef.current = true;
 749:         // Anchor the zoom at the finger midpoint, not the preset center.
 750:         const midpoint = pinchMidpoint();
 751:         const nextZoom = pinchRef.current.zoom * (distance / pinchRef.current.distance);
 752:         if (midpoint) setCameraZoomAnchored(nextZoom, midpoint.x, midpoint.y);
 753:         else setCameraZoom(nextZoom);
 754:         return;
 755:       }
 756: 
 757:       if (!dragRef.current.active) {
 758:         // Hover is a mouse concept; touch move outside a drag is noise.
 759:         if (event.pointerType === "touch") return;
 760:         setHoverPlaceId((current) => {
 761:           const next = findHitPlace(event.clientX, event.clientY);
 762:           return current === next ? current : next;
 763:         });
 764:         return;
 765:       }
 766: 
 767:       const dx = event.clientX - dragRef.current.x;

1052:   function findHitPlace(clientX: number, clientY: number): string | undefined {
1053:     const mount = mountRef.current;
1054:     if (!mount) return undefined;
1055:     const rect = mount.getBoundingClientRect();
1056:     const camera = cameraRef.current;
1057:     const screenX = clientX - rect.left;
1058:     const screenY = clientY - rect.top;
1059:     let nearest: { id: string; distance: number } | undefined;
1060: 
1061:     for (const place of sceneRef.current.places) {
1062:       const point = project(place.anchor);
1063:       const x = camera.x + point.x * camera.zoom;
1064:       const y = camera.y + point.y * camera.zoom;
1065:       const distance = Math.hypot(screenX - x, screenY - y);
1066:       const threshold = Math.max(34, place.hitRadius * 14 * camera.zoom);
1067:       if (distance <= threshold && (!nearest || distance < nearest.distance)) {
1068:         nearest = { id: place.id, distance };
1069:       }
1070:     }
1071: 
1072:     return nearest?.id;
1073:   }

1085: function pointerDistance(pointers: Map<number, { x: number; y: number }>): number | undefined {
1086:   if (pointers.size < 2) return undefined;
1087:   const pair = Array.from(pointers.values()).slice(0, 2);
1088:   const first = pair[0];
1089:   const second = pair[1];
1090:   if (!first || !second) return undefined;
1091:   return Math.hypot(first.x - second.x, first.y - second.y);
1092: }

1094: // Everything the incremental focus overlay needs to redraw hover/selection
1095: // without touching the base scene: visible places, their anchored buildings,

1097: type FocusIndex = {
1098:   placesById: Map<string, CityWorldPlace>;

1100:   crownLift: Map<string, number>;

1104: // Frame-independent scene-window artifacts are memoized per scene object +
1105: // option set: createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler wraps the same compile as
1106: // compileCityWorldSceneWindow but only re-runs the frame filter on streaming
1107: // pan refreshes.
1108: const sceneWindowCompilerCache = new WeakMap<CityWorldScene, Map<string, ReturnType<typeof createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler>>>();

1110: function sceneWindowCompilerFor(scene: CityWorldScene, includeLabels: boolean, includeDebug: boolean) {
1111:   let byOptions = sceneWindowCompilerCache.get(scene);
1112:   if (!byOptions) {
1113:     byOptions = new Map();
1114:     sceneWindowCompilerCache.set(scene, byOptions);
1115:   }
1116:   const key = `${includeLabels}:${includeDebug}`;
1117:   let compiler = byOptions.get(key);
1118:   if (!compiler) {
1119:     compiler = createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler(scene, { includeLabels, includeDebug });
1120:     byOptions.set(key, compiler);
1121:   }
1122:   return compiler;
1123: }

1125: function drawScene(
1126:   world: Container,
1127:   scene: CityWorldScene,
1128:   cameraPresetId: CityWorldCameraPresetId,
1129:   viewportFrame: CityWorldViewportFrame,
1130:   cameraZoom: number,
1131:   atlasTextures: CityWorldTextureMap,
1132:   debugMode: CityWorldDebugMode | undefined,
1133:   suppressPlaceLabels: boolean,
1134:   onSelectPlace: (placeId: string) => void,
1135:   onHoverPlace: (placeId: string | undefined) => void,
1136:   animated: AnimatedTarget[],
1137: ): { frame: CityWorldViewportFrame; focus: FocusIndex } {
1138:   const previousChildren = world.removeChildren();
1139:   for (const child of previousChildren) {
1140:     child.destroy({ children: true });
1141:   }
1142:   animated.length = 0;
1143: 
1144:   const layers = createLayers();
1145:   Object.values(layers).forEach((layer) => world.addChild(layer));
1146:   const atlas = createCityWorldAtlasResolver(scene, atlasTextures);
1147:   const includeLabels = !suppressPlaceLabels && !shouldHideCityWorldLabels();
1148:   const compiler = sceneWindowCompilerFor(scene, includeLabels, debugMode === "engine");
1149:   const sceneWindow = compiler.windowFor(cameraPresetId, viewportFrame);
1150:   const itemIndex = compiler.itemIndex;
1151:   const renderCommands = sceneWindow.visibleCommands;
1152: 
1153:   // Ground layers merge into a few depth-band Graphics (band = floor((x+y)/4)):
1154:   // bands partition painter depth, so adding bands in ascending order with
1155:   // in-band call order preserved is exactly order-safe â€” and drops thousands
1156:   // of per-tile/per-lot Graphics to ~dozens.
1157:   drawBanded(layers.terrainLayer, orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "terrain_tile", itemIndex.terrainTiles), (g, tile) => drawTerrainTile(g, tile, atlas));
1158:   drawRoadNetwork(layers.roadLayer, orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "road_segment", itemIndex.roadSegments));
1159:   drawBanded(layers.lotLayer, orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "lot", itemIndex.lots), (g, lot) => drawLot(g, lot));
1160: 
1161:   const buildings = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "building", itemIndex.buildings);
1162:   // 0.67H focal calm â€” props inside the focal anchor's ring dim toward
1163:   // ambience so the hero building's face separation stays the loudest read.
1164:   // The base scene is focus-agnostic (0.74F), so the focal anchor keys off
1165:   // the scene's default selection, not live hover state. Threaded through
1166:   // the 0.75C depth-interleaved draw so calm and correct occlusion compose.
1167:   const focalAnchor = focalPlaceAnchor(scene, scene.hudDefaults.selectedPlaceId);
1168:   const props = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "prop", itemIndex.props);
1169:   drawDepthInterleavedBuildingsAndProps(layers, buildings, props, animated, atlas, shouldDrawMaterialTexture(cameraZoom), (prop) =>
1170:     focalCalm(prop.position, focalAnchor),
1171:   );
1172:   const actors = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "actor", itemIndex.actors);
1173:   for (const actor of actors) drawActor(layers.actorLayer, actor, animated, atlas, focalCalm(actor.position, focalAnchor));
1174:   const visiblePlaces = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "place_marker", itemIndex.places);
1175:   for (const place of visiblePlaces) drawPlaceMarker(layers, place, onSelectPlace, onHoverPlace);
1176:   for (const pin of orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "pin", itemIndex.pins)) drawPin(layers.markerLayer, pin, atlas);
1177:   // 0.56E â€” labels clear the architecture: each place's label lifts above
1178:   // the tallest structure anchored to it (plus crown allowance), instead of
1179:   // sitting at a fixed ground offset that erased landmark crowns.
1180:   const crownLift = placeCrownLiftMap(scene.buildings);
1181:   if (includeLabels) {
1182:     // 0.67H label demotion â€” ambient labels are a hard cap (none on mobile,
1183:     // two on desktop); selected/hover labels render from the focus overlay.
1184:     const ambientLabelIds = ambientLabelAllowance(scene, cameraPresetId);
1185:     for (const place of orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "place_label", itemIndex.places)) drawPlaceLabel(layers.labelLayer, place, ambientLabelIds, crownLift.get(place.id));
1186:   }
1187:   if (debugMode === "engine") drawEngineDebugOverlay(layers.hudBridgeLayer, scene);
1188: 
1189:   const focus: FocusIndex = {
1190:     placesById: new Map(visiblePlaces.map((place) => [place.id, place])),
1191:     buildingsByPlaceId: new Map(),
1192:     crownLift,
1193:     drawnPlaceIds: new Set(visiblePlaces.map((place) => place.id)),
1194:   };
1195:   for (const building of buildings) {
1196:     if (!building.placeId) continue;
1197:     const anchored = focus.buildingsByPlaceId.get(building.placeId);
1198:     if (anchored) anchored.push(building);
1199:     else focus.buildingsByPlaceId.set(building.placeId, [building]);
1200:   }
1201:   return { frame: sceneWindow.frame, focus };
1202: }

1204: const GROUND_BAND_TILES = 4;
1205: 
1206: function drawBanded<T extends { position: CityWorldPoint }>(
1207:   layer: Container,
1208:   items: T[],
1209:   draw: (g: Graphics, item: T) => void,
1210: ) {
1211:   const bands = new Map<number, Graphics>();
1212:   for (const item of items) {
1213:     const band = Math.floor((item.position.x + item.position.y) / GROUND_BAND_TILES);
1214:     let g = bands.get(band);
1215:     if (!g) {
1216:       g = new Graphics();
1217:       bands.set(band, g);
1218:     }
1219:     draw(g, item);
1220:   }
1221:   for (const band of [...bands.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
1222:     const g = bands.get(band);
1223:     if (g) layer.addChild(g);
1224:   }
1225: }

1227: function shouldHideCityWorldLabels(): boolean {
1228:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
1229:   return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("atlasNoLabels") === "1";
1230: }
1231: 
1232: // 0.67H label demotion â€” the ambient (non-focused) label budget is a hard
1233: // cap, not a priority threshold: mobile gets none, desktop gets the two
1234: // highest-priority anchors. Focus-overlay labels render on top of this
1235: // allowance, so a desktop frame tops out at three label cards.
1236: function ambientLabelAllowance(scene: CityWorldScene, cameraPresetId: CityWorldCameraPresetId): Set<string> {
1237:   if (cameraPresetId === "mobile") return new Set();
1238:   return new Set(
1239:     scene.places
1240:       .filter((place) => place.labelPriority >= 9)
1241:       .sort((a, b) => b.labelPriority - a.labelPriority)
1242:       .slice(0, 2)
1243:       .map((place) => place.id),
1244:   );
1245: }
1246: 
1247: // 0.67H focal calm â€” the default-selected place (or the first landmark as a
1248: // fallback) defines the focal ring where decoration must yield to architecture.
1249: function focalPlaceAnchor(scene: CityWorldScene, selectedPlaceId: string): CityWorldPoint | undefined {
1250:   const focal = scene.places.find((place) => place.id === selectedPlaceId) ?? scene.places.find((place) => place.kind === "landmark");
1251:   return focal?.anchor;
1252: }

1254: function focalCalm(position: CityWorldPoint, focalAnchor: CityWorldPoint | undefined): number {
1255:   if (!focalAnchor) return 1;
1256:   const distance = Math.hypot(position.x - focalAnchor.x, position.y - focalAnchor.y);
1257:   if (distance < 2.2) return 0.55;
1258:   if (distance < 3.6) return 0.78;
1259:   return 1;
1260: }

1262: function resolveCameraPresetId(scene: CityWorldScene, requestedId: CityWorldCameraPresetId | undefined, width: number): CityWorldCameraPresetId {
1263:   if (requestedId && scene.cameraPresets.some((item) => item.id === requestedId)) return requestedId;
1264:   const responsiveId = width < 720 ? "mobile" : "desktop";
1265:   if (scene.cameraPresets.some((item) => item.id === responsiveId)) return responsiveId;
1266:   return scene.cameraPresets[0]?.id ?? "desktop";
1267: }

1269: function rendererViewportFrame(mount: HTMLDivElement, camera: CameraState, cameraPresetId: CityWorldCameraPresetId, marginTiles: number): CityWorldViewportFrame {
1270:   const center = cityWorldScreenCenterForCamera({
1271:     x: camera.x,
1272:     y: camera.y,
1273:     zoom: camera.zoom,
1274:     viewportWidth: mount.clientWidth,
1275:     viewportHeight: mount.clientHeight,
1276:   });
1277:   return cityWorldExpandViewportFrame(cityWorldViewportFrameForPreset(cameraPresetId, center, camera.zoom), marginTiles);

1284: function orderedSceneItems<T extends { id: string }>(
1285:   commands: readonly CityWorldRenderCommand[],
1286:   kind: CityWorldRenderCommandKind,
1287:   itemById: ReadonlyMap<string, T>,
1288: ): T[] {
1289:   // Single pass over the visible commands resolving through the scene's
1290:   // shared id index â€” the old per-call Map rebuild scanned every item array
1291:   // nine times per scene rebuild.
1292:   const items: T[] = [];
1293:   for (const command of commands) {
1294:     if (command.kind !== kind) continue;
1295:     const item = itemById.get(command.sourceId);
1296:     if (item) items.push(item);
1297:   }
1298:   return items;
1299: }

1301: function drawDepthInterleavedBuildingsAndProps(
1302:   layers: LayerMap,
1303:   buildings: CityWorldBuilding[],
1304:   props: CityWorldProp[],
1305:   animated: AnimatedTarget[],
1306:   atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver,
1307:   materialTextureEnabled: boolean,
1308:   propCalm: (prop: CityWorldProp) => number = () => 1,
1309: ) {
1310:   const buildingProxy = layers.buildingLayer as QaVisibilityProxyLayer;
1311:   const propProxy = layers.propLayer as QaVisibilityProxyLayer;
1312:   buildingProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.length = 0;
1313:   propProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.length = 0;
1314:   layers.buildingPropDepthLayer.sortableChildren = true;
1315: 
1316:   const items = [
1317:     ...buildings.map((building, sourceIndex) => ({
1318:       id: building.id,
1319:       kind: "building" as const,
1320:       depthKey: cityWorldBuildingDepthKey(building),
1321:       sourceIndex,
1322:       building,
1323:     })),
1324:     ...props.map((prop, sourceIndex) => ({
1325:       id: prop.id,
1326:       kind: "prop" as const,
1327:       depthKey: cityWorldPropDepthKey(prop),
1328:       sourceIndex,
1329:       prop,
1330:     })),
1331:   ].sort(compareCityWorldDepthInterleaveItems);
1332: 
1333:   for (const item of items) {
1334:     const group = new Container();
1335:     group.label = `${item.kind}-${item.id}`;
1336:     group.zIndex = item.depthKey;
1337:     if (item.kind === "building") {
1338:       drawBuilding(layers, group, item.building, atlas, materialTextureEnabled);
1339:       group.visible = buildingProxy.visible;
1340:       buildingProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.push(group);
1341:     } else {
1342:       drawProp(group, item.prop, animated, atlas, propCalm(item.prop));
1343:       group.visible = propProxy.visible;
1344:       propProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.push(group);
1345:     }
1346:     layers.buildingPropDepthLayer.addChild(group);
1347:   }
1348:   layers.buildingPropDepthLayer.sortChildren();
1349: }

1351: function drawEngineDebugOverlay(layer: Container, scene: CityWorldScene) {
1352:   for (const tile of scene.terrainTiles) {
1353:     const massing = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainChunkMassing ?? "none";
1354:     if (massing === "none") continue;
1355:     const point = project(tile.position);
1356:     const color = debugColorForMassing(massing);
1357:     const outline = new Graphics();
1358:     outline.poly(diamondPoints(point, TILE_WIDTH * 1.18, TILE_HEIGHT * 1.12), true);
1359:     outline.stroke({ color, alpha: 0.42, width: 1.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1360:     layer.addChild(outline);
1361:   }
1362: 
1363:   for (const road of scene.roadSegments) {
1364:     const from = project(road.from);
1365:     const to = project(road.to);
1366:     const line = new Graphics()
1367:       .moveTo(from.x, from.y)
1368:       .lineTo(to.x, to.y);
1369:     line.stroke({ color: 0x55d7ff, alpha: 0.36, width: Math.max(1.2, road.width), cap: "round", join: "round" });
1370:     layer.addChild(line);
1371:   }
1372: 
1373:   for (const lot of scene.lots) {
1374:     const point = project(lot.position);
1375:     const outline = new Graphics();
1376:     outline.poly(diamondPoints(point, lot.width * TILE_WIDTH, lot.depth * TILE_HEIGHT), true);
1377:     outline.stroke({ color: 0xffd166, alpha: 0.34, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1378:     layer.addChild(outline);
1379:   }
1380: 
1381:   for (const building of scene.buildings) {
1382:     const point = project(building.position);
1383:     const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily ?? "none";
1384:     const color = debugColorForObjectFamily(family);
1385:     const outline = new Graphics();
1386:     outline.poly(diamondPoints(point, building.width * TILE_WIDTH, building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT), true);
1387:     outline.stroke({ color, alpha: 0.58, width: building.visualGrammar?.clusterRole === "anchor" ? 2 : 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1388:     if (building.visualGrammar?.noLabelPriority === "primary_anchor") {
1389:       outline.circle(point.x, point.y - building.height * TILE_DEPTH - 14, 5).fill({ color, alpha: 0.72 });
1390:     }
1391:     layer.addChild(outline);
1392:     if (building.visualGrammar?.clusterRole === "anchor" || building.visualGrammar?.noLabelPriority === "primary_anchor") {
1393:       layer.addChild(debugText(familyShortLabel(family), point.x, point.y - building.height * TILE_DEPTH - 24, color));
1394:     }
1395:   }
1396: }

1447: function createLayers(): LayerMap {
1448:   return {
1449:     terrainLayer: namedLayer("terrainLayer"),
1450:     // Lots under roads: both are ground material, but a road corridor crossing
1451:     // a lot (park loop, generated overlaps) must read as embedded asphalt
1452:     // cutting the lot, never as a lot sheet laid over the road.
1453:     lotLayer: namedLayer("lotLayer"),
1454:     roadLayer: namedLayer("roadLayer"),
1455:     padLayer: namedLayer("padLayer"),
1456:     shadowLayer: namedLayer("shadowLayer"),
1457:     buildingPropDepthLayer: namedLayer("buildingPropDepthLayer"),
1458:     buildingLayer: namedVisibilityProxyLayer("buildingLayer"),
1459:     propLayer: namedVisibilityProxyLayer("propLayer"),
1460:     actorLayer: namedLayer("actorLayer"),
1461:     // Hover/selection emphasis draws here alone â€” over the buildings it
1462:     // traces, under labels and hit targets â€” so focus changes never rebuild
1463:     // the base scene.
1464:     focusLayer: namedLayer("focusLayer"),
1465:     labelLayer: namedLayer("labelLayer"),
1466:     markerLayer: namedLayer("markerLayer"),
1467:     hudBridgeLayer: namedLayer("hudBridgeLayer"),
1468:   };
1469: }

1471: function namedLayer(label: keyof LayerMap): Container {
1472:   const layer = new Container();
1473:   layer.label = label;
1474:   return layer;
1475: }
1476: 
1477: function namedVisibilityProxyLayer(label: "buildingLayer" | "propLayer"): QaVisibilityProxyLayer {
1478:   const layer = namedLayer(label) as QaVisibilityProxyLayer;
1479:   layer.atlasProxyVisible = true;
1480:   layer.atlasVisibilityTargets = [];
1481:   Object.defineProperty(layer, "visible", {
1482:     configurable: true,
1483:     get() {
1484:       return this.atlasProxyVisible;
1485:     },
1486:     set(value: boolean) {
1487:       this.atlasProxyVisible = value;
1488:       for (const target of this.atlasVisibilityTargets) target.visible = value;
1489:     },
1490:   });
1491:   return layer;
1492: }

1494: function drawTerrainTile(g: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver) {
1495:   const point = project(tile.position);
1496:   const contact = resolveTerrainContact(tile);
1497:   const draftTile = contact.tone === "draft";
1498:   const shellTile = contact.tone === "shell";
1499:   const regionalTerrain = tile.paletteKey?.startsWith("terrain.region.") ? atlas.resolvePalette(tile.paletteKey, "terrain").colors : undefined;
1500:   const baseColor = shellTile ? SHELL_TERRAIN_COLORS[tile.kind] : draftTile ? DRAFT_TERRAIN_COLORS[tile.kind] : regionalTerrain ? colorToNumber(regionalTerrain.base) : TERRAIN_COLORS[tile.kind];
1501:   // Deterministic tonal variation: two low-frequency waves plus a whisper of
1502:   // per-tile hash so the ground reads as planted terrain, not a flat board â€”
1503:   // and not a checkerboard. Calm range only.
1504:   const lowFrequencyTone =
1505:     Math.sin(tile.position.x * 0.16 + tile.position.y * 0.23) * 3.4 +
1506:     Math.sin(tile.position.x * 0.055 - tile.position.y * 0.083) * 3.0;
1507:   const toneHash = ((tile.position.x * 73856093) ^ (tile.position.y * 19349663) ^ (tile.variant * 83492791)) >>> 0;
1508:   const hashTone = ((toneHash % 5) - 2) * 0.8;
1509:   const toneScale = tile.kind === "water" ? 0.9 : tile.kind === "grass" ? 1.25 : 0.6;
1510:   const variation = (tile.variant - 2) * (tile.kind === "water" ? 3.1 : tile.kind === "grass" ? 1.2 : 1.8) + (lowFrequencyTone + hashTone) * toneScale;
1511:   // Ground sits a half-step below the sunlit rooftops so built forms read
1512:   // bright against the terrain instead of blending into it.
1513:   const color = shellTile
1514:     ? mixColor(scaleColor(shadeColor(baseColor, variation * 0.35), 0.96), 0xe0dec4, 0.16)
1515:     : tile.kind === "water"
1516:       ? mixColor(scaleColor(shadeColor(baseColor, variation), 0.96), 0x082f57, 0.18)
1517:       : mixColor(scaleColor(shadeColor(baseColor, variation), 0.98), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.07);
1518:   const alpha = shellTile ? (tile.kind === "grass" ? 0.86 : 0.9) : draftTile ? (tile.kind === "grass" ? 0.84 : 0.92) : tile.kind === "water" ? 0.97 : tile.kind === "grass" ? 0.92 : 0.94;
1519:   const strokeAlpha = shellTile ? (tile.kind === "grass" ? 0.1 : 0.14) : draftTile ? (tile.kind === "grass" ? 0.018 : 0.1) : tile.kind === "grass" ? 0.026 : tile.kind === "water" ? 0.28 : 0.12;
1520:   const strokeColor = tile.kind === "water" ? 0x0b4f79 : shellTile ? 0x747965 : draftTile ? 0x7a8a58 : regionalTerrain ? colorToNumber(regionalTerrain.shade) : 0x6d824f;
1521:   // Massing/elevation extrusions first, then the tile face: within a shared
1522:   // Graphics, path order is z order (old per-object add order preserved).
1523:   drawTerrainChunkMassing(g, tile, point, color);
1524:   drawTerrainElevationEdges(g, tile, point, color);
1525:   drawTerrainCliffCourses(g, tile, point, color);
1526:   const graphic = appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints(point, TILE_WIDTH + 1, TILE_HEIGHT + 1), color, alpha, strokeColor, strokeAlpha);
1527: 
1528:   if (tile.kind === "water") {
1529:     // Depth gradient + sheen: bright sun edge, deep blue falloff below.
1530:     graphic
1531:       .poly([point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y, point.x, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5, point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.16, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.34, point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.28, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.1], true)
1532:       .fill({ color: 0x75c9ee, alpha: 0.22 })
1533:       .poly([point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y, point.x, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5, point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.14, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.36, point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.26, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.08], true)
1534:       .fill({ color: 0x052f5a, alpha: 0.28 })
1535:       .poly([point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.22, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.04, point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.1, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.2, point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.34, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02, point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.02, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.16], true)
1536:       .fill({ color: 0x0e5f98, alpha: 0.18 });
1537:     if (tile.variant % 2 === 0) {
1538:       graphic
1539:         .moveTo(point.x - 11, point.y - 1)
1540:         .lineTo(point.x + 13, point.y - 1)
1541:         .stroke({ color: 0xd7f8ff, alpha: 0.28, width: 1.15, cap: "round" });
1542:     }
1543:   } else if (tile.kind === "park" && tile.variant % 3 === 0) {
1544:     graphic.circle(point.x - 5, point.y - 1, 1.8).fill({ color: 0xd8f0b2, alpha: 0.32 });
1545:   } else if (tile.kind === "plaza" && tile.variant % 2 === 0) {
1546:     graphic
1547:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.22, point.y)
1548:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.22, point.y)
1549:       .stroke({ color: 0xf5e7c1, alpha: 0.26, width: 1 });
1550:   } else if (tile.kind === "grass" && tile.variant === 4) {
1551:     graphic.circle(point.x + 7, point.y + 1, 1.1).fill({ color: 0xe0efb4, alpha: 0.08 });
1552:   }
1553: 
1554:   if (tile.kind === "grass") drawGrassFacet(graphic, tile, point);
1555:   drawTerrainElevationChunkFace(graphic, tile, point, color);
1556:   drawTerrainParcelComposition(graphic, tile, point);
1557:   drawTerrainContactSeams(graphic, tile, point, contact, color);
1558:   if (draftTile) drawDraftTerrainFacet(graphic, tile, point);
1559:   if (shellTile) drawShellTerrainFacet(graphic, tile, point);
1560: }
1561: 
1562: // 0.74F terrain relief: raised tiles extrude stacked voxel cliff courses on
1563: // every side that drops to a lower neighbor. South/east faces are the
1564: // sun-consistent visible cliff walls; north/west bands read as shadowed cuts
1565: // AND cover the projection gap a raised tile leaves over its back neighbors.
1566: // Authored by the generator as visualGrammar.elevation â€” no neighbor scans here.
1567: function drawTerrainCliffCourses(g: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, color: number) {
1568:   const elevation = tile.visualGrammar?.elevation;
1569:   if (!elevation || elevation.dropDepth <= 0 || elevation.dropSides.length === 0) return;
1570: 
1571:   const width = TILE_WIDTH + 1;
1572:   const height = TILE_HEIGHT + 1;
1573:   const courseZ = 0.5;
1574:   const courseCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(elevation.dropDepth / courseZ));
1575:   const coursePx = (elevation.dropDepth * TILE_DEPTH) / courseCount;
1576:   const cliffBase = shadeColor(color, -10);
1577: 
1578:   for (const side of elevation.dropSides) {
1579:     const edge = tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side);
1580:     const frontFace = side === "south" || side === "east";
1581:     for (let course = 0; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
1582:       const topDrop = course * coursePx;
1583:       const bottomDrop = (course + 1) * coursePx + (course === courseCount - 1 ? 1.5 : 0);
1584:       const faceColor = frontFace
1585:         ? sunlitColor(shadeColor(cliffBase, -course * 9), side === "south" ? "sun" : "shade")
1586:         : shadeColor(cliffBase, -30 - course * 8);
1587:       g
1588:         .poly(
1589:           [
1590:             edge.from.x, edge.from.y + topDrop,
1591:             edge.to.x, edge.to.y + topDrop,
1592:             edge.to.x, edge.to.y + bottomDrop,
1593:             edge.from.x, edge.from.y + bottomDrop,
1594:           ],
1595:           true,
1596:         )
1597:         .fill({ color: faceColor, alpha: frontFace ? 0.98 : 0.92 });
1598:       if (frontFace) {
1599:         // Sunlit lip along the top of each course â€” the stacked-block read.
1600:         g
1601:           .moveTo(edge.from.x, edge.from.y + topDrop)
1602:           .lineTo(edge.to.x, edge.to.y + topDrop)
1603:           .stroke({ color: shadeColor(color, 30), alpha: course === 0 ? 0.58 : 0.36, width: 1.15, cap: "butt" });
1604:       }
1605:       g
1606:         .moveTo(edge.from.x, edge.from.y + bottomDrop - 0.9)
1607:         .lineTo(edge.to.x, edge.to.y + bottomDrop - 0.9)
1608:         .stroke({ color: frontFace ? shadeColor(color, 12) : shadeColor(color, -46), alpha: frontFace ? 0.24 : 0.18, width: 0.9, cap: "butt" });
1609:     }
1610:   }
1611: }
1612: 
1613: // Material seams + water bank strands, authored by the compiler as
1614: // terrainContact metadata. Seams are inset inside the owning tile so they
1615: // survive the painter's draw order regardless of which neighbor drew last.
1616: function drawTerrainContactSeams(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, contact: CityWorldTerrainContactGrammar, color: number) {
1617:   const style = TERRAIN_SEAM_TONE_STYLE[contact.tone];
1618:   const edgeSides = contact.edgeSides ?? [];
1619:   const waterEdgeSides = contact.waterEdgeSides ?? [];
1620:   if (edgeSides.length === 0 && waterEdgeSides.length === 0) return;
1621: 
1622:   const width = TILE_WIDTH + 1;
1623:   const height = TILE_HEIGHT + 1;
1624: 
1625:   if (edgeSides.length > 0 && style.seamAlpha > 0) {
1626:     // Dark groove where the slab material meets the softer neighbor...
1627:     for (const side of edgeSides) {
1628:       const seam = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.08);
1629:       graphic.moveTo(seam.from.x, seam.from.y).lineTo(seam.to.x, seam.to.y);
1630:     }
1631:     graphic.stroke({ color: shadeColor(color, -52), alpha: style.seamAlpha, width: 1.15, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1632: 
1633:     if (contact.contactShadow && style.lipAlpha > 0) {
1634:       // ...with a sunlit lip just inside it, so the slab reads as a physical
1635:       // step instead of a painted boundary.
1636:       for (const side of edgeSides) {
1637:         const lip = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.2);
1638:         graphic.moveTo(lip.from.x, lip.from.y).lineTo(lip.to.x, lip.to.y);
1639:       }
1640:       graphic.stroke({ color: shadeColor(color, 34), alpha: style.lipAlpha, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1641:     }
1642:   }
1643: 
1644:   if (waterEdgeSides.length > 0 && style.strandAlpha > 0) {
1645:     // Beach strand on the land side: a filled sand wedge between the tile
1646:     // edge and the dry line, then a pale dry line above a darker wet line â€”
1647:     // the shore reads as a beach, not a painted boundary.
1648:     for (const side of waterEdgeSides) {
1649:       const edge = tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side);
1650:       const inner = insetEdgeSegment(point, edge, 0.34);
1651:       graphic
1652:         .poly([edge.from.x, edge.from.y, edge.to.x, edge.to.y, inner.to.x, inner.to.y, inner.from.x, inner.from.y], true)
1653:         .fill({ color: 0xead7a6, alpha: style.strandAlpha * 0.68 });
1654:     }
1655:     for (const side of waterEdgeSides) {
1656:       const strand = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.1);
1657:       graphic.moveTo(strand.from.x, strand.from.y).lineTo(strand.to.x, strand.to.y);
1658:     }
1659:     graphic.stroke({ color: 0xf1dfae, alpha: style.strandAlpha, width: 1.65, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1660:     for (const side of waterEdgeSides) {
1661:       const wet = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.22);
1662:       graphic.moveTo(wet.from.x, wet.from.y).lineTo(wet.to.x, wet.to.y);
1663:     }
1664:     graphic.stroke({ color: 0x185f85, alpha: style.wetAlpha, width: 1.25, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1665:   }
1666: }
1667: 
1668: function drawTerrainChunkMassing(g: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, color: number) {
1669:   const massing = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainChunkMassing ?? "none";
1670:   if (massing === "none") return;
1671: 
1672:   const chunkEdge = tile.visualGrammar?.chunkEdge ?? "none";
1673:   const config = terrainChunkMassingStyle(massing, color, chunkEdge);
1674:   const width = TILE_WIDTH * config.widthScale;
1675:   const height = TILE_HEIGHT * config.heightScale;
1676:   const depth = config.depth;
1677:   appendPolygon(
1678:     g,
1679:     diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + depth + 3 }, width * 1.04, height * 1.02),
1680:     0x1d2a22,
1681:     config.shadowAlpha,
1682:     0x1d2a22,
1683:     0,
1684:   );
1685:   // Sun-consistent massing faces: lower-left face lit, lower-right in shade.
1686:   const massLit = sunlitColor(config.rightColor, "sun");
1687:   const massShade = sunlitColor(config.leftColor, "shade");
1688:   const massAlpha = Math.min(config.faceAlpha * 1.9, 0.5);
1689:   g
1690:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y)
1691:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5)
1692:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + depth)
1693:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y + depth)
1694:     .closePath()
1695:     .fill({ color: massLit, alpha: massAlpha * 0.82 });
1696:   g
1697:     .moveTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5)
1698:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y)
1699:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y + depth)
1700:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + depth)
1701:     .closePath()
1702:     .fill({ color: massShade, alpha: massAlpha });
1703:   g
1704:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y + depth)
1705:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + depth)
1706:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y + depth)
1707:     .stroke({ color: config.rimColor, alpha: config.rimAlpha, width: config.rimWidth, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1708: 
1709:   if (config.strataAlpha > 0) {
1710:     g
1711:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.38, point.y + depth * 0.52)
1712:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.08, point.y + height * 0.18 + depth * 0.58)
1713:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.28, point.y + depth * 0.5)
1714:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.26, point.y + depth * 0.86)
1715:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.28 + depth * 0.92)
1716:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.24, point.y + depth * 0.84)
1717:       .stroke({ color: config.strataColor, alpha: config.strataAlpha, width: 1.05, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1718:   }
1719: }

1721: function terrainChunkMassingStyle(
1722:   massing: NonNullable<CityWorldTerrainTile["visualGrammar"]>["terrainChunkMassing"],
1723:   color: number,
1724:   chunkEdge: NonNullable<CityWorldTerrainTile["visualGrammar"]>["chunkEdge"],
1725: ) {
1726:   const structuralEdge = chunkEdge !== "none";
1727:   if (massing === "outer_world_edge_mass") {
1728:     return {
1729:       depth: structuralEdge ? 14 : 9,
1730:       widthScale: structuralEdge ? 1.26 : 1.16,
1731:       heightScale: structuralEdge ? 1.13 : 1.07,
1732:       leftColor: 0x637f55,
1733:       rightColor: 0x779969,
1734:       faceAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.2 : 0.11,
1735:       shadowAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.065 : 0.035,
1736:       rimColor: 0xf1e5bb,
1737:       rimAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.21 : 0.105,
1738:       rimWidth: structuralEdge ? 1.65 : 1.05,

1740:       strataAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.105 : 0.035,

1767:       shadowAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.055 : 0.026,
1768:       rimColor: 0xf0e2b7,
1769:       rimAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.18 : 0.085,
1770:       rimWidth: structuralEdge ? 1.45 : 0.9,
1771:       strataColor: 0xe7d6a4,
1772:       strataAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.095 : 0.025,

1774:   }
1775:   if (massing === "commercial_slab_mass") {

1784:       rimColor: 0xf6e6c2,
1785:       rimAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.245 : 0.125,
1786:       rimWidth: structuralEdge ? 1.55 : 0.9,
1787:       strataColor: 0x8c7855,
1788:       strataAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.14 : 0.05,
1789:     };
1790:   }
1791:   if (massing === "park_basin_cut_mass") {

1797:       rightColor: 0x83aa67,
1798:       faceAlpha: structuralEdge ? 0.17 : 0.09,

1800:       rimColor: 0xe9dba8,

1855: function drawTerrainElevationEdges(g: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, color: number) {
1856:   const elevation = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainElevation;
1857:   if (!elevation || elevation === "flat_field" || elevation === "shell_flat") return;
1858: 
1859:   const hash = (tile.position.x * 29 + tile.position.y * 31 + tile.variant * 5) % 17;
1860:   const raised = elevation === "raised_parcel_shelf" || elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf" || elevation === "hidden_draft_shelf";
1861:   const cut = elevation === "water_edge_cut";
1862:   const basin = elevation === "park_basin_shelf";
1863:   const depth = elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf" ? 7 : cut ? 8 : basin ? 4 : 5;
1864:   const sideColor = cut ? sunlitColor(0x155c80, "shade") : sunlitColor(shadeColor(color, basin ? -8 : -12), "shade");
1865:   const faceAlpha = cut ? 0.48 : elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf" ? 0.42 : 0.3;
1866: 
1867:   if (raised || cut || (basin && hash % 2 === 0)) {
1868:     g
1869:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y)
1870:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5)
1871:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y)
1872:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y + depth)
1873:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5 + depth)
1874:       .lineTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y + depth)
1875:       .closePath()
1876:       .fill({ color: sideColor, alpha: faceAlpha });
1877:   }
1878: 
1879:   if ((elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf" || cut || hash === 3 || hash === 11) && elevation !== "park_basin_shelf") {
1880:     g
1881:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.36, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.12 + depth * 0.55)
1882:       .lineTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.08, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.28 + depth * 0.55)
1883:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.28, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.1 + depth * 0.55)
1884:       .stroke({ color: cut ? 0xcdf5ff : 0xf3dfb2, alpha: cut ? 0.22 : 0.12, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1885:   }
1886: }

1888: function drawGrassFacet(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint) {
1889:   const hash = (tile.position.x * 19 + tile.position.y * 23 + tile.variant * 11) % 29;
1890: 
1891:   if (hash === 0 || hash === 9 || hash === 21) {
1892:     const patch = hash === 0 ? shadeColor(TERRAIN_COLORS.grass, 14) : hash === 9 ? shadeColor(TERRAIN_COLORS.grass, -12) : mixColor(TERRAIN_COLORS.grass, 0xcabf7e, 0.5);
1893:     graphic
1894:       .poly([point.x - 12, point.y - 2, point.x - 2, point.y - 7, point.x + 10, point.y - 1, point.x, point.y + 5], true)
1895:       .fill({ color: patch, alpha: 0.1 });
1896:   }
1897: 
1898:   if (hash === 3 || hash === 17) {
1899:     graphic
1900:       .moveTo(point.x - 13, point.y + 1)
1901:       .lineTo(point.x - 2, point.y + 6)
1902:       .lineTo(point.x + 12, point.y)
1903:       .stroke({ color: 0xd9edaf, alpha: 0.09, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1904:   }
1905: 
1906:   if (hash === 6 || hash === 25) {
1907:     graphic
1908:       .poly([point.x + 4, point.y - 4, point.x + 13, point.y - 1, point.x + 6, point.y + 3, point.x - 1, point.y], true)
1909:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(TERRAIN_COLORS.grass, -18), alpha: 0.08 });
1910:   }
1911: }

1913: function drawTerrainParcelComposition(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint) {
1914:   const composition = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainComposition;
1915:   const profile = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainProfile;
1916:   if (!composition || composition === "shell_boundary") return;
1917: 
1918:   const hash = (tile.position.x * 37 + tile.position.y * 41 + tile.variant * 7) % 31;
1919:   const civic = composition === "civic_focus_field" || profile === "landmark_civic_ground";
1920:   const commercial = composition === "commercial_apron_field";
1921:   const waterfront = composition === "waterfront_edge_strata";
1922:   const park = composition === "park_basin";
1923:   const draft = composition === "hidden_draft_field";
1924:   const quiet = composition === "quiet_field";
1925:   const parcelColor = civic ? 0xe5d7ad : commercial ? 0xddc798 : park ? 0xbfdc91 : draft ? 0xd2cf98 : 0xc9dea0;
1926:   const seamColor = civic || commercial ? 0xf5e9c9 : park ? 0xeaf1bb : draft ? 0xf2dfb4 : 0xe6efbd;
1927:   const shadowColor = civic || commercial ? 0x7c765f : 0x587f4d;
1928: 
1929:   // Quiet outer fields still need a whisper of mowed-field weave so the map
1930:   // edge reads as tended ground instead of an empty board â€” one facet per
1931:   // ~4 tiles, at half the alpha of the fabric fields.
1932:   if (quiet && hash % 4 !== 0) return;
1933:   const quietScale = quiet ? 0.55 : 1;
1934: 
1935:   if (hash % 3 === 0) {
1936:     graphic
1937:       .poly(
1938:         [
1939:           point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.36,
1940:           point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02,
1941:           point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.08,
1942:           point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.18,
1943:           point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.28,
1944:           point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02,
1945:           point.x,
1946:           point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.14,
1947:         ],
1948:         true,
1949:       )
1950:       .fill({ color: parcelColor, alpha: (civic ? 0.105 : commercial ? 0.09 : draft ? 0.07 : 0.075) * quietScale });
1951:   }
1952: 
1953:   if (hash === 5 || hash === 13 || hash === 22 || (quiet && hash % 8 === 4)) {
1954:     graphic
1955:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.42, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.04)
1956:       .lineTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.1, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.2)
1957:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.24, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.04)
1958:       .stroke({ color: seamColor, alpha: (civic || commercial ? 0.18 : 0.12) * quietScale, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1959:   }
1960: 
1961:   if ((civic || commercial) && (hash === 2 || hash === 18)) {
1962:     graphic
1963:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.26, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.12)
1964:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.24, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.12)
1965:       .stroke({ color: shadowColor, alpha: 0.08, width: 1.2, cap: "round" });
1966:   }
1967: 
1968:   if (park && (hash === 1 || hash === 15)) {
1969:     graphic
1970:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.28, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.08)
1971:       .lineTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.02, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.08)
1972:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.24, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.06)
1973:       .stroke({ color: 0xf0dba8, alpha: 0.16, width: 1.6, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1974:   }
1975: 
1976:   if (waterfront && hash % 4 === 0) {
1977:     graphic
1978:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.34, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02)
1979:       .lineTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.04, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.18)
1980:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.3, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02)
1981:           .stroke({ color: 0xd7f8ff, alpha: 0.26, width: 1.45, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1982:   }
1983: }

1985: function drawTerrainElevationChunkFace(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, color: number) {
1986:   const elevation = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainElevation;
1987:   const chunkEdge = tile.visualGrammar?.chunkEdge ?? "none";
1988:   if (!elevation || (elevation === "flat_field" && chunkEdge === "none") || elevation === "shell_flat") return;
1989: 
1990:   const depth = terrainElevationDepth(elevation, chunkEdge);
1991:   // Elevation risers obey the scene sun: the lower-left face is lit, the
1992:   // lower-right face is in shade, so terrain steps read as real height.
1993:   const leftShade = sunlitColor(shadeColor(color, elevation === "water_edge_cut" ? -16 : -8), "sun");
1994:   const rightShade = sunlitColor(color, "shade");
1995:   const faceAlpha =
1996:     elevation === "hidden_draft_shelf"
1997:       ? 0.3
1998:       : elevation === "water_edge_cut"
1999:         ? 0.58
2000:         : elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf"
2001:           ? 0.46
2002:           : 0.38;
2003: 
2004:   if (depth > 0) {
2005:     graphic
2006:       .poly(
2007:         [
2008:           point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5,
2009:           point.y,
2010:           point.x,
2011:           point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5,
2012:           point.x,
2013:           point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5 + depth,
2014:           point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5,
2015:           point.y + depth,
2016:         ],
2017:         true,
2018:       )
2019:       .fill({ color: leftShade, alpha: faceAlpha * 0.8 });
2020:     graphic
2021:       .poly(
2022:         [
2023:           point.x,
2024:           point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5,
2025:           point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.5,
2026:           point.y,
2027:           point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.5,
2028:           point.y + depth,
2029:           point.x,
2030:           point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5 + depth,
2031:         ],
2032:         true,
2033:       )
2034:       .fill({ color: rightShade, alpha: faceAlpha });
2035:   }
2036: 
2037:   if (chunkEdge !== "none") {
2038:     const edgeColor =
2039:       chunkEdge === "waterfront_bank_edge"
2040:         ? 0xd7f8ff
2041:         : chunkEdge === "park_basin_edge"
2042:           ? 0xe7dca9
2043:           : chunkEdge === "hidden_draft_boundary"
2044:             ? 0xd9c28b
2045:             : 0xf2e5bd;
2046:     const edgeAlpha = chunkEdge === "waterfront_bank_edge" ? 0.24 : chunkEdge === "world_edge" ? 0.1 : chunkEdge === "parcel_cluster_edge" ? 0.13 : 0.18;
2047:     graphic
2048:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y + depth * 0.45)
2049:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5 + depth * 0.65)
2050:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y + depth * 0.45)
2051:       .stroke({ color: edgeColor, alpha: edgeAlpha, width: chunkEdge === "waterfront_bank_edge" ? 1.4 : 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2052:   }
2053: }
2054: 
2055: function terrainElevationDepth(elevation: NonNullable<CityWorldTerrainTile["visualGrammar"]>["terrainElevation"], chunkEdge: NonNullable<CityWorldTerrainTile["visualGrammar"]>["chunkEdge"]) {
2056:   if (elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf") return 5.5;
2057:   if (elevation === "raised_parcel_shelf") return 4.2;
2058:   if (elevation === "commercial_slab_field") return 4.8;
2059:   if (elevation === "park_basin_shelf") return 3.2;
2060:   if (elevation === "water_edge_cut") return 7.4;
2061:   if (elevation === "hidden_draft_shelf") return 4;
2062:   return chunkEdge && chunkEdge !== "none" ? 2.4 : 0;
2063: }

2065: function drawDraftTerrainFacet(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint) {
2066:   const hash = (tile.position.x * 31 + tile.position.y * 17 + tile.variant * 13) % 23;
2067: 
2068:   if (tile.kind === "grass" && (hash === 2 || hash === 11 || hash === 19)) {
2069:     graphic
2070:       .poly([point.x - 14, point.y - 1, point.x - 5, point.y - 6, point.x + 8, point.y - 1, point.x - 1, point.y + 5], true)
2071:       .fill({ color: 0xc7cf8d, alpha: 0.06 });
2072:   }
2073: 
2074:   if (tile.kind === "plaza" && hash % 4 === 0) {
2075:     graphic
2076:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.34, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02)
2077:       .lineTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.02, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.16)
2078:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.32, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.01)
2079:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.2, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.18)
2080:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.18, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.02)
2081:       .stroke({ color: 0xf2dfb4, alpha: 0.18, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2082:   }
2083: 
2084:   if (tile.kind === "park" && hash % 5 === 0) {
2085:     graphic.circle(point.x + 4, point.y - 1, 1.6).fill({ color: 0xdde6aa, alpha: 0.16 });
2086:   }
2087: }

2089: function drawShellTerrainFacet(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint) {
2090:   const hash = Math.abs((tile.position.x * 19 + tile.position.y * 29 + tile.variant * 7) % 17);
2091: 
2092:   if (hash % 3 === 0) {
2093:     graphic
2094:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.28, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.04)
2095:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.12)
2096:       .lineTo(point.x + TILE_WIDTH * 0.28, point.y - TILE_HEIGHT * 0.04)
2097:       .stroke({ color: 0xf1ead2, alpha: 0.15, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2098:   }
2099: 
2100:   if (tile.kind === "grass" && hash === 4) {
2101:     graphic
2102:       .poly([point.x - 12, point.y, point.x - 2, point.y - 5, point.x + 12, point.y, point.x + 2, point.y + 5], true)
2103:       .fill({ color: 0xd5dcc1, alpha: 0.11 });
2104:   }
2105: }
2106: 
2107: // The road network renders as ~11 PASS Graphics instead of ~10 Graphics per
2108: // segment: every segment strokes into shared per-pass Graphics, added in pass
2109: // order. Cross-segment layering becomes seamless by construction â€” segment
2110: // N's shadow can no longer smear over segment N-1's finished surface, because
2111: // ALL shadows draw under ALL surfaces.
2112: type RoadPassSet = {
2113:   shadow: Graphics;
2114:   sideFace: Graphics;
2115:   curb: Graphics;
2116:   bed: Graphics;
2117:   surface: Graphics;
2118:   bevels: Graphics;
2119:   seams: Graphics;
2120:   material: Graphics;
2121:   dashes: Graphics;
2122:   joints: Graphics;
2123:   crosswalks: Graphics;
2124: };
2125: 
2126: function drawRoadNetwork(layer: Container, roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]) {
2127:   const passes: RoadPassSet = {
2128:     shadow: new Graphics(),
2129:     sideFace: new Graphics(),
2130:     curb: new Graphics(),
2131:     bed: new Graphics(),
2132:     surface: new Graphics(),
2133:     bevels: new Graphics(),
2134:     seams: new Graphics(),
2135:     material: new Graphics(),
2136:     dashes: new Graphics(),
2137:     joints: new Graphics(),
2138:     crosswalks: new Graphics(),
2139:   };
2140:   const physicalRoads = roads.filter((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile !== "painted");
2141:   for (const road of physicalRoads) drawRoadSegmentModule(passes, road);
2142: 
2143:   const joints = collectRoadJoints(physicalRoads);
2144:   for (const joint of joints.sort((a, b) => a.point.x + a.point.y - (b.point.x + b.point.y))) {
2145:     if (joint.roads.length > 1 || joint.roads.some((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "apron")) {
2146:       drawRoadJointModule(passes.joints, joint);
2147:     } else if (joint.roads.length === 1 && resolveRoadContact(joint.roads[0] as CityWorldRoadSegment).profile === "embedded") {
2148:       drawRoadEndCap(passes.joints, joint);
2149:     }
2150:   }
2151: 
2152:   for (const road of roads.filter((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "painted")) drawCrosswalkRoad(passes.crosswalks, road);
2153: 
2154:   layer.addChild(
2155:     passes.shadow,
2156:     passes.sideFace,
2157:     passes.curb,
2158:     passes.bed,
2159:     passes.surface,
2160:     passes.bevels,
2161:     passes.seams,
2162:     passes.material,
2163:     passes.dashes,
2164:     passes.joints,
2165:     passes.crosswalks,
2166:   );
2167: }
2168: 
2169: // Dead-end streets stop looking sheared: a rounded curb stub + surface disk
2170: // caps the open end.
2171: function drawRoadEndCap(g: Graphics, joint: RoadJoint) {
2172:   const road = joint.roads[0];
2173:   if (!road) return;
2174:   const point = project(joint.point);
2175:   const radius = road.width * 8.2;
2176:   g.ellipse(point.x, point.y + 1, radius, radius * 0.52).fill({ color: 0xd6c996, alpha: 0.72 });
2177:   g.ellipse(point.x, point.y, radius * 0.78, radius * 0.4).fill({ color: 0x58635f, alpha: 0.95 });
2178:   g.ellipse(point.x, point.y - 1, radius * 0.6, radius * 0.3).fill({ color: 0x68736d, alpha: 0.7 });
2179: }

2181: function drawRoadSegmentModule(passes: RoadPassSet, road: CityWorldRoadSegment) {
2182:   const start = project(road.from);
2183:   const end = project(road.to);
2184:   const baseWidth = road.width * 15.2;
2185:   const contact = resolveRoadContact(road);
2186:   const draftRoad = contact.tone === "draft";
2187:   const shellRoad = contact.tone === "shell";
2188:   const apron = contact.profile === "apron";
2189:   const cap = apron ? "round" : "butt";
2190:   passes.shadow
2191:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y + 7)
2192:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y + 7)
2193:     .stroke({ color: 0x263a34, alpha: shellRoad ? 0.18 : draftRoad ? 0.2 : 0.16, width: baseWidth + (draftRoad || shellRoad ? 15 : 13), cap, join: "round" });
2194:   passes.sideFace
2195:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y + 4)
2196:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y + 4)
2197:     .stroke({
2198:       color: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0x8d8c7d : 0x59615d) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0x8b846d : 0x4d554d) : apron ? 0x7c806f : 0x46514c,
2199:       alpha: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0.48 : 0.62) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0.44 : 0.56) : apron ? 0.34 : 0.48,
2200:       width: baseWidth + 8,
2201:       cap,
2202:       join: "round",
2203:     });
2204: 
2205:   passes.curb
2206:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y)
2207:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y)
2208:     .stroke({
2209:       color: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0xc9c0a4 : 0xd4ceb2) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0xc4b182 : 0xd8c28b) : apron ? 0xc1ae88 : 0xd6c996,
2210:       alpha: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0.58 : 0.76) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0.58 : 0.82) : apron ? 0.48 : 0.78,
2211:       width: baseWidth + 7,
2212:       cap,
2213:       join: "round",
2214:     });
2215:   passes.bed
2216:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y + 1)
2217:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y + 1)
2218:     .stroke({
2219:       color: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0x8f9185 : 0x646c67) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0x8e8c7d : 0x555e58) : apron ? 0x858b7e : 0x58635f,
2220:       alpha: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0.76 : 0.88) : apron ? 0.82 : 0.98,
2221:       width: baseWidth + 1,
2222:       cap,
2223:       join: "round",
2224:     });
2225:   passes.surface
2226:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y - 1)
2227:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y - 1)
2228:     .stroke({
2229:       color: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0xaaa58e : 0x7c8278) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0xa09c87 : 0x697069) : apron ? 0x969b8b : 0x68736d,
2230:       alpha: shellRoad ? (apron ? 0.62 : 0.76) : draftRoad ? (apron ? 0.62 : 0.82) : apron ? 0.58 : 0.78,
2231:       width: Math.max(4, baseWidth - 6),
2232:       cap,
2233:       join: "round",
2234:     });
2235:   drawRoadEdgeBevels(passes.bevels, start, end, baseWidth, apron);
2236:   drawRoadModuleSeams(passes.seams, start, end, baseWidth, apron);
2237:   if (draftRoad) drawDraftRoadMaterial(passes.material, start, end, baseWidth, contact);
2238:   else if (shellRoad) drawShellRoadMaterial(passes.material, start, end, baseWidth, contact);
2239:   else drawPublicRoadMaterial(passes.material, start, end, baseWidth, contact);
2240: 
2241:   if (contact.laneMarking === "avenue_dash") {
2242:     drawDashedLine(passes.dashes, start, end, 9, 12, shellRoad ? 0xded8bb : draftRoad ? 0xe9d59c : 0xf3e3a4, 1.45, shellRoad ? 0.24 : draftRoad ? 0.28 : 0.38);
2243:   } else if (contact.laneMarking === "street_dash") {
2244:     drawDashedLine(passes.dashes, start, end, 6, 10, shellRoad ? 0xded8bb : draftRoad ? 0xe9d59c : 0xf3e3a4, 1.1, shellRoad ? 0.24 : draftRoad ? 0.28 : 0.38);
2245:   } else if (contact.laneMarking === "apron_dash") {
2246:     drawDashedLine(passes.dashes, start, end, 4, 12, 0xe8dfbd, 0.9, 0.18);
2247:   }
2248: }

2250: function drawShellRoadMaterial(g: Graphics, start: ProjectedPoint, end: ProjectedPoint, roadWidth: number, contact: CityWorldRoadContactGrammar) {
2251:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2252:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2253:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
2254:   if (length <= 0 || contact.profile === "painted") return;
2255: 
2256:   const ux = dx / length;
2257:   const uy = dy / length;
2258:   const nx = -dy / length;
2259:   const ny = dx / length;
2260:   const edgeInset = roadWidth * 0.45;
2261:   g
2262:     .moveTo(start.x + nx * edgeInset, start.y + ny * edgeInset - 1)
2263:     .lineTo(end.x + nx * edgeInset, end.y + ny * edgeInset - 1)
2264:     .moveTo(start.x - nx * edgeInset, start.y - ny * edgeInset + 2)
2265:     .lineTo(end.x - nx * edgeInset, end.y - ny * edgeInset + 2)
2266:     .stroke({ color: 0xf1ead2, alpha: 0.16, width: 1.2, cap: "butt" });
2267: 
2268:   const step = contact.profile === "apron" ? 34 : 44;
2269:   let ribCount = 0;
2270:   for (let cursor = step * 0.65; cursor < length - step * 0.35; cursor += step) {
2271:     const centerX = start.x + ux * cursor;
2272:     const centerY = start.y + uy * cursor;
2273:     g
2274:       .moveTo(centerX - nx * roadWidth * 0.22 - ux * 3, centerY - ny * roadWidth * 0.22 - uy * 3)
2275:       .lineTo(centerX + nx * roadWidth * 0.22 + ux * 3, centerY + ny * roadWidth * 0.22 + uy * 3);
2276:     ribCount += 1;
2277:   }
2278:   if (ribCount > 0) g.stroke({ color: 0x3f4945, alpha: 0.1, width: 1, cap: "round" });
2279: }
2280: 
2281: function drawDraftRoadMaterial(g: Graphics, start: ProjectedPoint, end: ProjectedPoint, roadWidth: number, contact: CityWorldRoadContactGrammar) {
2282:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2283:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2284:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
2285:   if (length <= 0 || contact.profile === "painted") return;
2286: 
2287:   const apron = contact.profile === "apron";
2288:   const ux = dx / length;
2289:   const uy = dy / length;
2290:   const nx = -dy / length;
2291:   const ny = dx / length;
2292:   const step = apron ? 34 : 42;
2293:   let gritCount = 0;
2294:   for (let cursor = step * 0.45; cursor < length - step * 0.2; cursor += step) {
2295:     const side = Math.floor(cursor / step) % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
2296:     const centerX = start.x + ux * cursor + nx * roadWidth * 0.18 * side;
2297:     const centerY = start.y + uy * cursor + ny * roadWidth * 0.18 * side;
2298:     g
2299:       .moveTo(centerX - ux * 7, centerY - uy * 7)
2300:       .lineTo(centerX + ux * 8, centerY + uy * 8);
2301:     gritCount += 1;
2302:   }
2303:   if (gritCount > 0) g.stroke({ color: 0x3e4944, alpha: apron ? 0.08 : 0.12, width: 1.1, cap: "round" });
2304: 
2305:   g
2306:     .moveTo(start.x + nx * roadWidth * 0.48, start.y + ny * roadWidth * 0.48)
2307:     .lineTo(end.x + nx * roadWidth * 0.48, end.y + ny * roadWidth * 0.48)
2308:     .moveTo(start.x - nx * roadWidth * 0.48, start.y - ny * roadWidth * 0.48 + 2)
2309:     .lineTo(end.x - nx * roadWidth * 0.48, end.y - ny * roadWidth * 0.48 + 2)
2310:     .stroke({ color: 0xf1ddad, alpha: 0.18, width: 1.3, cap: "butt" });
2311: }

2313: function drawPublicRoadMaterial(g: Graphics, start: ProjectedPoint, end: ProjectedPoint, roadWidth: number, contact: CityWorldRoadContactGrammar) {
2314:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2315:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2316:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
2317:   if (length <= 0 || contact.profile === "painted") return;
2318: 
2319:   const apron = contact.profile === "apron";
2320:   const ux = dx / length;
2321:   const uy = dy / length;
2322:   const nx = -dy / length;
2323:   const ny = dx / length;
2324:   const step = apron ? 38 : 50;
2325:   const edgeInset = roadWidth * (apron ? 0.44 : 0.48);
2326: 
2327:   // Old child order preserved: bed face under curb lift under slab wear.
2328:   g
2329:     .moveTo(start.x - nx * roadWidth * 0.34, start.y - ny * roadWidth * 0.34 + 4)
2330:     .lineTo(end.x - nx * roadWidth * 0.34, end.y - ny * roadWidth * 0.34 + 4)
2331:     .stroke({ color: 0x253b35, alpha: apron ? 0.08 : 0.12, width: Math.max(2, roadWidth * 0.08), cap: "butt" });
2332: 
2333:   g
2334:     .moveTo(start.x + nx * edgeInset, start.y + ny * edgeInset - 1.5)
2335:     .lineTo(end.x + nx * edgeInset, end.y + ny * edgeInset - 1.5)
2336:     .moveTo(start.x - nx * edgeInset, start.y - ny * edgeInset + 2.5)
2337:     .lineTo(end.x - nx * edgeInset, end.y - ny * edgeInset + 2.5)
2338:     .stroke({ color: apron ? 0xf1ddb2 : 0xe8d49f, alpha: apron ? 0.12 : 0.16, width: 1.2, cap: "butt" });
2339: 
2340:   let wearCount = 0;
2341:   for (let cursor = step * 0.7; cursor < length - step * 0.45; cursor += step) {
2342:     const side = Math.floor(cursor / step) % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
2343:     const centerX = start.x + ux * cursor + nx * roadWidth * 0.16 * side;
2344:     const centerY = start.y + uy * cursor + ny * roadWidth * 0.16 * side;
2345:     g
2346:       .moveTo(centerX - ux * 8, centerY - uy * 8)
2347:       .lineTo(centerX + ux * 11, centerY + uy * 11);
2348:     wearCount += 1;
2349:   }
2350:   if (wearCount > 0) g.stroke({ color: 0x3f4d47, alpha: apron ? 0.055 : 0.075, width: 1.05, cap: "round" });
2351: }

2353: function drawCrosswalkRoad(g: Graphics, road: CityWorldRoadSegment) {
2354:   const start = project(road.from);
2355:   const end = project(road.to);
2356:   const baseWidth = road.width * 15.2;
2357:   const draftRoad = resolveRoadContact(road).tone === "draft";
2358:   g
2359:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y + 5)
2360:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y + 5)
2361:     .stroke({ color: 0x263a34, alpha: draftRoad ? 0.16 : 0.12, width: baseWidth + 8, cap: "butt", join: "round" });
2362:   g
2363:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y + 1)
2364:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y + 1)
2365:     .stroke({ color: draftRoad ? 0xe3d2ad : 0xeadfc7, alpha: draftRoad ? 0.78 : 0.86, width: baseWidth + 4, cap: "butt", join: "round" });
2366:   g
2367:     .moveTo(start.x, start.y)
2368:     .lineTo(end.x, end.y)
2369:     .stroke({ color: draftRoad ? 0xf0e4c6 : 0xf8f0df, alpha: draftRoad ? 0.72 : 0.84, width: Math.max(3, baseWidth - 1), cap: "butt", join: "round" });
2370:   drawCrosswalkStripes(g, start, end, baseWidth);
2371: }

2373: function drawCrosswalkStripes(g: Graphics, start: ProjectedPoint, end: ProjectedPoint, roadWidth: number) {
2374:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2375:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2376:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
2377:   const stepCount = Math.max(3, Math.floor(length / 9));
2378:   const nx = -dy / length;
2379:   const ny = dx / length;
2380:   const ux = dx / length;
2381:   const uy = dy / length;
2382: 
2383:   for (let index = 0; index <= stepCount; index += 1) {
2384:     const centerX = start.x + ux * ((length / stepCount) * index);
2385:     const centerY = start.y + uy * ((length / stepCount) * index);
2386:     g
2387:       .moveTo(centerX - nx * roadWidth * 0.42, centerY - ny * roadWidth * 0.42)
2388:       .lineTo(centerX + nx * roadWidth * 0.42, centerY + ny * roadWidth * 0.42);
2389:   }
2390: 
2391:   g.stroke({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.62, width: 2.2, cap: "butt" });
2392: }

2394: function drawRoadEdgeBevels(g: Graphics, start: ProjectedPoint, end: ProjectedPoint, roadWidth: number, driveway: boolean) {
2395:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2396:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2397:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
2398:   if (length <= 0) return;
2399: 
2400:   const nx = -dy / length;
2401:   const ny = dx / length;
2402:   const inset = roadWidth * 0.42;
2403:   g
2404:     .moveTo(start.x + nx * inset, start.y + ny * inset - 1)
2405:     .lineTo(end.x + nx * inset, end.y + ny * inset - 1)
2406:     .moveTo(start.x - nx * inset, start.y - ny * inset + 2)
2407:     .lineTo(end.x - nx * inset, end.y - ny * inset + 2)
2408:     .stroke({ color: driveway ? 0xd9d0ae : 0x87928a, alpha: driveway ? 0.2 : 0.24, width: 1.1, cap: "butt" });
2409: }
