2411: function drawRoadModuleSeams(g: Graphics, start: ProjectedPoint, end: ProjectedPoint, roadWidth: number, driveway: boolean) {
2412:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2413:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2414:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
2415:   if (length <= 72) return;
2416: 
2417:   const ux = dx / length;
2418:   const uy = dy / length;
2419:   const nx = -dy / length;
2420:   const ny = dx / length;
2421:   const step = driveway ? 42 : 54;
2422:   const seamHalf = roadWidth * (driveway ? 0.24 : 0.34);
2423:   let seamCount = 0;
2424: 
2425:   for (let cursor = step; cursor < length - step * 0.55; cursor += step) {
2426:     const centerX = start.x + ux * cursor;
2427:     const centerY = start.y + uy * cursor;
2428:     g
2429:       .moveTo(centerX - nx * seamHalf, centerY - ny * seamHalf + 1)
2430:       .lineTo(centerX + nx * seamHalf, centerY + ny * seamHalf + 1);
2431:     seamCount += 1;
2432:   }
2433: 
2434:   if (seamCount > 0) g.stroke({ color: driveway ? 0xd9d0ae : 0x9aa49b, alpha: driveway ? 0.08 : 0.1, width: 1, cap: "butt" });
2435: }
2436: 
2437: function drawDashedLine(
2438:   g: Graphics,
2439:   start: ProjectedPoint,
2440:   end: ProjectedPoint,
2441:   dashLength: number,
2442:   gapLength: number,
2443:   color: number,
2444:   width: number,
2445:   alpha: number,
2446: ) {
2447:   const dx = end.x - start.x;
2448:   const dy = end.y - start.y;
2449:   const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
2450:   if (length <= 0) return;
2451: 
2452:   const ux = dx / length;
2453:   const uy = dy / length;
2454:   let cursor = gapLength * 0.5;
2455:   let dashCount = 0;
2456: 
2457:   while (cursor < length) {
2458:     const next = Math.min(cursor + dashLength, length);
2459:     g
2460:       .moveTo(start.x + ux * cursor, start.y + uy * cursor)
2461:       .lineTo(start.x + ux * next, start.y + uy * next);
2462:     cursor = next + gapLength;
2463:     dashCount += 1;
2464:   }
2465: 
2466:   if (dashCount > 0) g.stroke({ color, alpha, width, cap: "round" });
2467: }

2469: function collectRoadJoints(roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]): RoadJoint[] {
2470:   const joints = new Map<string, RoadJoint>();
2471:   const addJoint = (point: CityWorldPoint, road: CityWorldRoadSegment) => {
2472:     const key = roadJointKey(point);
2473:     const existing = joints.get(key);
2474:     if (existing) {
2475:       if (!existing.roads.includes(road)) existing.roads.push(road);
2476:       return;
2477:     }
2478:     joints.set(key, { point: { x: point.x, y: point.y, z: point.z }, roads: [road] });
2479:   };
2480: 
2481:   for (const road of roads) {
2482:     addJoint(road.from, road);
2483:     addJoint(road.to, road);
2484:   }
2485: 
2486:   for (let outer = 0; outer < roads.length; outer += 1) {
2487:     for (let inner = outer + 1; inner < roads.length; inner += 1) {
2488:       const first = roads[outer];
2489:       const second = roads[inner];
2490:       if (!first || !second) continue;
2491:       const point = axisAlignedRoadIntersection(first, second);
2492:       if (!point) continue;
2493:       addJoint(point, first);
2494:       addJoint(point, second);
2495:     }
2496:   }
2497: 
2498:   return Array.from(joints.values());
2499: }

2501: function drawRoadJointModule(g: Graphics, joint: RoadJoint) {
2502:   const point = project(joint.point);
2503:   const maxWidth = Math.max(...joint.roads.map((road) => road.width));
2504:   const directions = roadDirectionsAtJoint(joint);
2505:   const contacts = joint.roads.map(resolveRoadContact);
2506:   const major = joint.roads.some((road) => road.kind === "avenue");
2507:   const drivewayOnly = contacts.every((contact) => contact.profile === "apron");
2508:   const draftJoint = contacts.some((contact) => contact.tone === "draft");
2509:   const radius = maxWidth * (major ? 15 : 13.5) + (directions.size >= 3 ? 7 : 4);
2510:   const width = drivewayOnly ? radius * 1.6 : radius * 1.9;
2511:   const height = drivewayOnly ? radius * 0.88 : radius * 1.02;
2512:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + 5 }, width * 1.05, height * 1.08), 0x263a34, drivewayOnly ? 0.1 : draftJoint ? 0.18 : 0.15, 0x263a34, 0);
2513:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + 2 }, width, height), drivewayOnly ? 0xc1ae88 : draftJoint ? 0xd5bf88 : 0xd6c996, drivewayOnly ? 0.62 : draftJoint ? 0.8 : 0.8, 0x6d684f, 0.18);
2514:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints(point, width * 0.8, height * 0.7), drivewayOnly ? 0x858b7e : draftJoint ? 0x59635c : 0x5d6862, drivewayOnly ? 0.78 : 0.96, 0x3f4b46, 0.1);
2515:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y - 1 }, width * 0.58, height * 0.46), drivewayOnly ? 0x969b8b : draftJoint ? 0x71796f : 0x6b7670, drivewayOnly ? 0.34 : draftJoint ? 0.42 : 0.46, 0xffffff, 0);
2516:   drawRoadJointBlockwork(g, point, width, height, drivewayOnly, draftJoint);
2517:   drawDrivewayJoinThroats(g, joint, point, maxWidth);
2518: 
2519:   if (directions.size >= 3) {
2520:     appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y - 2 }, width * 0.34, height * 0.25), draftJoint ? 0x858b7f : 0x818b83, draftJoint ? 0.22 : 0.26, 0xffffff, 0);
2521:   }
2522: }
2523: 
2524: function drawRoadJointBlockwork(g: Graphics, point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number, drivewayOnly: boolean, draftJoint: boolean) {
2525:   const edgeAlpha = drivewayOnly ? 0.12 : draftJoint ? 0.18 : 0.15;
2526:   const centerAlpha = drivewayOnly ? 0.08 : draftJoint ? 0.12 : 0.1;
2527:   g
2528:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.36, point.y + height * 0.08)
2529:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.22)
2530:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.1)
2531:     .moveTo(point.x + width * 0.36, point.y + height * 0.08)
2532:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.22)
2533:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.1)
2534:     .stroke({ color: 0xe6d09a, alpha: edgeAlpha, width: 1.15, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2535: 
2536:   g
2537:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.14, point.y - height * 0.06)
2538:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.08)
2539:     .moveTo(point.x + width * 0.15, point.y - height * 0.04)
2540:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.1, point.y + height * 0.1)
2541:     .stroke({ color: 0xf5e5bb, alpha: centerAlpha, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2542: }

2544: function drawDrivewayJoinThroats(g: Graphics, joint: RoadJoint, point: ProjectedPoint, maxRoadWidth: number) {
2545:   const hasMainRoad = joint.roads.some((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "embedded");
2546:   if (!hasMainRoad) return;
2547: 
2548:   const driveways = joint.roads.filter((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "apron");
2549:   for (const driveway of driveways) {
2550:     const opposite = sameCityPoint(joint.point, driveway.from) ? driveway.to : driveway.from;
2551:     const target = project(opposite);
2552:     const dx = target.x - point.x;
2553:     const dy = target.y - point.y;
2554:     const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
2555:     const ux = dx / length;
2556:     const uy = dy / length;
2557:     const throatLength = Math.max(18, maxRoadWidth * 13);
2558:     g
2559:       .moveTo(point.x + ux * 2, point.y + uy * 2)
2560:       .lineTo(point.x + ux * throatLength, point.y + uy * throatLength)
2561:       .stroke({ color: 0xd8c79d, alpha: 0.28, width: 7, cap: "butt" });
2562:     g
2563:       .moveTo(point.x + ux * 5, point.y + uy * 5 + 1)
2564:       .lineTo(point.x + ux * (throatLength - 2), point.y + uy * (throatLength - 2) + 1)
2565:       .stroke({ color: 0x737c74, alpha: 0.34, width: 3.5, cap: "butt" });
2566:   }
2567: }
2568: 
2569: function roadDirectionsAtJoint(joint: RoadJoint): Set<string> {
2570:   const directions = new Set<string>();
2571:   for (const road of joint.roads) {
2572:     if (sameCoordinate(road.from.y, road.to.y)) {
2573:       if (road.from.x < joint.point.x - 0.001 || road.to.x < joint.point.x - 0.001) directions.add("west");
2574:       if (road.from.x > joint.point.x + 0.001 || road.to.x > joint.point.x + 0.001) directions.add("east");
2575:     } else if (sameCoordinate(road.from.x, road.to.x)) {
2576:       if (road.from.y < joint.point.y - 0.001 || road.to.y < joint.point.y - 0.001) directions.add("north");
2577:       if (road.from.y > joint.point.y + 0.001 || road.to.y > joint.point.y + 0.001) directions.add("south");
2578:     } else {
2579:       directions.add(`${Math.sign(road.from.x - joint.point.x)},${Math.sign(road.from.y - joint.point.y)}`);
2580:       directions.add(`${Math.sign(road.to.x - joint.point.x)},${Math.sign(road.to.y - joint.point.y)}`);
2581:     }
2582:   }
2583:   return directions;
2584: }
2585: 
2586: function sameCityPoint(first: CityWorldPoint, second: CityWorldPoint): boolean {
2587:   return sameCoordinate(first.x, second.x) && sameCoordinate(first.y, second.y) && sameCoordinate(first.z ?? 0, second.z ?? 0);
2588: }
2589: 
2590: function axisAlignedRoadIntersection(first: CityWorldRoadSegment, second: CityWorldRoadSegment): CityWorldPoint | undefined {
2591:   const firstHorizontal = sameCoordinate(first.from.y, first.to.y);
2592:   const firstVertical = sameCoordinate(first.from.x, first.to.x);
2593:   const secondHorizontal = sameCoordinate(second.from.y, second.to.y);
2594:   const secondVertical = sameCoordinate(second.from.x, second.to.x);
2595: 
2596:   if (firstHorizontal && secondVertical) {
2597:     const point = { x: second.from.x, y: first.from.y, z: 0 };
2598:     if (pointInsideRoad(point, first) && pointInsideRoad(point, second)) return point;
2599:   }
2600:   if (firstVertical && secondHorizontal) {
2601:     const point = { x: first.from.x, y: second.from.y, z: 0 };
2602:     if (pointInsideRoad(point, first) && pointInsideRoad(point, second)) return point;
2603:   }
2604:   return undefined;
2605: }
2606: 
2607: function pointInsideRoad(point: CityWorldPoint, road: CityWorldRoadSegment) {
2608:   return betweenInclusive(point.x, road.from.x, road.to.x) && betweenInclusive(point.y, road.from.y, road.to.y);
2609: }
2610: 
2611: function betweenInclusive(value: number, first: number, second: number) {
2612:   return value >= Math.min(first, second) - 0.001 && value <= Math.max(first, second) + 0.001;
2613: }
2614: 
2615: function sameCoordinate(first: number, second: number) {
2616:   return Math.abs(first - second) < 0.001;
2617: }
2618: 
2619: function roadJointKey(point: CityWorldPoint) {
2620:   return `${point.x.toFixed(2)}:${point.y.toFixed(2)}:${(point.z ?? 0).toFixed(2)}`;
2621: }
2622: 
2623: function drawLot(g: Graphics, lot: CityWorldLot) {
2624:   const point = project(lot.position);
2625:   const width = lot.width * TILE_WIDTH;
2626:   const height = lot.depth * TILE_HEIGHT;
2627:   const lotContact = resolveLotContact(lot);
2628:   const draftLot = lotContact.tone === "draft";
2629:   const shellLot = lotContact.tone === "shell";
2630:   const mutedLot = draftLot || shellLot;
2631:   const quietPad = lotContact.profile === "foundation";
2632:   const color = shellLot ? SHELL_LOT_COLORS[lot.kind] : draftLot ? DRAFT_LOT_COLORS[lot.kind] : LOT_COLORS[lot.kind];
2633:   // Lots are ground material, not tinted film: near-opaque so aprons and
2634:   // yards read as real surfaces instead of a translucent wash over grass.
2635:   const lotAlpha = shellLot ? (quietPad ? 0.82 : 0.86) : draftLot ? (quietPad ? 0.84 : 0.86) : lotContact.profile === "shore" ? 0.55 : quietPad ? 0.94 : 0.96;
2636:   const lotContactProfile = lot.visualGrammar?.contactProfile ?? "parcel_pad_shadow";
2637:   const contactAlpha = shellLot
2638:     ? lotContact.profile === "green"
2639:       ? 0.12
2640:       : 0.16
2641:     : draftLot
2642:     ? lotContact.profile === "green"
2643:       ? 0.1
2644:       : 0.18
2645:     : lotContactProfile === "landmark_base_shadow"
2646:       ? 0.17
2647:       : lotContactProfile === "soft_ground_shadow"
2648:         ? 0.09
2649:         : quietPad
2650:           ? 0.14
2651:           : 0.13;
2652:   const contactSpread = lotContactProfile === "landmark_base_shadow" ? 1.1 : lotContactProfile === "soft_ground_shadow" ? 1.12 : 1.04;
2653:   // Waterfront lots have real water terrain beneath them; a lot slab on top
2654:   // reads as a glass sheet floating on the shore. Water carries the surface,
2655:   // the lot contributes nothing.
2656:   if (lotContact.profile === "shore") return;
2657:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + 6 }, width * contactSpread, height * (contactSpread + 0.04)), 0x23342e, contactAlpha, 0x23342e, 0);
2658:   if (!mutedLot && lotContactProfile === "landmark_base_shadow") {
2659:     appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + 8 }, width * 0.86, height * 0.8), 0x1d2a24, 0.09, 0x1d2a24, 0);
2660:   }
2661:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints(point, width, height), color, lotAlpha, shellLot ? 0x747965 : draftLot ? 0x7f6d4e : 0x28473f, shellLot ? 0.16 : draftLot ? 0.14 : quietPad ? 0.1 : 0.18);
2662:   g
2663:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y)
2664:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5)
2665:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y)
2666:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y + 4)
2667:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + 6)
2668:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y + 4)
2669:     .closePath()
2670:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(color, -28), alpha: shellLot ? 0.24 : draftLot ? 0.3 : quietPad ? 0.18 : 0.24 });
2671:   appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints(point, width * 0.88, height * 0.82), shadeColor(color, mutedLot ? 7 : 10), shellLot ? 0.14 : draftLot ? 0.13 : quietPad ? 0.09 : 0.12, 0xffffff, 0);
2672:   drawParcelElevationShelf(g, point, width, height, lot, color, mutedLot);
2673:   drawLotWorldComposition(g, point, width, height, lot, color, mutedLot);
2674:   drawLotEdgeBlockwork(g, point, width, height, lotContact, mutedLot);
2675:   drawParcelEdgeTicks(g, point, width, height, lotContact);
2676:   drawParcelCompositionDetails(g, point, width, height, lot);
2677:   drawLotCurbCut(g, lotContact, point, width, height);
2678:   if (draftLot) drawDraftLotMaterial(g, point, width, height, lot.kind);
2679:   if (shellLot) drawShellLotMaterial(g, point, width, height, lot.kind);
2680: 
2681:   if (shellLot) {
2682:     return;
2683:   }
2684: 
2685:   if (lot.kind === "park") {
2686:     g
2687:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.28, point.y - height * 0.08)
2688:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.05, point.y + height * 0.12)
2689:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.25, point.y - height * 0.02)
2690:       .stroke({ color: 0xf1d9a5, alpha: 0.72, width: 5, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2691:     appendPolygon(g, diamondPoints({ x: point.x + width * 0.14, y: point.y + height * 0.16 }, 34, 18), 0xc3d989, 0.72, 0x5b8b52, 0.28);
2692:   } else if (lot.kind === "home") {
2693:     drawHomeLotDetails(g, point, width, height, color);
2694:   } else if (lot.kind === "shop" || lot.kind === "civic") {
2695:     drawForecourtPad(g, point, width, height, color, lot.kind === "civic");
2696:     if (lot.kind === "civic") drawCivicLotComposition(g, point, width, height, color);
2697:     for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i += 1) {
2698:       g
2699:         .moveTo(point.x + i * 24 - width * 0.25, point.y + height * 0.16)
2700:         .lineTo(point.x + i * 24 + width * 0.04, point.y - height * 0.08);
2701:     }
2702:     g.stroke({ color: 0xf4e8c7, alpha: 0.2, width: 1 });
2703:   } else if (lot.kind === "gym" || lot.kind === "apartments") {
2704:     drawForecourtPad(g, point, width, height, color, false);
2705:   } else if (lot.kind === "waterfront") {
2706:     g
2707:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.38, point.y - height * 0.08)
2708:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.02, point.y + height * 0.12)
2709:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.34, point.y - height * 0.04)
2710:       .stroke({ color: 0xe9fbff, alpha: 0.42, width: 3, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2711:   }
2712: }

2716: 
2717:   appendPolygon(
2718:     g,
2719:     diamondPoints({ x: point.x + width * 0.08, y: point.y - height * 0.08 }, width * 0.3, height * 0.18),
2720:     0xd4d0b8,
2721:     0.14,
2722:     0xffffff,
2723:     0,
2724:   );
2725:   g
2726:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.4, point.y + height * 0.1)
2727:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.16, point.y + height * 0.23)
2728:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.08, point.y + height * 0.1)
2729:     .moveTo(point.x + width * 0.4, point.y + height * 0.08)
2730:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.16, point.y + height * 0.22)
2731:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.06, point.y + height * 0.1)

2735: function drawLotWorldComposition(g: Graphics, point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number, lot: CityWorldLot, color: number, draftLot: boolean) {
2736:   if (draftLot || lot.kind === "park" || lot.kind === "waterfront") return;
2737: 
2738:   const profile = lot.visualGrammar?.lotProfile;
2739: 
2740:   if (profile === "residential_yard_grid") {
2741:     const variant = objectVariant(lot.id, 4);
2742:     const yardSide = variant % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
2743:     appendPolygon(
2744:       g,
2745:       diamondPoints({ x: point.x + yardSide * width * 0.18, y: point.y - height * 0.08 }, width * 0.22, height * 0.22),
2746:       shadeColor(color, variant === 3 ? -8 : 12),
2747:       0.12,
2748:       0xffffff,
2749:       0,
2750:     );
2751:     appendPolygon(
2752:       g,
2753:       diamondPoints({ x: point.x - yardSide * width * 0.16, y: point.y + height * 0.27 }, width * 0.34, height * 0.13),
2754:       shadeColor(color, 18),
2755:       0.15,
2756:       0xffffff,
2757:       0,
2758:     );
2759:     g
2760:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.42, point.y - height * 0.08)
2761:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.08)
2762:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.2, point.y - height * 0.06)
2763:       .moveTo(point.x + width * 0.42, point.y + height * 0.06)
2764:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.12, point.y + height * 0.22)
2765:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.1, point.y + height * 0.1)
2766:       .stroke({ color: 0x557a4e, alpha: 0.16, width: 1.1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2767:     g
2768:       .moveTo(point.x - yardSide * width * 0.02, point.y + height * 0.08)
2769:       .lineTo(point.x - yardSide * width * 0.2, point.y + height * 0.42)
2770:       .stroke({ color: 0xf1ddad, alpha: 0.26, width: Math.max(1.6, width * 0.026), cap: "round" });
2771:     return;
2772:   }
2773: 
2774:   if (profile === "landmark_civic_ground") {
2775:     appendPolygon(
2776:       g,
2777:       diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + height * 0.34 }, width * 0.38, height * 0.16),
2778:       0xf2ddb3,
2779:       0.28,
2780:       0x7f6d4e,
2781:       0.08,
2782:     );
2783:     g
2784:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.46, point.y + height * 0.1)
2785:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.2, point.y + height * 0.24)
2786:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.08, point.y + height * 0.12)
2787:       .moveTo(point.x + width * 0.46, point.y + height * 0.08)
2788:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.2, point.y + height * 0.23)
2789:       .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.08, point.y + height * 0.11)
2790:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.22, point.y - height * 0.18)
2791:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.18, point.y + height * 0.02)
2792:       .stroke({ color: 0xf8eac7, alpha: 0.24, width: 1.45, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2793:     return;
2794:   }
2795: 
2796:   if (profile === "commercial_forecourt" || profile === "apartment_court") {
2797:     appendPolygon(
2798:       g,
2799:       diamondPoints({ x: point.x, y: point.y + height * 0.36 }, width * 0.72, height * 0.16),
2800:       profile === "apartment_court" ? 0xdac7a1 : 0xe8cf9f,
2801:       0.18,
2802:       0x7f6d4e,
2803:       0.06,
2804:     );
2805:     const count = profile === "apartment_court" ? 3 : 5;
2806:     for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
2807:       const offset = (index / Math.max(1, count - 1) - 0.5) * width * 0.54;
2808:       g
2809:         .moveTo(point.x + offset - width * 0.04, point.y + height * 0.24)
2810:         .lineTo(point.x + offset + width * 0.06, point.y + height * 0.31);
2811:     }
2812:     g.stroke({ color: 0xf6e8c8, alpha: 0.16, width: 1, cap: "round" });
2813:   }
2814: }

2816: function drawParcelElevationShelf(g: Graphics, point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number, lot: CityWorldLot, color: number, draftLot: boolean) {
2817:   const elevation = lot.visualGrammar?.parcelElevation;
2818:   if (!elevation || elevation === "thin_pad_lip") return;
2819: 
2820:   const depth =
2821:     elevation === "civic_plinth_stack"
2822:       ? 8
2823:       : elevation === "commercial_slab_lip"
2824:         ? 5.5
2825:         : elevation === "apartment_court_lip"
2826:           ? 5
2827:           : elevation === "waterfront_bank_cut"
2828:             ? 7
2829:             : elevation === "hidden_anchor_shelf"
2830:               ? 5.5
2831:               : elevation === "park_basin_lip"
2832:                 ? 3
2833:                 : 4.5;
2834:   const alpha = draftLot ? 0.34 : elevation === "civic_plinth_stack" ? 0.42 : 0.32;
2835:   g
2836:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y)
2837:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5)
2838:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + depth)
2839:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y + depth)
2840:     .closePath()
2841:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(color, -8), "sun"), alpha: alpha * 0.8 });
2842:   g
2843:     .moveTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5)
2844:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y)
2845:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y + depth)
2846:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + depth)
2847:     .closePath()
2848:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "shade"), alpha });
2849:   g
2850:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.5, point.y + depth * 0.55)
2851:     .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.5 + depth * 0.75)
2852:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.5, point.y + depth * 0.55)
2853:     .stroke({ color: elevation === "waterfront_bank_cut" ? 0xe9fbff : 0xf1dfb7, alpha: elevation === "waterfront_bank_cut" ? 0.2 : 0.14, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2854: 
2855:   if (elevation === "civic_plinth_stack") {
2856:     g
2857:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.34, point.y + height * 0.2)
2858:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.38)
2859:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.34, point.y + height * 0.2)
2860:       .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.24, point.y + height * 0.28)
2861:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + height * 0.42)
2862:       .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.24, point.y + height * 0.28)
2863:       .stroke({ color: 0x8b7954, alpha: 0.22, width: 1.15, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2864:   }
2865: }

2867: function drawLotEdgeBlockwork(g: Graphics, point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number, lotContact: CityWorldLotContactGrammar, draftLot: boolean) {
2868:   if (lotContact.profile === "shore" || lotContact.profile === "green") return;
2869: 
2870:   const quiet = lotContact.profile === "foundation";
2871:   const alpha = draftLot ? 0.16 : quiet ? 0.1 : 0.14;
2872:   const edgeColor = quiet ? 0xe9ddb4 : 0xf0dfb7;
2873:   g
2874:     .moveTo(point.x - width * 0.46, point.y + height * 0.02)
2875:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.18, point.y + height * 0.18)
2876:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.08, point.y + height * 0.05)
2877:     .moveTo(point.x + width * 0.46, point.y + height * 0.02)
2878:     .lineTo(point.x + width * 0.18, point.y + height * 0.18)
2879:     .lineTo(point.x - width * 0.08, point.y + height * 0.05)
2880:     .stroke({ color: edgeColor, alpha, width: quiet ? 1 : 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
2881: 
2882:   const blockCount = quiet ? 3 : 5;
2883:   for (let block = 0; block < blockCount; block += 1) {
2884:     const t = block / (blockCount - 1);
2885:     const x = point.x - width * 0.28 + t * width * 0.56;
2886:     g
2887:       .moveTo(x - width * 0.035, point.y + height * 0.26)
2888:       .lineTo(x + width * 0.025, point.y + height * 0.3);
2889:   }
2890:   g.stroke({ color: 0x7f6d4e, alpha: draftLot ? 0.14 : quiet ? 0.08 : 0.12, width: 0.9, cap: "round" });
2891: }
2892: 
2893: // Curb-cut / walk join toward the serving road, authored by the compiler as
2894: // lotContact.curbCutEdge. This is the driveway-mouth read that makes a parcel
2895: // look served by its street instead of floating beside it.
2896: function drawLotCurbCut(g: Graphics, lotContact: CityWorldLotContactGrammar, point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number) {
2897:   if (!lotContact.curbCutEdge || lotContact.profile === "shore") return;
2898:

3172: function drawBuilding(layers: LayerMap, layer: Container, building: CityWorldBuilding, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver, materialTextureEnabled: boolean) {
3173:   // The base scene is focus-agnostic: hover/selection emphasis draws in the
3174:   // focusLayer overlay so focus changes never rebuild these Graphics.
3175:   const geometry = createBuildingGeometry(building, atlas);
3176:   // Foundation pads are ground decals: they live in a shared layer below every
3177:   // cast shadow so shadows land ON pads instead of being washed out by them.
3178:   drawBuildingFootprint(layers.padLayer, geometry, building);
3179:   drawBuildingCastShadow(layers.shadowLayer, building);
3180: 
3181:   if (geometry.asset.mode === "sprite") {
3182:     drawSpriteBuilding(layer, geometry, building);
3183:     return;
3184:   }
3185: 
3186:   // One facade system draws every vector building: opaque walls, a roof, and
3187:   // a wall-plane window/storefront grid. The legacy per-kind + per-family
3188:   // "authorship" overlay stack (15 functions of translucent screen-space
3189:   // decals) is retired â€” misregistered decals were the ghost-facade defect.
3190:   drawBuildingShell(layer, geometry, building, materialTextureEnabled);
3191: }
3192: 
3193: function createBuildingGeometry(building: CityWorldBuilding, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver): BuildingGeometry {
3194:   const bottom = project(building.position);
3195:   const top = project({ x: building.position.x, y: building.position.y, z: (building.position.z ?? 0) + building.height });
3196:   const asset = atlas.resolveAsset(building.spriteKey, building.paletteKey, "building");
3197:   const useAuthoredDraftColors = isDraftBuilding(building);
3198:   const useShellColors = isShellBuilding(building);
3199:   return {
3200:     bottom,
3201:     top,
3202:     footprintWidth: building.width * TILE_WIDTH,
3203:     footprintDepth: building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT,
3204:     height: building.height * TILE_DEPTH,
3205:     bodyColor: useShellColors ? 0xb9bca2 : useAuthoredDraftColors ? colorToNumber(building.bodyColor ?? asset.palette.colors.base) : paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.base, building.bodyColor),
3206:     roofColor: useShellColors ? 0x9ca58d : useAuthoredDraftColors ? colorToNumber(building.roofColor ?? asset.palette.colors.roof ?? "#8c9b75") : paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.roof, building.roofColor),
3207:     highlightColor: useShellColors ? 0xe4dec6 : useAuthoredDraftColors ? 0xf8e8ca : paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.highlight, "#fff4d8"),
3208:     accentColor: useShellColors ? 0x80928c : useAuthoredDraftColors ? 0x5f8f8a : paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.accent, asset.palette.colors.roof ?? "#ffcf56"),
3209:     trimColor: useShellColors ? 0x5f665b : useAuthoredDraftColors ? 0x5f5547 : paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.trim, "#26332c"),
3210:     outline: 0x26332c,
3211:     activeStrokeAlpha: 0.38,
3212:     asset,
3213:   };
3214: }
3215: 
3216: function isDraftBuilding(building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3217:   return building.id.startsWith("draft-building-");
3218: }
3219: 
3220: function isShellBuilding(building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3221:   return building.id.startsWith("shell-building-");
3222: }
3223: 
3224: function isObjectKitCommerceStrip(building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3225:   return building.objectKit?.prefabFamily === "commerce_strip";
3226: }
3227: 
3228: function isObjectKitCivicLandmark(building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3229:   return building.objectKit?.prefabFamily === "civic_landmark";
3230: }
3231: 
3232: function isObjectKitServiceGym(building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3233:   return building.objectKit?.prefabFamily === "service_gym";
3234: }
3235: 
3236: function objectVariant(id: string, modulo: number) {
3237:   let hash = 0;
3238:   for (let index = 0; index < id.length; index += 1) {
3239:     hash = (hash * 31 + id.charCodeAt(index)) >>> 0;
3240:   }
3241:   return hash % modulo;
3242: }
3243: 
3244: function drawSpriteBuilding(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3245:   const { bottom, footprintDepth, asset } = geometry;
3246:   if (asset.mode !== "sprite") return;
3247: 
3248:   drawSpriteBuildingFitDetails(layer, geometry, building);
3249: 
3250:   const sprite = new Sprite(asset.texture);
3251:   sprite.anchor.set(asset.anchor.x, asset.anchor.y);
3252:   // 0.53E Hero Silhouette (item A) â€” deterministic per-home variety kills the
3253:   // clone read without new art: hash-based horizontal mirror + gentle scale
3254:   // jitter break the "one model repeated" row, all keyed on the building id so
3255:   // it is stable across frames. Homes only; commerce sprites stay uniform.
3256:   const home = building.kind === "home";
3257:   const variant = objectVariant(building.id, 97);
3258:   const flip = home && variant % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
3259:   const jitter = home ? 0.95 + (variant % 11) / 100 : 1; // 0.95â€“1.05
3260:   // 0.57E generated-district parity â€” sprites must FIT the building footprint
3261:   // they stand on. Curated Riverside footprints match the authored art
3262:   // (ratio ~1, unchanged); parametric districts author arbitrary widths, and
3263:   // a fixed-scale sprite there read as a toy box floating on its apron. The
3264:   // fit is clamped so damaged ratios can never balloon or vanish a sprite.
3265:   const displayWidth = asset.texture.width * asset.scale;
3266:   const footprintFit = displayWidth > 0 ? clamp(geometry.footprintWidth / displayWidth, 0.72, 1.45) : 1;
3267:   sprite.scale.set(asset.scale * footprintFit * jitter * flip, asset.scale * footprintFit * jitter);
3268:   sprite.position.set(Math.round(bottom.x), Math.round(bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.5));
3269:   // Honor the building's assigned palette-variant ramp on screen: gently wash
3270:   // the textured sprite toward its resolved body color so sprite-mode buildings
3271:   // (rowhomes, strip stores) read the same variant identity the diagnostics key
3272:   // on. Kept subtle (mixed toward white) so authored SVG art is preserved.
3273:   // For homes, spread the wash factor + a whisper of warm/cool per house so no
3274:   // two neighbours read identical â€” still the resolved palette, never raw color.
3275:   let homeTint = geometry.bodyColor;
3276:   if (home) {
3277:     const warmCool = (variant % 3) - 1;
3278:     if (warmCool > 0) homeTint = mixColor(homeTint, SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.07);
3279:     else if (warmCool < 0) homeTint = mixColor(homeTint, SUN_COOL_TINT, 0.06);
3280:   }
3281:   // 0.68H sprite tint wash â€” homes keep just enough wash to hold their
3282:   // palette-variant identity; commerce sprites drop to a whisper so the
3283:   // authored art carries its own crisp material read.
3284:   sprite.tint = mixColor(0xffffff, homeTint, home ? 0.14 + (variant % 7) * 0.018 : 0.12);
3285:   sprite.label = `sprite-${building.id}`;
3286:   layer.addChild(sprite);
3287: 
3288:   if (home) {
3289:     drawHomeStoop(layer, geometry, building, flip);
3290:     drawHomeRoofAccent(layer, geometry, building, flip, variant);
3291:   }
3292: 
3293: }
3294: 
3295: function drawSpriteBuildingFitDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3296:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, trimColor } = geometry;
3297:   const style = building.facadeStyle ?? building.kind;
3298:   // Ground contact for sprite buildings comes from the shared foundation pad
3299:   // + contact shadow in drawBuildingFootprint. The extra per-sprite contact
3300:   // diamond, base-shadow stroke, apron, and awning strokes stacked into the
3301:   // translucent smear ring around every sprite â€” removed.
3302:   if (style === "rowhome") {
3303:     const stoops = new Graphics();
3304:     for (let bay = 0; bay < 3; bay += 1) {
3305:       const offset = (bay / 2 - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.56;
3306:       const yLift = bay === 1 ? -2 : 0;
3307:       stoops
3308:         .roundRect(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.035, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22 + yLift, footprintWidth * 0.07, 5.5, 1.5)
3309:         .fill({ color: 0xf2d8a6, alpha: 0.9 })
3310:         .roundRect(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.04, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.15 + yLift, footprintWidth * 0.08, 9, 1.5)
3311:         .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.3, width: 0.9 });
3312:     }
3313:     layer.addChild(stoops);
3314:   }
3315: }
3316: 
3317: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette (item A finish) â€” tiny deterministic roof accents so
3318: // pitched homes stop reading as one repeated model: every gable/hip home gets a
3319: // ridge shadow line, and by hash a third get a chimney fleck, a third a front
3320: // dormer, a third stay quiet. Whisper-small on purpose â€” at overview zoom they
3321: // read as variety, not detail. Follows the same per-home mirror as the sprite.
3322: function drawHomeRoofAccent(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, flip: number, variant: number) {
3323:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
3324:   if (roofShape !== "gable" && roofShape !== "hip") return;
3325:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, bodyColor } = geometry;
3326: 
3327:   const ridge = new Graphics()
3328:     .moveTo(top.x - flip * footprintWidth * 0.22, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
3329:     .lineTo(top.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08);
3330:   ridge.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -34), alpha: 0.3, width: 1.1, cap: "round" });
3331:   layer.addChild(ridge);
3332: 
3333:   if (variant % 3 === 0) {
3334:     const cx = top.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.16;
3335:     const cy = top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04;
3336:     const chimney = new Graphics()
3337:       .rect(cx - 1.2, cy - 5, 2.4, 5)
3338:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -18), "sun"), alpha: 0.88 })
3339:       .rect(cx - 1.6, cy - 6, 3.2, 1.2)
3340:       .fill({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 34), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.25), alpha: 0.88 });
3341:     layer.addChild(chimney);
3342:   } else if (variant % 3 === 1 && building.facadeStyle !== "cottage") {
3343:     // cottages already carry an authored dormer â€” no double-stamping
3344:     const dx = top.x - flip * footprintWidth * 0.09;
3345:     const dy = top.y + footprintDepth * 0.2;
3346:     const dormer = new Graphics()
3347:       .rect(dx - 2.1, dy - 2.4, 4.2, 3.2)
3348:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(bodyColor, "sun"), alpha: 0.82 })
3349:       .poly([dx - 2.7, dy - 2.4, dx, dy - 4.2, dx + 2.7, dy - 2.4], true)
3350:       .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(roofColor, "top"), alpha: 0.88 }); // 0.68H â€” pigmented top curve
3351:     layer.addChild(dormer);
3352:   }
3353: }
3354: 
3355: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette (item A finish) â€” a front entry stoop: a small warm pad
3356: // at the facade base plus a short walk stub toward the street, mirrored with
3357: // the house. Grounds each home with an authored entrance; rowhomes keep their
3358: // existing per-bay stoops so this skips them.
3359: function drawHomeStoop(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, flip: number) {
3360:   if (building.facadeStyle === "rowhome") return;
3361:   const { bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, trimColor } = geometry;
3362:   const px = bottom.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.12;
3363:   const py = bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.3;
3364:   const pad = new Graphics()
3365:     .roundRect(px - footprintWidth * 0.05, py - 1.6, footprintWidth * 0.1, 3.4, 1.2)
3366:     .fill({ color: 0xf2d8a6, alpha: 0.58 })
3367:     .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.16, width: 0.8 });
3368:   const walk = new Graphics()
3369:     .moveTo(px, py + 1.4)
3370:     .lineTo(px + flip * footprintWidth * 0.04, py + footprintDepth * 0.15);
3371:   walk.stroke({ color: 0xe8d0a3, alpha: 0.46, width: 2, cap: "round" });
3372:   layer.addChild(pad, walk);
3373: }

3375: function drawSpriteObjectAuthorshipBase(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3376:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;

3379:   const strongBase = family === "commerce_strip" || family === "residential_kit" || family === "lowrise_cluster";
3380:   if (!strongBase) return;
3381: 
3382:   const base = new Graphics()
3383:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.3)
3384:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.14, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.43)
3385:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.16, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
3386:     .moveTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.29)
3387:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.14, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.44)
3388:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.32);
3389:   base.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, family === "commerce_strip" ? 12 : -6), alpha: 0.34, width: 1.9, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3390: 
3391:   const baseStrata = new Graphics()
3392:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.36, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.39)
3393:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.51)
3394:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.39)
3395:     .moveTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.36, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.37)
3396:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.51)
3397:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.16, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.39);
3398:   baseStrata.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -28), alpha: 0.22, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3399: 
3400:   const entryPads = new Graphics();
3401:   const bayCount = family === "commerce_strip" ? 4 : family === "residential_kit" ? 3 : 2;
3402:   for (let bay = 0; bay < bayCount; bay += 1) {
3403:     const offset = (bay / Math.max(1, bayCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.64;
3404:     entryPads
3405:       .roundRect(bottom.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.04, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22, footprintWidth * 0.08, 4.5, 1.5)
3406:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, 28), alpha: family === "commerce_strip" ? 0.34 : 0.22 });
3407:   }
3408:   layer.addChild(base, baseStrata, entryPads);
3409: }

3411: function drawObjectAuthorshipDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {

3415:   if (family === "commerce_strip") drawAuthoredCommerceStripRhythm(layer, geometry, building);
3416:   if (family === "civic_landmark") drawAuthoredCivicLandmarkMass(layer, geometry, building);
3417:   if (family === "lowrise_cluster") drawAuthoredLowriseClusterRhythm(layer, geometry);

3419:   if (!isDraftBuilding(building)) drawPublicRiversideObjectAuthorshipPass(layer, geometry, building, family);

3439: // 0.55E decal discipline â€” the object-kit read owns the entry canopy and

3441: // kit buildings), so this generation's duplicate canopy + pilaster bars and
3442: // plinth-edge strokes (stairCuts in the base hierarchy do that job) are

3460:     0x2d423b,
3461:     0.12,
3462:     0x2d423b,
3463:     0,
3464:   );
3465:   const forecourt = polygon(
3466:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.34 }, footprintWidth * 0.68, footprintDepth * 0.22),
3467:     0xe6c58f,
3468:     0.28,
3469:     0x7f6d4e,
3470:     0.12,
3471:   );
3472:   const stairCuts = new Graphics()
3473:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.24, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.32)
3474:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.43)
3475:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.25, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
3476:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.4)
3477:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.49)
3478:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.2, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.39);
3479:   stairCuts.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -20), alpha: 0.28, width: 1.5, cap: "round", join: "round" });

3483: function drawCivicLandmarkRoofHierarchy(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3484:   // 0.55E â€” the hero's tiered crown owns its roof; this generation's floating
3485:   // cap + inset + shoulder strokes only draw for non-hero kit landmarks.
3486:   if (hasHeroTieredCrown(building)) return;
3487:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, trimColor } = geometry;
3488:   const civicCap = polygon(
3489:     diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.36 }, footprintWidth * 0.42, footprintDepth * 0.22),
3490:     shadeColor(roofColor, 30),
3491:     0.42,
3492:     trimColor,
3493:     0.14,
3494:   );
3495:   const capInset = polygon(
3496:     diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.38 }, footprintWidth * 0.24, footprintDepth * 0.12),
3497:     shadeColor(roofColor, -12),
3498:     0.2,
3499:     trimColor,
3500:     0.08,
3501:   );
3502:   const shoulderLines = new Graphics()
3503:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
3504:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.16, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
3505:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
3506:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.36, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.18)
3507:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.34, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.05)
3508:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.04, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.16)
3509:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.28, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.02);
3510:   shoulderLines.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -42), alpha: 0.26, width: 1.5, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3511:   layer.addChild(civicCap, capInset, shoulderLines);

3514: // 0.55E â€” wingRhythm retired: the object-kit read's entry bays own the facade

3545: function drawPublicResidentialSilhouette(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {

3551:     shadeColor(bodyColor, style === "ranch" ? -8 : -14),

3561:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.36, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)

3565:   layer.addChild(sideWing, roofBreak);

3568: function drawPublicCommerceSilhouette(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {

3589: function drawPublicLowriseSilhouette(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry) {

3592:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.28, y: bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08 }, footprintWidth * 0.16, footprintDepth * 0.18),
3593:     shadeColor(bodyColor, -18),
3594:     0.18,

3597:   );
3598:   const roofInset = polygon(
3599:     diamondPoints({ x: top.x - footprintWidth * 0.1, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08 }, footprintWidth * 0.28, footprintDepth * 0.16),
3600:     shadeColor(roofColor, 20),
3601:     0.22,
3602:     trimColor,
3603:     0.07,

3605:   const stackedWindows = new Graphics();
3606:   for (let column = -2; column <= 2; column += 1) {

3608:       .roundRect(top.x + column * (footprintWidth * 0.1) - 3, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.34, 6, 5, 1.2)

3610:       .roundRect(top.x + column * (footprintWidth * 0.1) - 3, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.17, 6, 5, 1.2)

3616: function drawPublicServiceSilhouette(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry) {
3617:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
3618:   const serviceEntry = polygon(
3619:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22 }, footprintWidth * 0.2, footprintDepth * 0.1),
3620:     0xe0c392,
3621:     0.28,
3622:     0x7f6d4e,
3623:     0.1,
3624:   );
3625:   // 0.57E parity â€” the zigzag's outer peaks sit where the roof diamond has
3626:   // almost no depth left; clamp each vertex under its local eave line so the
3627:   // profile never bleeds past the roof edge on generated footprints.
3628:   const sawHalfW = footprintWidth / 2;
3629:   const sawHalfD = footprintDepth / 2;
3630:   const sawEave = (dx: number, want: number) =>
3631:     Math.min(footprintDepth * want, sawHalfD * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(dx) / sawHalfW) * 0.85);
3632:   const sawtooth = new Graphics()
3633:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.38, top.y - sawEave(-footprintWidth * 0.38, 0.16))
3634:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y - sawEave(-footprintWidth * 0.18, 0.02))
3635:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y - sawEave(0, 0.16))
3636:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.2, top.y - sawEave(footprintWidth * 0.2, 0.02))
3637:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.4, top.y - sawEave(footprintWidth * 0.4, 0.16));
3638:   sawtooth.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -42), alpha: 0.34, width: 2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3639:   const serviceWindows = new Graphics();
3640:   for (let bay = -1; bay <= 1; bay += 1) {
3641:     serviceWindows
3642:       .roundRect(top.x + bay * (footprintWidth * 0.18) - 4, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.24, 8, 6, 1.4)
3643:       .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: bay === 0 ? 0.38 : 0.26 });
3644:   }
3645:   serviceWindows.stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.12, width: 0.7 });
3646:   layer.addChild(serviceEntry, sawtooth, serviceWindows);
3647: }

3649: // 0.55E decal discipline â€” this generation's threshold pad (drawHomeDetails
3650: // porches + drawHomeStoop own entries), side block (the public silhouette's
3651: // sideWing owns the side mass), and white wall-rib bar fills (material-band
3652: // sills + style windows own the window rhythm) are retired. The fn keeps its
3653: // unique jobs: the dark eave stroke and the vertical parcel rib lines.
3654: function drawAuthoredResidentialKitRhythm(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3655:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor } = geometry;
3656:   const style = building.facadeStyle ?? "suburban";
3657:   const roofEave = new Graphics()
3658:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.48, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.07)
3659:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.34)
3660:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.48, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.07);
3661:   roofEave.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -42), alpha: style === "rowhome" ? 0.18 : 0.28, width: 2.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3662: 
3663:   const wallRibs = new Graphics();
3664:   const bayCount = style === "ranch" ? 4 : style === "rowhome" ? 5 : 3;
3665:   for (let bay = 0; bay < bayCount; bay += 1) {
3666:     const offset = (bay / Math.max(1, bayCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.68;
3667:     wallRibs
3668:       .moveTo(top.x + offset + footprintWidth * 0.055, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.13)
3669:       .lineTo(top.x + offset + footprintWidth * 0.055, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.06);
3670:   }
3671:   wallRibs.stroke({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, -32), alpha: 0.17, width: 0.9 });
3672:   layer.addChild(roofEave, wallRibs);
3673: }

3700: function drawObjectKitCommerceStripRead(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3701:   if (!isObjectKitCommerceStrip(building)) return;
3702:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor, highlightColor, trimColor, accentColor } = geometry;
3703:   const commerceGeometry = building.objectKit?.commerceGeometry;
3704:   const bayCount = commerceGeometry?.bayCount ?? (building.objectKit?.signatureTags.includes("storefront-bay-rhythm") ? 5 : 4);
3705:   const apronDepth = commerceGeometry?.apronDepth ?? 0.24;
3706:   const glassRecessDepth = commerceGeometry?.glassRecessDepth ?? 0.24;
3707:   const parapetWeight = commerceGeometry?.parapetWeight ?? 0.72;
3708:   const signMountCount = Math.min(commerceGeometry?.signMountCount ?? bayCount, bayCount);
3709:   const isPlazaRowFocus = commerceGeometry?.focusTarget === "plaza_row";
3710: 
3711:   const sharedStorefrontApron = polygon(
3712:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * (0.45 + apronDepth * 0.08) }, footprintWidth * 1.02, footprintDepth * apronDepth),
3713:     0xe2c796,
3714:     isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.52 : 0.42,
3715:     0x756947,
3716:     isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.22 : 0.16,
3717:   );
3718:   const foundationShadow = new Graphics()
3719:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.46, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.35)
3720:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.1, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.52)
3721:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.46, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
3722:     .moveTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.46, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.35)
3723:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.1, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.53)
3724:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.44, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.31);
3725:   foundationShadow.stroke({ color: 0x24352f, alpha: isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.3 : 0.24, width: isPlazaRowFocus ? 3.6 : 2.8, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3726: 
3727:   const parapetCap = new Graphics()
3728:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.48, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
3729:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.09)
3730:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
3731:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.46, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.07);
3732:   parapetCap.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -44), alpha: 0.44 + parapetWeight * 0.1, width: 2.4 + parapetWeight * 1.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3733: 
3734:   const glassRecesses = new Graphics();
3735:   const signMounts = new Graphics();
3736:   const awningLip = new Graphics();
3737:   const bayPilasters = new Graphics();
3738:   const storefrontThresholds = new Graphics();
3739:   for (let bay = 0; bay < bayCount; bay += 1) {
3740:     const offset = (bay / Math.max(1, bayCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.76;
3741:     const bayWidth = footprintWidth * (isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.082 : 0.095);
3742:     const doorHeight = bay === Math.floor(bayCount / 2) ? 14 + glassRecessDepth * 5 : 10 + glassRecessDepth * 4;
3743:     glassRecesses
3744:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.5, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.23, bayWidth, doorHeight, 2)
3745:       .fill({ color: bay === Math.floor(bayCount / 2) ? 0xb9dfe7 : highlightColor, alpha: 0.6 })
3746:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.54, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.24, bayWidth * 1.08, doorHeight + 1.5, 2)
3747:       .stroke({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, -34), alpha: 0.18, width: 0.9 });
3748: 
3749:     if (bay < signMountCount) {
3750:       signMounts
3751:         .roundRect(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.62, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.23, bayWidth * 1.24, isPlazaRowFocus ? 5.8 : 4.8, 1.2)
3752:         .fill({ color: bay % 2 === 0 ? accentColor : shadeColor(roofColor, 18), alpha: isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.56 : 0.46 });
3753:     }
3754: 
3755:     awningLip
3756:       .moveTo(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.68, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
3757:       .lineTo(top.x + offset + bayWidth * 0.58, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02);
3758: 
3759:     bayPilasters
3760:       .moveTo(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.7, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.26)
3761:       .lineTo(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.7, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02)
3762:       .moveTo(top.x + offset + bayWidth * 0.7, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.25)
3763:       .lineTo(top.x + offset + bayWidth * 0.7, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02);
3764: 
3765:     storefrontThresholds
3766:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.64, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.025, bayWidth * 1.28, isPlazaRowFocus ? 3.8 : 2.8, 1.1)
3767:       .fill({ color: 0xc9a46f, alpha: isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.38 : 0.24 });
3768:   }
3769:   awningLip.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -46), alpha: 0.32, width: 2.1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3770:   bayPilasters.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -18), alpha: isPlazaRowFocus ? 0.28 : 0.18, width: isPlazaRowFocus ? 1.4 : 0.9, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3771: 
3772:   const sideFaceRibs = new Graphics()
3773:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.47, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.1)
3774:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.45, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.14)
3775:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.31, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.21)
3776:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.47, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.1)
3777:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.45, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.14)
3778:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.31, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.21);
3779:   sideFaceRibs.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -20), alpha: 0.2, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3780: 
3781:   const plazaRowFrontageDepth = isPlazaRowFocus
3782:     ? polygon(
3783:       diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.04, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.28 }, footprintWidth * 0.82, footprintDepth * 0.16),
3784:       0xd9b983,
3785:       0.26,
3786:       0x756947,
3787:       0.1,
3788:     )
3789:     : null;
3790: 
3791:   layer.addChild(
3792:     sharedStorefrontApron,
3793:     foundationShadow,
3794:     ...(plazaRowFrontageDepth ? [plazaRowFrontageDepth] : []),
3795:     parapetCap,
3796:     glassRecesses,
3797:     signMounts,
3798:     awningLip,
3799:     bayPilasters,
3800:     storefrontThresholds,
3801:     sideFaceRibs,
3802:   );
3803: }

3805: function drawObjectKitCivicLandmarkRead(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3806:   if (!isObjectKitCivicLandmark(building)) return;
3807:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
3808:   const civicGeometry = building.objectKit?.civicGeometry;
3809:   const plinthTierCount = civicGeometry?.plinthTierCount ?? 2;
3810:   const entryBayCount = civicGeometry?.entryBayCount ?? 4;
3811:   const facadePierCount = civicGeometry?.facadePierCount ?? 5;
3812:   const glassBandCount = civicGeometry?.glassBandCount ?? 2;
3813:   const roofCapWeight = civicGeometry?.roofCapWeight ?? 0.84;
3814:   const canopyDepth = civicGeometry?.civicCanopyDepth ?? 0.24;
3815:   const isEastvaleCore = civicGeometry?.focusTarget === "eastvale_core";
3816: 
3817:   const plinthTiers = new Graphics();
3818:   for (let tier = 0; tier < plinthTierCount; tier += 1) {
3819:     const tierScale = 0.9 - tier * 0.11;
3820:     const tierY = bottom.y + footprintDepth * (0.43 + tier * 0.06);
3821:     plinthTiers
3822:       .poly(diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: tierY }, footprintWidth * tierScale, footprintDepth * (0.2 - tier * 0.025)), true)
3823:       .fill({ color: tier === 0 ? 0xd6bb86 : 0xead0a1, alpha: isEastvaleCore ? 0.22 + tier * 0.06 : 0.16 + tier * 0.04 })
3824:       .stroke({ color: 0x756947, alpha: isEastvaleCore ? 0.14 : 0.09, width: 0.9 });
3825:   }
3826: 
3827:   const civicEntryBays = new Graphics();
3828:   for (let bay = 0; bay < entryBayCount; bay += 1) {
3829:     const offset = (bay / Math.max(1, entryBayCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.66;
3830:     const isCenter = bay === Math.floor(entryBayCount / 2);
3831:     civicEntryBays
3832:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.034, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.3, footprintWidth * 0.068, isCenter ? 24 : 17, 1.8)
3833:       .fill({ color: isCenter ? 0xd4eff3 : highlightColor, alpha: isCenter ? 0.52 : 0.34 })
3834:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.04, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.31, footprintWidth * 0.08, isCenter ? 25.5 : 18.5, 1.8)
3835:       .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: isCenter ? 0.16 : 0.09, width: 0.8 });
3836:   }
3837: 
3838:   const facadePiers = new Graphics();
3839:   for (let pier = 0; pier < facadePierCount; pier += 1) {
3840:     const offset = (pier / Math.max(1, facadePierCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.76;
3841:     facadePiers
3842:       .moveTo(top.x + offset, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.42)
3843:       .lineTo(top.x + offset + footprintWidth * 0.025, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.02);
3844:   }
3845:   facadePiers.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -18), alpha: isEastvaleCore ? 0.24 : 0.14, width: isEastvaleCore ? 1.2 : 0.9, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3846: 
3847:   const glassBands = new Graphics();
3848:   for (let band = 0; band < glassBandCount; band += 1) {
3849:     const y = bottom.y - footprintDepth * (0.16 + band * 0.11);
3850:     glassBands
3851:       .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.34, y)
3852:       .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, y + footprintDepth * 0.07)
3853:       .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.16, y)
3854:       .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.36, y + footprintDepth * 0.07);
3855:   }
3856:   glassBands.stroke({ color: 0xc9edf2, alpha: isEastvaleCore ? 0.34 : 0.22, width: 1.6, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3857: 
3858:   const canopy = polygon(
3859:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08 }, footprintWidth * 0.34, footprintDepth * canopyDepth),
3860:     0xc4e4e9,
3861:     isEastvaleCore ? 0.38 : 0.26,
3862:     trimColor,
3863:     0.1,
3864:   );
3865: 
3866:   // 0.53E item C â€” the hero landmark's entry reads as a real portal: a wider
3867:   // plinth apron below the tiers, a lit canopy slab over the center bay with a
3868:   // shadow line under its lip, and two slim posts grounding it. Typed off the
3869:   // same civicGeometry focus the other hero reads key on â€” not a per-id hack.
3870:   if (isEastvaleCore) {
3871:     const apron = polygon(
3872:       diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.52 }, footprintWidth * 1.02, footprintDepth * 0.22),
3873:       0xd6bb86,
3874:       0.3,
3875:       0x756947,
3876:       0.16,
3877:     );
3878:     const canopySlab = polygon(
3879:       diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.06 }, footprintWidth * 0.3, footprintDepth * 0.14),
3880:       sunlitColor(0xd8ecef, "top"),
3881:       0.85,
3882:       trimColor,
3883:       0.3,
3884:     );
3885:     const canopyShadow = new Graphics()
3886:       .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.14, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.05)
3887:       .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.02)
3888:       .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.14, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.05);
3889:     canopyShadow.stroke({ color: 0x1a2c37, alpha: 0.3, width: 2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3890:     const posts = new Graphics()
3891:       .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.11, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.05)
3892:       .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.11, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16)
3893:       .moveTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.11, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.05)
3894:       .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.11, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16);
3895:     posts.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -8), alpha: 0.5, width: 1.4, cap: "round" });
3896:     layer.addChild(apron, canopySlab, canopyShadow, posts);
3897:   }
3898:   // 0.53E item C â€” the hero landmark's crown is the TIERED MASSING (drawn in
3899:   // the shell pass); the old floating roof-cap decal painted a pale diamond
3900:   // right over that crown and flattened it back into a lid. Hero skips the
3901:   // decal; ordinary civic landmarks keep it.
3902:   const roofCap = isEastvaleCore
3903:     ? null
3904:     : polygon(
3905:         diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.01, y: top.y - footprintDepth * (0.45 + roofCapWeight * 0.04) }, footprintWidth * (0.38 + roofCapWeight * 0.08), footprintDepth * 0.16),
3906:         shadeColor(roofColor, 38),
3907:         0.32,
3908:         trimColor,
3909:         0.13,
3910:       );
3911: 
3912:   layer.addChild(plinthTiers, civicEntryBays, facadePiers, glassBands, canopy);
3913:   if (roofCap) layer.addChild(roofCap);
3914: }

3916: function drawObjectKitServiceGymRead(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
3917:   if (!isObjectKitServiceGym(building)) return;
3918:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
3919:   const serviceGeometry = building.objectKit?.serviceGeometry;
3920:   const serviceBayCount = serviceGeometry?.serviceBayCount ?? 3;
3921:   const sawtoothCount = serviceGeometry?.sawtoothCount ?? 3;
3922:   const entryRecessDepth = serviceGeometry?.entryRecessDepth ?? 0.22;
3923:   const utilityApronDepth = serviceGeometry?.utilityApronDepth ?? 0.26;
3924:   const roofMonitorWeight = serviceGeometry?.roofMonitorWeight ?? 0.82;
3925:   const isEastvaleGym = serviceGeometry?.focusTarget === "eastvale_gym";
3926: 
3927:   const serviceApron = polygon(
3928:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * (0.4 + utilityApronDepth * 0.06) }, footprintWidth * 0.86, footprintDepth * utilityApronDepth),
3929:     0xd8bf90,
3930:     isEastvaleGym ? 0.4 : 0.28,
3931:     0x756947,
3932:     isEastvaleGym ? 0.18 : 0.1,
3933:   );
3934:   const foundationLine = new Graphics()
3935:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
3936:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.48)
3937:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.28)
3938:     .moveTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
3939:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.49)
3940:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.4, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.29);
3941:   foundationLine.stroke({ color: 0x24352f, alpha: isEastvaleGym ? 0.28 : 0.18, width: isEastvaleGym ? 3 : 2.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3942: 
3943:   // 0.57E parity â€” monitors stay inside the roof diamond: the outer teeth sat
3944:   // at offsets where the eave allows far less rise than the fixed 0.23 depth,
3945:   // so the monitor strokes bled past the eaves on generated footprints.
3946:   const roofMonitors = new Graphics();
3947:   const monitorHalfW = footprintWidth / 2;
3948:   const monitorHalfD = footprintDepth / 2;
3949:   const monitorRise = (dx: number, want: number) =>
3950:     Math.min(footprintDepth * want, monitorHalfD * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(dx) / monitorHalfW) * 0.85);
3951:   for (let tooth = 0; tooth < sawtoothCount; tooth += 1) {
3952:     const offset = (tooth / Math.max(1, sawtoothCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.62;
3953:     const x0 = offset - footprintWidth * 0.045;
3954:     const x1 = offset + footprintWidth * 0.045;
3955:     const x2 = offset + footprintWidth * 0.12;
3956:     roofMonitors
3957:       .moveTo(top.x + x0, top.y - monitorRise(x0, 0.23))
3958:       .lineTo(top.x + x1, top.y - monitorRise(x1, 0.1))
3959:       .lineTo(top.x + x2, top.y - monitorRise(x2, 0.2));
3960:   }
3961:   roofMonitors.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -46), alpha: 0.38 + roofMonitorWeight * 0.08, width: 1.7 + roofMonitorWeight * 0.65, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3962: 
3963:   const serviceBays = new Graphics();
3964:   const bayWidth = footprintWidth * 0.09;
3965:   for (let bay = 0; bay < serviceBayCount; bay += 1) {
3966:     const offset = (bay / Math.max(1, serviceBayCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.62;
3967:     const isEntry = bay === 0;
3968:     serviceBays
3969:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.5, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.22, bayWidth, isEntry ? 15 : 10, 1.8)
3970:       .fill({ color: isEntry ? highlightColor : shadeColor(bodyColor, -16), alpha: isEntry ? 0.5 : 0.27 })
3971:       .roundRect(top.x + offset - bayWidth * 0.56, bottom.y - footprintDepth * (0.23 + entryRecessDepth * 0.03), bayWidth * 1.12, isEntry ? 16.5 : 11.5, 1.8)
3972:       .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: isEntry ? 0.18 : 0.09, width: 0.8 });
3973:   }
3974: 
3975:   const utilitySideRibs = new Graphics()
3976:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.46, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04)
3977:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.1)
3978:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.24, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.18)
3979:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.46, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04)
3980:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.1)
3981:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.24, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.18);
3982:   utilitySideRibs.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -22), alpha: isEastvaleGym ? 0.22 : 0.14, width: 1.15, cap: "round", join: "round" });
3983: 
3984:   layer.addChild(serviceApron, foundationLine, roofMonitors, serviceBays, utilitySideRibs);
3985: }

3987: // 0.55E decal discipline â€” this generation's baseTerrace (duplicate of the
3988: // object-kit plinth tiers) and facadeBeats (duplicate facade bar rhythm) are
3989: // retired; the fn keeps the non-hero upper roof cap it uniquely owns.

4070: // Directional cast shadow: the building silhouette swept along the sun->ground
4071: // vector (sun upper-left, so shadows skew to the lower-right). Drawn in a
4072: // dedicated layer under all buildings so shadows land on ground and lots.
4073: function drawBuildingCastShadow(layer: Container, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4074:   const bottom = project(building.position);
4075:   const heightPx = Math.min(building.height * TILE_DEPTH, 96) + 16;
4076:   if (heightPx <= 18) return;
4077:   const width = building.width * TILE_WIDTH * 0.96;
4078:   const depth = building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT * 0.92;
4079:   // Anchor a touch toward the shadow side so the sweep emerges past the
4080:   // building's foundation pad instead of hiding underneath it.
4081:   const anchorX = bottom.x + 5;
4082:   const anchorY = bottom.y + depth * 0.08;
4083:   const left = { x: anchorX - width * 0.5, y: anchorY };
4084:   const top = { x: anchorX, y: anchorY - depth * 0.5 };
4085:   const right = { x: anchorX + width * 0.5, y: anchorY };
4086:   const base = { x: anchorX, y: anchorY + depth * 0.5 };
4087: 
4088:   const sweep = (reach: number, alpha: number) => {
4089:     const vx = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.x * heightPx * reach;
4090:     const vy = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.y * heightPx * reach;
4091:     return new Graphics()
4092:       .poly(
4093:         [top.x, top.y, left.x, left.y, base.x, base.y, base.x + vx, base.y + vy, right.x + vx, right.y + vy, top.x + vx, top.y + vy],
4094:         true,
4095:       )
4096:       .fill({ color: CAST_SHADOW_COLOR, alpha });
4097:   };
4098: 
4099:   // Short, quiet sweep + a faint penumbra in ONE Graphics. The old 0.5-alpha
4100:   // full-height sweep painted half-black sheets across roads and pads.
4101:   const shadow = sweep(0.5, 0.14);
4102:   const vx = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.x * heightPx * 0.78;
4103:   const vy = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.y * heightPx * 0.78;
4104:   shadow
4105:     .poly(
4106:       [top.x, top.y, left.x, left.y, base.x, base.y, base.x + vx, base.y + vy, right.x + vx, right.y + vy, top.x + vx, top.y + vy],
4107:       true,
4108:     )
4109:     .fill({ color: CAST_SHADOW_COLOR, alpha: 0.05 });
4110:   layer.addChild(shadow);
4111: }

4113: function drawBuildingFootprint(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4114:   const { bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor, trimColor } = geometry;
4115:   const spriteBacked = geometry.asset.mode === "sprite";
4116:   const style = building.facadeStyle ?? building.kind;
4117:   const draftBuilding = isDraftBuilding(building);
4118:   const padWidth = footprintWidth * (spriteBacked ? 0.94 : style === "rowhome" || style === "strip_store" ? 1.02 : 0.92);
4119:   const padDepth = footprintDepth * (spriteBacked ? 0.72 : style === "rowhome" || style === "strip_store" ? 0.86 : 0.76);
4120:   const padCenter = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * (spriteBacked ? 0.24 : 0.2) };
4121:   const padColor = draftBuilding ? (building.kind === "civic" ? 0xe6cf9f : 0xe7c999) : style === "strip_store" || building.kind === "shop" || building.kind === "civic" ? 0xe7d0a2 : shadeColor(bodyColor, 18);
4122:   const edgeColor = style === "rowhome" || style === "strip_store" ? shadeColor(trimColor, -14) : shadeColor(roofColor, -48);
4123: 
4124:   // Foundation pads are physical slabs: an opaque top, a thin solid south lip
4125:   // for slab thickness, and one quiet contact shadow. Translucent cream pads
4126:   // read as cards floating on the grass â€” the 0.72 "cream card" defect.
4127:   const slabColor = mixColor(padColor, 0xffffff, 0.08);
4128:   const lipDrop = 2.5;
4129:   // One Graphics per pad: contact ellipse under slab top under lip.
4130:   const pad = new Graphics()
4131:     .ellipse(padCenter.x, padCenter.y + padDepth * 0.18, padWidth * 0.5, padDepth * 0.4)
4132:     .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.1 });
4133:   pad
4134:     .poly(diamondPoints(padCenter, padWidth, padDepth), true)
4135:     .fill({ color: slabColor })
4136:     .stroke({ color: shadeColor(slabColor, -42), alpha: 0.3, width: 1 });
4137:   pad
4138:     .moveTo(padCenter.x - padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y)
4139:     .lineTo(padCenter.x, padCenter.y + padDepth * 0.5)
4140:     .lineTo(padCenter.x + padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y)
4141:     .lineTo(padCenter.x + padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y + lipDrop)
4142:     .lineTo(padCenter.x, padCenter.y + padDepth * 0.5 + lipDrop)
4143:     .lineTo(padCenter.x - padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y + lipDrop)
4144:     .closePath()
4145:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(slabColor, -38) })
4146:     .stroke({ color: edgeColor, alpha: 0.2, width: 1 });
4147: 
4148:   layer.addChild(pad);
4149: }

4151: function buildingContactShadow(
4152:   geometry: BuildingGeometry,
4153:   building: CityWorldBuilding,
4154:   selected: boolean,
4155:   hovered: boolean,
4156:   padWidth: number,
4157:   padDepth: number,
4158:   draftBuilding: boolean,
4159: ): Graphics[] {
4160:   const { bottom, footprintDepth } = geometry;
4161:   const profile = building.visualGrammar?.contactProfile ?? "parcel_pad_shadow";
4162:   const activeBoost = selected ? 0.09 : hovered ? 0.05 : 0;
4163:   const draftBoost = draftBuilding ? 0.04 : 0;
4164:   const centerY = bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.38;
4165: 
4166:   if (profile === "landmark_base_shadow") {
4167:     const penumbra = new Graphics()
4168:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY + 2, padWidth * 0.64, padDepth * 0.68)
4169:       .fill({ color: 0x1d2a24, alpha: 0.07 + activeBoost * 0.4 + draftBoost * 0.5 });
4170:     const core = new Graphics()
4171:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY, padWidth * 0.44, padDepth * 0.5)
4172:       .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.18 + activeBoost + draftBoost });
4173:     const plinthSeam = new Graphics()
4174:       .moveTo(bottom.x - padWidth * 0.46, centerY + padDepth * 0.08)
4175:       .lineTo(bottom.x, centerY + padDepth * 0.4)
4176:       .lineTo(bottom.x + padWidth * 0.46, centerY + padDepth * 0.08);
4177:     plinthSeam.stroke({ color: 0x1d2a24, alpha: 0.2, width: 1.7, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4178:     return [penumbra, core, plinthSeam];
4179:   }
4180: 
4181:   if (profile === "soft_ground_shadow") {
4182:     const soft = new Graphics()
4183:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY + 1, padWidth * 0.6, padDepth * 0.66)
4184:       .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.11 + activeBoost + draftBoost });
4185:     return [soft];
4186:   }
4187: 
4188:   if (profile === "curb_shadow") {
4189:     const curb = new Graphics()
4190:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY + 2, padWidth * 0.52, padDepth * 0.42)
4191:       .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.2 + activeBoost + draftBoost });
4192:     return [curb];
4193:   }
4194: 
4195:   const padSkirt = polygon(
4196:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: centerY + 1.5 }, padWidth * 1.06, padDepth * 0.92),
4197:     0x23342e,
4198:     0.05 + activeBoost * 0.3 + draftBoost * 0.5,
4199:     0x23342e,
4200:     0,
4201:   );
4202:   const core = new Graphics()
4203:     .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY, padWidth * 0.44, padDepth * 0.5)
4204:     .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.13 + activeBoost + draftBoost });
4205:   return [padSkirt, core];
4206: }

4221: function drawBuildingShell(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, materialTextureEnabled: boolean) {
4222:   const { bottom, top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, outline, activeStrokeAlpha } = geometry;
4223:   // Unified sun: lower-left wall faces the sun, lower-right wall falls into
4224:   // cool shade. Same factors for every building in the scene.
4225:   // 0.68H â€” walls use the building-face curve so the lit wall stays pigmented.
4226:   const sideLeft = buildingFaceColor(bodyColor, "sun");
4227:   const sideRight = buildingFaceColor(bodyColor, "shade");
4228:   const topLeft = { x: top.x - footprintWidth / 2, y: top.y };
4229:   const topRight = { x: top.x + footprintWidth / 2, y: top.y };
4230:   const topFront = { x: top.x, y: top.y + footprintDepth / 2 };
4231:   const bottomLeft = { x: bottom.x - footprintWidth / 2, y: bottom.y };
4232:   const bottomRight = { x: bottom.x + footprintWidth / 2, y: bottom.y };
4233:   const bottomFront = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth / 2 };
4234:   const leftSide = [topLeft.x, topLeft.y, topFront.x, topFront.y, bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y, bottomLeft.x, bottomLeft.y];
4235:   const rightSide = [topRight.x, topRight.y, topFront.x, topFront.y, bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y, bottomRight.x, bottomRight.y];
4236: 
4237:   const left = polygon(leftSide, sideLeft, 1, outline, activeStrokeAlpha);
4238:   const right = polygon(rightSide, sideRight, 1, outline, activeStrokeAlpha);
4239:   layer.addChild(left, right);
4240:   drawBuildingShellLighting(layer, geometry);
4241:   if (materialTextureEnabled) drawWallMaterialTexture(layer, geometry, building);
4242:   drawWallBlockCourses(layer, geometry, building);
4243:   drawWallFacade(layer, geometry, building);
4244: 
4245:   drawRoof(layer, geometry, building, materialTextureEnabled);
4246:   drawTieredMassing(layer, geometry, building);
4247: }
