4249: // 0.74F chunky treatment â€” one horizontal course line per storey across each
4250: // wall, in wall-plane coordinates: the box reads as stacked voxel courses
4251: // instead of a single extrusion. Inset-only (lines live ON the wall quads).
4252: function drawWallBlockCourses(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4253:   const floors = Math.max(1, Math.round(building.height));
4254:   if (floors < 2 || geometry.height < 22) return;
4255:   const courses = new Graphics();
4256:   for (const side of ["sun", "shade"] as const) {
4257:     const surface = wallSurface(geometry, side);
4258:     for (let floor = 1; floor < floors; floor += 1) {
4259:       const v = (surface.heightPx / floors) * floor;
4260:       const from = wallPoint(surface, 0, v);
4261:       const to = wallPoint(surface, 1, v);
4262:       courses.moveTo(from.x, from.y).lineTo(to.x, to.y);
4263:     }
4264:   }
4265:   courses.stroke({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, -26), alpha: 0.15, width: 1, cap: "butt" });
4266:   layer.addChild(courses);
4267: }
4268: 
4269: function drawWallMaterialTexture(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4270:   const material = new Graphics();
4271:   let hasTexture = false;
4272:   for (const side of ["sun", "shade"] as const) {
4273:     const surface = wallSurface(geometry, side);
4274:     if (surface.heightPx < 18 || surface.edgeLengthPx < 18) continue;
4275:     const courseCount = Math.max(2, Math.min(7, Math.floor(surface.heightPx / 9)));
4276:     const courseHeight = surface.heightPx / courseCount;
4277:     const blockColumns = Math.max(2, Math.min(5, Math.floor(surface.edgeLengthPx / 18)));
4278:     for (let course = 0; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
4279:       const seed = materialTextureSeed(building.id, side, course);
4280:       const v0 = course * courseHeight + 0.7;
4281:       const v1 = Math.min(surface.heightPx - 0.7, (course + 1) * courseHeight - 0.7);
4282:       if (v1 <= v0 + 2) continue;
4283:       const delta = materialTextureDelta(seed);
4284:       const bandAlpha = side === "sun" ? 0.08 : 0.1;
4285:       material
4286:         .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, 0.04, v0, 0.96, v1), true)
4287:         .fill({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, delta), alpha: bandAlpha });
4288:       hasTexture = true;
4289: 
4290:       if (seed % 4 !== 0) continue;
4291:       const column = Math.floor(seed / 7) % blockColumns;
4292:       const offset = course % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 0.5 / blockColumns;
4293:       const u0 = 0.08 + ((column / blockColumns + offset) % 0.84);
4294:       const u1 = Math.min(0.94, u0 + 0.52 / blockColumns);
4295:       if (u1 <= u0 + 0.04) continue;
4296:       material
4297:         .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0, v0 + courseHeight * 0.18, u1, v1 - courseHeight * 0.12), true)
4298:         .fill({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, delta > 0 ? 16 : -16), alpha: side === "sun" ? 0.1 : 0.12 });
4299:     }
4300:   }
4301:   if (hasTexture) layer.addChild(material);
4302: }
4303: 
4304: function materialTextureSeed(buildingId: string, face: string, courseIndex: number): number {
4305:   const key = `${buildingId}:${face}:${courseIndex}`;
4306:   let hash = 2166136261;
4307:   for (let index = 0; index < key.length; index += 1) {
4308:     hash ^= key.charCodeAt(index);
4309:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619) >>> 0;
4310:   }
4311:   return hash;
4312: }
4313: 
4314: function materialTextureDelta(seed: number): number {
4315:   const steps = [-16, -10, 10, 16] as const;
4316:   return steps[seed % steps.length] ?? 10;
4317: }
4318: 
4319: // ---- Wall-plane facade system ----------------------------------------------
4320: // Every window, storefront, and door is authored in wall-plane coordinates:
4321: // u âˆˆ [0,1] runs along the wall's ground edge from the outer corner to the
4322: // shared front corner; v is height in screen pixels. Elements are projected
4323: // through the same corner math as the wall quads, so they register exactly on
4324: // the wall â€” they cannot float off the face or leak past the silhouette.
4325: 
4326: type WallSide = "sun" | "shade";
4327: 
4328: type WallSurface = {
4329:   groundCorner: ProjectedPoint;
4330:   groundFront: ProjectedPoint;
4331:   heightPx: number;
4332:   edgeLengthPx: number;
4333: };
4334: 
4335: function wallSurface(geometry: BuildingGeometry, side: WallSide): WallSurface {
4336:   const { bottom, top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth } = geometry;
4337:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
4338:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
4339:   const groundCorner = side === "sun" ? { x: bottom.x - halfW, y: bottom.y } : { x: bottom.x + halfW, y: bottom.y };
4340:   const groundFront = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + halfD };
4341:   const heightPx = Math.max(0, bottom.y - top.y);
4342:   const edgeLengthPx = Math.hypot(groundFront.x - groundCorner.x, groundFront.y - groundCorner.y);
4343:   return { groundCorner, groundFront, heightPx, edgeLengthPx };
4344: }
4345: 
4346: function wallPoint(surface: WallSurface, u: number, v: number): ProjectedPoint {
4347:   return {
4348:     x: surface.groundCorner.x + (surface.groundFront.x - surface.groundCorner.x) * u,
4349:     y: surface.groundCorner.y + (surface.groundFront.y - surface.groundCorner.y) * u - v,
4350:   };
4351: }
4352: 
4353: function wallQuadPoints(surface: WallSurface, u0: number, v0: number, u1: number, v1: number): number[] {
4354:   const a = wallPoint(surface, u0, v0);
4355:   const b = wallPoint(surface, u1, v0);
4356:   const c = wallPoint(surface, u1, v1);
4357:   const d = wallPoint(surface, u0, v1);
4358:   return [a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y, d.x, d.y];
4359: }
4360: 
4361: function isCommerceFacade(building: CityWorldBuilding): boolean {
4362:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
4363:   return (
4364:     building.kind === "shop" ||
4365:     building.kind === "gym" ||
4366:     building.kind === "civic" ||
4367:     family === "commerce_strip" ||
4368:     family === "civic_landmark" ||
4369:     family === "service_block" ||
4370:     family === "venue_anchor" ||
4371:     family === "transit_anchor"
4372:   );
4373: }
4374: 
4375: function drawWallFacade(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4376:   const commerce = isCommerceFacade(building);
4377:   const variant = objectVariant(building.id, 977);
4378:   for (const side of ["sun", "shade"] as const) {
4379:     const surface = wallSurface(geometry, side);
4380:     if (surface.heightPx < 10 || surface.edgeLengthPx < 12) continue;
4381:     const storefront = commerce && surface.heightPx >= 24;
4382:     drawFacadeStorefront(layer, geometry, surface, side, storefront);
4383:     drawFacadeWindows(layer, geometry, surface, side, building, variant, storefront);
4384:   }
4385:   if (!commerce) drawFacadeDoor(layer, geometry, building, variant);
4386: }
4387: 
4388: // Recessed ground-storey glass band with mullions and a canopy lip. Opaque:
4389: // the storefront is real material, not a wash over the wall.
4390: function drawFacadeStorefront(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, surface: WallSurface, side: WallSide, enabled: boolean) {
4391:   if (!enabled) return;
4392:   const { bodyColor, trimColor } = geometry;
4393:   const bandTop = Math.min(16, surface.heightPx * 0.34);
4394:   const recess = new Graphics()
4395:     .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, 0.06, 1, 0.94, bandTop), true)
4396:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -34), side) });
4397:   const glass = new Graphics()
4398:     .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, 0.09, 2.5, 0.91, bandTop - 3), true)
4399:     .fill({ color: side === "sun" ? 0xbcd8de : 0x8fb0bd });
4400:   const mullions = new Graphics();
4401:   const bays = Math.max(2, Math.round(surface.edgeLengthPx / 18));
4402:   for (let bay = 1; bay < bays; bay += 1) {
4403:     const u = 0.09 + (0.82 * bay) / bays;
4404:     const lower = wallPoint(surface, u, 2.5);
4405:     const upper = wallPoint(surface, u, bandTop - 3);
4406:     mullions.moveTo(lower.x, lower.y).lineTo(upper.x, upper.y);
4407:   }
4408:   mullions.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -8), alpha: 0.85, width: 1 });
4409:   const canopyA = wallPoint(surface, 0.04, bandTop + 1.5);
4410:   const canopyB = wallPoint(surface, 0.96, bandTop + 1.5);
4411:   const canopy = new Graphics().moveTo(canopyA.x, canopyA.y).lineTo(canopyB.x, canopyB.y);
4412:   canopy.stroke({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(geometry.roofColor, -8), side), alpha: 0.95, width: 2.2, cap: "butt" });
4413:   layer.addChild(recess, glass, mullions, canopy);
4414: }
4415: 
4416: // Window grid: floors split the wall height, bays split the wall length.
4417: // Each window is a parallelogram in the wall plane â€” an opaque frame quad
4418: // with an opaque glass quad inside; a hashed minority of panes glow warm so
4419: // facades read inhabited without pattern noise.
4420: function drawFacadeWindows(
4421:   layer: Container,
4422:   geometry: BuildingGeometry,
4423:   surface: WallSurface,
4424:   side: WallSide,
4425:   building: CityWorldBuilding,
4426:   variant: number,
4427:   storefront: boolean,
4428: ) {
4429:   const { bodyColor, trimColor } = geometry;
4430:   const baseV = storefront ? Math.min(16, surface.heightPx * 0.34) + 4 : 4;
4431:   const usableHeight = surface.heightPx - baseV - 4;
4432:   if (usableHeight < 7) return;
4433:   const floors = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.floor(usableHeight / 12)));
4434:   const floorStep = usableHeight / floors;
4435:   const bays = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, Math.floor(surface.edgeLengthPx / 16)));
4436:   const bayStep = 0.84 / bays;
4437:   const windowH = Math.min(7.5, floorStep * 0.58);
4438:   const frames = new Graphics();
4439:   const panes = new Graphics();
4440:   const litPanes = new Graphics();
4441:   const frameColor = sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -38), side);
4442:   const glassColor = side === "sun" ? 0xd7e9ea : 0x92aebc;
4443:   const litColor = 0xf7e3ae;
4444:   for (let floor = 0; floor < floors; floor += 1) {
4445:     const v0 = baseV + floor * floorStep + (floorStep - windowH) * 0.55;
4446:     for (let bay = 0; bay < bays; bay += 1) {
4447:       const u0 = 0.08 + bay * bayStep + bayStep * 0.18;
4448:       const u1 = 0.08 + (bay + 1) * bayStep - bayStep * 0.18;
4449:       frames.poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0 - 0.012, v0 - 0.8, u1 + 0.012, v0 + windowH + 0.8), true);
4450:       const lit = ((variant + floor * 7 + bay * 13 + (side === "sun" ? 3 : 0)) % 9) === 0;
4451:       const paneTarget = lit ? litPanes : panes;
4452:       paneTarget.poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0, v0, u1, v0 + windowH), true);
4453:     }
4454:   }
4455:   frames.fill({ color: frameColor });
4456:   panes.fill({ color: glassColor });
4457:   litPanes.fill({ color: litColor });
4458:   panes.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -6), alpha: 0.4, width: 0.8 });
4459:   layer.addChild(frames, panes, litPanes);
4460: }
4461: 
4462: // Homes get a door instead of a storefront: a dark recessed leaf with a
4463: // lintel shadow on the sun wall near the front corner.
4464: function drawFacadeDoor(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, variant: number) {
4465:   const surface = wallSurface(geometry, variant % 2 === 0 ? "sun" : "shade");
4466:   if (surface.heightPx < 14) return;
4467:   const doorH = Math.min(11, surface.heightPx * 0.5);
4468:   const u0 = 0.6;
4469:   const u1 = Math.min(0.78, u0 + 14 / Math.max(14, surface.edgeLengthPx));
4470:   const leaf = new Graphics()
4471:     .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0, 0.5, u1, doorH), true)
4472:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(geometry.trimColor, 14) });
4473:   const lintelA = wallPoint(surface, u0 - 0.02, doorH + 1);
4474:   const lintelB = wallPoint(surface, u1 + 0.02, doorH + 1);
4475:   const lintel = new Graphics().moveTo(lintelA.x, lintelA.y).lineTo(lintelB.x, lintelB.y);
4476:   lintel.stroke({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, -44), alpha: 0.8, width: 1.4, cap: "butt" });
4477:   layer.addChild(leaf, lintel);
4478: }
4479: 
4480: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette â€” a setback upper tier for civic/venue/transit anchors,
4481: // so the hero landmark reads as a stepped, tall structure instead of a single
4482: // extruded box. A smaller box rises from the roof center with its own lit/shade
4483: // walls, cap, and a warm sunlit crown edge â€” the "this is the important building"
4484: // silhouette cue. Sun-consistent; only for tall anchors so it stays rare.
4485: // 0.53E item C â€” when the hero landmark carries the tiered crown, the crown
4486: // OWNS the roof: the five legacy civic functions that each float their own
4487: // pale cap/lantern/crown decal over the same roof plane must stand down, or
4488: // they average into a milky fog that erases the silhouette. Ground-level
4489: // richness (plinth, entry, columns, glass) stays untouched.
4490: function hasHeroTieredCrown(building: CityWorldBuilding): boolean {
4491:   return building.objectKit?.civicGeometry?.focusTarget === "eastvale_core";
4492: }
4493: 
4494: function drawTieredMassing(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4495:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
4496:   const isAnchor = family === "civic_landmark" || family === "venue_anchor" || family === "transit_anchor";
4497:   // 0.74F chunky treatment â€” tall apartment slabs also get one restrained
4498:   // setback tier, so towers read stepped instead of extruded.
4499:   const tallLowrise = family === "lowrise_cluster" && building.height >= 2.4;
4500:   if ((!isAnchor && !tallLowrise) || building.height < 1.9) return;
4501: 
4502:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor } = geometry;
4503:   // 0.53E item C â€” the hero landmark (typed via civicGeometry.focusTarget) gets
4504:   // a taller, front-offset, TWO-step crown so the stepped silhouette clears the
4505:   // place marker + label band that sit over the roof's back half. Ordinary
4506:   // anchors keep the single restrained tier.
4507:   const hero = hasHeroTieredCrown(building);
4508:   const steps = hero ? 2 : 1;
4509:   let tierW = footprintWidth * (hero ? 0.62 : 0.46);
4510:   let tierD = footprintDepth * (hero ? 0.62 : 0.46);
4511:   // Hero rise is tuned to the label band: the place label floats ~44px above
4512:   // the ground anchor, so the crown caps must land in the open window between
4513:   // the label's bottom edge and the roofline â€” taller just hides the crown
4514:   // behind the label backing. Offset left so the marker pin column clears it.
4515:   let rise = hero
4516:     ? Math.max(18, Math.min(building.height * TILE_DEPTH * 0.52, 30))
4517:     : Math.max(12, Math.min(building.height * TILE_DEPTH * 0.34, 30));
4518:   let baseC = hero
4519:     ? { x: top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.1 }
4520:     : { x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04 };
4521: 
4522:   for (let step = 0; step < steps; step += 1) {
4523:     const halfW = tierW / 2;
4524:     const halfD = tierD / 2;
4525:     const apex = { x: baseC.x, y: baseC.y - rise };
4526:     const bL = { x: baseC.x - halfW, y: baseC.y };
4527:     const bF = { x: baseC.x, y: baseC.y + halfD };
4528:     const bR = { x: baseC.x + halfW, y: baseC.y };
4529:     const tL = { x: apex.x - halfW, y: apex.y };
4530:     const tF = { x: apex.x, y: apex.y + halfD };
4531:     const tR = { x: apex.x + halfW, y: apex.y };
4532: 
4533:     const litWall = new Graphics()
4534:       .poly([tL.x, tL.y, tF.x, tF.y, bF.x, bF.y, bL.x, bL.y], true)
4535:       .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(bodyColor, "sun"), alpha: 0.98 });
4536:     const shadeWall = new Graphics()
4537:       .poly([tR.x, tR.y, tF.x, tF.y, bF.x, bF.y, bR.x, bR.y], true)
4538:       .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(bodyColor, "shade"), alpha: 0.98 });
4539:     // Hero caps hold a deeper roof tone so they stay saturated instead of
4540:     // blowing out toward white next to the sunlit cream walls.
4541:     const capTone = hero ? buildingFaceColor(shadeColor(roofColor, -12), "top") : buildingFaceColor(roofColor, "top");
4542:     const cap = polygon(diamondPoints(apex, tierW, tierD), capTone, 0.99, 0x26332c, hero ? 0.55 : 0.4);
4543:     const crown = new Graphics().moveTo(tL.x, tL.y).lineTo(apex.x, apex.y - halfD).lineTo(tR.x, tR.y);
4544:     crown.stroke({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 42), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.2), alpha: 0.85, width: 1.5, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4545:     const cornerSeam = new Graphics().moveTo(tF.x, tF.y).lineTo(bF.x, bF.y);
4546:     cornerSeam.stroke({ color: 0x18262e, alpha: 0.22, width: 1.1, cap: "round" });
4547:     layer.addChild(litWall, shadeWall, cap, crown, cornerSeam);
4548: 
4549:     // Next step rises from this cap, set back toward the sun-lit front corner.
4550:     baseC = { x: apex.x - tierW * 0.06, y: apex.y - tierD * 0.02 };
4551:     tierW *= 0.58;
4552:     tierD *= 0.58;
4553:     rise *= 0.6;
4554:   }
4555: }
4556: 
4557: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette â€” a recessed, glazed ground-floor band with a canopy lip
4558: // across the two front walls of commerce/civic/service buildings. Reads as a
4559: // real shopfront / entrance storey, so the box gains a base storey instead of
4560: // being a single blank extrusion. Sun-consistent; skips homes and towers.
4561: function drawStorefrontBase(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4562:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
4563:   const eligible = family === "commerce_strip" || family === "civic_landmark" || family === "service_block" || family === "venue_anchor" || family === "transit_anchor";
4564:   if (!eligible) return;
4565: 
4566:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor } = geometry;
4567:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
4568:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
4569:   const wallSpan = bottom.y - top.y;
4570:   if (wallSpan < 16) return; // too short to carry a distinct storey
4571:   const f = 0.66; // band starts ~two-thirds down the wall
4572:   const bandY = (edgeTopY: number) => edgeTopY + wallSpan * f;
4573:   const civic = family === "civic_landmark" || family === "venue_anchor" || family === "transit_anchor";
4574:   const glassTone = civic ? 0xd6e4e0 : 0xbfe2ea;
4575:   const recess = shadeColor(bodyColor, -30);
4576: 
4577:   // Left (sun) + right (shade) lower-wall quads.
4578:   const leftBand = new Graphics()
4579:     .poly([top.x - halfW, bandY(top.y), top.x, bandY(top.y + halfD), top.x, bottom.y + halfD, top.x - halfW, bottom.y], true)
4580:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(recess, "sun"), alpha: 0.55 });
4581:   const rightBand = new Graphics()
4582:     .poly([top.x + halfW, bandY(top.y), top.x, bandY(top.y + halfD), top.x, bottom.y + halfD, top.x + halfW, bottom.y], true)
4583:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(recess, "shade"), alpha: 0.6 });
4584:   // Glazing sheen on the sun side + a canopy lip line where the band starts.
4585:   const glazing = new Graphics()
4586:     .poly([top.x - halfW * 0.9, bandY(top.y) + wallSpan * 0.06, top.x - halfW * 0.06, bandY(top.y + halfD * 0.9) + wallSpan * 0.06, top.x - halfW * 0.06, bottom.y + halfD * 0.86, top.x - halfW * 0.9, bottom.y - wallSpan * 0.02], true)
4587:     .fill({ color: glassTone, alpha: civic ? 0.16 : 0.2 });
4588:   const canopy = new Graphics()
4589:     .moveTo(top.x - halfW, bandY(top.y))
4590:     .lineTo(top.x, bandY(top.y + halfD))
4591:     .lineTo(top.x + halfW, bandY(top.y));
4592:   canopy.stroke({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, 30), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.16), alpha: 0.7, width: 1.6, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4593:   layer.addChild(leftBand, rightBand, glazing, canopy);
4594: }
4595: 
4596: // Ambient occlusion + rim light for the box shell: dark gradient bands where
4597: // the walls meet the ground, a darkened seam on the front corner, and a warm
4598: // rim on the sun-facing top edge.
4599: function drawBuildingShellLighting(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry) {
4600:   const { bottom, top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, height, bodyColor } = geometry;
4601:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
4602:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
4603:   const topFront = { x: top.x, y: top.y + halfD };
4604:   const bottomLeft = { x: bottom.x - halfW, y: bottom.y };
4605:   const bottomRight = { x: bottom.x + halfW, y: bottom.y };
4606:   const bottomFront = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + halfD };
4607: 
4608:   const aoBand = (lift: number, alpha: number) =>
4609:     new Graphics()
4610:       .poly(
4611:         [
4612:           bottomLeft.x, bottomLeft.y - lift,
4613:           bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y - lift,
4614:           bottomRight.x, bottomRight.y - lift,
4615:           bottomRight.x, bottomRight.y,
4616:           bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y,
4617:           bottomLeft.x, bottomLeft.y,
4618:         ],
4619:         true,
4620:       )
4621:       .fill({ color: 0x18262e, alpha });
4622:   // 0.68H â€” firmer ground-contact bands.
4623:   const aoTall = Math.max(4, Math.min(height * 0.22, 12));
4624:   layer.addChild(aoBand(aoTall, 0.16), aoBand(aoTall * 0.5, 0.18));
4625: 
4626:   const cornerSeam = new Graphics().moveTo(topFront.x, topFront.y).lineTo(bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y);
4627:   cornerSeam.stroke({ color: 0x18262e, alpha: 0.26, width: 1.2, cap: "round" });
4628:   // Sun-corner pillar: a vertical highlight on the sun-facing outer edge â€”
4629:   // the "lit block corner" cue that separates the box from its neighbors.
4630:   cornerSeam
4631:     .moveTo(bottom.x - halfW, bottom.y)
4632:     .lineTo(top.x - halfW, top.y)
4633:     .stroke({ color: 0xfff4d6, alpha: 0.32, width: 1.3, cap: "round" });
4634: 
4635:   // 0.68H â€” the sun rim derives from the wall pigment instead of near-white.
4636:   const rim = new Graphics().moveTo(top.x - halfW, top.y).lineTo(topFront.x, topFront.y);
4637:   rim.stroke({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, 52), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.34), alpha: 0.6, width: 1.6, cap: "round" });
4638:   const shadeEdge = new Graphics().moveTo(topFront.x, topFront.y).lineTo(top.x + halfW, top.y);
4639:   shadeEdge.stroke({ color: 0x1a2c37, alpha: 0.46, width: 1.5, cap: "round" });
4640:   layer.addChild(cornerSeam, rim, shadeEdge);
4641: }
4642: 
4643: function drawAuthoredWallMaterial(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4644:   const profile = building.visualGrammar?.materialProfile;
4645:   if (!profile) return;
4646:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor } = geometry;
4647:   const halfWidth = footprintWidth / 2;
4648:   const wallY = (t: number) => top.y + (bottom.y - top.y) * t;
4649: 
4650:   const wallBand = (t: number, color: number, alpha: number, width: number, reach = 1): Graphics => {
4651:     const band = new Graphics()
4652:       .moveTo(top.x - halfWidth * reach, wallY(t) + (footprintDepth / 2) * (1 - reach))
4653:       .lineTo(top.x, wallY(t) + footprintDepth / 2)
4654:       .lineTo(top.x + halfWidth * reach, wallY(t) + (footprintDepth / 2) * (1 - reach));
4655:     band.stroke({ color, alpha, width, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4656:     return band;
4657:   };
4658: 
4659:   if (profile === "socal_stucco_warm") {
4660:     layer.addChild(wallBand(0.88, shadeColor(bodyColor, -30), 0.22, 1.5), wallBand(0.28, shadeColor(bodyColor, 26), 0.13, 1));
4661:     return;
4662:   }
4663: 
4664:   if (profile === "socal_stucco_light") {
4665:     layer.addChild(wallBand(0.6, shadeColor(bodyColor, 30), 0.15, 1), wallBand(0.88, shadeColor(bodyColor, -24), 0.17, 1.3));
4666:     return;
4667:   }
4668: 
4669:   if (profile === "socal_cool_stucco") {
4670:     const rightWash = new Graphics()
4671:       .poly(
4672:         [
4673:           top.x,
4674:           wallY(0.16) + footprintDepth / 2,
4675:           top.x + halfWidth,
4676:           wallY(0.16),
4677:           top.x + halfWidth,
4678:           wallY(0.94),
4679:           top.x,
4680:           wallY(0.94) + footprintDepth / 2,
4681:         ],
4682:         true,
4683:       )
4684:       .fill({ color: 0x5f7d86, alpha: 0.08 });
4685:     layer.addChild(rightWash, wallBand(0.88, shadeColor(bodyColor, -32), 0.19, 1.4));
4686:     return;
4687:   }
4688: 
4689:   if (profile === "socal_storefront") {
4690:     layer.addChild(
4691:       wallBand(0.52, 0xbfe2ea, 0.36, 4.2, 0.86),
4692:       wallBand(0.9, shadeColor(bodyColor, -44), 0.28, 2.1),
4693:     );
4694:     return;
4695:   }
4696: 
4697:   if (profile === "socal_lowrise") {
4698:     layer.addChild(
4699:       wallBand(0.34, shadeColor(bodyColor, -26), 0.15, 1),
4700:       wallBand(0.6, shadeColor(bodyColor, -26), 0.15, 1),
4701:       wallBand(0.9, shadeColor(bodyColor, -34), 0.19, 1.3),
4702:     );
4703:     return;
4704:   }
4705: 
4706:   if (profile === "civic_glass_stucco") {
4707:     const fins = new Graphics();
4708:     for (let fin = -1; fin <= 1; fin += 1) {
4709:       const u = fin * 0.34;
4710:       const x = top.x + u * halfWidth;
4711:       const lift = (1 - Math.abs(u)) * (footprintDepth / 2);
4712:       fins.moveTo(x, wallY(0.2) + lift).lineTo(x, wallY(0.92) + lift);
4713:     }
4714:     fins.stroke({ color: 0xcfeaf2, alpha: 0.26, width: 1.5, cap: "round" });
4715:     layer.addChild(fins, wallBand(0.92, shadeColor(bodyColor, -38), 0.24, 1.8));
4716:   }
4717: }
4718: 
4719: function drawRoof(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, materialTextureEnabled: boolean) {
4720:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, outline, activeStrokeAlpha } = geometry;
4721:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
4722:   // Roofs are the brightest surfaces in the scene: lit from above by the sun.
4723:   // 0.68H â€” brightest but still pigmented: the building-face top curve keeps
4724:   // roof color identity instead of riding the rolloff into paper white.
4725:   const roof = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth), buildingFaceColor(roofColor, "top"), 0.99, outline, activeStrokeAlpha);
4726:   layer.addChild(roof);
4727: 
4728:   // Sun-facing upper-left roof edge catches a warm rim; the lower-right edge
4729:   // falls away into shade â€” consistent with the wall shading below.
4730:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
4731:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
4732:   // 0.53E item D â€” a whisper directional split across the roof plane itself:
4733:   // the sun-side half lifts warm, the fall-away half cools, so every roof
4734:   // reads directional under the same key light as the walls. Deliberately
4735:   // faint â€” this is the ROOF light finish, not the 0.54E whole-canvas grade.
4736:   const roofLitHalf = new Graphics()
4737:     .poly([top.x, top.y - halfD, top.x, top.y + halfD, top.x - halfW, top.y], true)
4738:     .fill({ color: 0xfff3d2, alpha: 0.09 });
4739:   const roofShadeHalf = new Graphics()
4740:     .poly([top.x, top.y - halfD, top.x, top.y + halfD, top.x + halfW, top.y], true)
4741:     .fill({ color: 0x2c4a5e, alpha: 0.13 });
4742:   const roofRim = new Graphics()
4743:     .moveTo(top.x - halfW, top.y)
4744:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y - halfD);
4745:   // 0.68H â€” the sun rim derives from roof pigment instead of near-white.
4746:   roofRim.stroke({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 50), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.3), alpha: 0.62, width: 1.7, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4747:   const roofFall = new Graphics()
4748:     .moveTo(top.x, top.y - halfD)
4749:     .lineTo(top.x + halfW, top.y);
4750:   roofFall.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -52), alpha: 0.58, width: 1.5, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4751:   layer.addChild(roofLitHalf, roofShadeHalf, roofRim, roofFall);
4752: 
4753:   const lines = new Graphics();
4754:   const generatedBuilding = building.id.startsWith("gen-building-");
4755:   if (roofShape === "gable") {
4756:     const ridgeHalf = footprintWidth * 0.24;
4757:     const ridgeY = top.y - footprintDepth * 0.035;
4758:     if (generatedBuilding) {
4759:       lines
4760:         .moveTo(top.x - ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4761:         .lineTo(top.x + ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4762:         .moveTo(top.x - ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4763:         .lineTo(top.x - halfW, top.y)
4764:         .moveTo(top.x + ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4765:         .lineTo(top.x + halfW, top.y);
4766:     } else {
4767:       lines
4768:         .moveTo(top.x - ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4769:         .lineTo(top.x + ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4770:         .moveTo(top.x - ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4771:         .lineTo(top.x, top.y - halfD)
4772:         .moveTo(top.x + ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4773:         .lineTo(top.x, top.y - halfD)
4774:         .moveTo(top.x - ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4775:         .lineTo(top.x - halfW, top.y)
4776:         .moveTo(top.x + ridgeHalf, ridgeY)
4777:         .lineTo(top.x + halfW, top.y)
4778:         .moveTo(top.x, top.y + halfD * 0.82)
4779:         .lineTo(top.x - ridgeHalf * 0.9, ridgeY)
4780:         .moveTo(top.x, top.y + halfD * 0.82)
4781:         .lineTo(top.x + ridgeHalf * 0.9, ridgeY);
4782:     }
4783:   } else if (roofShape === "hip") {
4784:     const inset = diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.44, footprintDepth * 0.38);
4785:     lines.poly(inset, true);
4786:     if (!generatedBuilding) {
4787:       lines
4788:         .moveTo(top.x, top.y - halfD)
4789:         .lineTo(top.x, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.19)
4790:         .moveTo(top.x + halfW, top.y)
4791:         .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.22, top.y)
4792:         .moveTo(top.x, top.y + halfD)
4793:         .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.19)
4794:         .moveTo(top.x - halfW, top.y)
4795:         .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.22, top.y);
4796:     }
4797:   } else if (roofShape === "sawtooth") {
4798:     // Sawtooth reads as MATERIAL, not linework: alternating lit/shade tooth
4799:     // strips filled inside the roof diamond (the old naked diagonal strokes
4800:     // read as scribble). Strip extents follow the diamond edge so teeth can
4801:     // never bleed past the eaves on generated footprints.
4802:     const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
4803:     const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
4804:     const eaveRise = (dx: number) => halfD * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(dx) / halfW) * 0.86;
4805:     const teeth = new Graphics();
4806:     const shadeTeeth = new Graphics();
4807:     const stripCount = 6;
4808:     for (let i = 0; i < stripCount; i += 1) {
4809:       const xa = -halfW * 0.86 + (i * (halfW * 1.72)) / stripCount;
4810:       const xb = xa + (halfW * 1.72) / stripCount;
4811:       const target = i % 2 === 0 ? teeth : shadeTeeth;
4812:       target.poly(
4813:         [top.x + xa, top.y - eaveRise(xa), top.x + xb, top.y - eaveRise(xb), top.x + xb, top.y + eaveRise(xb), top.x + xa, top.y + eaveRise(xa)],
4814:         true,
4815:       );
4816:     }
4817:     teeth.fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, 16) });
4818:     shadeTeeth.fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -14) });
4819:     layer.addChild(teeth, shadeTeeth);
4820:   } else if (roofShape === "tower") {
4821:     lines
4822:       .poly(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - 12 }, footprintWidth * 0.36, footprintDepth * 0.34), true)
4823:       .moveTo(top.x, top.y - 24)
4824:       .lineTo(top.x, top.y - 3);
4825:   } else {
4826:     // 0.74F chunky treatment â€” flat roofs step: a darker inner well between
4827:     // the roof rim and a RAISED inset cap deck. The lid reads as stacked
4828:     // voxel slabs instead of a flush sticker. Inset-only (never past eaves).
4829:     lines
4830:       .poly(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.86, footprintDepth * 0.82), true)
4831:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(sunlitColor(roofColor, "top"), -16) });
4832:     lines
4833:       .poly(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - 2.5 }, footprintWidth * 0.7, footprintDepth * 0.64), true)
4834:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 8), "top") });
4835:     lines.poly(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.72, footprintDepth * 0.64), true);
4836:   }
4837:   lines.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -44), alpha: 0.38, width: 1.5, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4838:   layer.addChild(lines);
4839:   if (materialTextureEnabled) drawRoofMaterialTexture(layer, geometry, building);
4840:   drawParapetCap(layer, geometry, building, roofShape);
4841:   drawRoofMaterial(layer, geometry, building);
4842:   drawAuthoredRoofProfile(layer, geometry, building);
4843: }
4844: 
4845: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette â€” a raised parapet wall around a flat roof edge. This is
4846: // 0.75C-3 close-zoom material: coarse roof seams and cells stay clipped to the
4847: // roof diamond and draw only behind parapets/authored roof profiles.
4848: function drawRoofMaterialTexture(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4849:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
4850:   if (footprintWidth < 28 || footprintDepth < 16) return;
4851:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
4852:   const material = new Graphics();
4853:   const courseCount = Math.max(3, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Math.min(footprintWidth, footprintDepth) / 9)));
4854:   const seamColor = shadeColor(roofColor, -18);
4855:   const capColor = shadeColor(roofColor, 18);
4856: 
4857:   for (let course = 1; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
4858:     const seed = materialTextureSeed(building.id, `roof-${roofShape}`, course);
4859:     const t = course / courseCount;
4860:     const start = roofMaterialPoint(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, 0.12, t);
4861:     const end = roofMaterialPoint(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, 0.88, t);
4862:     material.moveTo(start.x, start.y).lineTo(end.x, end.y);
4863: 
4864:     if (seed % 3 !== 0) continue;
4865:     const u0 = 0.18 + ((Math.floor(seed / 11) % 4) * 0.14);
4866:     const u1 = Math.min(0.82, u0 + 0.16);
4867:     const t0 = Math.max(0.08, t - 0.055);
4868:     const t1 = Math.min(0.92, t + 0.055);
4869:     material
4870:       .poly(roofMaterialQuadPoints(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, u0, t0, u1, t1), true)
4871:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, materialTextureDelta(seed)), alpha: 0.12 });
4872:   }
4873:   material.stroke({ color: seamColor, alpha: roofShape === "flat" ? 0.2 : 0.16, width: 1, cap: "butt", join: "round" });
4874: 
4875:   if (roofShape === "gable" || roofShape === "hip") {
4876:     const caps = 2 + (materialTextureSeed(building.id, "roof-ridge", 0) % 3);
4877:     for (let cap = 0; cap < caps; cap += 1) {
4878:       const seed = materialTextureSeed(building.id, "roof-ridge", cap);
4879:       const u = 0.34 + (cap / Math.max(1, caps - 1)) * 0.32;
4880:       const t = 0.42 + (seed % 3) * 0.035;
4881:       const center = roofMaterialPoint(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, u, t);
4882:       material
4883:         .moveTo(center.x - 3.2, center.y - 1.2)
4884:         .lineTo(center.x + 3.2, center.y + 1.2);
4885:     }
4886:     material.stroke({ color: capColor, alpha: 0.22, width: 1.4, cap: "butt", join: "round" });
4887:   }
4888: 
4889:   layer.addChild(material);
4890: }
4891: 
4892: function roofMaterialPoint(top: ProjectedPoint, width: number, depth: number, u: number, t: number): ProjectedPoint {
4893:   const halfW = width / 2;
4894:   const halfD = depth / 2;
4895:   const clampedT = clamp(t, 0, 1);
4896:   const span = halfW * (1 - Math.abs(clampedT * 2 - 1));
4897:   return {
4898:     x: top.x + (clamp(u, 0, 1) * 2 - 1) * span,
4899:     y: top.y - halfD + depth * clampedT,
4900:   };
4901: }
4902: 
4903: function roofMaterialQuadPoints(top: ProjectedPoint, width: number, depth: number, u0: number, t0: number, u1: number, t1: number): number[] {
4904:   const a = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u0, t0);
4905:   const b = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u1, t0);
4906:   const c = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u1, t1);
4907:   const d = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u0, t1);
4908:   return [a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y, d.x, d.y];
4909: }
4910: 
4911: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette - a raised parapet wall around a flat roof edge. This is
4912: // the single biggest "box -> building" cue: the roof stops reading as a flush
4913: // lid and starts reading as a real rooftop bounded by a low wall.
4914: function drawParapetCap(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, roofShape: CityWorldBuilding["roofShape"]) {
4915:   if (roofShape !== "flat" && roofShape !== "sawtooth") return;
4916:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
4917:   const eligible =
4918:     family === "commerce_strip" || family === "civic_landmark" || family === "lowrise_cluster" ||
4919:     family === "service_block" || family === "venue_anchor" || family === "transit_anchor";
4920:   if (!eligible) return;
4921: 
4922:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
4923:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
4924:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
4925:   const lift = Math.max(3.2, Math.min(footprintWidth * 0.05, 6.5));
4926:   // Perimeter diamond corners of the roof top.
4927:   const left = { x: top.x - halfW, y: top.y };
4928:   const front = { x: top.x, y: top.y + halfD };
4929:   const right = { x: top.x + halfW, y: top.y };
4930: 
4931:   // Two lit-vs-shade parapet wall faces standing up from the front edges.
4932:   const litFace = new Graphics()
4933:     .poly([left.x, left.y, front.x, front.y, front.x, front.y - lift, left.x, left.y - lift], true)
4934:     .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(shadeColor(roofColor, -6), "sun"), alpha: 0.9 });
4935:   const shadeFace = new Graphics()
4936:     .poly([front.x, front.y, right.x, right.y, right.x, right.y - lift, front.x, front.y - lift], true)
4937:     .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(shadeColor(roofColor, -6), "shade"), alpha: 0.92 });
4938:   // Bright coping line along the top of the parapet + a warm sunlit front corner.
4939:   const coping = new Graphics()
4940:     .moveTo(left.x, left.y - lift)
4941:     .lineTo(front.x, front.y - lift)
4942:     .lineTo(right.x, right.y - lift);
4943:   coping.stroke({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 40), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.18), alpha: 0.85, width: 1.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
4944:   layer.addChild(litFace, shadeFace, coping);
4945: }
4946: 
4947: function drawAuthoredRoofProfile(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
4948:   const profile = building.visualGrammar?.roofProfile;
4949:   if (!profile) return;
4950:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
4951: 
4952:   if (profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" || profile === "cool_clay_tile" || profile === "sage_tile") {
4953:     // 0.53E item B â€” clay reads warm and COURSED: a stronger tile tint plus
4954:     // eave-parallel course lines so tile separates from metal (smooth/cool)
4955:     // and membrane (flat/dark) at a glance.
4956:     const tileTint = profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 0xc4764e : profile === "cool_clay_tile" ? 0x7f9aa8 : 0x8ba372;
4957:     // Tile identity = tint + ridge barrel caps. The old chevron course strokes
4958:     // stacked with the gable ridge/eave linework into roof scribble.
4959:     const tint = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.94, footprintDepth * 0.86), tileTint, profile === "sage_tile" ? 0.2 : 0.18, tileTint, 0);
4960:     const ridgeStart = { x: top.x - footprintWidth * 0.24, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.13 };
4961:     const ridgeEnd = { x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.24, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.13 };
4962:     const barrelCaps = new Graphics();
4963:     const capCount = profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 5 : 4;
4964:     for (let cap = 0; cap < capCount; cap += 1) {
4965:       const t = capCount > 1 ? cap / (capCount - 1) : 0.5;
4966:       const x = ridgeStart.x + (ridgeEnd.x - ridgeStart.x) * t;
4967:       const y = ridgeStart.y + (ridgeEnd.y - ridgeStart.y) * t;
4968:       barrelCaps.moveTo(x, y - 1.8).lineTo(x, y + 1.8);
4969:     }
4970:     barrelCaps.stroke({
4971:       color: shadeColor(roofColor, profile === "cool_clay_tile" ? 34 : 28),
4972:       alpha: profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 0.5 : 0.4,
4973:       width: profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 1.7 : 1.3,
4974:       cap: "round",
4975:     });
4976:     layer.addChild(tint, barrelCaps);
4977:     return;
4978:   }
4979: 
4980:   if (profile === "flat_parapet_cap") {
4981:     // 0.53E item B â€” the parapet (drawParapetCap) and the roof deck must read
4982:     // as ONE surface: a recessed membrane field sits inside the parapet line,
4983:     // darker than the coping, with gravel flecks on the membrane. The old
4984:     // bright cap ring competed with the parapet coping and made two decals.
4985:     const membrane = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.84, footprintDepth * 0.76), shadeColor(roofColor, -14), 0.32, shadeColor(roofColor, -30), 0.24);
4986:     const gravelFlecks = new Graphics()
4987:       .circle(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.16, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04, 1.1)
4988:       .circle(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.06, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.1, 1)
4989:       .circle(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.2, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08, 1.1)
4990:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, 22), alpha: 0.34 });
4991:     layer.addChild(membrane, gravelFlecks);
4992:     return;
4993:   }
4994: 
4995:   if (profile === "blue_metal_utility") {
4996:     // 0.53E item B â€” metal reads SMOOTH and COOL: a cool panel field under
4997:     // crisper standing seams and a long specular streak. No courses, no warmth.
4998:     const panelField = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.9, footprintDepth * 0.82), mixColor(roofColor, SUN_COOL_TINT, 0.24), 0.16, roofColor, 0);
4999:     const seams = new Graphics();
5000:     for (let seam = -2; seam <= 2; seam += 1) {
5001:       const offset = seam * footprintWidth * 0.13;
5002:       seams
5003:         .moveTo(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.09, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
5004:         .lineTo(top.x + offset + footprintWidth * 0.09, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.2);
5005:     }
5006:     // Parallel seams only. The old counter-diagonal sheen streak crossed the
5007:     // seams into an X-scribble at map zoom â€” metal identity is the cool panel
5008:     // field + quiet seams.
5009:     seams.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -30), alpha: 0.22, width: 1, cap: "round" });
5010:     layer.addChild(panelField, seams);
5011:     return;
5012:   }
5013: 
5014:   if (profile === "civic_glass_cap") {
5015:     // 0.53E item B â€” civic glass reads GLAZED: a wider glass field with a
5016:     // mullion cross and a bright specular so it is unmistakable next to clay
5017:     // and metal, and catches the key light (item D pairs the roof rim).
5018:     const glassField = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04 }, footprintWidth * 0.62, footprintDepth * 0.44), 0xbfe4ee, 0.3, 0x4e8298, 0.2);
5019:     const mullions = new Graphics()
5020:       .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.31, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04)
5021:       .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.31, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04)
5022:       .moveTo(top.x, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.26)
5023:       .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.18);
5024:     mullions.stroke({ color: 0x4e8298, alpha: 0.28, width: 1, cap: "round" });
5025:     const specular = new Graphics()
5026:       .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.16)
5027:       .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04);
5028:     specular.stroke({ color: 0xeafaff, alpha: 0.55, width: 1.8, cap: "round" });
5029:     layer.addChild(glassField, mullions, specular);
5030:   }
5031: }

5033: function drawRoofMaterial(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
5034:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
5035:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
5036:   const detail = new Graphics();
5037:   const dark = shadeColor(roofColor, -38);
5038:   const light = shadeColor(roofColor, 24);
5039: 
5040:   detail
5041:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.5, top.y)
5042:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.5)
5043:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.5, top.y)
5044:     .stroke({ color: dark, alpha: 0.38, width: 2.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5045: 
5046:   if (roofShape === "hip") {
5047:     detail
5048:       .poly(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.72, footprintDepth * 0.66), true)
5049:       .stroke({ color: dark, alpha: 0.16, width: 1.2 })
5050:       .poly(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.42, footprintDepth * 0.36), true)
5051:       .stroke({ color: light, alpha: 0.16, width: 1.1 });
5052:   } else if (roofShape === "flat") {
5053:     detail
5054:       .poly(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.82, footprintDepth * 0.72), true)
5055:       .stroke({ color: dark, alpha: 0.24, width: 1.4 })
5056:       .poly(diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.13, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04 }, footprintWidth * 0.18, footprintDepth * 0.16), true)
5057:       .fill({ color: light, alpha: 0.14 })
5058:       .stroke({ color: dark, alpha: 0.14, width: 1 });
5059:   }
5060:   layer.addChild(detail);
5061:   if (!isDraftBuilding(building)) drawSoCalRoofCourses(layer, geometry, building);
5062: }
5063: 
5064: function drawSoCalRoofCourses(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
5065:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
5066:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
5067:   // One eave shadow under pitched home roofs. The old wandering parapet
5068:   // squiggles, shingle-course strokes, and translucent roof pads were the
5069:   // scribble noise that made roofs read procedural.
5070:   if (building.kind !== "home" || (roofShape !== "gable" && roofShape !== "hip")) return;
5071:   const eaveLip = new Graphics()
5072:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.5, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.02)
5073:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
5074:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.5, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.02);
5075:   eaveLip.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -50), alpha: 0.24, width: 1.8, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5076:   layer.addChild(eaveLip);
5077: }
5078: 
5079: function drawWallDepthLines(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
5080:   if (building.kind !== "home" && building.kind !== "shop" && building.kind !== "civic") return;
5081:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, trimColor } = geometry;
5082:   const lineAlpha = building.kind === "civic" ? 0.18 : 0.14;
5083:   const ribs = new Graphics();
5084:   const count = building.facadeStyle === "rowhome" || building.facadeStyle === "strip_store" ? 4 : 2;
5085:   for (let index = 1; index <= count; index += 1) {
5086:     const offset = (index / (count + 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.72;
5087:     ribs
5088:       .moveTo(top.x + offset, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.12)
5089:       .lineTo(bottom.x + offset * 0.7, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08);
5090:   }
5091:   ribs.stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: lineAlpha, width: 1, cap: "round" });
5092:   layer.addChild(ribs);
5093: }

5095: function drawHomeDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
5096:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, bodyColor, highlightColor, trimColor, accentColor } = geometry;
5097:   const style = building.facadeStyle ?? "cottage";
5098:   const foundation = new Graphics()
5099:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.34, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16)
5100:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.32)
5101:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.34, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16)
5102:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.26, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.24)
5103:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.38)
5104:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.26, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.24)
5105:     .closePath()
5106:     .fill({ color: 0xe7d0a2, alpha: style === "rowhome" ? 0.46 : 0.34 })
5107:     .stroke({ color: 0x7f6d4e, alpha: 0.18, width: 1 });
5108:   layer.addChild(foundation);
5109:   drawResidentialMaterialBands(layer, geometry, style);
5110:   drawResidentialAuthorshipVariation(layer, geometry, building, style);
5111: 
5112:   if (style === "cottage") {
5113:     const roofLip = new Graphics()
5114:       .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.5, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.01)
5115:       .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.31)
5116:       .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.5, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.01)
5117:       .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.45, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
5118:       .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.37)
5119:       .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.45, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
5120:       .closePath()
5121:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -30), alpha: 0.18 });
5122:     const gableFace = polygon(
5123:       [
5124:         top.x - footprintWidth * 0.22,
5125:         top.y + footprintDepth * 0.07,
5126:         top.x,
5127:         top.y + footprintDepth * 0.27,
5128:         top.x + footprintWidth * 0.22,
5129:         top.y + footprintDepth * 0.07,
5130:         top.x,
5131:         top.y + footprintDepth * 0.02,
5132:       ],
5133:       shadeColor(bodyColor, 10),
5134:       0.62,
5135:       shadeColor(roofColor, -42),
5136:       0.22,
5137:     );
5138:     const porchShadow = new Graphics()

5244: function drawResidentialAuthorshipVariation(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, style: CityWorldBuilding["facadeStyle"]) {
5245:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, bodyColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
5246:   const variant = objectVariant(building.id, 4);
5247:   const accentShift = variant % 2 === 0 ? shadeColor(bodyColor, 22) : shadeColor(roofColor, 18);
5248: 
5249:   if (style === "cottage") {
5250:     const gableOffset = variant === 1 ? -footprintWidth * 0.18 : variant === 2 ? footprintWidth * 0.16 : 0;
5251:     const dormer = polygon(
5252:       diamondPoints({ x: top.x + gableOffset, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.09 }, footprintWidth * 0.18, footprintDepth * 0.13),
5253:       shadeColor(roofColor, variant === 3 ? 18 : 8),
5254:       0.42,
5255:       trimColor,
5256:       0.14,
5257:     );
5258:     const dormerFace = new Graphics()
5259:       .roundRect(top.x + gableOffset - footprintWidth * 0.035, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08, footprintWidth * 0.07, 7, 1.5)
5260:       .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: 0.56 })
5261:       .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.18, width: 0.8 });
5262:     layer.addChild(dormer, dormerFace);
5263:     return;
5264:   }
5265: 
5266:   if (style === "ranch") {
5267:     const porchSide = variant < 2 ? -1 : 1;
5268:     const sideEntry = polygon(
5269:       diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x + porchSide * footprintWidth * 0.25, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.26 }, footprintWidth * 0.24, footprintDepth * 0.1),
5270:       0xe9d3a5,
5271:       0.42,
5272:       0x7f6d4e,
5273:       0.16,
5274:     );
5275:     const garageFace = new Graphics()
5276:       .roundRect(top.x - porchSide * footprintWidth * 0.34, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.06, footprintWidth * 0.18, 9, 1.5)
5277:       .fill({ color: accentShift, alpha: 0.26 })
5278:       .moveTo(top.x - porchSide * footprintWidth * 0.33, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02)
5279:       .lineTo(top.x - porchSide * footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02);
5280:     garageFace.stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.18, width: 1, cap: "round" });
5281:     layer.addChild(sideEntry, garageFace);
5282:   }
5283: }

5285: function drawResidentialMaterialBands(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, style: CityWorldBuilding["facadeStyle"]) {
5286:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
5287:   const materialAlpha = style === "ranch" ? 0.3 : style === "rowhome" ? 0.22 : 0.26;
5288:   const lowerShadow = new Graphics()
5289:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.44, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.01)
5290:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.17, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.11)
5291:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.01)
5292:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.44, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02)
5293:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.16, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.11)
5294:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.1, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.02);
5295:   lowerShadow.stroke({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, -28), alpha: materialAlpha, width: 1.3, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5296: 
5297:   const trimBand = new Graphics()
5298:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.38, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.21)
5299:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
5300:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.38, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
5301:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08);
5302:   trimBand.stroke({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, 26), alpha: style === "ranch" ? 0.24 : 0.2, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5303: 
5304:   const sillColor = shadeColor(trimColor, 16);
5305:   const sills = new Graphics();
5306:   const windowCount = style === "ranch" ? 4 : style === "rowhome" ? 3 : 2;
5307:   for (let index = 0; index < windowCount; index += 1) {
5308:     const position = index / (windowCount - 1);
5309:     const x = top.x - footprintWidth * 0.32 + position * footprintWidth * 0.64;
5310:     const y = bottom.y - footprintDepth * (style === "ranch" ? 0.17 : 0.2) + (index % 2) * 2;
5311:     sills
5312:       .roundRect(x - footprintWidth * 0.035, y + 6, footprintWidth * 0.08, 3.2, 1.5)
5313:       .fill({ color: sillColor, alpha: 0.34 })
5314:       .roundRect(x - footprintWidth * 0.032, y - 1, footprintWidth * 0.074, 6, 1.5)
5315:       .stroke({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, -34), alpha: 0.14, width: 1 });
5316:   }
5317: 
5318:   const eaveShadow = new Graphics()
5319:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.46, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.05)
5320:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.3)
5321:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.46, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.05);
5322:   eaveShadow.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -48), alpha: style === "rowhome" ? 0.14 : 0.24, width: 1.8, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5323: 
5324:   const sideFacet = polygon(
5325:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.22, y: bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08 }, footprintWidth * 0.16, footprintDepth * 0.14),
5326:     shadeColor(bodyColor, -14),
5327:     style === "ranch" ? 0.16 : 0.12,
5328:     0xffffff,
5329:     0,
5330:   );
5331:   layer.addChild(sideFacet, lowerShadow, trimBand, sills, eaveShadow);
5332: }

5375:     .roundRect(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.16, footprintWidth * 0.22, 12, 2)

5396:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.24, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.04)
5397:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.1)
5398:     .lineTo(top.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.21)
5399:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.1)
5400:     .closePath()

5416:       .lineTo(top.x + tooth * (footprintWidth * 0.12) + footprintWidth * 0.05, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)

5424:     .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: 0.34 });

5428: function drawApartmentDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry) {
5429:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, bodyColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
5430:   const roofCap = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.06 }, footprintWidth * 0.68, footprintDepth * 0.46), shadeColor(roofColor, 16), 0.48, trimColor, 0.16);
5431:   const stairCore = polygon(
5432:     diamondPoints({ x: top.x - footprintWidth * 0.27, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.12 }, footprintWidth * 0.22, footprintDepth * 0.22),
5433:     shadeColor(bodyColor, -10),
5434:     0.42,
5435:     trimColor,
5436:     0.14,
5437:   );
5438:   layer.addChild(roofCap, stairCore);
5439: 
5440:   const steppedWing = polygon(
5441:     diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.25, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.15 }, footprintWidth * 0.24, footprintDepth * 0.28),
5442:     shadeColor(bodyColor, -8),
5443:     0.34,
5444:     trimColor,
5445:     0.12,
5446:   );
5447:   const wingCap = polygon(
5448:     diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.25, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08 }, footprintWidth * 0.2, footprintDepth * 0.18),
5449:     shadeColor(roofColor, 18),
5450:     0.38,
5451:     trimColor,
5452:     0.12,
5453:   );
5454:   layer.addChild(steppedWing, wingCap);
5455: 
5456:   // 0.57E parity â€” window columns LIVE on the front-left wall face: each
5457:   // column starts under the eave line at its own horizontal offset (the face
5458:   // slopes down toward center) and rows divide the actual wall height. The
5459:   // old fixed-pixel grid floated columns off the face on generated widths.
5460:   const windows = new Graphics();
5461:   const wallHalfW = footprintWidth / 2;
5462:   const wallHalfD = footprintDepth / 2;
5463:   const wallHeight = Math.max(0, bottom.y - top.y);
5464:   const windowRows = Math.min(4, Math.max(2, Math.floor((wallHeight - 8) / 9)));
5465:   const rowStep = (wallHeight - 10) / windowRows;
5466:   for (let col = 0; col < 3; col += 1) {
5467:     const dx = -footprintWidth * (0.34 - col * 0.13);
5468:     const eaveDrop = wallHalfD * (1 - Math.abs(dx) / wallHalfW);
5469:     for (let row = 0; row < windowRows; row += 1) {
5470:       const x = top.x + dx;
5471:       const y = top.y + eaveDrop + 4 + row * rowStep;
5472:       windows
5473:         .roundRect(x - 1, y - 1, 9, 7, 1.5)
5474:         .fill({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, -34), alpha: 0.22 })

5513:     .poly(diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.18, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.02 }, footprintWidth * 0.2, footprintDepth * 0.13), true)

5518: function drawCivicDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
5519:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, highlightColor, accentColor, trimColor } = geometry;
5520:   const roofTier = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04 }, footprintWidth * 0.72, footprintDepth * 0.58), shadeColor(roofColor, 16), 0.56, trimColor, 0.2);
5521:   const roofCap = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.18 }, footprintWidth * 0.42, footprintDepth * 0.34), shadeColor(roofColor, 28), 0.78, trimColor, 0.24);
5522:   const skylight = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.16 }, footprintWidth * 0.16, footprintDepth * 0.12), 0xdaf2ff, 0.5, trimColor, 0.12);
5523:   const roofShadow = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.06 }, footprintWidth * 0.78, footprintDepth * 0.48), shadeColor(roofColor, -18), 0.2, trimColor, 0);
5524:   const roofFacetLeft = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x - footprintWidth * 0.22, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04 }, footprintWidth * 0.22, footprintDepth * 0.18), shadeColor(roofColor, 30), 0.28, trimColor, 0.08);
5525:   const roofFacetRight = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.22, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.02 }, footprintWidth * 0.22, footprintDepth * 0.18), shadeColor(roofColor, -8), 0.22, trimColor, 0.08);
5526:   const roofRidge = new Graphics()
5527:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.25, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.19)
5528:     .lineTo(top.x, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.29)
5529:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.25, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.19);
5530:   roofRidge.stroke({ color: 0xe7f4f0, alpha: 0.3, width: 1.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5531:   if (!hasHeroTieredCrown(building)) layer.addChild(roofShadow, roofTier, roofFacetLeft, roofFacetRight, roofCap, skylight, roofRidge);
5532: 
5533:   const plinth = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16 }, footprintWidth * 0.72, footprintDepth * 0.24), 0xe6cf9f, 0.36, 0x7f6d4e, 0.12);
5534:   const sideTerraceLeft = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.31, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22 }, footprintWidth * 0.22, footprintDepth * 0.15), 0xd8c08d, 0.4, 0x7f6d4e, 0.14);
5535:   const sideTerraceRight = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.31, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.2 }, footprintWidth * 0.22, footprintDepth * 0.15), 0xd8c08d, 0.36, 0x7f6d4e, 0.12);
5536:   const frontSteps = new Graphics()
5537:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.28, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
5538:     .lineTo(top.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22)
5539:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.28, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
5540:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.2, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16)
5541:     .lineTo(top.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.28)
5542:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.2, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.16)
5543:     .closePath()
5544:     .fill({ color: 0xe7d0a2, alpha: 0.76 })
5545:     .stroke({ color: 0x7f6d4e, alpha: 0.24, width: 1.2 });
5546:   const entryBlock = new Graphics()
5547:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.31, footprintWidth * 0.36, 22, 3)
5548:     .fill({ color: 0xf8e8ca, alpha: 0.84 })
5549:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.2, footprintWidth * 0.16, 15, 3)
5550:     .fill({ color: 0x5d8fa8, alpha: 0.78 })
5551:     .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.28, width: 1.1 });
5552:   const entryCanopy = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.34 }, footprintWidth * 0.46, footprintDepth * 0.16), shadeColor(roofColor, 20), 0.64, trimColor, 0.2);
5553:   const columns = new Graphics();
5554:   for (let col = -2; col <= 2; col += 1) {
5555:     columns
5556:       .roundRect(top.x + col * (footprintWidth * 0.115) - 2.4, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.34, 4.8, 23, 1.5)
5557:       .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: 0.95 });
5558:   }
5559:   columns
5560:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.3, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.41, footprintWidth * 0.6, 7, 2)
5561:     .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: 0.94 })
5562:     .circle(top.x, top.y - 20, 7)
5563:     .fill({ color: roofColor, alpha: 0.96 })
5564:     .stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.32, width: 1 });
5565:   const sideWindows = new Graphics();
5566:   for (let col = -1; col <= 1; col += 1) {
5567:     sideWindows
5568:       .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.36 + col * (footprintWidth * 0.11), bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.08, 7, 7, 1.5)
5569:       .roundRect(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.23 + col * (footprintWidth * 0.08), bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.13, 6, 7, 1.5);
5570:   }
5571:   sideWindows.fill({ color: 0xfff4bd, alpha: 0.68 }).stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.18, width: 0.8 });
5572:   const facadeRhythm = new Graphics()
5573:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.22)
5574:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.3, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.13)
5575:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.22)
5576:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.3, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.13)
5577:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.34, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.02)
5578:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.14)
5579:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.34, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.02)
5580:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.14);
5581:   facadeRhythm.stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.16, width: 1.1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5582:   const baseRibs = new Graphics()
5583:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.48, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02)
5584:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.31, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
5585:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.48, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02)
5586:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.31, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08);
5587:   baseRibs.stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.14, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5588:   // 0.55E decal discipline â€” on object-kit civic landmarks the kit read owns
5589:   // the plinth (plinthTiers), the entry canopy, and the facade bar rhythm, so
5590:   // this generation's plinth pad, canopy, and near-white column bars (the
5591:   // worst single wash: 5 bars + a wide band at alpha ~0.95) stand down there.
5592:   // Non-kit civic buildings keep the full legacy read.
5593:   if (isObjectKitCivicLandmark(building)) {
5594:     layer.addChild(sideTerraceLeft, sideTerraceRight, frontSteps, entryBlock, sideWindows, facadeRhythm, baseRibs);
5595:   } else {
5596:     layer.addChild(sideTerraceLeft, sideTerraceRight, plinth, frontSteps, entryBlock, entryCanopy, columns, sideWindows, facadeRhythm, baseRibs);
5597:   }
5598: 
5599:   const flag = new Graphics()
5600:     .rect(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, top.y - 34, 2, 17)
5601:     .fill({ color: 0x46564f, alpha: 0.86 })
5602:     .poly([top.x + footprintWidth * 0.1, top.y - 34, top.x + footprintWidth * 0.28, top.y - 29, top.x + footprintWidth * 0.1, top.y - 25], true)
5603:     .fill({ color: accentColor, alpha: 0.92 });
5604:   layer.addChild(flag);
5605: 
5606:   if (building.id === "building-civic") drawEastvaleCoreLandmarkDetails(layer, geometry);
5607: }

5609: function drawEastvaleCoreLandmarkDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry) {
5610:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, highlightColor, trimColor } = geometry;
5611:   const entryGlass = new Graphics()
5612:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.16, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.28, footprintWidth * 0.32, 24, 4)
5613:     .fill({ color: 0xb7dceb, alpha: 0.74 })
5614:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.13, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.25, footprintWidth * 0.1, 18, 2)
5615:     .fill({ color: 0xe7f6f4, alpha: 0.44 })
5616:     .roundRect(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.03, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.25, footprintWidth * 0.1, 18, 2)
5617:     .fill({ color: 0xe7f6f4, alpha: 0.34 })
5618:     .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.28, width: 1.1 });
5619: 
5620:   const entryFrame = new Graphics()
5621:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.24, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.31)
5622:     .lineTo(top.x, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.43)
5623:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.24, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.31)
5624:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.25)
5625:     .lineTo(top.x, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.35)
5626:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.25)
5627:     .closePath()
5628:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, 28), alpha: 0.66 })
5629:     .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.22, width: 1.2 });
5630: 
5631:   // (item C) roofLantern + lanternGlass retired â€” the tiered crown owns the
5632:   // hero roof; the ground-storey glass entry below keeps the lantern read.
5633:   const wingBays = new Graphics();
5634:   for (let bay = -2; bay <= 2; bay += 1) {
5635:     if (bay === 0) continue;
5636:     wingBays
5637:       .roundRect(top.x + bay * (footprintWidth * 0.15) - 4.5, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.16, 9, 9, 2)
5638:       .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: 0.76 })
5639:       .roundRect(top.x + bay * (footprintWidth * 0.15) - 5.8, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.17, 11.6, 11, 2)
5640:       .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.18, width: 0.9 });
5641:   }
5642: 
5643:   const civicNameplateGeometry = new Graphics()
5644:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.32, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.04)
5645:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.1, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.06)
5646:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.02)
5647:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.34, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08);
5648:   civicNameplateGeometry.stroke({ color: 0xfff1cc, alpha: 0.32, width: 2.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5649: 
5650:   const civicPlinthStack = new Graphics()
5651:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.44, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.18)
5652:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.34)
5653:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.2, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.18)
5654:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.35, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.27)
5655:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.4)
5656:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.28, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22);
5657:   civicPlinthStack.stroke({ color: 0x8b7954, alpha: 0.3, width: 1.7, cap: "round", join: "round" });
5658: 
5659:   // (item C) roofShoulders retired with the other roof decals â€” crown owns it.
5660:   // (0.55E) the entryAxis ground pad is retired too: the base hierarchy
5661:   // forecourt + the kit plinth tiers already own the approach read.
5662:   layer.addChild(civicPlinthStack, entryFrame, entryGlass, wingBays, civicNameplateGeometry);
5663: }

6047: 
6048: type DraftVoxelGrammarFamily =
6049:   | "large_venue_hall"
6050:   | "transit_hub"
6051:   | "stadium_bowl"
6052:   | "mixed_use_edge"
6053:   | "commercial_edge"
6054:   | "airport_logistics_edge"
6055:   | "civic_core"
6056:   | "residential_variety"
6057:   | "generic_draft";
6058: 
6059: function draftVoxelGrammarFamily(id: string): DraftVoxelGrammarFamily {
6060:   if (id.includes("anaheim-convention-center")) return "large_venue_hall";
6061:   if (id.includes("artic-transit-center")) return "transit_hub";
6062:   if (id.includes("angel-stadium")) return "stadium_bowl";
6063:   if (id.includes("platinum-triangle")) return "mixed_use_edge";
6064:   if (id.includes("ontario-international-airport")) return "airport_logistics_edge";
6065:   if (id.includes("ontario-mills") || id.includes("downtown-service")) return "commercial_edge";
6066:   if (id.includes("ontario-civic") || id.includes("downtown-anaheim-community")) return "civic_core";
6067:   if (id.includes("ontario-inland-residential")) return "residential_variety";
6068:   return "generic_draft";
6069: }
6070: 
6071: function drawDraftVoxelGrammarSystem(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
6072:   const family = draftVoxelGrammarFamily(building.id);
6073:   if (family === "generic_draft") return;
6074: 
6075:   drawDraftContactGrammar(layer, geometry, family);
6076: 
6077:   if (family === "large_venue_hall") drawLargeVenueHallGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6078:   if (family === "transit_hub") drawTransitHubGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6079:   if (family === "stadium_bowl") drawStadiumBowlGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6080:   if (family === "mixed_use_edge") drawMixedUseEdgeGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6081:   if (family === "commercial_edge") drawCommercialEdgeGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6082:   if (family === "airport_logistics_edge") drawAirportLogisticsGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6083:   if (family === "civic_core") drawCivicCoreDraftGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6084:   if (family === "residential_variety") drawResidentialVarietyGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
6085: }
6086: 
6087: function drawDraftContactGrammar(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, family: DraftVoxelGrammarFamily) {
6088:   const { bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth } = geometry;
6089:   const padScale = family === "large_venue_hall" || family === "airport_logistics_edge" ? 1.12 : family === "stadium_bowl" ? 1.12 : family === "transit_hub" ? 1.0 : 0.92;
6090:   const apronScale = family === "transit_hub" || family === "stadium_bowl" || family === "commercial_edge" ? 0.96 : 0.76;
6091:   const contact = polygon(
6092:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.46 }, footprintWidth * padScale, footprintDepth * 0.28),
6093:     family === "transit_hub" ? 0x9fb3af : family === "stadium_bowl" ? 0xb9c184 : 0xdac49b,
6094:     family === "stadium_bowl" ? 0.22 : 0.28,
6095:     0x6d5e43,
6096:     0.12,
6097:   );
6098:   const sideFace = new Graphics()
6099:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * apronScale * 0.5, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.42)
6100:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.58)
6101:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * apronScale * 0.5, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.42)
6102:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * apronScale * 0.5, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.52)
6103:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.7)
6104:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * apronScale * 0.5, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.52)
6105:     .closePath()
6106:     .fill({ color: 0x8e7a55, alpha: 0.14 })
6107:     .stroke({ color: 0x5f553f, alpha: 0.12, width: 1 });
6108:   layer.addChild(contact, sideFace);

6111: function drawLargeVenueHallGrammar(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
6112:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, trimColor } = geometry;
6113:   const isEntry = building.id.includes("entry-spine") || building.id.includes("frontage-wing");
6114:   const roofWidth = footprintWidth * (isEntry ? 0.94 : 1.06);
6115:   const roofDepth = footprintDepth * (isEntry ? 0.34 : 0.5);
6116:   const longRoof = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.05 }, roofWidth, roofDepth), shadeColor(roofColor, 24), 0.32, trimColor, 0.1);
6117:   const hallPlinth = polygon(
6118:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.42 }, footprintWidth * (isEntry ? 0.9 : 1.12), footprintDepth * 0.22),
6119:     0xe4caa0,
6120:     isEntry ? 0.36 : 0.42,
6121:     0x7f6d4e,
6122:     0.16,
6123:   );
6124:   const glassBand = new Graphics()
6125:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.47, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.34, footprintWidth * 0.94, Math.max(9, footprintDepth * 0.12), 3)
6126:     .fill({ color: 0xc7edf0, alpha: isEntry ? 0.72 : 0.5 })
6127:     .stroke({ color: 0x558698, alpha: 0.14, width: 1 });
6128:   const continuousCurtainWall = new Graphics()
6129:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.5, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.3, footprintWidth, Math.max(7, footprintDepth * 0.1), 3)
6130:     .fill({ color: 0xd9f7f4, alpha: isEntry ? 0.48 : 0.34 })
6131:     .stroke({ color: 0x4e8298, alpha: 0.16, width: 1 });
6132:   const bayRhythm = new Graphics();
6133:   const bayCount = isEntry ? 9 : 11;
6134:   for (let bay = 0; bay < bayCount; bay += 1) {
6135:     const offset = (bay / (bayCount - 1) - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.82;
6136:     bayRhythm
6137:       .moveTo(top.x + offset, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.36)
6138:       .lineTo(top.x + offset, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.18)
6139:       .moveTo(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.025, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04)
6140:       .lineTo(top.x + offset + footprintWidth * 0.08, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.18);
6141:   }
6142:   bayRhythm.stroke({ color: 0xf8f0d0, alpha: 0.34, width: isEntry ? 1.6 : 1.3, cap: "round" });
6143:   const layeredRoof = new Graphics()
6144:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.46, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.22)
6145:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.32)
6146:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
6147:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.3)
6148:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.4, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.06)
6149:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.22)
6150:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.25, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.07);
6151:   layeredRoof.stroke({ color: 0xfaf3d4, alpha: 0.34, width: 2.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6152:   const waveEdge = new Graphics()
6153:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.48, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
6154:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.28, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.28)
6155:     .lineTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.06, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.16)
6156:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.24)
6157:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.45, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08);
6158:   waveEdge.stroke({ color: 0xfff5d8, alpha: isEntry ? 0.34 : 0.42, width: isEntry ? 2 : 2.6, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6159:   const forecourtGrooves = new Graphics()
6160:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.36, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.34)
6161:     .lineTo(bottom.x, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.5)
6162:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.36, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.34)
6163:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.22, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.45)
6164:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.22, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.45);
6165:   forecourtGrooves.stroke({ color: 0xf8e8c0, alpha: 0.3, width: 1.7, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6166:   layer.addChild(hallPlinth, longRoof, continuousCurtainWall, glassBand, bayRhythm, layeredRoof, waveEdge, forecourtGrooves);
6167: }
