6169: function drawTransitHubGrammar(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
6170:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, trimColor } = geometry;
6171:   const terminal = building.id.includes("terminal-shed");
6172:   if (!terminal) {
6173:     const platformJoin = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.34 }, footprintWidth * 0.84, footprintDepth * 0.18), 0xdac89f, 0.32, 0x7f6d4e, 0.12);
6174:     layer.addChild(platformJoin);
6175:     return;
6176:   }
6177: 
6178:   const barrelShadow = new Graphics()
6179:     .ellipse(top.x, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04, footprintWidth * 0.54, footprintDepth * 0.4)
6180:     .fill({ color: 0x5c7d82, alpha: 0.24 });
6181:   const barrelShell = new Graphics()
6182:     .ellipse(top.x, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.06, footprintWidth * 0.56, footprintDepth * 0.38)
6183:     .fill({ color: 0xd8eeee, alpha: 0.58 })
6184:     .stroke({ color: 0xf8ffff, alpha: 0.52, width: 3 });
6185:   const highVault = new Graphics()
6186:     .ellipse(top.x, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.16, footprintWidth * 0.5, footprintDepth * 0.3)
6187:     .stroke({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.42, width: 4 });
6188:   const ribGrid = new Graphics();
6189:   for (let rib = -5; rib <= 5; rib += 1) {
6190:     ribGrid
6191:       .moveTo(top.x + rib * (footprintWidth * 0.072) - footprintWidth * 0.1, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.38)
6192:       .lineTo(top.x + rib * (footprintWidth * 0.072) + footprintWidth * 0.12, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.32)
6193:       .moveTo(top.x + rib * (footprintWidth * 0.072) + footprintWidth * 0.14, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.35)
6194:       .lineTo(top.x + rib * (footprintWidth * 0.072) - footprintWidth * 0.14, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.3);
6195:   }
6196:   ribGrid.stroke({ color: 0xf8ffff, alpha: 0.6, width: 1.75, cap: "round" });
6197:   const trackBed = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.62 }, footprintWidth * 0.98, footprintDepth * 0.13), 0x697b78, 0.3, 0x394845, 0.16);
6198:   const platformEdge = new Graphics()
6199:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.46, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.42)
6200:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.46, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.42)
6201:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.38, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.56)
6202:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.38, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.56)
6203:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.64)
6204:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.64);
6205:   platformEdge.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -36), alpha: 0.34, width: 2.3, cap: "round" });
6206:   const portals = new Graphics()
6207:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.5, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.19, footprintWidth * 0.18, 18, 5)
6208:     .roundRect(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.32, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.21, footprintWidth * 0.18, 18, 5)
6209:     .fill({ color: 0xe4f6f3, alpha: 0.58 })
6210:     .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.16, width: 1 });
6211:   const trackSplit = new Graphics()
6212:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.45, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.68)
6213:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.45, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.68)
6214:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.4, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.76)
6215:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.4, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.76);
6216:   trackSplit.stroke({ color: 0x334543, alpha: 0.34, width: 1.8, cap: "round" });
6217:   const shellNodes = new Graphics();
6218:   for (let node = -3; node <= 3; node += 1) {
6219:     shellNodes.circle(top.x + node * (footprintWidth * 0.11), top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08 + Math.abs(node) * footprintDepth * 0.025, 2.2);
6220:   }
6221:   shellNodes.fill({ color: 0xf8ffff, alpha: 0.42 });
6222:   layer.addChild(trackBed, barrelShadow, barrelShell, highVault, ribGrid, platformEdge, portals, trackSplit, shellNodes);
6223: }

6340: function drawDraftSoCalFacadeMaterial(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {

6342:   const id = building.id;

6344:   const roofPanels = new Graphics()
6345:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.34, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)

6347:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.28, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.06)
6348:     .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.22, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.12)
6349:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.08, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.28)
6350:     .moveTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
6351:     .lineTo(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.34, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08);
6352:   roofPanels.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -42), alpha: roofPanelAlpha, width: 1.25, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6353: 
6354:   const stuccoFacet = new Graphics()
6355:     .roundRect(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.12, footprintWidth * 0.16, 10, 2)
6356:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, -16), alpha: 0.12 })
6357:     .roundRect(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.23, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.18, footprintWidth * 0.15, 9, 2)
6358:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(bodyColor, 18), alpha: 0.12 });
6359: 
6360:   const baseCourse = new Graphics()
6361:     .moveTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
6362:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22)
6363:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.16, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
6364:     .moveTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.42, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.08)
6365:     .lineTo(bottom.x + footprintWidth * 0.12, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22)
6366:     .lineTo(bottom.x - footprintWidth * 0.08, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.12);
6367:   baseCourse.stroke({ color: 0x8f7953, alpha: 0.22, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6368: 
6369:   if (id.includes("mixed-use") || id.includes("rowhome") || id.includes("lowrise")) {
6370:     const shadeBlocks = new Graphics();
6371:     for (let bay = -2; bay <= 2; bay += 1) {

6373:         .roundRect(top.x + bay * (footprintWidth * 0.11) - 4, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.27, 8, 4, 1.5)
6374:         .fill({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.18 })
6375:         .roundRect(top.x + bay * (footprintWidth * 0.11) - 3, bottom.y - footprintDepth * 0.21, 6, 7, 1.5)
6376:         .fill({ color: highlightColor, alpha: 0.46 });

6380: 
6381:   layer.addChild(roofPanels, stuccoFacet, baseCourse);

6384: function drawProp(layer: Container, prop: CityWorldProp, animated: AnimatedTarget[], atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver, calm = 1) {
6385:   const point = project(prop.position);
6386:   const asset = atlas.resolveAsset(prop.spriteKey, prop.paletteKey, "prop");
6387:   const baseColor = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.base);
6388:   const shade = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.shade);
6389:   const highlight = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.highlight);
6390:   const accent = paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.accent, asset.palette.colors.highlight);
6391: 
6392:   if (prop.kind === "tree" || prop.kind === "bush") {
6393:     // Blocky voxel foliage: trunk cube + 2-3 stacked, shrinking canopy boxes
6394:     // (north-star stacked-cube grammar). Deterministic per-variant palette
6395:     // shift + silhouette so groves read varied without noise.
6396:     const foliage = prop.variant % 2 === 0 ? baseColor : shadeColor(baseColor, 12);
6397:     const shadowReach = prop.kind === "bush" ? 8 : 14;
6398:     const tree = new Graphics()
6399:       .ellipse(point.x + shadowReach * 0.6, point.y - 1 + shadowReach * 0.18, prop.kind === "bush" ? 10 : 15, prop.kind === "bush" ? 3.6 : 4.6)
6400:       .fill({ color: CAST_SHADOW_COLOR, alpha: 0.26 });
6401:     if (prop.kind === "tree") {
6402:       const tall = prop.variant % 3 === 0;
6403:       voxelBox(tree, { x: point.x, y: point.y - 2 }, 5, 3, tall ? 13 : 10, shade);
6404:       voxelBox(tree, { x: point.x, y: point.y - (tall ? 13 : 10) }, 19, 11, 9, shadeColor(foliage, -8));
6405:       voxelBox(tree, { x: point.x, y: point.y - (tall ? 21 : 18) }, 14, 8, 7, foliage);
6406:       if (prop.variant % 2 === 0) {
6407:         voxelBox(tree, { x: point.x, y: point.y - (tall ? 27 : 24) }, 9, 5, 5, shadeColor(foliage, 14));
6408:       }
6409:     } else {
6410:       voxelBox(tree, { x: point.x, y: point.y - 1 }, 13, 8, 6, shadeColor(foliage, -6));
6411:       voxelBox(tree, { x: point.x, y: point.y - 6.5 }, 8, 5, 4, shadeColor(foliage, 10));
6412:     }
6413:     tree.stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.2, width: 1 });
6414:     // Trees stay planted in the focal ring but yield opacity so they never
6415:     // obscure the hero building's face separation.
6416:     tree.alpha = Math.max(calm, 0.7);
6417:     layer.addChild(tree);
6418:     return;
6419:   }
6420: 
6421:   if (prop.kind === "dock") {
6422:     const dock = new Graphics()
6423:       .ellipse(point.x + 4, point.y + 2, 16, 4)
6424:       .fill({ color: 0x1d3a42, alpha: 0.2 });
6425:     // Plank boxes marching toward the water (SE), on two pile cubes.
6426:     voxelBox(dock, { x: point.x - 8, y: point.y - 1 }, 15, 9, 2.5, shade);
6427:     voxelBox(dock, { x: point.x + 3, y: point.y + 4 }, 15, 9, 2.5, baseColor);
6428:     voxelBox(dock, { x: point.x + 14, y: point.y + 9 }, 15, 9, 2.5, shadeColor(baseColor, -8));
6429:     voxelBox(dock, { x: point.x + 20, y: point.y + 14 }, 3, 2.5, 5, shadeColor(shade, -14));
6430:     voxelBox(dock, { x: point.x + 9, y: point.y + 12 }, 3, 2.5, 5, shadeColor(shade, -14));
6431:     dock.stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.22, width: 1 });
6432:     dock.alpha = calm;
6433:     layer.addChild(dock);
6434:     return;
6435:   }
6436: 
6437:   if (prop.kind === "boat") {
6438:     const hullColor = prop.variant % 2 === 0 ? 0xd8dee2 : accent;
6439:     const boat = new Graphics()
6440:       .ellipse(point.x, point.y + 2, 15, 4.5)
6441:       .fill({ color: 0x1d3a42, alpha: 0.24 });
6442:     voxelBox(boat, { x: point.x, y: point.y }, 22, 9, 4, hullColor);
6443:     voxelBox(boat, { x: point.x - 3, y: point.y - 4 }, 9, 6, 4.5, shadeColor(hullColor, 18));
6444:     boat
6445:       .moveTo(point.x + 6, point.y - 4)
6446:       .lineTo(point.x + 6, point.y - 16)
6447:       .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.8, width: 1.4, cap: "round" });
6448:     boat.stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.24, width: 1 });
6449:     boat.alpha = calm;
6450:     layer.addChild(boat);
6451:     return;
6452:   }
6453: 
6454:   if (prop.kind === "water_tower") {
6455:     const tower = new Graphics()
6456:       .ellipse(point.x + 6, point.y + 1, 15, 4.5)
6457:       .fill({ color: CAST_SHADOW_COLOR, alpha: 0.22 });
6458:     // Four leg strokes, tank cylinder, cone cap â€” the skyline landmark.
6459:     tower
6460:       .moveTo(point.x - 8, point.y)
6461:       .lineTo(point.x - 5, point.y - 22)
6462:       .moveTo(point.x + 8, point.y)
6463:       .lineTo(point.x + 5, point.y - 22)
6464:       .moveTo(point.x - 4, point.y + 3)
6465:       .lineTo(point.x - 2.5, point.y - 22)
6466:       .moveTo(point.x + 4, point.y + 3)
6467:       .lineTo(point.x + 2.5, point.y - 22)
6468:       .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.9, width: 1.6, cap: "round" });
6469:     tower
6470:       .moveTo(point.x - 6.5, point.y - 8)
6471:       .lineTo(point.x + 6.5, point.y - 12)
6472:       .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.6, width: 1, cap: "round" });
6473:     tower
6474:       .rect(point.x - 9, point.y - 36, 18, 14)
6475:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(baseColor, "sun") })
6476:       .rect(point.x + 1, point.y - 36, 8, 14)
6477:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(baseColor, "shade"), alpha: 0.6 })
6478:       .ellipse(point.x, point.y - 22, 9, 3)
6479:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(baseColor, -20) });
6480:     tower
6481:       .moveTo(point.x - 10, point.y - 35)
6482:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y - 42)
6483:       .lineTo(point.x + 10, point.y - 35)
6484:       .closePath()
6485:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(accent, "top") });
6486:     tower.stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.3, width: 1 });
6487:     tower.alpha = calm;
6488:     layer.addChild(tower);
6489:     return;
6490:   }
6491: 
6492:   if (prop.kind === "fountain") {
6493:     const fountain = new Graphics()
6494:       .ellipse(point.x, point.y - 7, 20, 11)
6495:       .fill({ color: baseColor, alpha: 0.85 })
6496:       .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.8, width: 2 })
6497:       .circle(point.x, point.y - 14, 4)
6498:       .fill({ color: highlight, alpha: 0.9 });
6499:     animated.push({ target: fountain, kind: "water", path: [], speed: 0.025, phase: prop.variant * 0.2, baseAlpha: 0.78 * calm, origin: point });
6500:     layer.addChild(fountain);

6502:   }

6504:   if (prop.kind === "water_shimmer") {

6507:       .lineTo(point.x + 28, point.y)

6510:     shimmer.stroke({ color: highlight, alpha: 0.54, width: 2, cap: "round" });
6511:     animated.push({ target: shimmer, kind: "water", path: [], speed: 0.02, phase: prop.variant * 0.35, baseAlpha: 0.52 * calm, origin: point });

6516:   if (prop.kind === "streetlight") {

6520:         .rect(point.x - 1.2, point.y - 22, 2.4, 20)
6521:         .fill({ color: baseColor, alpha: 0.9 })
6522:         .rect(point.x - 1.2, point.y - 22, 11, 2)
6523:         .fill({ color: baseColor, alpha: 0.9 })
6524:         .circle(point.x + 2, point.y - 24, 4)

6526:         .circle(point.x + 2, point.y - 24, 9)

6552:       windowColor: highlight,

6589: function drawActor(layer: Container, actor: CityWorldActor, animated: AnimatedTarget[], atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver, calm = 1) {
6590:   if (actor.kind === "clawd") return;
6591: 
6592:   const point = project(actor.position);
6593:   const actorPoint = point;
6594:   const asset = atlas.resolveAsset(actor.spriteKey, actor.paletteKey, "actor");
6595:   const actorBase = colorToNumber(actor.color);
6596:   const shade = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.shade);
6597:   const highlight = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.highlight);
6598:   const accent = paletteColor(asset.palette.colors.accent, asset.palette.colors.highlight);
6599:   const color = colorToNumber(actor.color);
6600:   let graphic: Graphics;
6601: 
6602:   if (actor.kind === "car") {
6603:     const first = actor.path[0] ?? actor.position;
6604:     const second = actor.path[1] ?? first;
6605:     graphic = drawSmallCarGraphic(actorPoint, actorBase, Math.abs(second.x - first.x) >= Math.abs(second.y - first.y) ? "east-west" : "north-south", {
6606:       windowColor: highlight,
6607:       lightColor: accent,
6608:       outlineColor: shade,
6609:     });
6610:   } else {
6611:     graphic = new Graphics()
6612:       .ellipse(actorPoint.x, actorPoint.y - 1, 5, 2)
6613:       .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.18 })
6614:       .circle(actorPoint.x, actorPoint.y - 15, 4.4)
6615:       .fill({ color, alpha: 0.94 })
6616:       .roundRect(actorPoint.x - 2.6, actorPoint.y - 12, 5.2, 9, 2)
6617:       .fill({ color: shade, alpha: 0.66 })
6618:       .moveTo(actorPoint.x - 1, actorPoint.y - 3)
6619:       .lineTo(actorPoint.x - 4, actorPoint.y + 2)
6620:       .moveTo(actorPoint.x + 1, actorPoint.y - 3)
6621:       .lineTo(actorPoint.x + 4, actorPoint.y + 1)
6622:       .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.64, width: 1.5, cap: "round" });
6623:   }
6624: 
6625:   // 0.67H â€” actors are ambience, not focal objects.
6626:   graphic.alpha = 0.8 * calm;
6627: 
6628:   animated.push({
6629:     target: graphic,
6630:     kind: actor.kind,
6631:     path: actor.path,
6632:     speed: actor.speed,
6633:     phase: actor.phase,
6634:     baseAlpha: 0.8 * calm,
6635:     origin: point,
6636:   });
6637:   layer.addChild(graphic);
6638: }

6640: function drawSmallCarGraphic(
6641:   point: ProjectedPoint,
6642:   color: number,
6643:   orientation: "east-west" | "north-south",
6644:   details: { windowColor?: number; lightColor?: number; outlineColor?: number } = {},
6645: ): Graphics {
6646:   const wide = orientation === "east-west";
6647:   const bodyWidth = wide ? 23 : 15;
6648:   const bodyHeight = wide ? 12 : 18;
6649:   const hoodOffset = wide ? 7 : 4;
6650:   const outlineColor = details.outlineColor ?? 0x26332c;
6651:   const windowColor = details.windowColor ?? 0xf5fbff;
6652:   const lightColor = details.lightColor ?? 0xfff0a8;
6653:   const car = new Graphics()
6654:     .ellipse(point.x, point.y - 1, bodyWidth * 0.5, bodyHeight * 0.28)
6655:     .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.16 })
6656:     .roundRect(point.x - bodyWidth / 2, point.y - bodyHeight - 1, bodyWidth, bodyHeight, 4)
6657:     .fill({ color, alpha: 0.97 })
6658:     .stroke({ color: outlineColor, alpha: 0.68, width: 1.3 })
6659:     .roundRect(point.x - bodyWidth * 0.2, point.y - bodyHeight - 4, bodyWidth * 0.4, 6, 2)
6660:     .fill({ color: windowColor, alpha: 0.86 })
6661:     .circle(point.x - hoodOffset, point.y - 2, 2)
6662:     .circle(point.x + hoodOffset, point.y - 2, 2)
6663:     .fill({ color: 0x222826, alpha: 0.72 });
6664: 
6665:   if (wide) {
6666:     car
6667:       .rect(point.x - bodyWidth * 0.48, point.y - bodyHeight * 0.58, 3, 3)
6668:       .rect(point.x + bodyWidth * 0.36, point.y - bodyHeight * 0.58, 3, 3)
6669:       .fill({ color: lightColor, alpha: 0.86 });
6670:   } else {
6671:     car
6672:       .rect(point.x - 4, point.y - bodyHeight - 1, 8, 3)
6673:       .fill({ color: lightColor, alpha: 0.82 });
6674:   }
6675: 
6676:   return car;
6677: }
6678: 
6679: function drawPlaceMarker(
6680:   layers: LayerMap,
6681:   place: CityWorldPlace,
6682:   onSelectPlace: (placeId: string) => void,
6683:   onHoverPlace: (placeId: string | undefined) => void,
6684: ) {
6685:   // Neutral, static marker only: emphasis rings + their pulse animation live
6686:   // in the focus overlay, so hover/selection never rebuilds the base scene
6687:   // and a scene with no focus has no perpetual marker animations.
6688:   // 0.67H marker quieting â€” the ring is a ground-contact indicator, not a
6689:   // glow: small, warm-neutral, held near the shadow floor.
6690:   const point = project(place.anchor);
6691:   const ring = new Graphics()
6692:     .ellipse(point.x, point.y - 4, 16, 16 * 0.48)
6693:     .fill({ color: 0xf3ecd8, alpha: 0.03 })
6694:     .stroke({ color: 0x33443b, alpha: 0.08, width: 1.2 });
6695:   // The ring is ground furniture: it lives under shadows and buildings so it
6696:   // can never draw across a wall when the anchor sits inside a structure.
6697:   layers.padLayer.addChild(ring);
6698: 
6699:   const hit = new Graphics().circle(point.x, point.y - 12, place.hitRadius * 13).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.001 });
6700:   hit.eventMode = "static";
6701:   hit.cursor = "pointer";
6702:   hit.on("pointertap", () => onSelectPlace(place.id));
6703:   hit.on("pointerover", () => onHoverPlace(place.id));
6704:   hit.on("pointerout", () => onHoverPlace(undefined));
6705:   layers.markerLayer.addChild(hit);
6706: }
6707: 
6708: type FocusMode = "selected" | "hovered";
6709: 
6710: // Redraws ONLY the focus overlay: emphasized ring (with the pulse animation),
6711: // stroke-only silhouettes of the place's anchored buildings, and the
6712: // emphasized label. A hover change costs ~4-10 Graphics instead of a full
6713: // scene teardown.
6714: function drawFocusOverlay(
6715:   layer: Container,
6716:   place: CityWorldPlace,
6717:   focus: FocusIndex,
6718:   mode: FocusMode,
6719:   animated: AnimatedTarget[],
6720: ) {
6721:   // 0.67H â€” selection is a warm contact accent, not a white debug glow: quiet
6722:   // warm ring near the shadow floor, warm-toned silhouette strokes.
6723:   const point = project(place.anchor);
6724:   const selected = mode === "selected";
6725:   const landmarkFocus = selected && place.kind === "landmark";
6726:   const markerPoint = landmarkFocus ? { x: point.x, y: point.y + 20 } : point;
6727:   const radius = selected ? (landmarkFocus ? 18 : 22) : 20;
6728:   const ring = new Graphics()
6729:     .ellipse(markerPoint.x, markerPoint.y - 4, radius, radius * 0.48)
6730:     .fill({ color: selected ? 0xe9d9ac : 0xf3ecd8, alpha: selected ? 0.12 : 0.09 })
6731:     .stroke({ color: selected ? 0xb99c5f : 0xcdbf9c, alpha: 0.44, width: selected ? 1.4 : 1.2 });
6732:   animated.push({ target: ring, kind: "pulse", path: [], speed: 0.02, phase: place.activity, baseAlpha: 0.32, origin: markerPoint });
6733:   layer.addChild(ring);
6734: 
6735:   const outlineColor = selected ? 0xc2a05e : 0xcdb98a;
6736:   for (const building of focus.buildingsByPlaceId.get(place.id) ?? []) {
6737:     const bottom = project(building.position);
6738:     const top = project({ x: building.position.x, y: building.position.y, z: (building.position.z ?? 0) + building.height });
6739:     const halfW = (building.width * TILE_WIDTH) / 2;
6740:     const halfD = (building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT) / 2;
6741:     const silhouette = new Graphics()
6742:       .poly(
6743:         [
6744:           top.x - halfW, top.y,
6745:           top.x, top.y - halfD,
6746:           top.x + halfW, top.y,
6747:           bottom.x + halfW, bottom.y,
6748:           bottom.x, bottom.y + halfD,
6749:           bottom.x - halfW, bottom.y,
6750:         ],
6751:         true,
6752:       )
6753:       .stroke({ color: outlineColor, alpha: selected ? 0.5 : 0.4, width: selected ? 1.6 : 1.3, join: "round" });
6754:     const roofEdge = new Graphics()
6755:       .poly(diamondPoints(top, building.width * TILE_WIDTH, building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT), true)
6756:       .stroke({ color: outlineColor, alpha: selected ? 0.36 : 0.28, width: 1.1 });
6757:     layer.addChild(silhouette, roofEdge);
6758:   }
6759: 
6760:   drawFocusPlaceLabel(layer, place, mode, focus.crownLift.get(place.id));
6761: }
6762: 
6763: function drawFocusPlaceLabel(layer: Container, place: CityWorldPlace, mode: FocusMode, crownLift?: number) {
6764:   const point = project(place.anchor);
6765:   const selected = mode === "selected";
6766:   const landmarkFocus = selected && place.kind === "landmark";
6767:   // 0.67H â€” focus labels are smaller and quieter; the selected landmark label
6768:   // slides off the roof axis and clears the crown with a small margin.
6769:   const text = new Text({
6770:     text: place.label,
6771:     style: {
6772:       fill: 0x2c3a33,
6773:       fontFamily: "Arial",
6774:       fontSize: landmarkFocus ? 10 : 11,
6775:       fontWeight: "700",
6776:       stroke: { color: 0xfff8e7, width: 3 },
6777:     },
6778:   });
6779:   text.anchor.set(0.5);
6780:   const baseLift = landmarkFocus ? 70 : 52;
6781:   text.position.set(point.x + (landmarkFocus ? -44 : 0), point.y - Math.max(baseLift, (crownLift ?? 0) + 6));
6782:   const paddingX = landmarkFocus ? 6 : 5;
6783:   const paddingY = landmarkFocus ? 2.5 : 3;
6784:   const backing = new Graphics()
6785:     .roundRect(
6786:       text.position.x - text.width / 2 - paddingX,
6787:       text.position.y - text.height / 2 - paddingY,
6788:       text.width + paddingX * 2,
6789:       text.height + paddingY * 2,
6790:       4,
6791:     )
6792:     .fill({ color: 0xfff7df, alpha: 0.5 })
6793:     .stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.12, width: 1 });
6794:   layer.addChild(backing, text);
6795: }
6796: 
6797: function drawPin(layer: Container, pin: CityWorldPin, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver) {
6798:   const point = project(pin.anchor);
6799:   const pinPoint = offsetPinPoint(point, pin);
6800:   const asset = atlas.resolveAsset(pin.spriteKey, pin.paletteKey, "marker");
6801:   // 0.67H â€” pins on the focal landmark shrink so the sticker never owns the
6802:   // silhouette it annotates.
6803:   const focalPin = pin.placeId === "place-eastvale-core";
6804:   if (asset.mode === "sprite") {
6805:     const sprite = new Sprite(asset.texture);
6806:     sprite.anchor.set(asset.anchor.x, asset.anchor.y);
6807:     sprite.scale.set(asset.scale * (focalPin ? 0.8 : 1));
6808:     sprite.position.set(pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y + 1);
6809:     sprite.label = `sprite-${pin.id}`;
6810:     layer.addChild(sprite);
6811:     return;
6812:   }
6813:   const color = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.base);
6814:   const shade = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.shade);
6815:   const highlight = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.highlight);
6816:   const badge = new Graphics()
6817:     .poly([pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y - 2, pinPoint.x - 5, pinPoint.y - 8, pinPoint.x + 5, pinPoint.y - 8], true)
6818:     .fill({ color: shade, alpha: 0.86 })
6819:     .circle(pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y - 15, 9)
6820:     .fill({ color, alpha: 0.98 })
6821:     .circle(pinPoint.x - 3, pinPoint.y - 18.5, 2)
6822:     .fill({ color: highlight, alpha: 0.34 })
6823:     .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.7, width: 1.5 });
6824:   const label = new Text({
6825:     text: pin.kind === "note" ? "N" : stickerGlyph(pin.kind),

6892: function animateTargets(targets: AnimatedTarget[], delta: number) {
6893:   const elapsed = performance.now() / 1000;
6894:   for (const item of targets) {
6895:     if (item.path.length > 1) {
6896:       const ratio = (elapsed * item.speed + item.phase) % 1;
6897:       const position = pointOnPath(item.path, ratio);
6898:       const point = project(position);
6899:       item.target.position.set(point.x - item.origin.x, point.y - item.origin.y);
6900:     }
6901: 
6902:     if (item.kind === "water") {
6903:       item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed * 2.2 + item.phase * 8) * 0.16;
6904:     } else if (item.kind === "cloud") {
6905:       item.target.x += delta * item.speed * 8;
6906:       item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed + item.phase * 4) * 0.06;
6907:     } else if (item.kind === "walker") {
6908:       item.target.y += Math.sin(elapsed * 4 + item.phase * 5) * 0.05;
6909:     } else if (item.kind === "pulse") {
6910:       item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed * 2 + item.phase * 4) * 0.05;
6911:     }
6912:   }
6913: }

6915: function pointOnPath(path: CityWorldPoint[], ratio: number): CityWorldPoint {
6916:   if (path.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
6917:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
6918: 
6919:   const scaled = ratio * path.length;
6920:   const index = Math.floor(scaled) % path.length;
6921:   const nextIndex = (index + 1) % path.length;
6922:   const local = scaled - Math.floor(scaled);
6923:   const start = path[index] ?? path[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
6924:   const end = path[nextIndex] ?? start;
6925:   return {
6926:     x: start.x + (end.x - start.x) * local,
6927:     y: start.y + (end.y - start.y) * local,
6928:     z: start.z + (end.z - start.z) * local,
6929:   };
6930: }

6933:   return projectCityWorldPoint(point);
6934: }

6940: function polygon(points: number[], fill: number, alpha = 1, stroke = 0x26332c, strokeAlpha = 0.42): Graphics {
6941:   return new Graphics().poly(points, true).fill({ color: fill, alpha }).stroke({ color: stroke, alpha: strokeAlpha, width: 1 });
6942: }

6944: // Iso voxel cube: top diamond + lit/shade faces appended into a Graphics.
6945: // The shared primitive behind the blocky prop kit and cliff courses â€” props
6946: // read as stacked cubes (north-star voxel grammar), not vector lollipops.
6947: function voxelBox(g: Graphics, base: ProjectedPoint, width: number, depth: number, height: number, color: number, alpha = 1): void {
6948:   const halfW = width / 2;
6949:   const halfD = depth / 2;
6950:   const topY = base.y - height;
6951:   g
6952:     .moveTo(base.x - halfW, topY)
6953:     .lineTo(base.x, topY + halfD)
6954:     .lineTo(base.x, base.y + halfD)
6955:     .lineTo(base.x - halfW, base.y)
6956:     .closePath()
6957:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "sun"), alpha });
6958:   g
6959:     .moveTo(base.x + halfW, topY)
6960:     .lineTo(base.x, topY + halfD)
6961:     .lineTo(base.x, base.y + halfD)
6962:     .lineTo(base.x + halfW, base.y)
6963:     .closePath()
6964:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "shade"), alpha });
6965:   g.poly(diamondPoints({ x: base.x, y: topY }, width, depth), true).fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "top"), alpha });
6966: }

6968: // Append a filled/stroked polygon into a SHARED Graphics. Ground layers
6969: // (terrain, lots, roads) merge thousands of per-item Graphics into a few
6970: // depth-band / pass Graphics; within one Graphics, path order is z order, so
6971: // append order must match the old per-object add order.
6972: function appendPolygon(g: Graphics, points: number[], fill: number, alpha = 1, stroke = 0x26332c, strokeAlpha = 0.42): Graphics {
6973:   g.poly(points, true).fill({ color: fill, alpha });
6974:   if (strokeAlpha > 0) g.stroke({ color: stroke, alpha: strokeAlpha, width: 1 });
6975:   return g;
6976: }

6978: function colorToNumber(color: string): number {
6979:   return Number.parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);

6982: function paletteColor(color: string | undefined, fallback: string): number {
6983:   return colorToNumber(color ?? fallback);

6986: function shadeColor(color: number, amount: number): number {
6987:   const r = clamp(((color >> 16) & 255) + amount, 0, 255);
6988:   const g = clamp(((color >> 8) & 255) + amount, 0, 255);
6989:   const b = clamp((color & 255) + amount, 0, 255);
6990:   return (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b;
6991: }
6992: 
6993: function scaleColor(color: number, factor: number): number {
6994:   const r = clamp(Math.round(((color >> 16) & 255) * factor), 0, 255);
6995:   const g = clamp(Math.round(((color >> 8) & 255) * factor), 0, 255);
6996:   const b = clamp(Math.round((color & 255) * factor), 0, 255);
6997:   return (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b;
6998: }
6999: 
7000: function mixColor(colorA: number, colorB: number, t: number): number {
7001:   const ratio = clamp(t, 0, 1);
7002:   const r = Math.round(((colorA >> 16) & 255) * (1 - ratio) + ((colorB >> 16) & 255) * ratio);
7003:   const g = Math.round(((colorA >> 8) & 255) * (1 - ratio) + ((colorB >> 8) & 255) * ratio);
7004:   const b = Math.round((colorA & 255) * (1 - ratio) + (colorB & 255) * ratio);
7005:   return (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b;
7006: }

7008: type SunFace = "top" | "sun" | "shade";
7009: 
7010: // Single source of truth for how any surface responds to the scene sun.
7011: function sunlitColor(color: number, face: SunFace): number {
7012:   // Real directional key light: the sun-facing wall must be brighter than the
7013:   // flat body, not merely un-shaded (it used to sit at factor 1.0, which is why
7014:   // lit walls read matte). Widening the top/sun/shade spread gives every box a
7015:   // legible light-to-shade gradient without going cartoon.
7016:   // 0.53E item D â€” the top face carries most of the frame; a slightly stronger
7017:   // lift + warm tint makes roofs read lit instead of matte next to the walls.
7018:   if (face === "top") return mixColor(scaleColor(color, 1.22), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.15);
7019:   if (face === "sun") return mixColor(scaleColor(color, 1.12), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.12);
7020:   return mixColor(scaleColor(color, 0.4), SUN_COOL_TINT, 0.32);
7021: }
7022: 
7023: // 0.68H face/material read â€” building faces get their own light response,
7024: // separate from terrain/props (sunlitColor). The global curve pushed lit walls
7025: // and roofs to near-white luma, where the 0.54E highlight rolloff grades them
7026: // into one milky paper tone â€” that is the "flat/milky planes" read. Building
7027: // faces keep more of their own pigment: a bright-but-saturated top, a warm mid
7028: // sun wall, and a firmly darker cool shade wall â€” three distinct values per
7029: // box, separated by tone instead of outlines.
7030: function buildingFaceColor(color: number, face: SunFace): number {
7031:   if (face === "top") return mixColor(scaleColor(color, 1.12), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.08);
7032:   if (face === "sun") return mixColor(scaleColor(color, 1.04), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.09);
7033:   return mixColor(scaleColor(color, 0.52), SUN_COOL_TINT, 0.24);
7034: }

  10: ## The idea, fleshed out
  11: 
  12: **ChatGPT grows a map.** When a conversation touches a place, Atlas opens a
  13: hand-built voxel diorama of that place inline â€” county-scale, isometric,
  14: explorable. Not a map widget embedded in chat: an **explorable answer**. Ask
  15: about Eastvale and instead of paragraphs you get the town itself â€” its road
  16: grid, its houses, its river dock â€” and the conversation keeps going *through*
  17: the map: the model focuses cameras, pins places, drops a scout, previews a
  18: campaign.
  19: 
  20: Three commitments define the product:
  21: 
  22: 1. **Voxel, deliberately.** The diorama look is an honesty device as much as an
  23:    aesthetic. A voxel town never pretends to be satellite truth â€” it reads as a
  24:    crafted model of a place, which is exactly what it is. It is also memorable,
  25:    cheap to render, and unlike anything else in the directory.
  26: 2. **Native, deliberately.** Atlas behaves like a capability ChatGPT always
  27:    had, not an app that rents space in it. The chrome is ChatGPT's own grammar;
  28:    the map is the only colorful thing on screen.
  29: 3. **Scalable, deliberately.** Riverside/Eastvale is the proof cell of one
  30:    world model that ladders county â†’ state â†’ country. Curated and generated
  31:    scenes are held to the same bar â€” the parity gates exist so "generated"
  32:    never becomes a second-class citizen.
  33: 
  34: The engine and the in-ChatGPT quality **are** the product. Everything below is
  35: that sentence, made testable.

 341:    4:   CITY_WORLD_TILE_BASIS,
 342:    5:   compileCityWorldScene,
 343:    6:   cityWorldDiamondPoints,
 344:    7:   projectCityWorldPoint,
 345:    8:   type CityWorldScene,
 346:    9:   type VoxelNote,
 347:   10:   type VoxelScene,
 348:   11:   type VoxelSticker,
 349:   12:   type VoxelStickerKind,
 350:   13: } from "@atlas/core/voxel";
 351:   14: import type { CityWorldRendererHandle } from "./CityWorldRenderer";
 352:   15: import { HostedClawdTray } from "./HostedClawdTray";
 353:   16: import { MapChrome, readRequestedCameraPreset, readRequestedDebugMode } from "./MapChrome";
 354:   17: import { PreviewPanel } from "./PreviewPanel";
 355:   18: import type { HostedClawdContext } from "./types";
 356:   19: 
 357:   20: const CityWorldRenderer = lazy(async () => {
 358:   21:   const module = await import("./CityWorldRenderer");
 359:   22:   return { default: module.CityWorldRenderer };
 360:   23: });
 361:   24: 
 362:   25: export type CityWorldViewProps = {
 363:   26:   scene: VoxelScene;
 364:   27:   generatedScene?: CityWorldScene | null;
 365:   28:   selectedDistrictId?: string | undefined;
 366:   29:   selectedPlaceId?: string | undefined;
 367:   30:   stickers?: VoxelSticker[];
 368:   31:   notes?: VoxelNote[];
 369:   32:   stickerMode?: VoxelStickerKind;
 370:   33:   noteDraft?: string;
 371:   34:   scoutPreview?: ScoutPreviewState | null;
 372:   35:   campaignPreview?: CampaignPreviewState | null;
 373:   36:   hostedClawdContext?: HostedClawdContext | null;
 374:   37:   hostedClawdOpen?: boolean;
 375:   38:   hostedClawdActionMessage?: string | undefined;
 376:   39:   onAdvancePreview?: () => void;
 377:   40:   onOpenHostedClawd?: () => void;
 378:   41:   onCloseHostedClawd?: () => void;
 379:   42:   onHostedClawdPrimaryAction?: () => void;
 380:   43:   onExitGeneratedPreview?: () => void;
 381:   44:   countySwitcher?: ReactNode;
 382:   45:   showFirstRunHint?: boolean;
 383:   46:   onDismissFirstRunHint?: () => void;
 384:   47:   onSelectPlace: (placeId: string) => void;
 385:   48:   onSelectStickerMode: (kind: VoxelStickerKind) => void;
 386:   49:   onPlaceSticker: (placeId: string, kind: VoxelStickerKind) => void;
 387:   50:   onNoteDraftChange: (value: string) => void;
 388:   51:   onSaveNote: (placeId: string, body: string) => void;
 389:   52: };
 390:   53: 
 391:   54: const STICKER_ORDER: VoxelStickerKind[] = ["favorite", "home", "shop", "park", "idea", "question"];
 392:   55: 
 393:   56: export function CityWorldView({
 394:   57:   scene,
 395:   58:   generatedScene = null,
 396:   59:   selectedDistrictId,
 397:   60:   selectedPlaceId,
 398:   61:   stickers = [],
 399:   62:   notes = [],
 400:   63:   stickerMode = "favorite",
 401:   64:   noteDraft = "",
 402:   65:   scoutPreview = null,
 403:   66:   campaignPreview = null,
 404:   67:   hostedClawdContext = null,
 405:   68:   hostedClawdOpen = false,
 406:   69:   hostedClawdActionMessage,
 407:   70:   onAdvancePreview,
 408:   71:   onOpenHostedClawd,
 409:   72:   onCloseHostedClawd,
 410:   73:   onHostedClawdPrimaryAction,
 411:   74:   onExitGeneratedPreview,
 412:   75:   countySwitcher,
 413:   76:   showFirstRunHint = false,
 414:   77:   onDismissFirstRunHint,
 415:   78:   onSelectPlace,
 416:   79:   onSelectStickerMode,
 417:   80:   onPlaceSticker,
 418:   81:   onNoteDraftChange,
 419:   82:   onSaveNote,
 420:   83: }: CityWorldViewProps) {
 421:   84:   const isGeneratedMode = Boolean(generatedScene);
 422:   85:   const hasPreview = !isGeneratedMode && Boolean(scoutPreview || campaignPreview);
 423:   86:   const hasHostedClawdTray = !isGeneratedMode && hostedClawdOpen && Boolean(hostedClawdContext);
 424:   87:   const rendererRef = useRef<CityWorldRendererHandle | null>(null);
 425:   88:   const cityScene = useMemo<CityWorldScene>(
 426:   89:     () => {
 427:   90:       if (generatedScene) return generatedScene;
 428:   91:       return compileCityWorldScene(scene, {
 429:   92:         selectedDistrictId,
 430:   93:         selectedPlaceId,
 431:   94:         stickers,
 432:   95:         notes,
 433:   96:       });
 434:   97:     },
 435:   98:     [generatedScene, notes, scene, selectedDistrictId, selectedPlaceId, stickers],
 436:   99:   );
 437:  100:   // 0.57E parity Ã¢â‚¬â€ resolve selection against places that exist in THIS scene:
 438:  101:   // in generated mode the widget-state place id belongs to the county scene,
 439:  102:   // and falling through to places[0] selected a many-building home_area that
 440:  103:   // ringed every house on first paint. The authored HUD default (the landmark)
 441:  104:   // is the scene's own first-paint choice.
 442:  105:   const requestedPlace = cityScene.places.find((place) => place.id === selectedPlaceId);
 443:  106:   const hudDefaultPlace = cityScene.places.find((place) => place.id === cityScene.hudDefaults.selectedPlaceId);
 444:  107:   const activePlace = requestedPlace ?? hudDefaultPlace ?? cityScene.places[0];
 445:  108:   const placePins = activePlace ? cityScene.pins.filter((pin) => pin.placeId === activePlace.id) : [];
 446:  109:   const worldStickers = scene.world?.stickers ?? [];
 447:  110:   const worldNotes = scene.world?.notes ?? [];
 448:  111:   const stickerCount = stickers.length + worldStickers.length;
 449:  112:   const noteCount = notes.length + worldNotes.length;
 450:  113:   const placeNotes = activePlace ? [...worldNotes, ...notes].filter((note) => note.placeId === activePlace.id) : [];
 451:  114:   const latestPlaceNote = placeNotes[placeNotes.length - 1];
 452:  115:   const activePlacePulse = activePlace ? `${Math.round(activePlace.activity * 100)}% of places active` : "Pick a place";
 453:  116:   const latestNoteBody = latestPlaceNote?.body ?? "";
 454:  117:   const cameraPresetId = readRequestedCameraPreset(cityScene);
 455:  118:   const debugMode = readRequestedDebugMode();
 456:  119: 
 457:  120:   useEffect(() => {
 458:  121:     const openaiWindow = window as Window & {
 459:  122:       openai?: { requestDisplayMode?: (payload: { mode: "inline" | "pip" | "fullscreen" }) => Promise<unknown> };
 460:  123:     };
 461:  124:     void openaiWindow.openai?.requestDisplayMode?.({ mode: "fullscreen" }).catch(() => undefined);
 462:  125:   }, []);
 463:  126: 
 464:  127:   // First-run gesture hint: one quiet line, gone on first interaction or
 465:  128:   // after a short dwell Ã¢â‚¬â€ never persistent chrome.
 466:  129:   const hintVisible = showFirstRunHint && !isGeneratedMode && !hasPreview && !hasHostedClawdTray;
 467:  130:   useEffect(() => {
 468:  131:     if (!hintVisible || !onDismissFirstRunHint) return;
 469:  132:     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => onDismissFirstRunHint(), 8000);
 470:  133:     return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
 471:  134:   }, [hintVisible, onDismissFirstRunHint]);
 472:  135: 
 473:  136:   const saveNote = () => {
 474:  137:     if (!activePlace || !noteDraft.trim()) return;
 475:  138:     onSaveNote(activePlace.id, noteDraft);
 476:  139:   };
 477:  140: 
 478:  141:   const dropSticker = () => {
 479:  142:     if (!activePlace) return;
 480:  143:     onSelectStickerMode(stickerMode);
 481:  144:     onPlaceSticker(activePlace.id, stickerMode);
 482:  145:   };
 483:  146: 
 484:  147:   return (
 485:  148:     <main
 486:  149:       className={hasPreview ? "city-world-shell has-preview" : hasHostedClawdTray ? "city-world-shell has-save-sheet" : "city-world-shell"}
 487:  150:       data-qa="alpha-city-world"
 488:  151:       data-qa-selected-place={activePlace?.id ?? ""}
 489:  152:       data-qa-pin-count={stickerCount}
 490:  153:       data-qa-note-count={noteCount}
 491:  154:       data-qa-latest-note={latestNoteBody}
 492:  155:       data-qa-session-boundary="session-only"
 493:  156:       data-qa-camera-preset={cameraPresetId ?? ""}
 494:  157:       data-qa-generated={isGeneratedMode ? "true" : undefined}
 495:  158:       onPointerDownCapture={hintVisible ? onDismissFirstRunHint : undefined}
 496:  159:     >
 497:  160:       <Suspense fallback={<CityWorldSceneFallback scene={cityScene} selectedPlaceId={activePlace?.id} />}>
 498:  161:         <CityWorldRenderer
 499:  162:           ref={rendererRef}
 500:  163:           scene={cityScene}
 501:  164:           selectedPlaceId={activePlace?.id}
 502:  165:           cameraPresetId={cameraPresetId}
 503:  166:           debugMode={debugMode}
 504:  167:           suppressPlaceLabels={isGeneratedMode}
 505:  168:           onSelectPlace={isGeneratedMode ? () => undefined : onSelectPlace}
 506:  169:         />
 507:  170:       </Suspense>
 508:  171: 
 509:  172:       {isGeneratedMode ? (
 510:  173:         <div className="city-world-generated-boundary" data-qa="generated-boundary">
 511:  174:           <div>
 512:  175:             <span>GENERATED PREVIEW</span>
 513:  176:             <strong>Generated district. Not real coverage. Nothing is saved.</strong>
 514:  177:           </div>
 515:  178:           <button type="button" data-qa="exit-generated" onClick={onExitGeneratedPreview}>
 516:  179:             Exit preview
 517:  180:           </button>
 518:  181:         </div>
 519:  182:       ) : (
 520:  183:         <div className="city-world-left-rail">
 521:  184:           <div className="city-world-location" aria-label="Current city map" data-qa="current-city-map">
 522:  185:             <span>{cityScene.region.county}</span>
 523:  186:             <strong>{cityScene.region.district.replace(" City Slice", "")}</strong>
 524:  187:           </div>
 525:  188:           {countySwitcher}
 526:  189:         </div>
 527:  190:       )}
 528:  191: 
 529:  192:       <MapChrome rendererRef={rendererRef} />
 530:  193: 
 531:  194:       {hintVisible ? (
 532:  195:         <div className="city-world-first-run-hint" role="note" data-qa="first-run-hint">
 533:  196:           Drag to explore Ã‚Â· Pinch to zoom Ã‚Â· Tap places
 534:  197:         </div>
 535:  198:       ) : null}
 536:  199: 
 537:  200:       {!hasPreview && !hasHostedClawdTray && !isGeneratedMode ? (
 538:  201:       <div className="city-world-stickers" aria-label="Sticker tools" data-qa="sticker-tools" data-qa-sticker-mode={stickerMode}>
 539:  202:         {STICKER_ORDER.map((kind) => (
 540:  203:           <button
 541:  204:             key={kind}
 542:  205:             type="button"
 543:  206:             aria-label={`Use ${stickerLabel(kind)} sticker`}
 544:  207:             aria-pressed={kind === stickerMode}
 545:  208:             data-qa={`sticker-mode-${kind}`}
 546:  209:             className={kind === stickerMode ? "is-active" : ""}
 547:  210:             onClick={() => onSelectStickerMode(kind)}
 548:  211:           >
 549:  212:             <span aria-hidden="true">
 550:  213:               <StickerGlyph kind={kind} />
 551:  214:             </span>
 552:  215:           </button>
 553:  216:         ))}
 554:  217:         <button
 555:  218:           type="button"
 556:  219:           aria-label="Drop sticker on selected place"
 557:  220:           className="city-world-drop"
 558:  221:           data-qa="drop-sticker-button"
 559:  222:           disabled={!activePlace}
 560:  223:           onClick={dropSticker}
 561:  224:         >
 562:  225:           <PinIcon />
 563:  226:           <span>Pin</span>
 564:  227:         </button>
 565:  228:       </div>
 566:  229:       ) : null}
 567:  230: 
 568:  231:       {hasHostedClawdTray && hostedClawdContext && onCloseHostedClawd && onHostedClawdPrimaryAction ? (
 569:  232:         <HostedClawdTray
 570:  233:           context={hostedClawdContext}
 571:  234:           actionMessage={hostedClawdActionMessage}
 572:  235:           onClose={onCloseHostedClawd}
 573:  236:           onPrimaryAction={onHostedClawdPrimaryAction}
 574:  237:         />
 575:  238:       ) : hasPreview ? (
 576:  239:         <PreviewPanel scoutPreview={scoutPreview} campaignPreview={campaignPreview} {...(onAdvancePreview ? { onAdvance: onAdvancePreview } : {})} />
 577:  240:       ) : !isGeneratedMode ? (
 578:  241:       <section
 579:  242:         className="city-world-tray"
 580:  243:         aria-label="Selected place"
 581:  244:         data-qa="selected-place-tray"
 582:  245:         data-qa-selected-place={activePlace?.id ?? ""}
 583:  246:         data-qa-selected-place-label={activePlace?.label ?? ""}
 584:  247:         data-qa-pin-count={stickerCount}
 585:  248:         data-qa-note-count={noteCount}
 586:  249:         data-qa-latest-note={latestNoteBody}
 587:  250:       >
 588:  251:         <div className="city-world-tray-head">
 589:  252:           <div className="city-world-place-copy">
 590:  253:             <span className="city-world-place-type">{activePlace ? placeKindLabel(activePlace.kind) : "Place"}</span>
 591:  254:             <strong data-qa="selected-place-label">{activePlace?.label ?? "Pick a place"}</strong>
 592:  255:             <p>{activePlace?.description ?? "Drag around the map and click a place."}</p>
 593:  256:           </div>
 594:  257:           <span className="city-world-place-pulse" title={activePlacePulse} aria-label={activePlacePulse}>
 595:  258:             {activePlacePulse}
 596:  259:           </span>
 597:  260:         </div>
 598:  261:         <div className="city-world-tray-meta" aria-label="Map collection">
 599:  262:           <span data-qa="pin-count">
 600:  263:             <b>{stickerCount}</b> {stickerCount === 1 ? "pin" : "pins"}
 601:  264:           </span>
 602:  265:           <span data-qa="note-count">
 603:  266:             <b>{noteCount}</b> {noteCount === 1 ? "note" : "notes"}
 604:  267:           </span>
 605:  268:           <span data-qa="selected-place-pin-count">
 606:  269:             <b>{placePins.length}</b> here
 607:  270:           </span>
 608:  271:         </div>
 609:  272:         <div className="city-world-session-boundary" data-qa="session-only-boundary">
 610:  273:           Pins and notes stay in this chat.
 611:  274:         </div>
 612:  275:         {hostedClawdContext && onOpenHostedClawd ? (
 613:  276:           <button type="button" className="city-world-hosted-clawd-open" data-qa="hosted-clawd-open" onClick={onOpenHostedClawd}>
 614:  277:             Save with ChatGPT
 615:  278:             <span>{hostedClawdContext.sessionBoundary}</span>
 616:  279:           </button>
 617:  280:         ) : null}
 618:  281:         {latestPlaceNote ? (
 619:  282:           <div className="city-world-latest-note" data-qa="latest-note">
 620:  283:             {latestPlaceNote.body}
 621:  284:           </div>
 622:  285:         ) : null}
 623:  286:         <div className="city-world-note">
 624:  287:           <input
 625:  288:             value={noteDraft}
 626:  289:             maxLength={160}
 627:  290:             disabled={!activePlace}
 628:  291:             data-qa="note-input"
 629:  292:             onChange={(event) => onNoteDraftChange(event.currentTarget.value)}
 630:  293:             placeholder={activePlace ? `Add note for ${activePlace.label}` : "Select a place"}
 631:  294:           />
 632:  295:           <button type="button" aria-label="Save note" data-qa="save-note-button" disabled={!activePlace || !noteDraft.trim()} onClick={saveNote}>
 633:  296:             Save
 634:  297:           </button>
 635:  298:         </div>
 636:  299:         {placePins.length > 0 ? (
 637:  300:           <div className="city-world-pin-row" aria-label="Pins on selected place" data-qa="selected-place-pins">
 638:  301:             {placePins.slice(-4).map((pin) => (
 639:  302:               <span key={pin.id}>{pin.kind === "note" ? "N" : <StickerGlyph kind={pin.kind} />}</span>
 640:  303:             ))}
 641:  304:           </div>
 642:  305:         ) : null}
 643:  306:       </section>
 644:  307:       ) : null}
 645:  308:     </main>
 646:  309:   );
 647:  310: }
 648:  311: 
 649:  312: function PinIcon() {
 650:  313:   return (
 651:  314:     <svg className="city-world-pin-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true">
 652:  315:       <path d="M10 3.5c-2.7 0-4.8 2-4.8 4.6 0 3.4 4.8 8.4 4.8 8.4s4.8-5 4.8-8.4c0-2.6-2.1-4.6-4.8-4.6Z" />
 653:  316:       <circle cx="10" cy="8.1" r="1.6" />
 654:  317:     </svg>
 655:  318:   );
 656:  319: }
 657:  320: 
 658:  321: function CityWorldSceneFallback({ scene, selectedPlaceId }: { scene: CityWorldScene; selectedPlaceId?: string | undefined }) {
 659:  322:   const terrainTiles = scene.terrainTiles.slice(0, 260);
 660:  323:   const lots = scene.lots.slice(0, 80);
 661:  324:   const projected = [
 662:  325:     ...terrainTiles.map((tile) => projectCityWorldPoint(tile.position)),
 663:  326:     ...lots.map((lot) => projectCityWorldPoint(lot.position)),
 664:  327:     ...scene.places.map((place) => projectCityWorldPoint(place.anchor)),
 665:  328:   ];
 666:  329:   const bounds = projected.reduce(
 667:  330:     (box, point) => ({
 668:  331:       minX: Math.min(box.minX, point.x),
 669:  332:       minY: Math.min(box.minY, point.y),
 670:  333:       maxX: Math.max(box.maxX, point.x),
 671:  334:       maxY: Math.max(box.maxY, point.y),
 672:  335:     }),
 673:  336:     { minX: 0, minY: 0, maxX: 1, maxY: 1 },
 674:  337:   );
 675:  338:   const pad = 96;
 676:  339:   const viewBox = `${bounds.minX - pad} ${bounds.minY - pad} ${Math.max(320, bounds.maxX - bounds.minX + pad * 2)} ${Math.max(260, bounds.maxY - bounds.minY + pad * 2)}`;
 677:  340: 
 678:  341:   return (
 679:  342:     <svg
 680:  343:       className="city-world-renderer city-world-renderer-fallback"
 681:  344:       viewBox={viewBox}
 682:  345:       role="img"
 683:  346:       aria-label={`${scene.region.district} voxel city map loading`}
 684:  347:       data-qa="city-world-renderer-fallback"
 685:  348:       preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
 686:  349:     >
 687:  350:       <rect className="city-world-renderer-fallback-bg" x={bounds.minX - pad} y={bounds.minY - pad} width={bounds.maxX - bounds.minX + pad * 2} height={bounds.maxY - bounds.minY + pad * 2} />
 688:  351:       <g>
 689:  352:         {terrainTiles.map((tile) => {
 690:  353:           const point = projectCityWorldPoint(tile.position);
 691:  354:           return (
 692:  355:             <polygon
 693:  356:               key={tile.id}
 694:  357:               className={`city-world-renderer-fallback-tile terrain-${tile.kind}`}
 695:  358:               points={cityWorldDiamondPoints(point, tile.width * CITY_WORLD_TILE_BASIS.tileWidth, tile.depth * CITY_WORLD_TILE_BASIS.tileHeight).join(" ")}
 696:  359:             />
 697:  360:           );
 698:  361:         })}
 699:  362:       </g>
 700:  363:       <g>
 701:  364:         {lots.map((lot) => {
 702:  365:           const point = projectCityWorldPoint(lot.position);
 703:  366:           return (
 704:  367:             <polygon
 705:  368:               key={lot.id}
 706:  369:               className={`city-world-renderer-fallback-lot lot-${lot.kind}`}
 707:  370:               points={cityWorldDiamondPoints(point, lot.width * CITY_WORLD_TILE_BASIS.tileWidth, lot.depth * CITY_WORLD_TILE_BASIS.tileHeight).join(" ")}
 708:  371:             />
 709:  372:           );
 710:  373:         })}
 711:  374:       </g>
 712:  375:       <g>
 713:  376:         {scene.places.map((place) => {
 714:  377:           const point = projectCityWorldPoint(place.anchor);
 715:  378:           const selected = place.id === selectedPlaceId;
 716:  379:           return <circle key={place.id} className={selected ? "city-world-renderer-fallback-place is-selected" : "city-world-renderer-fallback-place"} cx={point.x} cy={point.y} r={selected ? 13 : 9} />;
 717:  380:         })}
 718:  381:       </g>
 719:  382:     </svg>
 720:  383:   );
 721:  384: }
 722:  385: 
 723:  386: /**
 724:  387:  * Six stroke-SVG sticker glyphs in the city-world-icon language:
 725:  388:  * house, heart, tag, tree, bolt, question.
 726:  389:  */
 727:  390: function StickerGlyph({ kind }: { kind: VoxelStickerKind }) {
 728:  391:   switch (kind) {
 729:  392:     case "home":
 730:  393:       return (
 731:  394:         <svg className="city-world-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true">
 732:  395:           <path d="M4 9.5 10 4.5l6 5" />
 733:  396:           <path d="M5.8 8.4v7.1h8.4V8.4" />
 734:  397:         </svg>
 735:  398:       );
 736:  399:     case "favorite":
 737:  400:       return (
 738:  401:         <svg className="city-world-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true">
 739:  402:           <path d="M10 15.6S4.6 12 4.6 8.5C4.6 6.6 6 5.1 7.8 5.1c.9 0 1.7.4 2.2 1.1.5-.7 1.3-1.1 2.2-1.1 1.8 0 3.2 1.5 3.2 3.4 0 3.5-5.4 7.1-5.4 7.1Z" />
 740:  403:         </svg>
 741:  404:       );
 742:  405:     case "shop":
 743:  406:       return (
 744:  407:         <svg className="city-world-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true">
 745:  408:           <path d="M4.5 4.5h5.2l5.8 5.8-5.2 5.2-5.8-5.8V4.5Z" />
 746:  409:           <circle cx="7.7" cy="7.7" r="1.1" />
 747:  410:         </svg>
 748:  411:       );
 749:  412:     case "park":
 750:  413:       return (
 751:  414:         <svg className="city-world-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true">
 752:  415:           <path d="M10 3.8 5.6 9.8h1.9L4.8 13.4h10.4L12.5 9.8h1.9L10 3.8Z" />
 753:  416:           <path d="M10 13.4v2.8" />
 754:  417:         </svg>
 755:  418:       );
 756:  419:     case "idea":
 757:  420:       return (
 758:  421:         <svg className="city-world-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true">
 759:  422:           <path d="M11.2 3.6 5.6 11h3.6l-1 5.4L13.9 9h-3.5l.8-5.4Z" />
 760:  423:         </svg>
 761:  424:       );
 762:  425:     case "question":

1491:  695: function endpointForHostedClawdAction(action: HostedClawdActionKind): string {
1492:  696:   switch (action) {
1493:  697:     case "continue_to_stripe":
1494:  698:       return "/api/hosted-clawd/checkout";
1495:  699:     case "open_billing_portal":
1496:  700:       return "/api/hosted-clawd/billing-portal";
1497:  701:     case "open_saved_campaign":
1498:  702:     case "refresh_status":
1499:  703:       return "/api/hosted-clawd/saved";
1500:  704:     case "create_hosted_clawd":
1501:  705:     case "join_waitlist":
1502:  706:       return "/api/hosted-clawd/create-or-attach";
1503:  707:   }
1504:  708: }

1506:  710: function savedStateEndpointForHostedClawd(payload: ReturnType<typeof hostedClawdPayload>): string {
1507:  711:   const params = new URLSearchParams();
1508:  712:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(payload)) {
1509:  713:     if (value === undefined || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) continue;
1510:  714:     params.set(key, String(value));
1511:  715:   }
1512:  716:   const query = params.toString();
1513:  717:   return query ? `/api/hosted-clawd/saved?${query}` : "/api/hosted-clawd/saved";
1514:  718: }

1516:  720: function hostedClawdPayload({

1521:  725:   campaignPreview,

1527:  731:   scoutPreview?: ScoutPreviewState | null;
1528:  732:   campaignPreview?: CampaignPreviewState | null;
1529:  733:   selectedNoteCount: number;
1530:  734: }) {

1532:  736:     trigger: context.trigger,

1534:  738:     primaryGoal: scoutPreview?.goal,

1546:  750: function defaultHostedClawdContext({

1560:  764: }): HostedClawdContext {

1574:  778:     },

1591:  795:       status: "needs_confirmation",
1592:  796:     });
1593:  797:   }
1594:  798: 
1595:  799:   return {
1596:  800:     type: "hostedClawdContext",
1597:  801:     mode: screenState === "waitlist" ? "alpha_free" : "beta_paid",
1598:  802:     screenState,
1599:  803:     trigger,
1600:  804:     statusLabel: statusLabelForHostedClawdScreen(screenState),
1601:  805:     contextLabel: `${businessType} at ${selectedPlaceLabel ?? scene.county.name}`,
1602:  806:     primaryCopy: primaryCopyForHostedClawdScreen(screenState),
1603:  807:     secondaryCopy: secondaryCopyForHostedClawdScreen(screenState),
1604:  808:     sessionBoundary: screenState === "active" ? "Saved state on." : screenState === "inactive_payment_failed" ? "Saved items are read only." : "This chat is temporary.",
1605:  809:     paymentCopy: screenState === "waitlist" ? "Billing is off in Alpha." : "Atlas checks billing before saving.",
1606:  810:     billing: billingSummaryForHostedClawdScreen(screenState),
1607:  811:     primaryAction: {
1608:  812:       kind:
1609:  813:         screenState === "checkout_pending"
1610:  814:           ? "continue_to_stripe"
1611:  815:           : screenState === "inactive_payment_failed"
1612:  816:             ? "open_billing_portal"
1613:  817:             : screenState === "active"
1614:  818:               ? "open_saved_campaign"
1615:  819:               : screenState === "activating"
1616:  820:                 ? "refresh_status"
1617:  821:                 : "join_waitlist",
1618:  822:       label:
1619:  823:         screenState === "checkout_pending"
1620:  824:           ? "Open test Checkout"
1621:  825:           : screenState === "inactive_payment_failed"
1622:  826:             ? "Fix billing"
1623:  827:             : screenState === "active"
1624:  828:               ? "Open saved state"
1625:  829:               : screenState === "activating"
1626:  830:                 ? "Check status"
1627:  831:                 : "Join waitlist",
1628:  832:       enabled: true,
1629:  833:     },
1630:  834:     savePreview,
1631:  835:     flags: {
1632:  836:       persistenceEnabled: screenState !== "waitlist",
1633:  837:       moneyEnabled: screenState !== "waitlist",
1634:  838:       publicClaimEnabled: false,
1635:  839:     },
1636:  840:     gates: [
1637:  841:       {
1638:  842:         gate: "HUMAN_APPROVAL_BEFORE_PERSISTENCE",
1639:  843:         flag: "ATLAS_HOSTED_CLAWD_PERSISTENCE_ENABLED",
1640:  844:         approved: screenState !== "waitlist",
1641:  845:         requiredFor: "accounts, business memory, Scout Drop saves, campaign saves, evidence, XP, reports, exports, and database migrations",
1642:  846:       },
1643:  847:       {
1644:  848:         gate: "HUMAN_APPROVAL_BEFORE_MONEY",
1645:  849:         flag: "ATLAS_HOSTED_CLAWD_MONEY_ENABLED",
1646:  850:         approved: screenState !== "waitlist",
1647:  851:         requiredFor: "Stripe Checkout, Billing Portal, paid limits, and subscription-gated writes",
1648:  852:       },

1831:    3:    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
1832:    4:    Two-layer grammar with a hard boundary:
1833:    5:      CHROME Ã¢â‚¬â€ every overlay/panel/control inherits ChatGPT: achromatic, system
1834:    6:               type, alpha hairlines, near-zero elevation. Hierarchy comes from
1835:    7:               type + ink-steps + alignment + hairlines, never fills or shadow.
1836:    8:      WORLD  Ã¢â‚¬â€ the map canvas is the only place Atlas's own color lives.
1837:    9:    Status hue exists ONLY on tiny status dots. Primary actions are solid ink.
1838:   10:    Hover is a tint, never a lift. Honesty copy is plain tertiary text.

4326:  203: function saveReadinessForContext(context: HostedClawdContext, closedGateCount: number): HostedClawdSaveReadiness {
4327:  204:   const slots = context.savePreview.map((item): HostedClawdSaveSlot => ({
4328:  205:     id: saveSlotId(item.label),
4329:  206:     label: item.label,
4330:  207:     detail: item.value,
4331:  208:     status: item.status === "ready" ? "ready" : item.status === "needs_confirmation" ? "pending" : "locked",
4332:  209:   }));
4333:  210:   const readyCount = slots.filter((slot) => slot.status === "ready").length;
4334:  211:   const status = context.canPersist ? "ready" : closedGateCount > 0 ? "session" : "needs_account";
4335:  212: 
4336:  213:   if (context.canPersist) {
4337:  214:     return {
4338:  215:       status,
4339:  216:       kicker: "Saved setup",
4340:  217:       title: `${readyCount}/${slots.length} ready`,
4341:  218:       detail: "Save confirmed business, map, Scout Drop, and campaign draft.",
4342:  219:       readyCount,
4343:  220:       slots,
4344:  221:     };
4345:  222:   }
4346:  223: 
4347:  224:   return {
4348:  225:     status,
4349:  226:     kicker: "Local view",
4350:  227:     title: `${readyCount}/${slots.length} ready in this chat`,
4351:  228:     detail:
4352:  229:       closedGateCount > 0
4353:  230:         ? "This chat is temporary. Connect an account before anything can be saved."
4354:  231:         : "Connect an account to save this setup.",
4355:  232:     readyCount,
4356:  233:     slots,
4357:  234:   };
4358:  235: }

4360:  237: function saveSlotId(label: string): string {
4361:  238:   return label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "") || "slot";
4362:  239: }
4363:  240: 
4364:  241: function saveSlotValue(slot: HostedClawdSaveSlot): string {
4365:  242:   if (slot.status === "locked") return "Not ready";
4366:  243:   if (slot.status === "pending") return slot.detail;
4367:  244:   if (slot.label === "Scout report" || slot.label === "Campaign draft") return "Saved";
4368:  245:   return slot.detail;
4369:  246: }

4386:  263: function savedShelfForContext(context: HostedClawdContext): HostedClawdSavedShelf | null {
4387:  264:   const savedState = context.savedState;
4388:  265:   if (!savedState) return null;
4389:  266: 
4390:  267:   const rows: HostedClawdSavedShelfRow[] = [];
4391:  268:   if (savedState.clawd) {
4392:  269:     rows.push({
4393:  270:       id: `clawd-${savedState.clawd.id}`,
4394:  271:       kind: "clawd",
4395:  272:       label: savedState.clawd.name,
4396:  273:       detail: "Saved assistant",
4397:  274:     });
4398:  275:   }
4399:  276:   if (savedState.businessProfile) {
4400:  277:     const place = savedState.businessProfile.placeLabel ?? savedState.businessProfile.countyLabel ?? savedState.businessProfile.countySlug;
4401:  278:     rows.push({
4402:  279:       id: `business-${savedState.businessProfile.id}`,
4403:  280:       kind: "business",
4404:  281:       label: savedState.businessProfile.name,
4405:  282:       detail: `${savedState.businessProfile.businessType ?? "Business profile"} - ${place}`,
4406:  283:     });
4407:  284:   }
4408:  285:   if (savedState.scoutDrops.length > 0) {
4409:  286:     const latest = savedState.scoutDrops[0];
4410:  287:     if (latest) {
4411:  288:       rows.push({
4412:  289:         id: `scout-${latest.id}`,
4413:  290:         kind: "scout",
4414:  291:         label: `${savedState.scoutDrops.length} saved Scout Drop${savedState.scoutDrops.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
4415:  292:         detail: `Latest preview ${latest.scoutPreviewId}`,
4416:  293:       });
4417:  294:     }
4418:  295:   }
4419:  296:   if (savedState.campaignDrafts.length > 0) {
4420:  297:     const latest = savedState.campaignDrafts[0];
4421:  298:     if (latest) {
4422:  299:       rows.push({
4423:  300:         id: `campaign-${latest.id}`,
4424:  301:         kind: "campaign",
4425:  302:         label: `${savedState.campaignDrafts.length} campaign draft${savedState.campaignDrafts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
4426:  303:         detail: latest.summary ?? `Preview ${latest.campaignPreviewId}`,
4427:  304:       });
4428:  305:     }
4429:  306:   }
4430:  307: 
4431:  308:   const recordCount =
4432:  309:     (savedState.clawd ? 1 : 0) +
4433:  310:     (savedState.businessProfile ? 1 : 0) +
4434:  311:     savedState.scoutDrops.length +
4435:  312:     savedState.campaignDrafts.length;
4436:  313: 
4437:  314:   if (rows.length === 0) {
4438:  315:     rows.push({
4439:  316:       id: "empty",
4440:  317:       kind: "empty",
4441:  318:       label: "Nothing saved yet",
4442:  319:       detail: "Start from this map.",
4443:  320:     });
4444:  321:   }
4445:  322: 
4446:  323:   return {
4447:  324:     title: recordCount === 0 ? "No saved state yet" : `${recordCount} saved in ChatGPT`,
4448:  325:     detail:
4449:  326:       savedState.readOnlyReason === "billing_attention"
4450:  327:         ? "Saved history is readable. New saves are paused."
4451:  328:         : savedState.paidWrites === "enabled"
4452:  329:           ? "Saved history is loaded. New saves are on."
4453:  330:           : "Saved history is readable. New saves are locked.",
4454:  331:     recordCount,
4455:  332:     readOnly: savedState.paidWrites === "read_only",
4456:  333:     rows,
4457:  334:   };
4458:  335: }

4503:  380:       status: context.canPersist ? "ready" : "blocked",

4517:  394: function setupStepFromPreview(

4842:  296: function formatLabel(value: string): string {
4843:  297:   const normalizedValue = value.trim().toLowerCase();
4844:  298:   if (normalizedValue === "qr_flyer") return "QR flyer";
4845:  299: 
4846:  300:   return value
4847:  301:     .split(/[_\s]+/)
4848:  302:     .filter(Boolean)
4849:  303:     .map((word, index) => {
4850:  304:       if (word.toLowerCase() === "qr") return "QR";
4851:  305:       return index === 0 ? word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word;
4852:  306:     })
4853:  307:     .join(" ");
4854:  308: }

5099:  243: // Tone tables keep shell counties honest (near-silent ground detail) and
5100:  244: // hidden drafts muted, while the public county carries the full treatment.
5101:  245: const TERRAIN_SEAM_TONE_STYLE: Record<CityWorldGroundTone, { seamAlpha: number; lipAlpha: number; strandAlpha: number; wetAlpha: number }> = {
5102:  246:   public: { seamAlpha: 0.3, lipAlpha: 0.2, strandAlpha: 0.56, wetAlpha: 0.42 },
5103:  247:   draft: { seamAlpha: 0.14, lipAlpha: 0.09, strandAlpha: 0.28, wetAlpha: 0.22 },
5104:  248:   shell: { seamAlpha: 0.18, lipAlpha: 0.09, strandAlpha: 0.16, wetAlpha: 0.12 },
5105:  249: };
5106:  250: 
5107:  251: const LOT_CURB_CUT_STYLE = {
5108:  252:   apron: 0xd9c89c,
5109:  253:   groove: 0x655742,
5110:  254:   walk: 0xefdcb0,
5111:  255: } as const;
5112:  256: 
5113:  257: // Diamond-edge geometry on the 2:1 iso grid. north = y-1 neighbor,
5114:  258: // east = x+1, south = y+1, west = x-1 (matches the compiler's edge authoring).
5115:  259: function tileEdgeSegment(point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number, side: CityWorldTileEdge): { from: ProjectedPoint; to: ProjectedPoint } {
5116:  260:   const top = { x: point.x, y: point.y - height / 2 };
5117:  261:   const right = { x: point.x + width / 2, y: point.y };
5118:  262:   const bottom = { x: point.x, y: point.y + height / 2 };
5119:  263:   const left = { x: point.x - width / 2, y: point.y };
5120:  264: 
5121:  265:   if (side === "north") return { from: top, to: right };
5122:  266:   if (side === "east") return { from: right, to: bottom };
5123:  267:   if (side === "south") return { from: bottom, to: left };
5124:  268:   return { from: left, to: top };
5125:  269: }
5126:  270: 
5127:  271: function insetEdgeSegment(point: ProjectedPoint, segment: { from: ProjectedPoint; to: ProjectedPoint }, inset: number): { from: ProjectedPoint; to: ProjectedPoint } {
5128:  272:   return {
5129:  273:     from: { x: segment.from.x + (point.x - segment.from.x) * inset, y: segment.from.y + (point.y - segment.from.y) * inset },
5130:  274:     to: { x: segment.to.x + (point.x - segment.to.x) * inset, y: segment.to.y + (point.y - segment.to.y) * inset },
5131:  275:   };
5132:  276: }
5133:  277: 
5134:  278: function lotCurbPoint(point: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number, edge: CityWorldTileEdge): ProjectedPoint {
5135:  279:   const segment = tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, edge);
5136:  280:   return {
5137:  281:     x: (segment.from.x + segment.to.x) / 2,
5138:  282:     y: (segment.from.y + segment.to.y) / 2,
5139:  283:   };
5140:  284: }
5141:  285: 
5142:  286: // ---- Whole-canvas golden-hour grade ---------------------------------------
5143:  287: // One post pass over the Pixi stage: gentle contrast S-curve, warm-highlight /
5144:  288: // cool-shadow split tone, soft vignette, warm atmospheric edge haze, and a
5145:  289: // 1-bit dither to kill gradient banding. Physically motivated (sunlight +
5146:  290: // atmosphere), not a glow effect.
5147:  291: const GRADE_VERTEX_SHADER = `
5148:  292: in vec2 aPosition;
5149:  293: out vec2 vTextureCoord;
5150:  294: out vec2 vFrameCoord;
5151:  295: 
5152:  296: uniform vec4 uInputSize;
5153:  297: uniform vec4 uOutputFrame;
5154:  298: uniform vec4 uOutputTexture;
5155:  299: 
5156:  300: vec4 filterVertexPosition( void )
5157:  301: {
5158:  302:     vec2 position = aPosition * uOutputFrame.zw + uOutputFrame.xy;
5159:  303:     position.x = position.x * (2.0 / uOutputTexture.x) - 1.0;
5160:  304:     position.y = position.y * (2.0 * uOutputTexture.z / uOutputTexture.y) - uOutputTexture.z;
5161:  305:     return vec4(position, 0.0, 1.0);
5162:  306: }
5163:  307: 
5164:  308: vec2 filterTextureCoord( void )
5165:  309: {
5166:  310:     return aPosition * (uOutputFrame.zw * uInputSize.zw);
5167:  311: }
5168:  312: 
5169:  313: void main(void)
5170:  314: {
5171:  315:     gl_Position = filterVertexPosition();
5172:  316:     vTextureCoord = filterTextureCoord();
5173:  317:     vFrameCoord = aPosition;
5174:  318: }
5175:  319: `;
5176:  320: 
5177:  321: const GRADE_FRAGMENT_SHADER = `
5178:  322: in vec2 vTextureCoord;
5179:  323: in vec2 vFrameCoord;
5180:  324: out vec4 finalColor;
5181:  325: 
5182:  326: uniform sampler2D uTexture;
5183:  327: 
5184:  328: void main(void)
5185:  329: {
5186:  330:     vec4 source = texture(uTexture, vTextureCoord);
5187:  331:     vec3 c = source.rgb;
5188:  332: 
5189:  333:     // S-curve for form contrast Ã¢â‚¬â€ firmer than before so directional wall
5190:  334:     // shading survives the grade instead of washing to a matte pastel.
5191:  335:     c = mix(c, c * c * (3.0 - 2.0 * c), 0.46);
5192:  336: 
5193:  337:     // 0.54E Ã¢â‚¬â€ highlight rolloff. Sunlit stucco and lit roofs ride near-white
5194:  338:     // luma and used to blow out into one paper tone; compressing the top of
5195:  339:     // the range keeps their form (rims, material fields, tint spreads)
5196:  340:     // legible while the scene still reads sunlit. This is the single biggest
5197:  341:     // wash fix and applies to every scene the engine serves.
5198:  342:     float luma = dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
5199:  343:     c *= mix(1.0, 0.87, smoothstep(0.68, 1.0, luma));
5200:  344: 
5201:  345:     // Gentler saturation trim: calm SoCal palette, but material identity
5202:  346:     // (clay vs metal vs glass, per-home tint spread) survives the grade.
5203:  347:     luma = dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
5204:  348:     c = mix(vec3(luma), c, 0.96);
5205:  349: 
5206:  350:     // Golden-hour split tone: warm sunlit highlights, cool shadows.
5207:  351:     vec3 warm = vec3(1.055, 1.005, 0.915);
5208:  352:     vec3 cool = vec3(0.925, 0.975, 1.065);
5209:  353:     c *= mix(cool, warm, smoothstep(0.16, 0.86, luma));
5210:  354: 
5211:  355:     // Soft vignette pulls focus to the district.
5212:  356:     vec2 p = vFrameCoord - 0.5;
5213:  357:     float radius = dot(p, p);
5214:  358:     float vignette = mix(0.86, 1.0, smoothstep(0.62, 0.12, radius));
5215:  359:     c *= vignette;
5216:  360: 
5217:  361:     // Light atmospheric haze toward a warm sky tone at the frame edges Ã¢â‚¬â€ kept
5218:  362:     // to the outer corners only so it frames without flattening the district.
5219:  363:     float haze = smoothstep(0.34, 0.66, radius);
5220:  364:     c = mix(c, vec3(0.955, 0.93, 0.83), haze * 0.07);
5221:  365: 
5222:  366:     // Fine dither hides banding in the large ground gradients.
5223:  367:     float noise = fract(sin(dot(vFrameCoord, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
5224:  368:     c += (noise - 0.5) * (1.6 / 255.0);
5225:  369: 
5226:  370:     finalColor = vec4(c, source.a);
5227:  371: }
5228:  372: `;
5229:  373: 
5230:  374: function createAtlasGradeFilter(): Filter {
5231:  375:   return new Filter({
5232:  376:     glProgram: GlProgram.from({
5233:  377:       vertex: GRADE_VERTEX_SHADER,
5234:  378:       fragment: GRADE_FRAGMENT_SHADER,
5235:  379:       name: "atlas-golden-hour-grade",
5236:  380:     }),
5237:  381:     resources: {},
5238:  382:   });
5239:  383: }

5304:  448:   function ensureRenderLoop() {

5311:  455:   function renderFrame() {

5319:  463:     // Wall-clock cap: rAF timestamps are virtualized in headless/BeginFrame

5330:  474:       loop.needsRender = false;
5331:  475:       perfRef.current.renderedFrames += 1;

5919: 1063:       const x = camera.x + point.x * camera.zoom;
5920: 1064:       const y = camera.y + point.y * camera.zoom;
5921: 1065:       const distance = Math.hypot(screenX - x, screenY - y);
5922: 1066:       const threshold = Math.max(34, place.hitRadius * 14 * camera.zoom);
5923: 1067:       if (distance <= threshold && (!nearest || distance < nearest.distance)) {
5924: 1068:         nearest = { id: place.id, distance };
5925: 1069:       }
5926: 1070:     }
5927: 1071: 
5928: 1072:     return nearest?.id;
5929: 1073:   }
5930: 1074: 
5931: 1075:   return (
5932: 1076:     <div
5933: 1077:       ref={mountRef}
5934: 1078:       className="city-world-renderer"
5935: 1079:       aria-label={`${scene.region.district} voxel city map`}
5936: 1080:       data-qa-place-labels={suppressPlaceLabels ? "suppressed" : "visible"}
5937: 1081:     />
5938: 1082:   );
5939: 1083: });

5941: 1085: function pointerDistance(pointers: Map<number, { x: number; y: number }>): number | undefined {
5942: 1086:   if (pointers.size < 2) return undefined;
5943: 1087:   const pair = Array.from(pointers.values()).slice(0, 2);
5944: 1088:   const first = pair[0];
5945: 1089:   const second = pair[1];
5946: 1090:   if (!first || !second) return undefined;
5947: 1091:   return Math.hypot(first.x - second.x, first.y - second.y);
5948: 1092: }

5950: 1094: // Everything the incremental focus overlay needs to redraw hover/selection
5951: 1095: // without touching the base scene: visible places, their anchored buildings,
5952: 1096: // and the label crown lifts, captured at scene-rebuild time.
5953: 1097: type FocusIndex = {
5954: 1098:   placesById: Map<string, CityWorldPlace>;
5955: 1099:   buildingsByPlaceId: Map<string, CityWorldBuilding[]>;
5956: 1100:   crownLift: Map<string, number>;
5957: 1101:   drawnPlaceIds: Set<string>;
5958: 1102: };
5959: 1103: 
5960: 1104: // Frame-independent scene-window artifacts are memoized per scene object +
5961: 1105: // option set: createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler wraps the same compile as
5962: 1106: // compileCityWorldSceneWindow but only re-runs the frame filter on streaming
5963: 1107: // pan refreshes.
5964: 1108: const sceneWindowCompilerCache = new WeakMap<CityWorldScene, Map<string, ReturnType<typeof createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler>>>();
5965: 1109: 
5966: 1110: function sceneWindowCompilerFor(scene: CityWorldScene, includeLabels: boolean, includeDebug: boolean) {
5967: 1111:   let byOptions = sceneWindowCompilerCache.get(scene);
5968: 1112:   if (!byOptions) {
5969: 1113:     byOptions = new Map();
5970: 1114:     sceneWindowCompilerCache.set(scene, byOptions);
5971: 1115:   }
5972: 1116:   const key = `${includeLabels}:${includeDebug}`;
5973: 1117:   let compiler = byOptions.get(key);
5974: 1118:   if (!compiler) {
5975: 1119:     compiler = createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler(scene, { includeLabels, includeDebug });
5976: 1120:     byOptions.set(key, compiler);
5977: 1121:   }
5978: 1122:   return compiler;
5979: 1123: }
