5981: 1125: function drawScene(
5982: 1126:   world: Container,
5983: 1127:   scene: CityWorldScene,
5984: 1128:   cameraPresetId: CityWorldCameraPresetId,
5985: 1129:   viewportFrame: CityWorldViewportFrame,
5986: 1130:   cameraZoom: number,
5987: 1131:   atlasTextures: CityWorldTextureMap,
5988: 1132:   debugMode: CityWorldDebugMode | undefined,
5989: 1133:   suppressPlaceLabels: boolean,
5990: 1134:   onSelectPlace: (placeId: string) => void,
5991: 1135:   onHoverPlace: (placeId: string | undefined) => void,
5992: 1136:   animated: AnimatedTarget[],
5993: 1137: ): { frame: CityWorldViewportFrame; focus: FocusIndex } {
5994: 1138:   const previousChildren = world.removeChildren();
5995: 1139:   for (const child of previousChildren) {
5996: 1140:     child.destroy({ children: true });
5997: 1141:   }
5998: 1142:   animated.length = 0;
5999: 1143: 
6000: 1144:   const layers = createLayers();
6001: 1145:   Object.values(layers).forEach((layer) => world.addChild(layer));
6002: 1146:   const atlas = createCityWorldAtlasResolver(scene, atlasTextures);
6003: 1147:   const includeLabels = !suppressPlaceLabels && !shouldHideCityWorldLabels();
6004: 1148:   const compiler = sceneWindowCompilerFor(scene, includeLabels, debugMode === "engine");
6005: 1149:   const sceneWindow = compiler.windowFor(cameraPresetId, viewportFrame);
6006: 1150:   const itemIndex = compiler.itemIndex;
6007: 1151:   const renderCommands = sceneWindow.visibleCommands;
6008: 1152: 
6009: 1153:   // Ground layers merge into a few depth-band Graphics (band = floor((x+y)/4)):
6010: 1154:   // bands partition painter depth, so adding bands in ascending order with
6011: 1155:   // in-band call order preserved is exactly order-safe Ã¢â‚¬â€ and drops thousands
6012: 1156:   // of per-tile/per-lot Graphics to ~dozens.
6013: 1157:   drawBanded(layers.terrainLayer, orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "terrain_tile", itemIndex.terrainTiles), (g, tile) => drawTerrainTile(g, tile, atlas));
6014: 1158:   drawRoadNetwork(layers.roadLayer, orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "road_segment", itemIndex.roadSegments));
6015: 1159:   drawBanded(layers.lotLayer, orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "lot", itemIndex.lots), (g, lot) => drawLot(g, lot));
6016: 1160: 
6017: 1161:   const buildings = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "building", itemIndex.buildings);
6018: 1162:   // 0.67H focal calm Ã¢â‚¬â€ props inside the focal anchor's ring dim toward
6019: 1163:   // ambience so the hero building's face separation stays the loudest read.
6020: 1164:   // The base scene is focus-agnostic (0.74F), so the focal anchor keys off
6021: 1165:   // the scene's default selection, not live hover state. Threaded through
6022: 1166:   // the 0.75C depth-interleaved draw so calm and correct occlusion compose.
6023: 1167:   const focalAnchor = focalPlaceAnchor(scene, scene.hudDefaults.selectedPlaceId);
6024: 1168:   const props = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "prop", itemIndex.props);
6025: 1169:   drawDepthInterleavedBuildingsAndProps(layers, buildings, props, animated, atlas, shouldDrawMaterialTexture(cameraZoom), (prop) =>
6026: 1170:     focalCalm(prop.position, focalAnchor),
6027: 1171:   );
6028: 1172:   const actors = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "actor", itemIndex.actors);
6029: 1173:   for (const actor of actors) drawActor(layers.actorLayer, actor, animated, atlas, focalCalm(actor.position, focalAnchor));
6030: 1174:   const visiblePlaces = orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "place_marker", itemIndex.places);
6031: 1175:   for (const place of visiblePlaces) drawPlaceMarker(layers, place, onSelectPlace, onHoverPlace);
6032: 1176:   for (const pin of orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "pin", itemIndex.pins)) drawPin(layers.markerLayer, pin, atlas);
6033: 1177:   // 0.56E Ã¢â‚¬â€ labels clear the architecture: each place's label lifts above
6034: 1178:   // the tallest structure anchored to it (plus crown allowance), instead of
6035: 1179:   // sitting at a fixed ground offset that erased landmark crowns.
6036: 1180:   const crownLift = placeCrownLiftMap(scene.buildings);
6037: 1181:   if (includeLabels) {
6038: 1182:     // 0.67H label demotion Ã¢â‚¬â€ ambient labels are a hard cap (none on mobile,
6039: 1183:     // two on desktop); selected/hover labels render from the focus overlay.
6040: 1184:     const ambientLabelIds = ambientLabelAllowance(scene, cameraPresetId);
6041: 1185:     for (const place of orderedSceneItems(renderCommands, "place_label", itemIndex.places)) drawPlaceLabel(layers.labelLayer, place, ambientLabelIds, crownLift.get(place.id));
6042: 1186:   }
6043: 1187:   if (debugMode === "engine") drawEngineDebugOverlay(layers.hudBridgeLayer, scene);
6044: 1188: 
6045: 1189:   const focus: FocusIndex = {
6046: 1190:     placesById: new Map(visiblePlaces.map((place) => [place.id, place])),
6047: 1191:     buildingsByPlaceId: new Map(),
6048: 1192:     crownLift,
6049: 1193:     drawnPlaceIds: new Set(visiblePlaces.map((place) => place.id)),
6050: 1194:   };
6051: 1195:   for (const building of buildings) {
6052: 1196:     if (!building.placeId) continue;
6053: 1197:     const anchored = focus.buildingsByPlaceId.get(building.placeId);
6054: 1198:     if (anchored) anchored.push(building);
6055: 1199:     else focus.buildingsByPlaceId.set(building.placeId, [building]);
6056: 1200:   }
6057: 1201:   return { frame: sceneWindow.frame, focus };
6058: 1202: }

6060: 1204: const GROUND_BAND_TILES = 4;
6061: 1205: 
6062: 1206: function drawBanded<T extends { position: CityWorldPoint }>(
6063: 1207:   layer: Container,
6064: 1208:   items: T[],
6065: 1209:   draw: (g: Graphics, item: T) => void,
6066: 1210: ) {
6067: 1211:   const bands = new Map<number, Graphics>();
6068: 1212:   for (const item of items) {
6069: 1213:     const band = Math.floor((item.position.x + item.position.y) / GROUND_BAND_TILES);
6070: 1214:     let g = bands.get(band);
6071: 1215:     if (!g) {
6072: 1216:       g = new Graphics();
6073: 1217:       bands.set(band, g);
6074: 1218:     }
6075: 1219:     draw(g, item);
6076: 1220:   }
6077: 1221:   for (const band of [...bands.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
6078: 1222:     const g = bands.get(band);
6079: 1223:     if (g) layer.addChild(g);
6080: 1224:   }
6081: 1225: }

6083: 1227: function shouldHideCityWorldLabels(): boolean {

6088: 1232: // 0.67H label demotion Ã¢â‚¬â€ the ambient (non-focused) label budget is a hard
6089: 1233: // cap, not a priority threshold: mobile gets none, desktop gets the two
6090: 1234: // highest-priority anchors. Focus-overlay labels render on top of this
6091: 1235: // allowance, so a desktop frame tops out at three label cards.
6092: 1236: function ambientLabelAllowance(scene: CityWorldScene, cameraPresetId: CityWorldCameraPresetId): Set<string> {
6093: 1237:   if (cameraPresetId === "mobile") return new Set();
6094: 1238:   return new Set(
6095: 1239:     scene.places
6096: 1240:       .filter((place) => place.labelPriority >= 9)
6097: 1241:       .sort((a, b) => b.labelPriority - a.labelPriority)
6098: 1242:       .slice(0, 2)
6099: 1243:       .map((place) => place.id),
6100: 1244:   );
6101: 1245: }

6103: 1247: // 0.67H focal calm Ã¢â‚¬â€ the default-selected place (or the first landmark as a
6104: 1248: // fallback) defines the focal ring where decoration must yield to architecture.
6105: 1249: function focalPlaceAnchor(scene: CityWorldScene, selectedPlaceId: string): CityWorldPoint | undefined {
6106: 1250:   const focal = scene.places.find((place) => place.id === selectedPlaceId) ?? scene.places.find((place) => place.kind === "landmark");
6107: 1251:   return focal?.anchor;
6108: 1252: }

6110: 1254: function focalCalm(position: CityWorldPoint, focalAnchor: CityWorldPoint | undefined): number {
6111: 1255:   if (!focalAnchor) return 1;
6112: 1256:   const distance = Math.hypot(position.x - focalAnchor.x, position.y - focalAnchor.y);
6113: 1257:   if (distance < 2.2) return 0.55;
6114: 1258:   if (distance < 3.6) return 0.78;
6115: 1259:   return 1;
6116: 1260: }

6118: 1262: function resolveCameraPresetId(scene: CityWorldScene, requestedId: CityWorldCameraPresetId | undefined, width: number): CityWorldCameraPresetId {
6119: 1263:   if (requestedId && scene.cameraPresets.some((item) => item.id === requestedId)) return requestedId;
6120: 1264:   const responsiveId = width < 720 ? "mobile" : "desktop";
6121: 1265:   if (scene.cameraPresets.some((item) => item.id === responsiveId)) return responsiveId;
6122: 1266:   return scene.cameraPresets[0]?.id ?? "desktop";

6140: 1284: function orderedSceneItems<T extends { id: string }>(
6141: 1285:   commands: readonly CityWorldRenderCommand[],
6142: 1286:   kind: CityWorldRenderCommandKind,
6143: 1287:   itemById: ReadonlyMap<string, T>,
6144: 1288: ): T[] {
6145: 1289:   // Single pass over the visible commands resolving through the scene's
6146: 1290:   // shared id index Ã¢â‚¬â€ the old per-call Map rebuild scanned every item array
6147: 1291:   // nine times per scene rebuild.
6148: 1292:   const items: T[] = [];
6149: 1293:   for (const command of commands) {
6150: 1294:     if (command.kind !== kind) continue;
6151: 1295:     const item = itemById.get(command.sourceId);
6152: 1296:     if (item) items.push(item);
6153: 1297:   }
6154: 1298:   return items;
6155: 1299: }

6157: 1301: function drawDepthInterleavedBuildingsAndProps(
6158: 1302:   layers: LayerMap,
6159: 1303:   buildings: CityWorldBuilding[],
6160: 1304:   props: CityWorldProp[],
6161: 1305:   animated: AnimatedTarget[],
6162: 1306:   atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver,
6163: 1307:   materialTextureEnabled: boolean,
6164: 1308:   propCalm: (prop: CityWorldProp) => number = () => 1,
6165: 1309: ) {
6166: 1310:   const buildingProxy = layers.buildingLayer as QaVisibilityProxyLayer;
6167: 1311:   const propProxy = layers.propLayer as QaVisibilityProxyLayer;
6168: 1312:   buildingProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.length = 0;
6169: 1313:   propProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.length = 0;
6170: 1314:   layers.buildingPropDepthLayer.sortableChildren = true;
6171: 1315: 
6172: 1316:   const items = [
6173: 1317:     ...buildings.map((building, sourceIndex) => ({
6174: 1318:       id: building.id,
6175: 1319:       kind: "building" as const,
6176: 1320:       depthKey: cityWorldBuildingDepthKey(building),
6177: 1321:       sourceIndex,
6178: 1322:       building,
6179: 1323:     })),
6180: 1324:     ...props.map((prop, sourceIndex) => ({
6181: 1325:       id: prop.id,
6182: 1326:       kind: "prop" as const,
6183: 1327:       depthKey: cityWorldPropDepthKey(prop),
6184: 1328:       sourceIndex,
6185: 1329:       prop,
6186: 1330:     })),
6187: 1331:   ].sort(compareCityWorldDepthInterleaveItems);
6188: 1332: 
6189: 1333:   for (const item of items) {
6190: 1334:     const group = new Container();
6191: 1335:     group.label = `${item.kind}-${item.id}`;
6192: 1336:     group.zIndex = item.depthKey;
6193: 1337:     if (item.kind === "building") {
6194: 1338:       drawBuilding(layers, group, item.building, atlas, materialTextureEnabled);
6195: 1339:       group.visible = buildingProxy.visible;
6196: 1340:       buildingProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.push(group);
6197: 1341:     } else {
6198: 1342:       drawProp(group, item.prop, animated, atlas, propCalm(item.prop));
6199: 1343:       group.visible = propProxy.visible;
6200: 1344:       propProxy.atlasVisibilityTargets.push(group);
6201: 1345:     }
6202: 1346:     layers.buildingPropDepthLayer.addChild(group);
6203: 1347:   }
6204: 1348:   layers.buildingPropDepthLayer.sortChildren();
6205: 1349: }

6207: 1351: function drawEngineDebugOverlay(layer: Container, scene: CityWorldScene) {
6208: 1352:   for (const tile of scene.terrainTiles) {
6209: 1353:     const massing = tile.visualGrammar?.terrainChunkMassing ?? "none";
6210: 1354:     if (massing === "none") continue;
6211: 1355:     const point = project(tile.position);
6212: 1356:     const color = debugColorForMassing(massing);
6213: 1357:     const outline = new Graphics();
6214: 1358:     outline.poly(diamondPoints(point, TILE_WIDTH * 1.18, TILE_HEIGHT * 1.12), true);
6215: 1359:     outline.stroke({ color, alpha: 0.42, width: 1.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6216: 1360:     layer.addChild(outline);
6217: 1361:   }
6218: 1362: 
6219: 1363:   for (const road of scene.roadSegments) {
6220: 1364:     const from = project(road.from);
6221: 1365:     const to = project(road.to);
6222: 1366:     const line = new Graphics()
6223: 1367:       .moveTo(from.x, from.y)
6224: 1368:       .lineTo(to.x, to.y);
6225: 1369:     line.stroke({ color: 0x55d7ff, alpha: 0.36, width: Math.max(1.2, road.width), cap: "round", join: "round" });
6226: 1370:     layer.addChild(line);
6227: 1371:   }
6228: 1372: 
6229: 1373:   for (const lot of scene.lots) {
6230: 1374:     const point = project(lot.position);
6231: 1375:     const outline = new Graphics();
6232: 1376:     outline.poly(diamondPoints(point, lot.width * TILE_WIDTH, lot.depth * TILE_HEIGHT), true);
6233: 1377:     outline.stroke({ color: 0xffd166, alpha: 0.34, width: 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6234: 1378:     layer.addChild(outline);
6235: 1379:   }
6236: 1380: 
6237: 1381:   for (const building of scene.buildings) {
6238: 1382:     const point = project(building.position);
6239: 1383:     const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily ?? "none";
6240: 1384:     const color = debugColorForObjectFamily(family);
6241: 1385:     const outline = new Graphics();
6242: 1386:     outline.poly(diamondPoints(point, building.width * TILE_WIDTH, building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT), true);
6243: 1387:     outline.stroke({ color, alpha: 0.58, width: building.visualGrammar?.clusterRole === "anchor" ? 2 : 1.2, cap: "round", join: "round" });
6244: 1388:     if (building.visualGrammar?.noLabelPriority === "primary_anchor") {
6245: 1389:       outline.circle(point.x, point.y - building.height * TILE_DEPTH - 14, 5).fill({ color, alpha: 0.72 });
6246: 1390:     }
6247: 1391:     layer.addChild(outline);
6248: 1392:     if (building.visualGrammar?.clusterRole === "anchor" || building.visualGrammar?.noLabelPriority === "primary_anchor") {
6249: 1393:       layer.addChild(debugText(familyShortLabel(family), point.x, point.y - building.height * TILE_DEPTH - 24, color));
6250: 1394:     }
6251: 1395:   }
6252: 1396: }

6303: 1447: function createLayers(): LayerMap {
6304: 1448:   return {
6305: 1449:     terrainLayer: namedLayer("terrainLayer"),
6306: 1450:     // Lots under roads: both are ground material, but a road corridor crossing

6308: 1452:     // cutting the lot, never as a lot sheet laid over the road.

6312: 1456:     shadowLayer: namedLayer("shadowLayer"),
6313: 1457:     buildingPropDepthLayer: namedLayer("buildingPropDepthLayer"),
6314: 1458:     buildingLayer: namedVisibilityProxyLayer("buildingLayer"),
6315: 1459:     propLayer: namedVisibilityProxyLayer("propLayer"),
6316: 1460:     actorLayer: namedLayer("actorLayer"),
6317: 1461:     // Hover/selection emphasis draws here alone Ã¢â‚¬â€ over the buildings it
6318: 1462:     // traces, under labels and hit targets Ã¢â‚¬â€ so focus changes never rebuild
6319: 1463:     // the base scene.
6320: 1464:     focusLayer: namedLayer("focusLayer"),
6321: 1465:     labelLayer: namedLayer("labelLayer"),
6322: 1466:     markerLayer: namedLayer("markerLayer"),
6323: 1467:     hudBridgeLayer: namedLayer("hudBridgeLayer"),
6324: 1468:   };

6418: 1562: // 0.74F terrain relief: raised tiles extrude stacked voxel cliff courses on
6419: 1563: // every side that drops to a lower neighbor. South/east faces are the
6420: 1564: // sun-consistent visible cliff walls; north/west bands read as shadowed cuts
6421: 1565: // AND cover the projection gap a raised tile leaves over its back neighbors.
6422: 1566: // Authored by the generator as visualGrammar.elevation Ã¢â‚¬â€ no neighbor scans here.

6429: 1573:   const courseZ = 0.5;

6432: 1576:   const cliffBase = shadeColor(color, -10);
6433: 1577: 
6434: 1578:   for (const side of elevation.dropSides) {
6435: 1579:     const edge = tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side);
6436: 1580:     const frontFace = side === "south" || side === "east";
6437: 1581:     for (let course = 0; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
6438: 1582:       const topDrop = course * coursePx;
6439: 1583:       const bottomDrop = (course + 1) * coursePx + (course === courseCount - 1 ? 1.5 : 0);

6444: 1588:         .poly(
6445: 1589:           [
6446: 1590:             edge.from.x, edge.from.y + topDrop,
6447: 1591:             edge.to.x, edge.to.y + topDrop,
6448: 1592:             edge.to.x, edge.to.y + bottomDrop,
6449: 1593:             edge.from.x, edge.from.y + bottomDrop,
6450: 1594:           ],
6451: 1595:           true,
6452: 1596:         )

6457: 1601:           .moveTo(edge.from.x, edge.from.y + topDrop)
6458: 1602:           .lineTo(edge.to.x, edge.to.y + topDrop)

6460: 1604:       }
6461: 1605:       g
6462: 1606:         .moveTo(edge.from.x, edge.from.y + bottomDrop - 0.9)
6463: 1607:         .lineTo(edge.to.x, edge.to.y + bottomDrop - 0.9)
6464: 1608:         .stroke({ color: frontFace ? shadeColor(color, 12) : shadeColor(color, -46), alpha: frontFace ? 0.24 : 0.18, width: 0.9, cap: "butt" });
6465: 1609:     }
6466: 1610:   }

6841: 1985: function drawTerrainElevationChunkFace(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, color: number) {

6876: 2020:     graphic

6887: 2031:         ],

6900: 2044:             ? 0xd9c28b
6901: 2045:             : 0xf2e5bd;

6903: 2047:     graphic
6904: 2048:       .moveTo(point.x - TILE_WIDTH * 0.5, point.y + depth * 0.45)
6905: 2049:       .lineTo(point.x, point.y + TILE_HEIGHT * 0.5 + depth * 0.65)

6911: 2055: function terrainElevationDepth(elevation: NonNullable<CityWorldTerrainTile["visualGrammar"]>["terrainElevation"], chunkEdge: NonNullable<CityWorldTerrainTile["visualGrammar"]>["chunkEdge"]) {
6912: 2056:   if (elevation === "civic_plinth_shelf") return 5.5;

6963: 2107: // The road network renders as ~11 PASS Graphics instead of ~10 Graphics per
6964: 2108: // segment: every segment strokes into shared per-pass Graphics, added in pass
6965: 2109: // order. Cross-segment layering becomes seamless by construction Ã¢â‚¬â€ segment
6966: 2110: // N's shadow can no longer smear over segment N-1's finished surface, because
6967: 2111: // ALL shadows draw under ALL surfaces.
6968: 2112: type RoadPassSet = {
6969: 2113:   shadow: Graphics;
6970: 2114:   sideFace: Graphics;
6971: 2115:   curb: Graphics;
6972: 2116:   bed: Graphics;
6973: 2117:   surface: Graphics;
6974: 2118:   bevels: Graphics;
6975: 2119:   seams: Graphics;
6976: 2120:   material: Graphics;
6977: 2121:   dashes: Graphics;
6978: 2122:   joints: Graphics;
6979: 2123:   crosswalks: Graphics;
6980: 2124: };
6981: 2125: 
6982: 2126: function drawRoadNetwork(layer: Container, roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]) {
6983: 2127:   const passes: RoadPassSet = {
6984: 2128:     shadow: new Graphics(),
6985: 2129:     sideFace: new Graphics(),
6986: 2130:     curb: new Graphics(),
6987: 2131:     bed: new Graphics(),
6988: 2132:     surface: new Graphics(),
6989: 2133:     bevels: new Graphics(),
6990: 2134:     seams: new Graphics(),
6991: 2135:     material: new Graphics(),
6992: 2136:     dashes: new Graphics(),
6993: 2137:     joints: new Graphics(),
6994: 2138:     crosswalks: new Graphics(),
6995: 2139:   };
6996: 2140:   const physicalRoads = roads.filter((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile !== "painted");
6997: 2141:   for (const road of physicalRoads) drawRoadSegmentModule(passes, road);
6998: 2142: 
6999: 2143:   const joints = collectRoadJoints(physicalRoads);
7000: 2144:   for (const joint of joints.sort((a, b) => a.point.x + a.point.y - (b.point.x + b.point.y))) {
7001: 2145:     if (joint.roads.length > 1 || joint.roads.some((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "apron")) {
7002: 2146:       drawRoadJointModule(passes.joints, joint);
7003: 2147:     } else if (joint.roads.length === 1 && resolveRoadContact(joint.roads[0] as CityWorldRoadSegment).profile === "embedded") {
7004: 2148:       drawRoadEndCap(passes.joints, joint);
7005: 2149:     }
7006: 2150:   }
7007: 2151: 
7008: 2152:   for (const road of roads.filter((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "painted")) drawCrosswalkRoad(passes.crosswalks, road);
7009: 2153: 
7010: 2154:   layer.addChild(
7011: 2155:     passes.shadow,
7012: 2156:     passes.sideFace,
7013: 2157:     passes.curb,
7014: 2158:     passes.bed,
7015: 2159:     passes.surface,
7016: 2160:     passes.bevels,
7017: 2161:     passes.seams,
7018: 2162:     passes.material,
7019: 2163:     passes.dashes,
7020: 2164:     passes.joints,
7021: 2165:     passes.crosswalks,
7022: 2166:   );
7023: 2167: }

7025: 2169: // Dead-end streets stop looking sheared: a rounded curb stub + surface disk
7026: 2170: // caps the open end.
7027: 2171: function drawRoadEndCap(g: Graphics, joint: RoadJoint) {
7028: 2172:   const road = joint.roads[0];
7029: 2173:   if (!road) return;
7030: 2174:   const point = project(joint.point);
7031: 2175:   const radius = road.width * 8.2;
7032: 2176:   g.ellipse(point.x, point.y + 1, radius, radius * 0.52).fill({ color: 0xd6c996, alpha: 0.72 });
7033: 2177:   g.ellipse(point.x, point.y, radius * 0.78, radius * 0.4).fill({ color: 0x58635f, alpha: 0.95 });
7034: 2178:   g.ellipse(point.x, point.y - 1, radius * 0.6, radius * 0.3).fill({ color: 0x68736d, alpha: 0.7 });
7035: 2179: }
7036: 2180: 
7037: 2181: function drawRoadSegmentModule(passes: RoadPassSet, road: CityWorldRoadSegment) {
7038: 2182:   const start = project(road.from);
7039: 2183:   const end = project(road.to);
7040: 2184:   const baseWidth = road.width * 15.2;
7041: 2185:   const contact = resolveRoadContact(road);
7042: 2186:   const draftRoad = contact.tone === "draft";
7043: 2187:   const shellRoad = contact.tone === "shell";
7044: 2188:   const apron = contact.profile === "apron";
7045: 2189:   const cap = apron ? "round" : "butt";
7046: 2190:   passes.shadow

7325: 2469: function collectRoadJoints(roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]): RoadJoint[] {

7349: 2493:       addJoint(point, first);
7350: 2494:       addJoint(point, second);
7351: 2495:     }
7352: 2496:   }
7353: 2497: 
7354: 2498:   return Array.from(joints.values());

7400: 2544: function drawDrivewayJoinThroats(g: Graphics, joint: RoadJoint, point: ProjectedPoint, maxRoadWidth: number) {
7401: 2545:   const hasMainRoad = joint.roads.some((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "embedded");

7404: 2548:   const driveways = joint.roads.filter((road) => resolveRoadContact(road).profile === "apron");

7406: 2550:     const opposite = sameCityPoint(joint.point, driveway.from) ? driveway.to : driveway.from;
7407: 2551:     const target = project(opposite);
7408: 2552:     const dx = target.x - point.x;
7409: 2553:     const dy = target.y - point.y;
7410: 2554:     const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
7411: 2555:     const ux = dx / length;
7412: 2556:     const uy = dy / length;

7415: 2559:       .moveTo(point.x + ux * 2, point.y + uy * 2)
7416: 2560:       .lineTo(point.x + ux * throatLength, point.y + uy * throatLength)

7418: 2562:     g
7419: 2563:       .moveTo(point.x + ux * 5, point.y + uy * 5 + 1)
7420: 2564:       .lineTo(point.x + ux * (throatLength - 2), point.y + uy * (throatLength - 2) + 1)
7421: 2565:       .stroke({ color: 0x737c74, alpha: 0.34, width: 3.5, cap: "butt" });
7422: 2566:   }
7423: 2567: }

7425: 2569: function roadDirectionsAtJoint(joint: RoadJoint): Set<string> {
7426: 2570:   const directions = new Set<string>();
7427: 2571:   for (const road of joint.roads) {
7428: 2572:     if (sameCoordinate(road.from.y, road.to.y)) {
7429: 2573:       if (road.from.x < joint.point.x - 0.001 || road.to.x < joint.point.x - 0.001) directions.add("west");
7430: 2574:       if (road.from.x > joint.point.x + 0.001 || road.to.x > joint.point.x + 0.001) directions.add("east");
7431: 2575:     } else if (sameCoordinate(road.from.x, road.to.x)) {
7432: 2576:       if (road.from.y < joint.point.y - 0.001 || road.to.y < joint.point.y - 0.001) directions.add("north");
7433: 2577:       if (road.from.y > joint.point.y + 0.001 || road.to.y > joint.point.y + 0.001) directions.add("south");
7434: 2578:     } else {
7435: 2579:       directions.add(`${Math.sign(road.from.x - joint.point.x)},${Math.sign(road.from.y - joint.point.y)}`);
7436: 2580:       directions.add(`${Math.sign(road.to.x - joint.point.x)},${Math.sign(road.to.y - joint.point.y)}`);
7437: 2581:     }
7438: 2582:   }
7439: 2583:   return directions;
7440: 2584: }

7446: 2590: function axisAlignedRoadIntersection(first: CityWorldRoadSegment, second: CityWorldRoadSegment): CityWorldPoint | undefined {

7448: 2592:   const firstVertical = sameCoordinate(first.from.x, first.to.x);

7458: 2602:     if (pointInsideRoad(point, first) && pointInsideRoad(point, second)) return point;
7459: 2603:   }
7460: 2604:   return undefined;

8028: 3172: function drawBuilding(layers: LayerMap, layer: Container, building: CityWorldBuilding, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver, materialTextureEnabled: boolean) {
8029: 3173:   // The base scene is focus-agnostic: hover/selection emphasis draws in the
8030: 3174:   // focusLayer overlay so focus changes never rebuild these Graphics.
8031: 3175:   const geometry = createBuildingGeometry(building, atlas);
8032: 3176:   // Foundation pads are ground decals: they live in a shared layer below every
8033: 3177:   // cast shadow so shadows land ON pads instead of being washed out by them.
8034: 3178:   drawBuildingFootprint(layers.padLayer, geometry, building);
8035: 3179:   drawBuildingCastShadow(layers.shadowLayer, building);
8036: 3180: 
8037: 3181:   if (geometry.asset.mode === "sprite") {
8038: 3182:     drawSpriteBuilding(layer, geometry, building);
8039: 3183:     return;
8040: 3184:   }
8041: 3185: 
8042: 3186:   // One facade system draws every vector building: opaque walls, a roof, and
8043: 3187:   // a wall-plane window/storefront grid. The legacy per-kind + per-family
8044: 3188:   // "authorship" overlay stack (15 functions of translucent screen-space
8045: 3189:   // decals) is retired Ã¢â‚¬â€ misregistered decals were the ghost-facade defect.
8046: 3190:   drawBuildingShell(layer, geometry, building, materialTextureEnabled);
8047: 3191: }

8049: 3193: function createBuildingGeometry(building: CityWorldBuilding, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver): BuildingGeometry {
8050: 3194:   const bottom = project(building.position);

8092: 3236: function objectVariant(id: string, modulo: number) {
8093: 3237:   let hash = 0;
8094: 3238:   for (let index = 0; index < id.length; index += 1) {
8095: 3239:     hash = (hash * 31 + id.charCodeAt(index)) >>> 0;
8096: 3240:   }
8097: 3241:   return hash % modulo;
8098: 3242: }

8100: 3244: function drawSpriteBuilding(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
8101: 3245:   const { bottom, footprintDepth, asset } = geometry;
8102: 3246:   if (asset.mode !== "sprite") return;
8103: 3247: 
8104: 3248:   drawSpriteBuildingFitDetails(layer, geometry, building);
8105: 3249: 
8106: 3250:   const sprite = new Sprite(asset.texture);
8107: 3251:   sprite.anchor.set(asset.anchor.x, asset.anchor.y);
8108: 3252:   // 0.53E Hero Silhouette (item A) Ã¢â‚¬â€ deterministic per-home variety kills the
8109: 3253:   // clone read without new art: hash-based horizontal mirror + gentle scale
8110: 3254:   // jitter break the "one model repeated" row, all keyed on the building id so
8111: 3255:   // it is stable across frames. Homes only; commerce sprites stay uniform.
8112: 3256:   const home = building.kind === "home";
8113: 3257:   const variant = objectVariant(building.id, 97);
8114: 3258:   const flip = home && variant % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
8115: 3259:   const jitter = home ? 0.95 + (variant % 11) / 100 : 1; // 0.95Ã¢â‚¬â€œ1.05
8116: 3260:   // 0.57E generated-district parity Ã¢â‚¬â€ sprites must FIT the building footprint
8117: 3261:   // they stand on. Curated Riverside footprints match the authored art
8118: 3262:   // (ratio ~1, unchanged); parametric districts author arbitrary widths, and
8119: 3263:   // a fixed-scale sprite there read as a toy box floating on its apron. The
8120: 3264:   // fit is clamped so damaged ratios can never balloon or vanish a sprite.
8121: 3265:   const displayWidth = asset.texture.width * asset.scale;
8122: 3266:   const footprintFit = displayWidth > 0 ? clamp(geometry.footprintWidth / displayWidth, 0.72, 1.45) : 1;
8123: 3267:   sprite.scale.set(asset.scale * footprintFit * jitter * flip, asset.scale * footprintFit * jitter);
8124: 3268:   sprite.position.set(Math.round(bottom.x), Math.round(bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.5));
8125: 3269:   // Honor the building's assigned palette-variant ramp on screen: gently wash
8126: 3270:   // the textured sprite toward its resolved body color so sprite-mode buildings
8127: 3271:   // (rowhomes, strip stores) read the same variant identity the diagnostics key
8128: 3272:   // on. Kept subtle (mixed toward white) so authored SVG art is preserved.
8129: 3273:   // For homes, spread the wash factor + a whisper of warm/cool per house so no
8130: 3274:   // two neighbours read identical Ã¢â‚¬â€ still the resolved palette, never raw color.
8131: 3275:   let homeTint = geometry.bodyColor;
8132: 3276:   if (home) {
8133: 3277:     const warmCool = (variant % 3) - 1;
8134: 3278:     if (warmCool > 0) homeTint = mixColor(homeTint, SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.07);
8135: 3279:     else if (warmCool < 0) homeTint = mixColor(homeTint, SUN_COOL_TINT, 0.06);
8136: 3280:   }
8137: 3281:   // 0.68H sprite tint wash Ã¢â‚¬â€ homes keep just enough wash to hold their
8138: 3282:   // palette-variant identity; commerce sprites drop to a whisper so the
8139: 3283:   // authored art carries its own crisp material read.
8140: 3284:   sprite.tint = mixColor(0xffffff, homeTint, home ? 0.14 + (variant % 7) * 0.018 : 0.12);
8141: 3285:   sprite.label = `sprite-${building.id}`;
8142: 3286:   layer.addChild(sprite);
8143: 3287: 
8144: 3288:   if (home) {
8145: 3289:     drawHomeStoop(layer, geometry, building, flip);
8146: 3290:     drawHomeRoofAccent(layer, geometry, building, flip, variant);
8147: 3291:   }
8148: 3292: 
8149: 3293: }

8151: 3295: function drawSpriteBuildingFitDetails(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
8152: 3296:   const { top, bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, trimColor } = geometry;
8153: 3297:   const style = building.facadeStyle ?? building.kind;

8155: 3299:   // + contact shadow in drawBuildingFootprint. The extra per-sprite contact
8156: 3300:   // diamond, base-shadow stroke, apron, and awning strokes stacked into the
8157: 3301:   // translucent smear ring around every sprite Ã¢â‚¬â€ removed.
8158: 3302:   if (style === "rowhome") {

8160: 3304:     for (let bay = 0; bay < 3; bay += 1) {
8161: 3305:       const offset = (bay / 2 - 0.5) * footprintWidth * 0.56;
8162: 3306:       const yLift = bay === 1 ? -2 : 0;
8163: 3307:       stoops
8164: 3308:         .roundRect(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.035, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.22 + yLift, footprintWidth * 0.07, 5.5, 1.5)
8165: 3309:         .fill({ color: 0xf2d8a6, alpha: 0.9 })
8166: 3310:         .roundRect(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.04, bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.15 + yLift, footprintWidth * 0.08, 9, 1.5)
8167: 3311:         .stroke({ color: trimColor, alpha: 0.3, width: 0.9 });
8168: 3312:     }
8169: 3313:     layer.addChild(stoops);
8170: 3314:   }
8171: 3315: }

8173: 3317: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette (item A finish) Ã¢â‚¬â€ tiny deterministic roof accents so
8174: 3318: // pitched homes stop reading as one repeated model: every gable/hip home gets a
8175: 3319: // ridge shadow line, and by hash a third get a chimney fleck, a third a front
8176: 3320: // dormer, a third stay quiet. Whisper-small on purpose Ã¢â‚¬â€ at overview zoom they
8177: 3321: // read as variety, not detail. Follows the same per-home mirror as the sprite.
8178: 3322: function drawHomeRoofAccent(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, flip: number, variant: number) {
8179: 3323:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";

8181: 3325:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, bodyColor } = geometry;
8182: 3326: 
8183: 3327:   const ridge = new Graphics()
8184: 3328:     .moveTo(top.x - flip * footprintWidth * 0.22, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
8185: 3329:     .lineTo(top.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08);
8186: 3330:   ridge.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -34), alpha: 0.3, width: 1.1, cap: "round" });
8187: 3331:   layer.addChild(ridge);
8188: 3332: 
8189: 3333:   if (variant % 3 === 0) {
8190: 3334:     const cx = top.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.16;
8191: 3335:     const cy = top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04;
8192: 3336:     const chimney = new Graphics()
8193: 3337:       .rect(cx - 1.2, cy - 5, 2.4, 5)
8194: 3338:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -18), "sun"), alpha: 0.88 })
8195: 3339:       .rect(cx - 1.6, cy - 6, 3.2, 1.2)
8196: 3340:       .fill({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 34), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.25), alpha: 0.88 });
8197: 3341:     layer.addChild(chimney);
8198: 3342:   } else if (variant % 3 === 1 && building.facadeStyle !== "cottage") {
8199: 3343:     // cottages already carry an authored dormer Ã¢â‚¬â€ no double-stamping
8200: 3344:     const dx = top.x - flip * footprintWidth * 0.09;
8201: 3345:     const dy = top.y + footprintDepth * 0.2;
8202: 3346:     const dormer = new Graphics()
8203: 3347:       .rect(dx - 2.1, dy - 2.4, 4.2, 3.2)
8204: 3348:       .fill({ color: sunlitColor(bodyColor, "sun"), alpha: 0.82 })
8205: 3349:       .poly([dx - 2.7, dy - 2.4, dx, dy - 4.2, dx + 2.7, dy - 2.4], true)
8206: 3350:       .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(roofColor, "top"), alpha: 0.88 }); // 0.68H Ã¢â‚¬â€ pigmented top curve
8207: 3351:     layer.addChild(dormer);
8208: 3352:   }

8926: 4070: // Directional cast shadow: the building silhouette swept along the sun->ground
8927: 4071: // vector (sun upper-left, so shadows skew to the lower-right). Drawn in a
8928: 4072: // dedicated layer under all buildings so shadows land on ground and lots.
8929: 4073: function drawBuildingCastShadow(layer: Container, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
8930: 4074:   const bottom = project(building.position);
8931: 4075:   const heightPx = Math.min(building.height * TILE_DEPTH, 96) + 16;
8932: 4076:   if (heightPx <= 18) return;
8933: 4077:   const width = building.width * TILE_WIDTH * 0.96;
8934: 4078:   const depth = building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT * 0.92;
8935: 4079:   // Anchor a touch toward the shadow side so the sweep emerges past the
8936: 4080:   // building's foundation pad instead of hiding underneath it.
8937: 4081:   const anchorX = bottom.x + 5;
8938: 4082:   const anchorY = bottom.y + depth * 0.08;
8939: 4083:   const left = { x: anchorX - width * 0.5, y: anchorY };
8940: 4084:   const top = { x: anchorX, y: anchorY - depth * 0.5 };
8941: 4085:   const right = { x: anchorX + width * 0.5, y: anchorY };
8942: 4086:   const base = { x: anchorX, y: anchorY + depth * 0.5 };
8943: 4087: 
8944: 4088:   const sweep = (reach: number, alpha: number) => {
8945: 4089:     const vx = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.x * heightPx * reach;
8946: 4090:     const vy = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.y * heightPx * reach;
8947: 4091:     return new Graphics()
8948: 4092:       .poly(
8949: 4093:         [top.x, top.y, left.x, left.y, base.x, base.y, base.x + vx, base.y + vy, right.x + vx, right.y + vy, top.x + vx, top.y + vy],
8950: 4094:         true,
8951: 4095:       )
8952: 4096:       .fill({ color: CAST_SHADOW_COLOR, alpha });
8953: 4097:   };
8954: 4098: 
8955: 4099:   // Short, quiet sweep + a faint penumbra in ONE Graphics. The old 0.5-alpha
8956: 4100:   // full-height sweep painted half-black sheets across roads and pads.
8957: 4101:   const shadow = sweep(0.5, 0.14);
8958: 4102:   const vx = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.x * heightPx * 0.78;
8959: 4103:   const vy = CAST_SHADOW_VECTOR.y * heightPx * 0.78;
8960: 4104:   shadow
8961: 4105:     .poly(
8962: 4106:       [top.x, top.y, left.x, left.y, base.x, base.y, base.x + vx, base.y + vy, right.x + vx, right.y + vy, top.x + vx, top.y + vy],
8963: 4107:       true,
8964: 4108:     )
8965: 4109:     .fill({ color: CAST_SHADOW_COLOR, alpha: 0.05 });
8966: 4110:   layer.addChild(shadow);
8967: 4111: }

8969: 4113: function drawBuildingFootprint(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
8970: 4114:   const { bottom, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, roofColor, trimColor } = geometry;
8971: 4115:   const spriteBacked = geometry.asset.mode === "sprite";
8972: 4116:   const style = building.facadeStyle ?? building.kind;
8973: 4117:   const draftBuilding = isDraftBuilding(building);
8974: 4118:   const padWidth = footprintWidth * (spriteBacked ? 0.94 : style === "rowhome" || style === "strip_store" ? 1.02 : 0.92);
8975: 4119:   const padDepth = footprintDepth * (spriteBacked ? 0.72 : style === "rowhome" || style === "strip_store" ? 0.86 : 0.76);
8976: 4120:   const padCenter = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth * (spriteBacked ? 0.24 : 0.2) };
8977: 4121:   const padColor = draftBuilding ? (building.kind === "civic" ? 0xe6cf9f : 0xe7c999) : style === "strip_store" || building.kind === "shop" || building.kind === "civic" ? 0xe7d0a2 : shadeColor(bodyColor, 18);
8978: 4122:   const edgeColor = style === "rowhome" || style === "strip_store" ? shadeColor(trimColor, -14) : shadeColor(roofColor, -48);
8979: 4123: 
8980: 4124:   // Foundation pads are physical slabs: an opaque top, a thin solid south lip
8981: 4125:   // for slab thickness, and one quiet contact shadow. Translucent cream pads
8982: 4126:   // read as cards floating on the grass Ã¢â‚¬â€ the 0.72 "cream card" defect.
8983: 4127:   const slabColor = mixColor(padColor, 0xffffff, 0.08);
8984: 4128:   const lipDrop = 2.5;
8985: 4129:   // One Graphics per pad: contact ellipse under slab top under lip.
8986: 4130:   const pad = new Graphics()
8987: 4131:     .ellipse(padCenter.x, padCenter.y + padDepth * 0.18, padWidth * 0.5, padDepth * 0.4)
8988: 4132:     .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.1 });
8989: 4133:   pad
8990: 4134:     .poly(diamondPoints(padCenter, padWidth, padDepth), true)
8991: 4135:     .fill({ color: slabColor })
8992: 4136:     .stroke({ color: shadeColor(slabColor, -42), alpha: 0.3, width: 1 });
8993: 4137:   pad
8994: 4138:     .moveTo(padCenter.x - padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y)
8995: 4139:     .lineTo(padCenter.x, padCenter.y + padDepth * 0.5)
8996: 4140:     .lineTo(padCenter.x + padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y)
8997: 4141:     .lineTo(padCenter.x + padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y + lipDrop)
8998: 4142:     .lineTo(padCenter.x, padCenter.y + padDepth * 0.5 + lipDrop)
8999: 4143:     .lineTo(padCenter.x - padWidth * 0.5, padCenter.y + lipDrop)
9000: 4144:     .closePath()

9002: 4146:     .stroke({ color: edgeColor, alpha: 0.2, width: 1 });

9004: 4148:   layer.addChild(pad);

9007: 4151: function buildingContactShadow(
9008: 4152:   geometry: BuildingGeometry,
9009: 4153:   building: CityWorldBuilding,
9010: 4154:   selected: boolean,
9011: 4155:   hovered: boolean,
9012: 4156:   padWidth: number,

9020: 4164:   const centerY = bottom.y + footprintDepth * 0.38;
9021: 4165:

9023: 4167:     const penumbra = new Graphics()
9024: 4168:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY + 2, padWidth * 0.64, padDepth * 0.68)
9025: 4169:       .fill({ color: 0x1d2a24, alpha: 0.07 + activeBoost * 0.4 + draftBoost * 0.5 });
9026: 4170:     const core = new Graphics()
9027: 4171:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY, padWidth * 0.44, padDepth * 0.5)

9029: 4173:     const plinthSeam = new Graphics()
9030: 4174:       .moveTo(bottom.x - padWidth * 0.46, centerY + padDepth * 0.08)
9031: 4175:       .lineTo(bottom.x, centerY + padDepth * 0.4)
9032: 4176:       .lineTo(bottom.x + padWidth * 0.46, centerY + padDepth * 0.08);
9033: 4177:     plinthSeam.stroke({ color: 0x1d2a24, alpha: 0.2, width: 1.7, cap: "round", join: "round" });
9034: 4178:     return [penumbra, core, plinthSeam];
9035: 4179:   }
9036: 4180: 
9037: 4181:   if (profile === "soft_ground_shadow") {

9039: 4183:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY + 1, padWidth * 0.6, padDepth * 0.66)
9040: 4184:       .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.11 + activeBoost + draftBoost });
9041: 4185:     return [soft];
9042: 4186:   }
9043: 4187: 
9044: 4188:   if (profile === "curb_shadow") {

9046: 4190:       .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY + 2, padWidth * 0.52, padDepth * 0.42)

9051: 4195:   const padSkirt = polygon(
9052: 4196:     diamondPoints({ x: bottom.x, y: centerY + 1.5 }, padWidth * 1.06, padDepth * 0.92),
9053: 4197:     0x23342e,
9054: 4198:     0.05 + activeBoost * 0.3 + draftBoost * 0.5,
9055: 4199:     0x23342e,
9056: 4200:     0,
9057: 4201:   );
9058: 4202:   const core = new Graphics()
9059: 4203:     .ellipse(bottom.x, centerY, padWidth * 0.44, padDepth * 0.5)
9060: 4204:     .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.13 + activeBoost + draftBoost });
9061: 4205:   return [padSkirt, core];

9077: 4221: function drawBuildingShell(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, materialTextureEnabled: boolean) {
9078: 4222:   const { bottom, top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, bodyColor, outline, activeStrokeAlpha } = geometry;
9079: 4223:   // Unified sun: lower-left wall faces the sun, lower-right wall falls into
9080: 4224:   // cool shade. Same factors for every building in the scene.
9081: 4225:   // 0.68H Ã¢â‚¬â€ walls use the building-face curve so the lit wall stays pigmented.
9082: 4226:   const sideLeft = buildingFaceColor(bodyColor, "sun");
9083: 4227:   const sideRight = buildingFaceColor(bodyColor, "shade");
9084: 4228:   const topLeft = { x: top.x - footprintWidth / 2, y: top.y };
9085: 4229:   const topRight = { x: top.x + footprintWidth / 2, y: top.y };
9086: 4230:   const topFront = { x: top.x, y: top.y + footprintDepth / 2 };
9087: 4231:   const bottomLeft = { x: bottom.x - footprintWidth / 2, y: bottom.y };
9088: 4232:   const bottomRight = { x: bottom.x + footprintWidth / 2, y: bottom.y };
9089: 4233:   const bottomFront = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + footprintDepth / 2 };
9090: 4234:   const leftSide = [topLeft.x, topLeft.y, topFront.x, topFront.y, bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y, bottomLeft.x, bottomLeft.y];
9091: 4235:   const rightSide = [topRight.x, topRight.y, topFront.x, topFront.y, bottomFront.x, bottomFront.y, bottomRight.x, bottomRight.y];
9092: 4236: 
9093: 4237:   const left = polygon(leftSide, sideLeft, 1, outline, activeStrokeAlpha);
9094: 4238:   const right = polygon(rightSide, sideRight, 1, outline, activeStrokeAlpha);
9095: 4239:   layer.addChild(left, right);
9096: 4240:   drawBuildingShellLighting(layer, geometry);
9097: 4241:   if (materialTextureEnabled) drawWallMaterialTexture(layer, geometry, building);
9098: 4242:   drawWallBlockCourses(layer, geometry, building);
9099: 4243:   drawWallFacade(layer, geometry, building);
9100: 4244: 
9101: 4245:   drawRoof(layer, geometry, building, materialTextureEnabled);
9102: 4246:   drawTieredMassing(layer, geometry, building);
9103: 4247: }

9105: 4249: // 0.74F chunky treatment Ã¢â‚¬â€ one horizontal course line per storey across each
9106: 4250: // wall, in wall-plane coordinates: the box reads as stacked voxel courses
9107: 4251: // instead of a single extrusion. Inset-only (lines live ON the wall quads).
9108: 4252: function drawWallBlockCourses(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
9109: 4253:   const floors = Math.max(1, Math.round(building.height));
9110: 4254:   if (floors < 2 || geometry.height < 22) return;
9111: 4255:   const courses = new Graphics();
9112: 4256:   for (const side of ["sun", "shade"] as const) {
9113: 4257:     const surface = wallSurface(geometry, side);
9114: 4258:     for (let floor = 1; floor < floors; floor += 1) {
9115: 4259:       const v = (surface.heightPx / floors) * floor;
9116: 4260:       const from = wallPoint(surface, 0, v);
9117: 4261:       const to = wallPoint(surface, 1, v);
9118: 4262:       courses.moveTo(from.x, from.y).lineTo(to.x, to.y);
9119: 4263:     }
9120: 4264:   }
9121: 4265:   courses.stroke({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, -26), alpha: 0.15, width: 1, cap: "butt" });
9122: 4266:   layer.addChild(courses);
9123: 4267: }

9125: 4269: function drawWallMaterialTexture(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
9126: 4270:   const material = new Graphics();
9127: 4271:   let hasTexture = false;
9128: 4272:   for (const side of ["sun", "shade"] as const) {
9129: 4273:     const surface = wallSurface(geometry, side);
9130: 4274:     if (surface.heightPx < 18 || surface.edgeLengthPx < 18) continue;
9131: 4275:     const courseCount = Math.max(2, Math.min(7, Math.floor(surface.heightPx / 9)));
9132: 4276:     const courseHeight = surface.heightPx / courseCount;
9133: 4277:     const blockColumns = Math.max(2, Math.min(5, Math.floor(surface.edgeLengthPx / 18)));
9134: 4278:     for (let course = 0; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
9135: 4279:       const seed = materialTextureSeed(building.id, side, course);
9136: 4280:       const v0 = course * courseHeight + 0.7;
9137: 4281:       const v1 = Math.min(surface.heightPx - 0.7, (course + 1) * courseHeight - 0.7);
9138: 4282:       if (v1 <= v0 + 2) continue;
9139: 4283:       const delta = materialTextureDelta(seed);
9140: 4284:       const bandAlpha = side === "sun" ? 0.08 : 0.1;
9141: 4285:       material
9142: 4286:         .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, 0.04, v0, 0.96, v1), true)
9143: 4287:         .fill({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, delta), alpha: bandAlpha });
9144: 4288:       hasTexture = true;
9145: 4289: 
9146: 4290:       if (seed % 4 !== 0) continue;
9147: 4291:       const column = Math.floor(seed / 7) % blockColumns;
9148: 4292:       const offset = course % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 0.5 / blockColumns;
9149: 4293:       const u0 = 0.08 + ((column / blockColumns + offset) % 0.84);
9150: 4294:       const u1 = Math.min(0.94, u0 + 0.52 / blockColumns);
9151: 4295:       if (u1 <= u0 + 0.04) continue;
9152: 4296:       material
9153: 4297:         .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0, v0 + courseHeight * 0.18, u1, v1 - courseHeight * 0.12), true)
9154: 4298:         .fill({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, delta > 0 ? 16 : -16), alpha: side === "sun" ? 0.1 : 0.12 });
9155: 4299:     }
9156: 4300:   }
9157: 4301:   if (hasTexture) layer.addChild(material);
9158: 4302: }
9159: 4303: 
9160: 4304: function materialTextureSeed(buildingId: string, face: string, courseIndex: number): number {
9161: 4305:   const key = `${buildingId}:${face}:${courseIndex}`;
9162: 4306:   let hash = 2166136261;
9163: 4307:   for (let index = 0; index < key.length; index += 1) {
9164: 4308:     hash ^= key.charCodeAt(index);
9165: 4309:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619) >>> 0;
9166: 4310:   }
9167: 4311:   return hash;
9168: 4312: }
9169: 4313: 
9170: 4314: function materialTextureDelta(seed: number): number {
9171: 4315:   const steps = [-16, -10, 10, 16] as const;
9172: 4316:   return steps[seed % steps.length] ?? 10;
9173: 4317: }
9174: 4318: 
9175: 4319: // ---- Wall-plane facade system ----------------------------------------------
9176: 4320: // Every window, storefront, and door is authored in wall-plane coordinates:
9177: 4321: // u Ã¢Ë†Ë† [0,1] runs along the wall's ground edge from the outer corner to the
9178: 4322: // shared front corner; v is height in screen pixels. Elements are projected
9179: 4323: // through the same corner math as the wall quads, so they register exactly on
9180: 4324: // the wall Ã¢â‚¬â€ they cannot float off the face or leak past the silhouette.
9181: 4325: 
9182: 4326: type WallSide = "sun" | "shade";
9183: 4327: 
9184: 4328: type WallSurface = {
9185: 4329:   groundCorner: ProjectedPoint;
9186: 4330:   groundFront: ProjectedPoint;
9187: 4331:   heightPx: number;
9188: 4332:   edgeLengthPx: number;
9189: 4333: };
9190: 4334: 
9191: 4335: function wallSurface(geometry: BuildingGeometry, side: WallSide): WallSurface {
9192: 4336:   const { bottom, top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth } = geometry;
9193: 4337:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
9194: 4338:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
9195: 4339:   const groundCorner = side === "sun" ? { x: bottom.x - halfW, y: bottom.y } : { x: bottom.x + halfW, y: bottom.y };
9196: 4340:   const groundFront = { x: bottom.x, y: bottom.y + halfD };
9197: 4341:   const heightPx = Math.max(0, bottom.y - top.y);
9198: 4342:   const edgeLengthPx = Math.hypot(groundFront.x - groundCorner.x, groundFront.y - groundCorner.y);
9199: 4343:   return { groundCorner, groundFront, heightPx, edgeLengthPx };
9200: 4344: }
9201: 4345: 
9202: 4346: function wallPoint(surface: WallSurface, u: number, v: number): ProjectedPoint {
9203: 4347:   return {
9204: 4348:     x: surface.groundCorner.x + (surface.groundFront.x - surface.groundCorner.x) * u,
9205: 4349:     y: surface.groundCorner.y + (surface.groundFront.y - surface.groundCorner.y) * u - v,
9206: 4350:   };
9207: 4351: }
9208: 4352: 
9209: 4353: function wallQuadPoints(surface: WallSurface, u0: number, v0: number, u1: number, v1: number): number[] {
9210: 4354:   const a = wallPoint(surface, u0, v0);
9211: 4355:   const b = wallPoint(surface, u1, v0);
9212: 4356:   const c = wallPoint(surface, u1, v1);
9213: 4357:   const d = wallPoint(surface, u0, v1);
9214: 4358:   return [a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y, d.x, d.y];
9215: 4359: }
9216: 4360: 
9217: 4361: function isCommerceFacade(building: CityWorldBuilding): boolean {
9218: 4362:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
9219: 4363:   return (
9220: 4364:     building.kind === "shop" ||
9221: 4365:     building.kind === "gym" ||
9222: 4366:     building.kind === "civic" ||
9223: 4367:     family === "commerce_strip" ||
9224: 4368:     family === "civic_landmark" ||
9225: 4369:     family === "service_block" ||
9226: 4370:     family === "venue_anchor" ||
9227: 4371:     family === "transit_anchor"
9228: 4372:   );
9229: 4373: }

9231: 4375: function drawWallFacade(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
9232: 4376:   const commerce = isCommerceFacade(building);
9233: 4377:   const variant = objectVariant(building.id, 977);
9234: 4378:   for (const side of ["sun", "shade"] as const) {
9235: 4379:     const surface = wallSurface(geometry, side);
9236: 4380:     if (surface.heightPx < 10 || surface.edgeLengthPx < 12) continue;
9237: 4381:     const storefront = commerce && surface.heightPx >= 24;
9238: 4382:     drawFacadeStorefront(layer, geometry, surface, side, storefront);
9239: 4383:     drawFacadeWindows(layer, geometry, surface, side, building, variant, storefront);
9240: 4384:   }
9241: 4385:   if (!commerce) drawFacadeDoor(layer, geometry, building, variant);
9242: 4386: }

9244: 4388: // Recessed ground-storey glass band with mullions and a canopy lip. Opaque:
9245: 4389: // the storefront is real material, not a wash over the wall.
9246: 4390: function drawFacadeStorefront(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, surface: WallSurface, side: WallSide, enabled: boolean) {
9247: 4391:   if (!enabled) return;
9248: 4392:   const { bodyColor, trimColor } = geometry;
9249: 4393:   const bandTop = Math.min(16, surface.heightPx * 0.34);
9250: 4394:   const recess = new Graphics()
9251: 4395:     .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, 0.06, 1, 0.94, bandTop), true)
9252: 4396:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -34), side) });
9253: 4397:   const glass = new Graphics()
9254: 4398:     .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, 0.09, 2.5, 0.91, bandTop - 3), true)
9255: 4399:     .fill({ color: side === "sun" ? 0xbcd8de : 0x8fb0bd });
9256: 4400:   const mullions = new Graphics();
9257: 4401:   const bays = Math.max(2, Math.round(surface.edgeLengthPx / 18));
9258: 4402:   for (let bay = 1; bay < bays; bay += 1) {
9259: 4403:     const u = 0.09 + (0.82 * bay) / bays;
9260: 4404:     const lower = wallPoint(surface, u, 2.5);
9261: 4405:     const upper = wallPoint(surface, u, bandTop - 3);
9262: 4406:     mullions.moveTo(lower.x, lower.y).lineTo(upper.x, upper.y);
9263: 4407:   }
9264: 4408:   mullions.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -8), alpha: 0.85, width: 1 });
9265: 4409:   const canopyA = wallPoint(surface, 0.04, bandTop + 1.5);
9266: 4410:   const canopyB = wallPoint(surface, 0.96, bandTop + 1.5);
9267: 4411:   const canopy = new Graphics().moveTo(canopyA.x, canopyA.y).lineTo(canopyB.x, canopyB.y);
9268: 4412:   canopy.stroke({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(geometry.roofColor, -8), side), alpha: 0.95, width: 2.2, cap: "butt" });
9269: 4413:   layer.addChild(recess, glass, mullions, canopy);
9270: 4414: }
9271: 4415: 
9272: 4416: // Window grid: floors split the wall height, bays split the wall length.
9273: 4417: // Each window is a parallelogram in the wall plane Ã¢â‚¬â€ an opaque frame quad
9274: 4418: // with an opaque glass quad inside; a hashed minority of panes glow warm so
9275: 4419: // facades read inhabited without pattern noise.
9276: 4420: function drawFacadeWindows(
9277: 4421:   layer: Container,
9278: 4422:   geometry: BuildingGeometry,
9279: 4423:   surface: WallSurface,
9280: 4424:   side: WallSide,
9281: 4425:   building: CityWorldBuilding,
9282: 4426:   variant: number,
9283: 4427:   storefront: boolean,
9284: 4428: ) {
9285: 4429:   const { bodyColor, trimColor } = geometry;
9286: 4430:   const baseV = storefront ? Math.min(16, surface.heightPx * 0.34) + 4 : 4;
9287: 4431:   const usableHeight = surface.heightPx - baseV - 4;
9288: 4432:   if (usableHeight < 7) return;
9289: 4433:   const floors = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.floor(usableHeight / 12)));
9290: 4434:   const floorStep = usableHeight / floors;
9291: 4435:   const bays = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, Math.floor(surface.edgeLengthPx / 16)));
9292: 4436:   const bayStep = 0.84 / bays;
9293: 4437:   const windowH = Math.min(7.5, floorStep * 0.58);
9294: 4438:   const frames = new Graphics();
9295: 4439:   const panes = new Graphics();
9296: 4440:   const litPanes = new Graphics();
9297: 4441:   const frameColor = sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -38), side);
9298: 4442:   const glassColor = side === "sun" ? 0xd7e9ea : 0x92aebc;
9299: 4443:   const litColor = 0xf7e3ae;
9300: 4444:   for (let floor = 0; floor < floors; floor += 1) {
9301: 4445:     const v0 = baseV + floor * floorStep + (floorStep - windowH) * 0.55;
9302: 4446:     for (let bay = 0; bay < bays; bay += 1) {
9303: 4447:       const u0 = 0.08 + bay * bayStep + bayStep * 0.18;
9304: 4448:       const u1 = 0.08 + (bay + 1) * bayStep - bayStep * 0.18;
9305: 4449:       frames.poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0 - 0.012, v0 - 0.8, u1 + 0.012, v0 + windowH + 0.8), true);
9306: 4450:       const lit = ((variant + floor * 7 + bay * 13 + (side === "sun" ? 3 : 0)) % 9) === 0;
9307: 4451:       const paneTarget = lit ? litPanes : panes;
9308: 4452:       paneTarget.poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0, v0, u1, v0 + windowH), true);
9309: 4453:     }
9310: 4454:   }
9311: 4455:   frames.fill({ color: frameColor });
9312: 4456:   panes.fill({ color: glassColor });
9313: 4457:   litPanes.fill({ color: litColor });
9314: 4458:   panes.stroke({ color: shadeColor(trimColor, -6), alpha: 0.4, width: 0.8 });
9315: 4459:   layer.addChild(frames, panes, litPanes);
9316: 4460: }
9317: 4461: 
9318: 4462: // Homes get a door instead of a storefront: a dark recessed leaf with a
9319: 4463: // lintel shadow on the sun wall near the front corner.
9320: 4464: function drawFacadeDoor(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, variant: number) {
9321: 4465:   const surface = wallSurface(geometry, variant % 2 === 0 ? "sun" : "shade");
9322: 4466:   if (surface.heightPx < 14) return;
9323: 4467:   const doorH = Math.min(11, surface.heightPx * 0.5);
9324: 4468:   const u0 = 0.6;
9325: 4469:   const u1 = Math.min(0.78, u0 + 14 / Math.max(14, surface.edgeLengthPx));
9326: 4470:   const leaf = new Graphics()
9327: 4471:     .poly(wallQuadPoints(surface, u0, 0.5, u1, doorH), true)
9328: 4472:     .fill({ color: shadeColor(geometry.trimColor, 14) });
9329: 4473:   const lintelA = wallPoint(surface, u0 - 0.02, doorH + 1);
9330: 4474:   const lintelB = wallPoint(surface, u1 + 0.02, doorH + 1);
9331: 4475:   const lintel = new Graphics().moveTo(lintelA.x, lintelA.y).lineTo(lintelB.x, lintelB.y);
9332: 4476:   lintel.stroke({ color: shadeColor(geometry.bodyColor, -44), alpha: 0.8, width: 1.4, cap: "butt" });
9333: 4477:   layer.addChild(leaf, lintel);
9334: 4478: }
9335: 4479: 
9336: 4480: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette Ã¢â‚¬â€ a setback upper tier for civic/venue/transit anchors,
9337: 4481: // so the hero landmark reads as a stepped, tall structure instead of a single
9338: 4482: // extruded box. A smaller box rises from the roof center with its own lit/shade
9339: 4483: // walls, cap, and a warm sunlit crown edge Ã¢â‚¬â€ the "this is the important building"
9340: 4484: // silhouette cue. Sun-consistent; only for tall anchors so it stays rare.
9341: 4485: // 0.53E item C Ã¢â‚¬â€ when the hero landmark carries the tiered crown, the crown
9342: 4486: // OWNS the roof: the five legacy civic functions that each float their own
9343: 4487: // pale cap/lantern/crown decal over the same roof plane must stand down, or
9344: 4488: // they average into a milky fog that erases the silhouette. Ground-level
9345: 4489: // richness (plinth, entry, columns, glass) stays untouched.
9346: 4490: function hasHeroTieredCrown(building: CityWorldBuilding): boolean {
9347: 4491:   return building.objectKit?.civicGeometry?.focusTarget === "eastvale_core";
9348: 4492: }

9350: 4494: function drawTieredMassing(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
9351: 4495:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
9352: 4496:   const isAnchor = family === "civic_landmark" || family === "venue_anchor" || family === "transit_anchor";

9413: 4557: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette Ã¢â‚¬â€ a recessed, glazed ground-floor band with a canopy lip

9701: 4845: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette Ã¢â‚¬â€ a raised parapet wall around a flat roof edge. This is
9702: 4846: // 0.75C-3 close-zoom material: coarse roof seams and cells stay clipped to the
9703: 4847: // roof diamond and draw only behind parapets/authored roof profiles.
9704: 4848: function drawRoofMaterialTexture(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
9705: 4849:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
9706: 4850:   if (footprintWidth < 28 || footprintDepth < 16) return;
9707: 4851:   const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
9708: 4852:   const material = new Graphics();
9709: 4853:   const courseCount = Math.max(3, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Math.min(footprintWidth, footprintDepth) / 9)));
9710: 4854:   const seamColor = shadeColor(roofColor, -18);
9711: 4855:   const capColor = shadeColor(roofColor, 18);
9712: 4856: 
9713: 4857:   for (let course = 1; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
9714: 4858:     const seed = materialTextureSeed(building.id, `roof-${roofShape}`, course);
9715: 4859:     const t = course / courseCount;
9716: 4860:     const start = roofMaterialPoint(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, 0.12, t);
9717: 4861:     const end = roofMaterialPoint(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, 0.88, t);
9718: 4862:     material.moveTo(start.x, start.y).lineTo(end.x, end.y);
9719: 4863: 
9720: 4864:     if (seed % 3 !== 0) continue;
9721: 4865:     const u0 = 0.18 + ((Math.floor(seed / 11) % 4) * 0.14);
9722: 4866:     const u1 = Math.min(0.82, u0 + 0.16);
9723: 4867:     const t0 = Math.max(0.08, t - 0.055);
9724: 4868:     const t1 = Math.min(0.92, t + 0.055);
9725: 4869:     material
9726: 4870:       .poly(roofMaterialQuadPoints(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, u0, t0, u1, t1), true)
9727: 4871:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, materialTextureDelta(seed)), alpha: 0.12 });
9728: 4872:   }
9729: 4873:   material.stroke({ color: seamColor, alpha: roofShape === "flat" ? 0.2 : 0.16, width: 1, cap: "butt", join: "round" });
9730: 4874: 
9731: 4875:   if (roofShape === "gable" || roofShape === "hip") {
9732: 4876:     const caps = 2 + (materialTextureSeed(building.id, "roof-ridge", 0) % 3);
9733: 4877:     for (let cap = 0; cap < caps; cap += 1) {
9734: 4878:       const seed = materialTextureSeed(building.id, "roof-ridge", cap);
9735: 4879:       const u = 0.34 + (cap / Math.max(1, caps - 1)) * 0.32;
9736: 4880:       const t = 0.42 + (seed % 3) * 0.035;
9737: 4881:       const center = roofMaterialPoint(top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, u, t);
9738: 4882:       material
9739: 4883:         .moveTo(center.x - 3.2, center.y - 1.2)
9740: 4884:         .lineTo(center.x + 3.2, center.y + 1.2);
9741: 4885:     }
9742: 4886:     material.stroke({ color: capColor, alpha: 0.22, width: 1.4, cap: "butt", join: "round" });
9743: 4887:   }
9744: 4888: 
9745: 4889:   layer.addChild(material);
9746: 4890: }

9748: 4892: function roofMaterialPoint(top: ProjectedPoint, width: number, depth: number, u: number, t: number): ProjectedPoint {
9749: 4893:   const halfW = width / 2;
9750: 4894:   const halfD = depth / 2;
9751: 4895:   const clampedT = clamp(t, 0, 1);
9752: 4896:   const span = halfW * (1 - Math.abs(clampedT * 2 - 1));
9753: 4897:   return {
9754: 4898:     x: top.x + (clamp(u, 0, 1) * 2 - 1) * span,
9755: 4899:     y: top.y - halfD + depth * clampedT,
9756: 4900:   };
9757: 4901: }

9759: 4903: function roofMaterialQuadPoints(top: ProjectedPoint, width: number, depth: number, u0: number, t0: number, u1: number, t1: number): number[] {
9760: 4904:   const a = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u0, t0);
9761: 4905:   const b = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u1, t0);
9762: 4906:   const c = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u1, t1);
9763: 4907:   const d = roofMaterialPoint(top, width, depth, u0, t1);
9764: 4908:   return [a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y, d.x, d.y];
9765: 4909: }

9767: 4911: // 0.53E Hero Silhouette - a raised parapet wall around a flat roof edge. This is
9768: 4912: // the single biggest "box -> building" cue: the roof stops reading as a flush
9769: 4913: // lid and starts reading as a real rooftop bounded by a low wall.
9770: 4914: function drawParapetCap(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, roofShape: CityWorldBuilding["roofShape"]) {
9771: 4915:   if (roofShape !== "flat" && roofShape !== "sawtooth") return;
9772: 4916:   const family = building.visualGrammar?.objectFamily;
9773: 4917:   const eligible =
9774: 4918:     family === "commerce_strip" || family === "civic_landmark" || family === "lowrise_cluster" ||
9775: 4919:     family === "service_block" || family === "venue_anchor" || family === "transit_anchor";
9776: 4920:   if (!eligible) return;
9777: 4921: 
9778: 4922:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
9779: 4923:   const halfW = footprintWidth / 2;
9780: 4924:   const halfD = footprintDepth / 2;
9781: 4925:   const lift = Math.max(3.2, Math.min(footprintWidth * 0.05, 6.5));
9782: 4926:   // Perimeter diamond corners of the roof top.
9783: 4927:   const left = { x: top.x - halfW, y: top.y };
9784: 4928:   const front = { x: top.x, y: top.y + halfD };
9785: 4929:   const right = { x: top.x + halfW, y: top.y };
9786: 4930: 
9787: 4931:   // Two lit-vs-shade parapet wall faces standing up from the front edges.
9788: 4932:   const litFace = new Graphics()
9789: 4933:     .poly([left.x, left.y, front.x, front.y, front.x, front.y - lift, left.x, left.y - lift], true)
9790: 4934:     .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(shadeColor(roofColor, -6), "sun"), alpha: 0.9 });
9791: 4935:   const shadeFace = new Graphics()
9792: 4936:     .poly([front.x, front.y, right.x, right.y, right.x, right.y - lift, front.x, front.y - lift], true)
9793: 4937:     .fill({ color: buildingFaceColor(shadeColor(roofColor, -6), "shade"), alpha: 0.92 });
9794: 4938:   // Bright coping line along the top of the parapet + a warm sunlit front corner.
9795: 4939:   const coping = new Graphics()
9796: 4940:     .moveTo(left.x, left.y - lift)
9797: 4941:     .lineTo(front.x, front.y - lift)
9798: 4942:     .lineTo(right.x, right.y - lift);
9799: 4943:   coping.stroke({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 40), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.18), alpha: 0.85, width: 1.4, cap: "round", join: "round" });
9800: 4944:   layer.addChild(litFace, shadeFace, coping);
9801: 4945: }

9803: 4947: function drawAuthoredRoofProfile(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
9804: 4948:   const profile = building.visualGrammar?.roofProfile;
9805: 4949:   if (!profile) return;
9806: 4950:   const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor } = geometry;
9807: 4951: 
9808: 4952:   if (profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" || profile === "cool_clay_tile" || profile === "sage_tile") {
9809: 4953:     // 0.53E item B Ã¢â‚¬â€ clay reads warm and COURSED: a stronger tile tint plus
9810: 4954:     // eave-parallel course lines so tile separates from metal (smooth/cool)
9811: 4955:     // and membrane (flat/dark) at a glance.
9812: 4956:     const tileTint = profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 0xc4764e : profile === "cool_clay_tile" ? 0x7f9aa8 : 0x8ba372;
9813: 4957:     // Tile identity = tint + ridge barrel caps. The old chevron course strokes
9814: 4958:     // stacked with the gable ridge/eave linework into roof scribble.
9815: 4959:     const tint = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.94, footprintDepth * 0.86), tileTint, profile === "sage_tile" ? 0.2 : 0.18, tileTint, 0);
9816: 4960:     const ridgeStart = { x: top.x - footprintWidth * 0.24, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.13 };
9817: 4961:     const ridgeEnd = { x: top.x + footprintWidth * 0.24, y: top.y + footprintDepth * 0.13 };
9818: 4962:     const barrelCaps = new Graphics();
9819: 4963:     const capCount = profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 5 : 4;
9820: 4964:     for (let cap = 0; cap < capCount; cap += 1) {
9821: 4965:       const t = capCount > 1 ? cap / (capCount - 1) : 0.5;
9822: 4966:       const x = ridgeStart.x + (ridgeEnd.x - ridgeStart.x) * t;
9823: 4967:       const y = ridgeStart.y + (ridgeEnd.y - ridgeStart.y) * t;
9824: 4968:       barrelCaps.moveTo(x, y - 1.8).lineTo(x, y + 1.8);
9825: 4969:     }
9826: 4970:     barrelCaps.stroke({
9827: 4971:       color: shadeColor(roofColor, profile === "cool_clay_tile" ? 34 : 28),
9828: 4972:       alpha: profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 0.5 : 0.4,
9829: 4973:       width: profile === "terracotta_barrel_tile" ? 1.7 : 1.3,
9830: 4974:       cap: "round",
9831: 4975:     });
9832: 4976:     layer.addChild(tint, barrelCaps);
9833: 4977:     return;
9834: 4978:   }
9835: 4979: 
9836: 4980:   if (profile === "flat_parapet_cap") {
9837: 4981:     // 0.53E item B Ã¢â‚¬â€ the parapet (drawParapetCap) and the roof deck must read
9838: 4982:     // as ONE surface: a recessed membrane field sits inside the parapet line,
9839: 4983:     // darker than the coping, with gravel flecks on the membrane. The old
9840: 4984:     // bright cap ring competed with the parapet coping and made two decals.
9841: 4985:     const membrane = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.84, footprintDepth * 0.76), shadeColor(roofColor, -14), 0.32, shadeColor(roofColor, -30), 0.24);
9842: 4986:     const gravelFlecks = new Graphics()
9843: 4987:       .circle(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.16, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.04, 1.1)
9844: 4988:       .circle(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.06, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.1, 1)
9845: 4989:       .circle(top.x + footprintWidth * 0.2, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08, 1.1)
9846: 4990:       .fill({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, 22), alpha: 0.34 });
9847: 4991:     layer.addChild(membrane, gravelFlecks);
9848: 4992:     return;
9849: 4993:   }
9850: 4994: 
9851: 4995:   if (profile === "blue_metal_utility") {
9852: 4996:     // 0.53E item B Ã¢â‚¬â€ metal reads SMOOTH and COOL: a cool panel field under
9853: 4997:     // crisper standing seams and a long specular streak. No courses, no warmth.
9854: 4998:     const panelField = polygon(diamondPoints(top, footprintWidth * 0.9, footprintDepth * 0.82), mixColor(roofColor, SUN_COOL_TINT, 0.24), 0.16, roofColor, 0);

9859: 5003:         .moveTo(top.x + offset - footprintWidth * 0.09, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.2)
9860: 5004:         .lineTo(top.x + offset + footprintWidth * 0.09, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.2);
9861: 5005:     }
9862: 5006:     // Parallel seams only. The old counter-diagonal sheen streak crossed the

9864: 5008:     // field + quiet seams.
9865: 5009:     seams.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -30), alpha: 0.22, width: 1, cap: "round" });
9866: 5010:     layer.addChild(panelField, seams);

9870: 5014:   if (profile === "civic_glass_cap") {

9872: 5016:     // mullion cross and a bright specular so it is unmistakable next to clay

9874: 5018:     const glassField = polygon(diamondPoints({ x: top.x, y: top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04 }, footprintWidth * 0.62, footprintDepth * 0.44), 0xbfe4ee, 0.3, 0x4e8298, 0.2);

9876: 5020:       .moveTo(top.x - footprintWidth * 0.31, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.04)

9878: 5022:       .moveTo(top.x, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.26)

9885: 5029:     layer.addChild(glassField, mullions, specular);
9886: 5030:   }

10904: 6048: type DraftVoxelGrammarFamily =
10905: 6049:   | "large_venue_hall"
10906: 6050:   | "transit_hub"
10907: 6051:   | "stadium_bowl"
10908: 6052:   | "mixed_use_edge"
10909: 6053:   | "commercial_edge"
10910: 6054:   | "airport_logistics_edge"
10911: 6055:   | "civic_core"
10912: 6056:   | "residential_variety"
10913: 6057:   | "generic_draft";

10915: 6059: function draftVoxelGrammarFamily(id: string): DraftVoxelGrammarFamily {
10916: 6060:   if (id.includes("anaheim-convention-center")) return "large_venue_hall";
10917: 6061:   if (id.includes("artic-transit-center")) return "transit_hub";
10918: 6062:   if (id.includes("angel-stadium")) return "stadium_bowl";
10919: 6063:   if (id.includes("platinum-triangle")) return "mixed_use_edge";
10920: 6064:   if (id.includes("ontario-international-airport")) return "airport_logistics_edge";
10921: 6065:   if (id.includes("ontario-mills") || id.includes("downtown-service")) return "commercial_edge";
10922: 6066:   if (id.includes("ontario-civic") || id.includes("downtown-anaheim-community")) return "civic_core";
10923: 6067:   if (id.includes("ontario-inland-residential")) return "residential_variety";
10924: 6068:   return "generic_draft";
10925: 6069: }

10927: 6071: function drawDraftVoxelGrammarSystem(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding) {
10928: 6072:   const family = draftVoxelGrammarFamily(building.id);
10929: 6073:   if (family === "generic_draft") return;
10930: 6074: 
10931: 6075:   drawDraftContactGrammar(layer, geometry, family);
10932: 6076: 
10933: 6077:   if (family === "large_venue_hall") drawLargeVenueHallGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10934: 6078:   if (family === "transit_hub") drawTransitHubGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10935: 6079:   if (family === "stadium_bowl") drawStadiumBowlGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10936: 6080:   if (family === "mixed_use_edge") drawMixedUseEdgeGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10937: 6081:   if (family === "commercial_edge") drawCommercialEdgeGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10938: 6082:   if (family === "airport_logistics_edge") drawAirportLogisticsGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10939: 6083:   if (family === "civic_core") drawCivicCoreDraftGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10940: 6084:   if (family === "residential_variety") drawResidentialVarietyGrammar(layer, geometry, building);
10941: 6085: }

10950: 6094:     family === "stadium_bowl" ? 0.22 : 0.28,
10951: 6095:     0x6d5e43,

11455: 6599:   const color = colorToNumber(actor.color);
11456: 6600:   let graphic: Graphics;
11457: 6601: 
11458: 6602:   if (actor.kind === "car") {
11459: 6603:     const first = actor.path[0] ?? actor.position;
11460: 6604:     const second = actor.path[1] ?? first;
11461: 6605:     graphic = drawSmallCarGraphic(actorPoint, actorBase, Math.abs(second.x - first.x) >= Math.abs(second.y - first.y) ? "east-west" : "north-south", {
11462: 6606:       windowColor: highlight,
11463: 6607:       lightColor: accent,
11464: 6608:       outlineColor: shade,
11465: 6609:     });
11466: 6610:   } else {
11467: 6611:     graphic = new Graphics()
11468: 6612:       .ellipse(actorPoint.x, actorPoint.y - 1, 5, 2)
11469: 6613:       .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.18 })
11470: 6614:       .circle(actorPoint.x, actorPoint.y - 15, 4.4)
11471: 6615:       .fill({ color, alpha: 0.94 })
11472: 6616:       .roundRect(actorPoint.x - 2.6, actorPoint.y - 12, 5.2, 9, 2)
11473: 6617:       .fill({ color: shade, alpha: 0.66 })
11474: 6618:       .moveTo(actorPoint.x - 1, actorPoint.y - 3)
11475: 6619:       .lineTo(actorPoint.x - 4, actorPoint.y + 2)
11476: 6620:       .moveTo(actorPoint.x + 1, actorPoint.y - 3)
11477: 6621:       .lineTo(actorPoint.x + 4, actorPoint.y + 1)
11478: 6622:       .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.64, width: 1.5, cap: "round" });
11479: 6623:   }
11480: 6624: 
11481: 6625:   // 0.67H Ã¢â‚¬â€ actors are ambience, not focal objects.
11482: 6626:   graphic.alpha = 0.8 * calm;
11483: 6627: 
11484: 6628:   animated.push({
11485: 6629:     target: graphic,
11486: 6630:     kind: actor.kind,
11487: 6631:     path: actor.path,
11488: 6632:     speed: actor.speed,
11489: 6633:     phase: actor.phase,
11490: 6634:     baseAlpha: 0.8 * calm,
11491: 6635:     origin: point,
11492: 6636:   });
11493: 6637:   layer.addChild(graphic);
11494: 6638: }

11496: 6640: function drawSmallCarGraphic(
11497: 6641:   point: ProjectedPoint,
11498: 6642:   color: number,
11499: 6643:   orientation: "east-west" | "north-south",
11500: 6644:   details: { windowColor?: number; lightColor?: number; outlineColor?: number } = {},
11501: 6645: ): Graphics {
11502: 6646:   const wide = orientation === "east-west";
11503: 6647:   const bodyWidth = wide ? 23 : 15;
11504: 6648:   const bodyHeight = wide ? 12 : 18;
11505: 6649:   const hoodOffset = wide ? 7 : 4;
11506: 6650:   const outlineColor = details.outlineColor ?? 0x26332c;
11507: 6651:   const windowColor = details.windowColor ?? 0xf5fbff;
11508: 6652:   const lightColor = details.lightColor ?? 0xfff0a8;
11509: 6653:   const car = new Graphics()
11510: 6654:     .ellipse(point.x, point.y - 1, bodyWidth * 0.5, bodyHeight * 0.28)
11511: 6655:     .fill({ color: 0x23342e, alpha: 0.16 })
11512: 6656:     .roundRect(point.x - bodyWidth / 2, point.y - bodyHeight - 1, bodyWidth, bodyHeight, 4)
11513: 6657:     .fill({ color, alpha: 0.97 })
11514: 6658:     .stroke({ color: outlineColor, alpha: 0.68, width: 1.3 })
11515: 6659:     .roundRect(point.x - bodyWidth * 0.2, point.y - bodyHeight - 4, bodyWidth * 0.4, 6, 2)
11516: 6660:     .fill({ color: windowColor, alpha: 0.86 })
11517: 6661:     .circle(point.x - hoodOffset, point.y - 2, 2)
11518: 6662:     .circle(point.x + hoodOffset, point.y - 2, 2)
11519: 6663:     .fill({ color: 0x222826, alpha: 0.72 });
11520: 6664: 
11521: 6665:   if (wide) {
11522: 6666:     car
11523: 6667:       .rect(point.x - bodyWidth * 0.48, point.y - bodyHeight * 0.58, 3, 3)
11524: 6668:       .rect(point.x + bodyWidth * 0.36, point.y - bodyHeight * 0.58, 3, 3)
11525: 6669:       .fill({ color: lightColor, alpha: 0.86 });
11526: 6670:   } else {
11527: 6671:     car
11528: 6672:       .rect(point.x - 4, point.y - bodyHeight - 1, 8, 3)
11529: 6673:       .fill({ color: lightColor, alpha: 0.82 });
11530: 6674:   }
11531: 6675: 
11532: 6676:   return car;
11533: 6677: }

11535: 6679: function drawPlaceMarker(
11536: 6680:   layers: LayerMap,
11537: 6681:   place: CityWorldPlace,
11538: 6682:   onSelectPlace: (placeId: string) => void,
11539: 6683:   onHoverPlace: (placeId: string | undefined) => void,
11540: 6684: ) {
11541: 6685:   // Neutral, static marker only: emphasis rings + their pulse animation live
11542: 6686:   // in the focus overlay, so hover/selection never rebuilds the base scene
11543: 6687:   // and a scene with no focus has no perpetual marker animations.
11544: 6688:   // 0.67H marker quieting Ã¢â‚¬â€ the ring is a ground-contact indicator, not a
11545: 6689:   // glow: small, warm-neutral, held near the shadow floor.
11546: 6690:   const point = project(place.anchor);
11547: 6691:   const ring = new Graphics()
11548: 6692:     .ellipse(point.x, point.y - 4, 16, 16 * 0.48)
11549: 6693:     .fill({ color: 0xf3ecd8, alpha: 0.03 })
11550: 6694:     .stroke({ color: 0x33443b, alpha: 0.08, width: 1.2 });
11551: 6695:   // The ring is ground furniture: it lives under shadows and buildings so it
11552: 6696:   // can never draw across a wall when the anchor sits inside a structure.
11553: 6697:   layers.padLayer.addChild(ring);
11554: 6698: 
11555: 6699:   const hit = new Graphics().circle(point.x, point.y - 12, place.hitRadius * 13).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.001 });
11556: 6700:   hit.eventMode = "static";
11557: 6701:   hit.cursor = "pointer";
11558: 6702:   hit.on("pointertap", () => onSelectPlace(place.id));
11559: 6703:   hit.on("pointerover", () => onHoverPlace(place.id));
11560: 6704:   hit.on("pointerout", () => onHoverPlace(undefined));
11561: 6705:   layers.markerLayer.addChild(hit);
11562: 6706: }
