11564: 6708: type FocusMode = "selected" | "hovered";
11565: 6709: 
11566: 6710: // Redraws ONLY the focus overlay: emphasized ring (with the pulse animation),
11567: 6711: // stroke-only silhouettes of the place's anchored buildings, and the
11568: 6712: // emphasized label. A hover change costs ~4-10 Graphics instead of a full
11569: 6713: // scene teardown.
11570: 6714: function drawFocusOverlay(
11571: 6715:   layer: Container,
11572: 6716:   place: CityWorldPlace,
11573: 6717:   focus: FocusIndex,
11574: 6718:   mode: FocusMode,
11575: 6719:   animated: AnimatedTarget[],
11576: 6720: ) {
11577: 6721:   // 0.67H Ã¢â‚¬â€ selection is a warm contact accent, not a white debug glow: quiet
11578: 6722:   // warm ring near the shadow floor, warm-toned silhouette strokes.
11579: 6723:   const point = project(place.anchor);
11580: 6724:   const selected = mode === "selected";
11581: 6725:   const landmarkFocus = selected && place.kind === "landmark";
11582: 6726:   const markerPoint = landmarkFocus ? { x: point.x, y: point.y + 20 } : point;
11583: 6727:   const radius = selected ? (landmarkFocus ? 18 : 22) : 20;
11584: 6728:   const ring = new Graphics()
11585: 6729:     .ellipse(markerPoint.x, markerPoint.y - 4, radius, radius * 0.48)
11586: 6730:     .fill({ color: selected ? 0xe9d9ac : 0xf3ecd8, alpha: selected ? 0.12 : 0.09 })
11587: 6731:     .stroke({ color: selected ? 0xb99c5f : 0xcdbf9c, alpha: 0.44, width: selected ? 1.4 : 1.2 });
11588: 6732:   animated.push({ target: ring, kind: "pulse", path: [], speed: 0.02, phase: place.activity, baseAlpha: 0.32, origin: markerPoint });
11589: 6733:   layer.addChild(ring);
11590: 6734: 
11591: 6735:   const outlineColor = selected ? 0xc2a05e : 0xcdb98a;
11592: 6736:   for (const building of focus.buildingsByPlaceId.get(place.id) ?? []) {
11593: 6737:     const bottom = project(building.position);
11594: 6738:     const top = project({ x: building.position.x, y: building.position.y, z: (building.position.z ?? 0) + building.height });
11595: 6739:     const halfW = (building.width * TILE_WIDTH) / 2;
11596: 6740:     const halfD = (building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT) / 2;
11597: 6741:     const silhouette = new Graphics()
11598: 6742:       .poly(
11599: 6743:         [
11600: 6744:           top.x - halfW, top.y,
11601: 6745:           top.x, top.y - halfD,
11602: 6746:           top.x + halfW, top.y,
11603: 6747:           bottom.x + halfW, bottom.y,
11604: 6748:           bottom.x, bottom.y + halfD,
11605: 6749:           bottom.x - halfW, bottom.y,
11606: 6750:         ],
11607: 6751:         true,
11608: 6752:       )
11609: 6753:       .stroke({ color: outlineColor, alpha: selected ? 0.5 : 0.4, width: selected ? 1.6 : 1.3, join: "round" });
11610: 6754:     const roofEdge = new Graphics()
11611: 6755:       .poly(diamondPoints(top, building.width * TILE_WIDTH, building.depth * TILE_HEIGHT), true)
11612: 6756:       .stroke({ color: outlineColor, alpha: selected ? 0.36 : 0.28, width: 1.1 });
11613: 6757:     layer.addChild(silhouette, roofEdge);
11614: 6758:   }
11615: 6759: 
11616: 6760:   drawFocusPlaceLabel(layer, place, mode, focus.crownLift.get(place.id));
11617: 6761: }

11619: 6763: function drawFocusPlaceLabel(layer: Container, place: CityWorldPlace, mode: FocusMode, crownLift?: number) {
11620: 6764:   const point = project(place.anchor);
11621: 6765:   const selected = mode === "selected";
11622: 6766:   const landmarkFocus = selected && place.kind === "landmark";
11623: 6767:   // 0.67H Ã¢â‚¬â€ focus labels are smaller and quieter; the selected landmark label
11624: 6768:   // slides off the roof axis and clears the crown with a small margin.
11625: 6769:   const text = new Text({
11626: 6770:     text: place.label,
11627: 6771:     style: {
11628: 6772:       fill: 0x2c3a33,
11629: 6773:       fontFamily: "Arial",
11630: 6774:       fontSize: landmarkFocus ? 10 : 11,
11631: 6775:       fontWeight: "700",
11632: 6776:       stroke: { color: 0xfff8e7, width: 3 },
11633: 6777:     },
11634: 6778:   });
11635: 6779:   text.anchor.set(0.5);
11636: 6780:   const baseLift = landmarkFocus ? 70 : 52;
11637: 6781:   text.position.set(point.x + (landmarkFocus ? -44 : 0), point.y - Math.max(baseLift, (crownLift ?? 0) + 6));
11638: 6782:   const paddingX = landmarkFocus ? 6 : 5;
11639: 6783:   const paddingY = landmarkFocus ? 2.5 : 3;
11640: 6784:   const backing = new Graphics()
11641: 6785:     .roundRect(
11642: 6786:       text.position.x - text.width / 2 - paddingX,
11643: 6787:       text.position.y - text.height / 2 - paddingY,
11644: 6788:       text.width + paddingX * 2,
11645: 6789:       text.height + paddingY * 2,
11646: 6790:       4,
11647: 6791:     )
11648: 6792:     .fill({ color: 0xfff7df, alpha: 0.5 })
11649: 6793:     .stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.12, width: 1 });
11650: 6794:   layer.addChild(backing, text);
11651: 6795: }

11653: 6797: function drawPin(layer: Container, pin: CityWorldPin, atlas: CityWorldAtlasResolver) {
11654: 6798:   const point = project(pin.anchor);
11655: 6799:   const pinPoint = offsetPinPoint(point, pin);
11656: 6800:   const asset = atlas.resolveAsset(pin.spriteKey, pin.paletteKey, "marker");
11657: 6801:   // 0.67H Ã¢â‚¬â€ pins on the focal landmark shrink so the sticker never owns the
11658: 6802:   // silhouette it annotates.
11659: 6803:   const focalPin = pin.placeId === "place-eastvale-core";
11660: 6804:   if (asset.mode === "sprite") {
11661: 6805:     const sprite = new Sprite(asset.texture);
11662: 6806:     sprite.anchor.set(asset.anchor.x, asset.anchor.y);
11663: 6807:     sprite.scale.set(asset.scale * (focalPin ? 0.8 : 1));
11664: 6808:     sprite.position.set(pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y + 1);
11665: 6809:     sprite.label = `sprite-${pin.id}`;
11666: 6810:     layer.addChild(sprite);
11667: 6811:     return;
11668: 6812:   }
11669: 6813:   const color = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.base);
11670: 6814:   const shade = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.shade);
11671: 6815:   const highlight = colorToNumber(asset.palette.colors.highlight);
11672: 6816:   const badge = new Graphics()
11673: 6817:     .poly([pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y - 2, pinPoint.x - 5, pinPoint.y - 8, pinPoint.x + 5, pinPoint.y - 8], true)
11674: 6818:     .fill({ color: shade, alpha: 0.86 })
11675: 6819:     .circle(pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y - 15, 9)
11676: 6820:     .fill({ color, alpha: 0.98 })
11677: 6821:     .circle(pinPoint.x - 3, pinPoint.y - 18.5, 2)
11678: 6822:     .fill({ color: highlight, alpha: 0.34 })
11679: 6823:     .stroke({ color: shade, alpha: 0.7, width: 1.5 });
11680: 6824:   const label = new Text({
11681: 6825:     text: pin.kind === "note" ? "N" : stickerGlyph(pin.kind),
11682: 6826:     style: { fill: shade, fontFamily: "Arial", fontSize: 9, fontWeight: "900" },
11683: 6827:   });
11684: 6828:   label.anchor.set(0.5);
11685: 6829:   label.position.set(pinPoint.x, pinPoint.y - 15);
11686: 6830:   layer.addChild(badge, label);
11687: 6831: }

11689: 6833: function offsetPinPoint(point: ProjectedPoint, pin: CityWorldPin): ProjectedPoint {
11690: 6834:   if (pin.placeId !== "place-eastvale-core") return point;
11691: 6835: 
11692: 6836:   // 0.67H Ã¢â‚¬â€ focal-landmark pins slide off the facade toward the plinth apron.
11693: 6837:   if (pin.kind === "note") return { x: point.x + 30, y: point.y + 14 };
11694: 6838:   if (pin.kind === "favorite") return { x: point.x - 30, y: point.y + 16 };
11695: 6839:   return { x: point.x + 6, y: point.y + 26 };
11696: 6840: }

11698: 6842: // 0.56E Ã¢â‚¬â€ a place label must never erase the architecture it names: the lift
11699: 6843: // is the max of the legacy ground offset and the tallest anchored structure's
11700: 6844: // silhouette (roof + crown allowance), clamped so labels stay attached.
11701: 6845: function placeCrownLiftMap(buildings: CityWorldBuilding[]): Map<string, number> {
11702: 6846:   const lift = new Map<string, number>();
11703: 6847:   for (const building of buildings) {
11704: 6848:     if (!building.placeId) continue;
11705: 6849:     const crownAllowance = hasHeroTieredCrown(building) ? 52 : building.roofShape === "tower" ? 30 : 14;
11706: 6850:     const clearance = Math.min(building.height * TILE_DEPTH + crownAllowance, 104);
11707: 6851:     if (clearance > (lift.get(building.placeId) ?? 0)) lift.set(building.placeId, clearance);
11708: 6852:   }
11709: 6853:   return lift;
11710: 6854: }

11712: 6856: function drawPlaceLabel(layer: Container, place: CityWorldPlace, ambientLabelIds: ReadonlySet<string>, crownLift?: number) {
11713: 6857:   // Neutral base label only; the focus overlay draws the emphasized variant
11714: 6858:   // and hides this one (matched by container label) while the place is focused.
11715: 6859:   // 0.67H Ã¢â‚¬â€ ambient labels are a hard allowance, and every label is smaller
11716: 6860:   // and quieter so building crowns own the frame.
11717: 6861:   if (!ambientLabelIds.has(place.id)) return;
11718: 6862: 
11719: 6863:   const point = project(place.anchor);
11720: 6864:   const text = new Text({
11721: 6865:     text: place.label,
11722: 6866:     style: {
11723: 6867:       fill: 0x2c3a33,
11724: 6868:       fontFamily: "Arial",
11725: 6869:       fontSize: 10,
11726: 6870:       fontWeight: "700",
11727: 6871:       stroke: { color: 0xfff8e7, width: 3 },
11728: 6872:     },
11729: 6873:   });
11730: 6874:   text.anchor.set(0.5);
11731: 6875:   text.position.set(point.x, point.y - Math.max(44, (crownLift ?? 0) + 6));
11732: 6876:   const backing = new Graphics()
11733: 6877:     .roundRect(
11734: 6878:       text.position.x - text.width / 2 - 5,
11735: 6879:       text.position.y - text.height / 2 - 3,
11736: 6880:       text.width + 10,
11737: 6881:       text.height + 6,
11738: 6882:       4,
11739: 6883:     )
11740: 6884:     .fill({ color: 0xfff7df, alpha: 0.34 })
11741: 6885:     .stroke({ color: 0x26332c, alpha: 0.08, width: 1 });
11742: 6886:   const group = new Container();
11743: 6887:   group.label = `place-label-${place.id}`;
11744: 6888:   group.addChild(backing, text);
11745: 6889:   layer.addChild(group);
11746: 6890: }

11748: 6892: function animateTargets(targets: AnimatedTarget[], delta: number) {
11749: 6893:   const elapsed = performance.now() / 1000;
11750: 6894:   for (const item of targets) {
11751: 6895:     if (item.path.length > 1) {
11752: 6896:       const ratio = (elapsed * item.speed + item.phase) % 1;
11753: 6897:       const position = pointOnPath(item.path, ratio);
11754: 6898:       const point = project(position);
11755: 6899:       item.target.position.set(point.x - item.origin.x, point.y - item.origin.y);
11756: 6900:     }
11757: 6901: 
11758: 6902:     if (item.kind === "water") {
11759: 6903:       item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed * 2.2 + item.phase * 8) * 0.16;
11760: 6904:     } else if (item.kind === "cloud") {
11761: 6905:       item.target.x += delta * item.speed * 8;
11762: 6906:       item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed + item.phase * 4) * 0.06;
11763: 6907:     } else if (item.kind === "walker") {
11764: 6908:       item.target.y += Math.sin(elapsed * 4 + item.phase * 5) * 0.05;
11765: 6909:     } else if (item.kind === "pulse") {
11766: 6910:       item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed * 2 + item.phase * 4) * 0.05;
11767: 6911:     }
11768: 6912:   }
11769: 6913: }
11770: 6914: 
11771: 6915: function pointOnPath(path: CityWorldPoint[], ratio: number): CityWorldPoint {
11772: 6916:   if (path.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
11773: 6917:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
11774: 6918: 
11775: 6919:   const scaled = ratio * path.length;
11776: 6920:   const index = Math.floor(scaled) % path.length;
11777: 6921:   const nextIndex = (index + 1) % path.length;
11778: 6922:   const local = scaled - Math.floor(scaled);
11779: 6923:   const start = path[index] ?? path[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
11780: 6924:   const end = path[nextIndex] ?? start;
11781: 6925:   return {
11782: 6926:     x: start.x + (end.x - start.x) * local,
11783: 6927:     y: start.y + (end.y - start.y) * local,
11784: 6928:     z: start.z + (end.z - start.z) * local,
11785: 6929:   };
11786: 6930: }
11787: 6931: 
11788: 6932: function project(point: CityWorldPoint): ProjectedPoint {
11789: 6933:   return projectCityWorldPoint(point);
11790: 6934: }
11791: 6935: 
11792: 6936: function diamondPoints(center: ProjectedPoint, width: number, height: number): number[] {
11793: 6937:   return cityWorldDiamondPoints(center, width, height);
11794: 6938: }
11795: 6939: 
11796: 6940: function polygon(points: number[], fill: number, alpha = 1, stroke = 0x26332c, strokeAlpha = 0.42): Graphics {
11797: 6941:   return new Graphics().poly(points, true).fill({ color: fill, alpha }).stroke({ color: stroke, alpha: strokeAlpha, width: 1 });
11798: 6942: }
11799: 6943: 
11800: 6944: // Iso voxel cube: top diamond + lit/shade faces appended into a Graphics.
11801: 6945: // The shared primitive behind the blocky prop kit and cliff courses Ã¢â‚¬â€ props
11802: 6946: // read as stacked cubes (north-star voxel grammar), not vector lollipops.
11803: 6947: function voxelBox(g: Graphics, base: ProjectedPoint, width: number, depth: number, height: number, color: number, alpha = 1): void {
11804: 6948:   const halfW = width / 2;
11805: 6949:   const halfD = depth / 2;
11806: 6950:   const topY = base.y - height;
11807: 6951:   g
11808: 6952:     .moveTo(base.x - halfW, topY)
11809: 6953:     .lineTo(base.x, topY + halfD)
11810: 6954:     .lineTo(base.x, base.y + halfD)
11811: 6955:     .lineTo(base.x - halfW, base.y)
11812: 6956:     .closePath()
11813: 6957:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "sun"), alpha });
11814: 6958:   g
11815: 6959:     .moveTo(base.x + halfW, topY)
11816: 6960:     .lineTo(base.x, topY + halfD)
11817: 6961:     .lineTo(base.x, base.y + halfD)
11818: 6962:     .lineTo(base.x + halfW, base.y)
11819: 6963:     .closePath()
11820: 6964:     .fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "shade"), alpha });
11821: 6965:   g.poly(diamondPoints({ x: base.x, y: topY }, width, depth), true).fill({ color: sunlitColor(color, "top"), alpha });
11822: 6966: }
11823: 6967: 
11824: 6968: // Append a filled/stroked polygon into a SHARED Graphics. Ground layers
11825: 6969: // (terrain, lots, roads) merge thousands of per-item Graphics into a few
11826: 6970: // depth-band / pass Graphics; within one Graphics, path order is z order, so
11827: 6971: // append order must match the old per-object add order.
11828: 6972: function appendPolygon(g: Graphics, points: number[], fill: number, alpha = 1, stroke = 0x26332c, strokeAlpha = 0.42): Graphics {
11829: 6973:   g.poly(points, true).fill({ color: fill, alpha });
11830: 6974:   if (strokeAlpha > 0) g.stroke({ color: stroke, alpha: strokeAlpha, width: 1 });
11831: 6975:   return g;
11832: 6976: }
11833: 6977: 
11834: 6978: function colorToNumber(color: string): number {
11835: 6979:   return Number.parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
11836: 6980: }
11837: 6981: 
11838: 6982: function paletteColor(color: string | undefined, fallback: string): number {

14216:   10: ## The idea, fleshed out
14217:   11: 
14218:   12: **ChatGPT grows a map.** When a conversation touches a place, Atlas opens a
14219:   13: hand-built voxel diorama of that place inline Ã¢â‚¬â€ county-scale, isometric,
14220:   14: explorable. Not a map widget embedded in chat: an **explorable answer**. Ask
14221:   15: about Eastvale and instead of paragraphs you get the town itself Ã¢â‚¬â€ its road
14222:   16: grid, its houses, its river dock Ã¢â‚¬â€ and the conversation keeps going *through*
14223:   17: the map: the model focuses cameras, pins places, drops a scout, previews a
14224:   18: campaign.
14225:   19: 
14226:   20: Three commitments define the product:
14227:   21: 
14228:   22: 1. **Voxel, deliberately.** The diorama look is an honesty device as much as an
14229:   23:    aesthetic. A voxel town never pretends to be satellite truth Ã¢â‚¬â€ it reads as a
14230:   24:    crafted model of a place, which is exactly what it is. It is also memorable,
14231:   25:    cheap to render, and unlike anything else in the directory.
14232:   26: 2. **Native, deliberately.** Atlas behaves like a capability ChatGPT always
14233:   27:    had, not an app that rents space in it. The chrome is ChatGPT's own grammar;
14234:   28:    the map is the only colorful thing on screen.
14235:   29: 3. **Scalable, deliberately.** Riverside/Eastvale is the proof cell of one
14236:   30:    world model that ladders county Ã¢â€ â€™ state Ã¢â€ â€™ country. Curated and generated
14237:   31:    scenes are held to the same bar Ã¢â‚¬â€ the parity gates exist so "generated"
14238:   32:    never becomes a second-class citizen.
14239:   33: 
14240:   34: The engine and the in-ChatGPT quality **are** the product. Everything below is
14241:   35: that sentence, made testable.
14242:   36:

14248:   42: when"** tests (falsifiable, most already verifier-enforced) Ã¢â€ â€™ honest current

14253:   47: ## NS-1 Ã‚Â· The Diorama Ã¢â‚¬â€ every scene reads hand-built
14254:   48: 
14255:   49: **Ideal:** any district, curated or generated, reads as a miniature town
14256:   50: someone assembled by hand, block by block.
14257:   51: 
14258:   52: **Anchor:** `assets/reference/atlas-voxel-town-north-star.png`.
14259:   53: 
14260:   54: **You've hit it when:**
14261:   55: - A cold screenshot of a generated district fails the "which one is curated?"
14262:   56:   test against Eastvale.
14263:   57: - No flat color field survives at any supported zoom: overview reads massing
14264:   58:   and palette; detail zoom reads material (courses, seams, texture).
14265:   59: - Occlusion is always correct Ã¢â‚¬â€ props, buildings, terrain interleave by true
14266:   60:   iso depth at every zoom.
14267:   61: - Residential fabric is dense and varied: continuous small-house streets, no

codex
1. [SEVERITY critical] Canvas map exploration is not accessible by keyboard or screen reader.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:543-544` appends a Pixi canvas; `:1075-1081` exposes only a labeled div.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:724-787` handles pan/tap with pointer events only; `:6699-6704` place hit targets are Pixi Graphics, not tabbable DOM.
Fix: Add a keyboard/screen-reader place navigator tied to the same `onSelectPlace`, plus a real DOM summary of visible places/map state.

2. [SEVERITY high] The save sheet claims `aria-modal` but is not a real modal.
Evidence: `web/src/HostedClawdTray.tsx:38-43` sets `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` only when expanded.
Evidence: `web/src/HostedClawdTray.tsx:22-24` focuses the close button, but there is no focus trap, inert background, or Tab handling; repo probe for `inert|FocusScope|Tab|tabbable` found none.
Fix: Use a real dialog/focus-scope implementation, inert the map chrome while open, restore opener focus on close, and keep Escape handling global to the dialog.

3. [SEVERITY high] Reduced motion is CSS-only; Pixi motion ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Evidence: `web/src/styles.css:199-207` only suppresses CSS animation/transition durations.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:448-477` keeps a rAF animation loop, and `:6892-6911` animates water/cloud/walker/pulse targets without a reduced-motion branch.
Fix: Read `prefers-reduced-motion` in the renderer and disable inertia, pulse, ambient target animation, and animated camera effects when reduced motion is requested.

4. [SEVERITY high] Muted text and status dots fail AA contrast on the actual translucent map chrome.
Evidence: `web/src/styles.css:40-45` defines status colors; `:83-89` sets `--ink-3: #757575`; `:162` makes chrome translucent over the green map.
Evidence: Probe result: `#757575` on blended light panels over map colors is `4.33-4.44:1` (<4.5); yellow status `#e0b84b` is `1.78-1.82:1` (<3).
Fix: Make chrome backgrounds opaque or darken muted/status tokens, and give status dots a high-contrast outline plus adjacent text state.

5. [SEVERITY medium] Async and selection state changes are mostly silent to screen readers.
Evidence: `web/src/App.tsx:456-465` sends the generated-district model request with no pending state or live region.
Evidence: `web/src/App.tsx:644-652` sends the campaign-preview request with no busy/status announcement; selected-place tray updates at `web/src/CityWorldView.tsx:241-255` are not live.
Fix: Add one app-level `role="status"`/`aria-live="polite"` region plus `aria-busy` on affected panels for map selection, generated draft, and preview/save round-trips.
